tei:div.tei:p: rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/༷ ༷ ༷ sha cha ༷ byu ༷༷ rsha ༷༄ga /mkhan chen padma badzra rim byon gyi rnam thar nyung ngu'i ngag gis brjod pa dad pa'i nyin byed 'dren pa'i skya rengs gsar pa/dpag med yon tan kun nas rab rdzogs mtshan dpe'i 'od stong 'bar ba'i sku//'bag med tshangs dbyangs drug cu'i dbyangs ldan zab zhi spros pa bral ba'i gsung //'khrul med ye shes stobs bcu'i bdag nyid ma lus shes bya mkhyen pa'i thugs// mnyam med ston pa shākya'i rgyal po gang zhabs spyi bo'i gtsub/ gis mchod//gzhi grol ga dag chos sku'i ngo bor gdod nas mngon par byang chub cing //nges pa lnga ldan rigs lnga'i zhing du kha sbyor bdun ldan longs spyod rdzogs//

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ ba ba ba ba la ba ba la da — ཿ ༷ ཿ da la ༷ rol rtsal ma 'gag gang 'dul mos ngor sna tshos/sa sprul pa'i skur snang ba//khyab bdag bla ma padma badzras da dung byang chub bar du skyongs//de yang snga 'gyur bstan pa'i spyi gzugs khyab bdag/ mkhan chen padma badzra rtsal zhes/mtshan snyan gyi grags dkar srid na g.yo ba'i mkhas grub kyi skyes bu gang nyid/ gzhi dbyings khyad chos drug ldan rig stong chos sku'i ngo bor gzod ma nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas shing / lhun grub ye shes kyi rol rtsal gang 'dul sgyu 'phrul 5 ba'i sprin du yongs su shar ba las snyigs ma'i dus 'dir gsang chen snga 'gyur ba'i ring lugs 'dzin skyong spel ba la bsam bzhin dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi tshul du sprul pa'i skye phreng ji ltar byon pa'i tshul brjod pa la/ thog mar sku'i skye ba snga ma zur chen chos dbyings rang grol ni/ rab byung bcu pa'i shing 'brug ste spyi lo 1604lor zur gyi rig 'dzin rgyud pa'i ga/dung rabs bar ma chad pa las/ yab rig 'dzin chen po ku mā rā dza'i rnam 'phrul zur chen gzhon nu don grub dang yum mkha' 'gro'i rigs las mtshan ldan yid 'dzin gnyis kyi sras su sku bltams/ drung pa dkon mchog rin chen pa'i sku'i skyebar ngos 'dzin mdzad/ rim gyis yi 2

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ba ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ 0 ༷ ༷ ba ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ pe ༷ ༷༷ la ༷ ༷ ༷ ga ༷ ༷ ge'i 'bri klog dang 'phags yul pa'i yig ris/sa rnams kyang dka' tshegs la ma ltos par thugs su chud/ yab las nyer mkho'i sgrub skor rnams kyang bslabs/ dgung lo dgu par byang pa rig 'dzin ngag gi dbang po dang mjal zhing / zhal nas sku skye bas snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa la phan thog chen po zhig yong zhes lung bstan/lha ris dang rtsis skor rnams dang drag sngags kyi skor 'ga' zhis/ kyang mkhyen par mdzad/ dgung lo bcu gnyis tsam nas snang gsal rin po che ngag dbang ye shes grub pa'i zhabs su bcar te bka' brgyad bde 'dus dang / mkha' 'gro snying thig bka' gter gnyis/bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho/ shar gling zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol sogs kyi dbang dang nyams khrid mthar phyin par gsan/ zhi khro'i dbang bskur ba'i gsang mtshan chos dbyings rang grol du phog /phyag chen lnga ldan dang gcod khrid sogs sku nyams su bstar/ zing pa stag mgor lo gsum phyogs gsum mdzad cing gtso bor rdzogs chen mkha' 'gro snying thig gi ga dag dang lhun grub gnad du bsnun pas chos thams cad kyi rdzun phug bdibs/ rang rig gdod ma'i mgon po'i rang zhal mngon du gyur pa'i rtogs pa brnyes shing 'od gsal du longs sku'i zhing khams nyul ba'i rtsal 'byongs par gyur/ dgung 3

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i g.yo thor bu/ spyo 00 ba ༷ ba ༷ ༷ 0 ༷ 0ba 0 0 ba ba ༷ rsha ba ba ༷ 0 0 0 b.lo bcu bdun par rdo rje 'chang 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi drung du byon te bla ma sku 'das kyi bar la rim gro ba mdzad cing mnyes pa gsum gyis bsnyen/ bla mas thugs dgyes pas rjes su bskyangs nas bka' gter gyi chos tshul rgya mtsho bum pa gang byo'i tshul gyis gnang / ga/tso bor dpal gsang ba snying po'i rgyud rtsa ba dang 'grel ba spar khab/ bod 'grel g.yung ṭīka rnams sbyar ba'i bshad khrid kyi chos thun nyin rer thengs gnyis re bstsal/ zin dka' se ba la zin bris brgyab e chog zhus pas/ rgyang tsam ma song bar zin bris byas na 'jag chen po mi yong bas re zhig nas nged kyis tshod byed gsungs/ gzims chung thog khar skyor sbyang gnang nas shos bu sum cu tsam song nas rje'i bka' bzhin zin bris kyang mdzad pas le'u lnga pa yan chad song / de man chad kyi zin bris 'phro can du lus/ dgung lo nyi shu bzhes pa chu khyi lor dge bsnyen nas bzung bsnyen rdzogs kyi bar tshigs gsum rim can du bsgrub par mdzad/ snying 'grel phyogs bcu mun sel sogs la gzigs rtogs dang / 'dus pa'i 'grel pa sgron gsal la bzhi sbrags kyi bshad pa/ rim lnga gsal sgon// bde mchog sbas don kun gsal/nor bzang dus 'khor spyi don sogs dang / gsang 'dus skyed 4

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ 0 ba ba 0 0 la ༷ ༷ ༷rdzogs sogs kyi bshad pa zhus shing thugs la nges par mdzad/shing bye lor chos grwa chen po dpal gyi rtses dang du dgun chos chen mo'i thog gsang ba snying po'i rgyud kyi bshad pa mdzad pas ston chen tshig la rton pa rnams kyi spobs pa bcom zhing snying po'i bstan pa la bya ba rgya cher mdzad pas gzu bor gnas pa rnams kyis bsngags pa brjod cing byang pa rig 'dzin chen pos legs dar dpyangs/rje pha wang kha pa las kyang klong gsal snying thig gi dbang lung man ngag gi khrid rnams zhib par gsan zhing bsgoms pas nyams rtogs kyi bogs sngar las kyang cher 'thangs/ ste ra ba'i 'phrul 'khor sogs gsar ma phyogs kyi drags sngags kyang mang du gsan/dge 'bri gnyis 'gras che zhing 'bri gung zur pa ratna'i zhabs sogs kyis rā hu la'i las sbyor mdzad pas dga' ldan khri pa mang po steng grib kyis gshegs pa la rje dkon mchog chos 'phel khyab 'jug gi 'jigs pa las grol ba'i srung 'khor kyang mdzad/ naḥthog pa las dgongs 'dus pu ti'i lung dbang dang rgyud dgu bcang thabs bcas pa dang / las byang me tog phreng mdzes sogs kyang gsan/ lhag par bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten te ra sa ya ṇa'i sgrub pa mdzad/ 'di skabs 5

rdzogasachen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/༷ ༷ la ༷ la ༷ mi ༷ ༷ ༷ ba ba ba ཿ ba ༷ rsha ཿ tsam nas rgyal mchog lnga pa chen pos bla mar bkur zhing zil gnon sos/sa chos bka' rnams gsan/ drag sngags kyi skor sogs zhi rgyas dbang drag ri/ phrin las rab 'byams kyi lung phyag khrid thams cad phul ba thugs nyams su bstar/ shar ba/tsang mchod yon gyis dge lugs spyi dang bye brag dge ldan pho brang la sdang zug che bas tsi gum par bde gzar gyi skabs su las sbyor mtha' yas pa mdzad pas/ rgyal dbang lnga pa'i phrin las dus su babs pa dang rje 'di nyid kyi byin rlabs lhag par myur ba'i rten 'brel las dge ldan pho brang gi lung las/ bod khams yongs la khyab pa de byung ste/ /snum zan grong pa'i rkang 'thung 'khrigs pa'i klong / /khe nyen gsher gyis don chen 'grub pa'i zhugs/ /'bar min ma babs las kyi rta gdong mes/ /shar gtsang srid sde'i chu bo skom de mtshar/ /zhes lnga pa chen pos 'ga' zhig gi mngon spyod kyi nus pa mngon du ma gyur par 'os med kyis rje 'di pas bstan pa spyi la sman yon chen por gyur pa ched du brjod par mdzad do/ /gzhan yang phur pa lugs gsum dang bka' brgyad phur gsum/ rdzogs pa chen po klong gsal snying thig sogs kyi nyams khrid rnams gsan pa sku nyams su bstar bas rdzogs pa chen po'i nyams myong ma 'khrul ba thugs rgyud la 'khrungs 6

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ ༷ 0 ༷ — cha la ba na ཿ shing / 'khor 'das re dogs dang bral gdeng 'khrungs so/ /zhes zhal gyis bzhes/ gnas gsar ba mabo/na po bsod nams mchog ldan dang chos kyi dga' ston spel res mdzad/ byang pa rig 'dzin ngag na/ dbang po'i sprul pa'i sku snga 'gyur bstan pa'i nyi ma rig 'dzin padma 'phrin las ngos 'dzin par mdzad cing thub bstan rdo rje brag gi gdan sar bkod nas/ bka' gter gyi chos tshul mtha' dag bstsal zhing bstan pa'i bdag por mnga' gsol/ sku che'i mthar 'gro mgon skye med zhing gi gdan sa 'bri gung thang du bzhugs/ dar lding rig 'dzin chen po 'phrin las lhun grub la snying po'i rgyud kyi bshad pa gnang / tshur yang bka' brgyad sogs dbang lung mang du gsan/ rgya bod hor gsum gyi bla ma skye sprul sogs dam chos don gnyer pa rnams la bka' gter gsar rnying gi rnam par grol ba'i lam gyi dngos po ci rigs par sbyor bar mdzad nas sa bya lor dgung grangs re drug lon pa na ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas padma 'od kyi zhing khams su gshegs so/ /rje 'di nyid la thugs sras slob ma'i tshogs bgrang gis mi longs par bzhugs kyang / gtso bor gyur pa ni rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po ste zhing khams gzhan du gshegs tshe yang ye shes kyi skus rjes su bzung 7

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra gsung thor bu/ la — byed ༷ ༷ — 0 tha ba rka ba bar gsungs shing rnam thar rgyal mchog gi zhal gsung mar/ legs byas 'dis mthus rig rtsal kun tu bzang / /mngon sum rang ngo 'phrod min de srid du//skyobar mgon po khyod kyis dge ba'i bshes//mdzad nas 'bral ba med par rjes 'dzin shog /ces gsungs pa dang / sa//zhan yang gsar phyogs dus 'khor gyi brgyud pa'ang rje 'di nyid nas lnga pa chen po la brgyud tshul rtse pho brang chen mo'i dus 'khor lha khang gi bla brgyud ldebs ris su gsal ba ltar la/ snga 'gyur sgyu 'phrul gsang snying gi brgyud pa'ang rje 'dis gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyi rnam rol banyos ston phrin las lhun grub la spar khab dang g.yung ṭīka gnyis sha'i steng nas bshad brgyud bstsal zhing / de las ba ro dang g.yu sgra'i thug/sa bskyed dus su smin pa rig 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje sku mched kyi bka' drin las rim par brgyud de grub dbang rdzogs chen pa rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas dang mkhan chen padma badzra yab sras nas da lta'i bar brgyud pa'i chu bo zam ma chad par shar nub 'dzam gling gi sa'i khyon kun tu yongs su khyab pa 'di byung ngo / /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i spyi gzugs 7grub pa'i dbang phyug rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang dbang po padma badzra rtsal ni/ bod rab byung bcu 8

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor ci/ 0 — — — ༷ — — ཿ ga ༷ spre gsum pa'i mjug tu mdo khams ru dam ldong nang du gling sprug po ldong gi rus las chad par grags pa'i rkang tsha zhes pa'i rigs su 1srid bzhes/ byis pa'i dus nas dngos med lha 'dre'i 'phrul ga/zugs gzigs shing dam la bzhag pa sogs grub pa'i rtags mtshan lhan skyes su mnga'/ dam pa'i skyes chen du mas zur chen chos dbyings rang grol byu rnam sprul du lung gis bsngags/ sku na ches gzhon pa'i skabs nas grub dbang rdzogs chen dgon du tshogs zhugs mdzad cing / skyes thob kyi mkhyen rab zla dang bral bas sgrub 'phrin cho ga'i phyag len sogs la bslab tsam nyid kyis mkhyen pa sogs thams cad ngo mtshar gyi sa la bkod/ rim par rdzogs chen bzhi pa mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje dang / 'jigs med rgyal ba'i myu gu/ rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas/ seng phrug padma bkra shis sogs mkhas grub skyes chen du ma las mdo sngags rig/ gnas kyi 'chad khrid/ bka' gter yin grol gyi nye brgyud/ man ngag snyan brgyud kyi zhal shes bcas bum pa gang byo'i tshul du gsan bzhes mdzad pas mkhas grub kyi rgyal sa mthon por gshegs/ khyad par kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'i ye shes kyi skus rjes su bzung pas don brgyud rtogs pa'i drod tshad brnyes te 'od gsal 9

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ba la cha 'a sa ༷ 4 4 ༷ la ༷ ཿ 0 spre 0 — gsang ba snying thig gi bka' babs/ sku che'i stod du gangs ljongs mkhas pa'i 'byung gnas rdzogs chen shrī seng chos grwa'i mkhan chen khyab bdag pa chen po'i gser khrir bzhusas te mdo sngags gzhung lugs kyi 'chad khrid spyi dang / rgyud rgyal sgyu 'phrul sa ba'i bshad pa mdzad pas phur tsha'i mkhan po a dkon dang / o rgyan bstan 'dzin nor bu/ 'jam mgon mi pham rnam rgyal/ sdom brtson dkon mchog grags pa sogs rgyud pa zin nges kyi bstan 'dzin skyes chen du ma byung / skyabs rje dam pa gang gi sku tshe'i smad du rdzogs chen padma'i thang du gdan sa'i mthil mdzad de rgyud lung man ngag rgya mtsho'i 'khor lo'i sgyur rgyal nges pa don gyi rdo rje 'chang chen por bzhugs pas/ phyogs kyi slob tshogs nam mkha'i skar tshogs bzhin brdol ba dang / skabs de'i ris med bstan 'dzin chen mo dag ris gtsug rgyan du bsnyen nas so byang sngags kyi sdom rgyun dang /bka' gter smin grol gyi dbang lung / man ngag snying thig gi gdam khrid kun rje 'di las gsan bzhes mdzad pa ste/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i rnam thar du/ me sbrul lor ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul mkhan padma badzra las 'dus mdo'i dbang gsan skabs/ dbang dngos gzhi'i skabs su 10

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ la — ༷ ༷ — la — la ཿ ཿ 0 ༷ ཿ ba — dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi gsal snang brtan po shar/ de nub so ye shes dbang phyug mjal nas 'dus mdo'i smin grol yongs rdzogs kyi nye brgyud thob/ ces dang de bzhin zhe chen rgyal tshab bzhi pas thun min rigs bdag tu bsnyen zhing rab tu byung ba'i mtshan la 'gyur med padma rnam rgyal zhes rje 'dis gsol ba dang / rgyal tshab mchog gi bka' 'bum las mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa padma badzra zhes dang / bla ma rgyang 'bod byin rlabs myur 'jug tu/rab 'byams rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i ye shes kyi spyi gzugs/ /theg gsum lung rtogs bstan pa rin chen kyi bang mdzod/ /mtha' yas skye dgu'i 'dren pa zla med kyi bshes gnyen/ /skyabs kun 'dus zhal padma badzra de mkhyen no/ /mtha' yas shes bya kun mkhyen 'jam dpal ni gzhon nu/ /brtse chen thugs rje'i gter gcig gangs can gyi mgon po/ /nus mthu'i rtsal rdzogs badzra pā bee dang dbyer med/ /bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon padma badzra de mkhyen no/ /phyi ru 'dul khrims rnam dag nyan thos kyi dge sbyong / /nang du byang chub sems 'byong theg chen gyi rgyal sras/ /gsang ba rim gnyis rtsal rdzogs sngags spyod kyi rnal 'byor/ /'jig rten mig gcig padma badzra de mkhyen no/ /chos brgyad zhen pa rang grol bya btang gi rgyal po/ /11

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma brngo'i gsung thor bu/༷ 'a la ba ba ༷ ba la da byu ཿ 0 ga 0ba — na spyo 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng ba rgyang bsring sgrub brtson gyi dbang phyug /snang sems ro mnyam rtogs pa 'khrul zhig gi sgom chen/ /snying po'i bstan 'dzin padma badzra de mkhyen no/ /thog mar bstan sgor 'jug mdzad so thar gyi mkhan po/ /bar du byang sdom 'bog pa thes/ chen gyi slob dpon//tha mar yin grol mchog stsol gsang sngags kyi bla ma/ /bka' drin 'khor med padma badzra de mkhyen no/ /zhes sogs gsol 'debs bsngags brjod rgya cher mdzad/ de bzhin mdo mkhyen brtse skyes bu ye shes rdo rje dang / rdo grub bstan pa'i nyi ma/ 'jam mgon mi pham rin po che sogs kyis dpal gsang ba snying po'i rgyud bshad rje 'di las gsan zhing rim par brgyud pa'i rgyun bzang da lta'i bar du ma nyams pa byung ba dang / a 'dzoms 'brug chen 'gro 'dul dpa' bo rdo rjes zab sa/sang snying po'i man ngag bla ma yang tig bzhes shing / de mtshungs rdzogs sprul lnga pa dang / zhe chen rab 'thams lnga pa/ dbon sprul mthu stobs rnam rgyal/ sprul pa'i gter chen las rab gling pa/ bdud 'joms rol ba rtsal sogs skyes chen du ma la bka' gter gyi smin khrid mtha' yas pa bapal ba sogs snying po'i bstan pa gzhir bzhengs su bslangs/ phyi rabs gdul bya'i bgo skal du mtshan nyid kyi gzhung 'grel dang gsar 2

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapo'i gas thor bu/ la ༷ ba 0 ༷ ba ba la ༷ ba ba ༷ ༷ ba ba rnying gi rgyud bshad sogs glegs bam drug lhag ljag/sa brtsams mdzad kyang / thog ma nas par du ma 'khod pa dang dus 'gyur gyi god chag skabs 'thor brlag tu song ba mang zhing / da lta dziseng chos grwar shing par du 'khod pa gleg bam gnyis tsam mjal du yod pa bcas/ de ltar don gnyis lhun grub kyi mdzad pa phyogs med du brdal nas rab byung bco lnga pa'i shing sprel hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gsum la zhing 'di'i 'gro don re zhig mtha' ru phyin te dbo/ngas pa chos dbyings su gshegs pa'i tshul bstan to/ /sprul pa'i sku rabs gnyis pa mkhan sprul bde mchog do rje mchog ni/ rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa khye lor byang nag chu lha ri 'gor lha bla'i gdung rigs bar ma chad par byon pa'i sngags btsun zhig gi sras su sku bltams/ rdzogs chen lnga pa thub bstan chos kyi rdo rje mchog yul dbus lha ldan du chibs skyong gnang bzhin pa'i lam bar nas sgrib bral ye shes kyi gzigs pas glo bur du mkhyen pa'i tshul gyis/ bdag gi bla ma'i yang srid gnas 'dir 'khrungs 'dug ces rje nyid kyis lam khrid mdzad de 'brog khyim zhig tu phebs/ khyim der btsas nas ring por ma lon pa'i byis par mgul dar sgron te ngos 'dzin sku bdag mdzad/ grub dbang 13

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ spyo ba da ba ༷ ba ba ཿ ཿ ba pa ༷ — nyid rim par dbus phyogs su chibs zhal sgyur zhing sprul pa'i sku yab yum dang zhabs 'greng pa 'ga' zhig bcas myur bar rdzogs chen gdan sar phebs dgos pa'i gsung bkod dang bcas phyir brdzangs/ ring min rje nyid dbus phyogs nas gdan sar zhabs sor 'khod pa dang rigs bdag bla ma rnam gnyis kyi rnam rol te yang srid 'di nyid dang / 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i thugs sprul gur dga' zung gser khrir mnga' ba/sol mdzad cing / rim par skyabs rje mchog dang / 'jam mgon mi pham/ mkhan chen gzhan dga' sogs las mdo dang sngags kyi chos tshul rgya mtsho lta bu bsan bzhes mthar phyin mdzad pas mkhas grub kyi skyes bur gyur/ dgung grangs so brgyad nas grub dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs pas bstan srid kyi thugs 'gan bzhes shing / tshogs chen lha khang sogs me 'jigs byung ba thams cad bskyar gso mdzad nas bstan 'gro'i legs mdzad dar rgyas su skyong bzhin pa'i skabs/ nag po'i rtsa lag stobs su bdo ba'i bar chad kyis sku tshe mthar ma phyin par zhing du gshegs/sprul pa'i sku rabs gsum pa bdag cag gi rigs kyi bdag po 7skyabs rje padma skal bzang mchog ni/ spyi lo 1943pa bod rab 14

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/0 ༷ cha ༷ rsha — 4 ༷ la cha 0 cha na ༷ — byung bcu drug pa'i chu lug/ lor mdo khams nyi ma shar phyogs kyi sa'i cha/ dal 'bab rdza chu'i stod rgyud dge rtse 'gab ma zhes pa'i sde bar yab hor shul 'jigs don dang / yum rig sngags 'chang pa a gro bsod chos kyi sras mo nor dbyangs gnyis kyi sras su chab zangs 'o mar 'gyur ba dang / 'ja' tshon gyi gur khyim phub pa sogs ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs/ byes pa'i dus nyid nas skyes thob kyi shes rab dang byang sems kyi bslab spyod sogs dam pa'i mngon rtags lhan skyes su mnga'/ sku bo/nga ma dang bla brang gcig tu bzhugs pa'i rdzogs chen kong sprul rin po che yul der phebs skabs sku pang du 'byar zhing gong ma'i phyag shan la mdzub mo btsugs te nga'i red ces ngos 'dzin mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse chos kyi blo gros dang / rdzogs chen yid bzhin nor bu 'jigs bral byang chub rdo rje/ sprul sku dri med sogs tshad ma'i skyes chen du ma bka' lung gcig mthun gyis mkhan chen padma badzra rtsal gyi sku phreng gsum par ngos 'dzin sku bdag dang / yongs 'dzin mkhan po chos 'byor ched mngag mdzad de rdza stod lcang ma sgar du yi ge'i phyi mo sogs thun mong rig sa/nas la sbyang ba mdzad/dgung grangs bdun la son skabs sku'i zhang po rdza mu ra sprul sku 16

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma batshu'i gsung thor ku/ ba 0 la la 0 ma mi ba ba ༷ zhe la ༷ la byu 'bul pa'i dgos pa ni/ rgyud las/ rnam dag sems ldan maṇḍal di/ /phul ba'i bsod nams ga la du med/ /ces dang / sangs rgyas zhing khams thams cad dang /stong gsum 'jig rten ma lus pa/ /lha mi'i longs spyod kyis brgyan nas//mchod na sangs rgyasaye shes rdzogs/ /ces pa ltar/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs chen po rtsol med du rdzogs pas/ gnas skabs su lha mi'i 'byor pa chen po la longs spyod pa dang mthar thug don gnyis lhun grub chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang mngon du byas nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams rgya mtsho lta bu la dbang bsgyur ba'i dbo/sa pa yod do/ /de la maṇḍal gyi ngo bo ni/ gtso bo la 'khor gyis bskor ba'i don te/skabs 'dir dbus kyi ri dbang lhun po la/ri gling rgya mtsho'i tshogasakyis bskor ba'o/ /nges tshil ni/ maṇḍal zhes pa'i sgra las drangs na/ maṇḍal ba da chags pa dang / la ni gzhi 'dzin pa ste/ gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa ngo mtshar gyi bkod pas brjid dang ldan cing 'pho 'gyur med par brtan chags pa'am/ lha mi'i 'gro ba kun gyi rten gzhir gyur pa'o/ /yang na maṇḍal ni snying po dang / la ni len pa ste/ snying po bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs len par byed pa'i thabs yin pas snying po len pa zhes bya/ dbye na/ gang la 'bul ba'i yul bsod nams kyi zhing sgrub pa'i maṇḍal dang / gang zhig 'bul ba mchod pa'i maṇḍal gnyis su yod pa lag mchod yul lha'i maṇḍal gyi dbang du byas na/ gnas nang dbyings don gyi 'og min mtha' dbus dang༄la ba'i zhing na/ ston pa chos kyi sku dbyings dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i bdag nyid cana'i/ 'khor ye shes rgya mchos tshogs dang bcas pa/ dus bzhi mnyam pa nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ chos ye shes 'od 25

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsong thor sa/ ba ༷ la ba cha cha ba la la ཿ ga la ཿ byu ༷ gsal ba'i dgongs pa la mnyam par bzhag pa/ chos kyi sku'i dkyil 'khor dang /gnas lhun grub stug po bkod pa ye shes rang snang gi zhing khams bkod pa tshad med pas brgyan pa na/ ston pa longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga gangs chen mtsho/ 'khor sa bcu'i sems dpa' rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi dbus na/ chos theg pa chen po/ dus rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lor bskor ba/ 'angs spyod rdzogs sku'i dkyil 'khor dang /gnas mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams la sogs par/ston pa mchog gi sprul pa'i sku mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po la sogs pas/'khor lha dang mi'i tshogs skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la/ dus gdul bya dus su babs pa'i tshe/ chos theg pa sna tshogs pas 'dul bar mdzad pa/ sprul pa'i sku'i dkyil 'khor rnams su yod kyang / 'dir skabs su babs pa ni/ sku gsum dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag /mchog gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i rang bzhin/ bsod nams dam pa'i zhing gi mchog tu gyur pa bla ma rdo rje slob dpon nyid yin te/ mdo dgongs pa 'dus pa las/ des na sangs rgyas stong phrag la/ /bam pa stong du mchod byas pas/ /bla ma'i ba spu'i khung re la/ / tsaṇḍan thigs pa gcig bkus pa'i/ /stong phras char yang phod pa min/ /ces dang / bla ma rdo rje slob dpon la//gser la sogs pa yon phul na//sangs rgyas zhing khams brjod med pa'i/ /gtso 'khor 'bum phrag grangasamed la/ bsnyen bkur mchod pa grangs med pas/ /bsod nams 'di yi char mi phod/ /ces dang / mchod pa gzhan rnams yongs spangs nas/ /bla ma mchod la yang dag brtson/ /de mnyes pas kun mkhyen gyi/ /ye shes mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ mchog gisal pa'i sku rin po chanyid rgyal kun 'dus 26

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma batre'i gan thor bu/ba ba la byu ༷ da ba ༷ bsha 0 g.yon du bskor nas lcags ri 'god cing / thabadzra re khe ā rgyu/ zhes brjod pas badzra re khe ni rdo rje'i rwa ba ste/ phyi'i khor yug gi lcags ri nag pos kun nas bskor ba/ de yi dbus su : zhes tshom bu gcis/ bkod pas ri yi rgyal po ri rab ste/ ri dbang rin chen rnam bzhi'i rang bzhin can/ /phyogs bzhi'i nam mkha' kha dog bsgyur ba yod/ /ces pa ltar/ shar shel las grub pas dkar po/ lho ngos bee byu1 las grub pas sngon po/ nub padma rā ga las grub pas dmar po/ byang gser las grub pas ser po/ phyogs bzhi'i nam mkha' rin po che'i kha dog tu bsgyur ba/ dbyibs gru bzhi pa/ dpag tshad brgyad khri rgya mchos nang du nub cing brgyad khri steng du 'phags pa/ ri rab kyi steng gi phyogs bzhi'i ngos re la dpag tshad brgyad khri brgyad khri yod pa/ de'i mtha' bskor du gnya' shing 'dzin la sogs pa'i gser gyi ri bdun/ de dag gi bar na/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i rol ba'i mtsho bdun rnams kyis bskor ba'i ri rab kyi bang rim bzhi la rgyal chen sde bzhi'i lha dang steng na lha yi dbang po brgya byin gyi pho brang rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang / grong khyer lta na sdug dang bcas pa/ rin po che'i ra ba dang / skyed mos tshal/ khrus kyi rdzing bu/dpag bsam gyi shing /nor bu'i phung po sogs kyis mdzes par brgyan pa de lta bu dang / de nas phyi rol gyi rgya mtsho chen po'i nang du shar nas g.yas bskor gyis rim pa bzhin/ shar lus 'phags po dbyibs zla ba byed pa lta bu mnyam pa'i ngos ri rab la bstan cing 'bur khor yus/ la bstan pa mtha' skor du dpag tshad drug stong sum brgya lnga bcu yod pa/ kha dog dkar po chu shel ltar 'tsher ba/ mi rnams lus bong khyad du 'phags pa yod pa/ lho 'dzam bu'i gling 28

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i sasung thor bu/ ga 0 ga ba — ba ba la na ba ba she — —— 0 ca phye ba de yang tshigs su bcad pa bco lngas ston pa las thog mar/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa ni//dngos po brgyad kyis yang dag bshad/ /ces gsungs te/ shes rab kyi pha rolaphyin pa'i mdo'i don dngos po brgyad du bye nas bshad na/ rjod byed gzhung sher phyin kyi don/ brjod bya lam dang 'bras bu'i sher phyin ma 'u sa pa mtha' das/ yang dag par phyin ci ma log par bshad par 'gyur bas de ltar bshad dbos so zhes gsungs/ de la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtshan gzhi ni/ theg chen 'phags lam gsum gyis chos thams cad rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i sgom byung gi shes rab/ mtshan nyid ni/ chos nyid spros bral mngon sum du stobs pa'i mkhyen pa sang zhig mi gnas pa'i myang 'das su phyin pa'am phyin byed de/ sdud pa las/ chos rnams rang bzhin med pa yongs su shes gyur pa/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyo da pa yin/ /'es gsungs/de ltar na slob dpon phyogs kyi glang pos/ shes rab pha rol phyin gnyis med/ /ye shes de ni de bzhin sa/shegs/ /bsgrub bya'i don de dang ldan pas/ /gzhung dang lam la de sgras bstan/ /zhes pa ltar/ sangs rgyas dang /byang sems 'phags pa'i mnyam bzhag gis bsdus pa'i rnam par mi rtog/ pa'i ye shes ni gtso bo dang / rjes thob kyi cha rnams sher phyin phal pa ste mtshan nyid pa yin la/ mos spyod kyi lam dang gzhung sher phyin rnams btags pa ba yin/ sa mtshalas ni/ theg chen mthong lam nas/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod pa chan no/ /nges tshig ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ don dam shes pa'i phyir bshad do/ /zhes pa ltar stong nyid la dmigs pa'i shes pa ni shes pa'i rab ste/ srid zhi'i pha rol tu phyin par byed pas so/ /de la/ mngon rtogs brgyad/ dngos po brgyad/41

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/0 la la ༷ la 0 ba ga ༷ ba zhe ba da na ༷ rteskabs brgyad ces pa rnams kyi khyad par ni/ don bsdus sgron mer/ mngon rtogs shes rgyud rim pa ste/ /dngos po brgyad ni brjod bya la// /skabs ni brjod byed shārnyi gsung / /zhes pa ltar/ mngon rtogs ni gang zag gi shes rgyud la satshul dang / dngos po ni brjod bya don gyi dbang du byas pa dang / skabs ni rjod byed tshig gi dbang dusas pa kun par gsungs/ 'o na dngos po brgyad po gang zin zhe na/ /rnam kun mkhyen nyid lam shes nyid/ /de nas thams cad shes pa nyid/ /rnam kun mngon rdzogs stob/sa pa dang / /rtse mor phyin dang mthar gyis pa/ /skad cig gcig mngon rdzogs byang chub/ /chos kyi sku dngade rnam brgyad/ /ces pa ltar brgyad du yod pa rnams kyi mtshan nyid rim pa bzhin 'di ltar yin te/ ji lta ji snyed kyis bsdus pa'i shes bya'i rnam pa thams cad dus skad cig ma gcig la rtog med mngon sum du mkhyen pa de dang po rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na ji lta ji snyed kyi rnam mkhyen gnyis yod/ theg pa gsum gyi lam mtha' dag rang bzhin med pa'i tshul du rtogs shing / rdzogs yin sbyang gsum gyi sgo nas yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon du byed pa'i slob las pa'i mkhyen pa de gnyis pa las shes kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na theg gsum gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes sasum yod/ ba/zhi phung khams skyemached kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad sang zag gi bdag gis stong par rtog/sa pa'i nyi tshe ba'i mkhyen pa de gsum pa bzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ dbye na nyan thos dang rang rgyal gyi bzhi shes gnyis yod/ mkhyen gsum kyi rtogs pa la rang dbang thob par bya ba'i phyir gzhi lam rnam gsum skye med thos pa dngasal ba'i rang bzhin du bsdus te sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de bzhi pa rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs 42

rdzogs chen malan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ —— 0 ba pa ba pa rka la la la ba ba ba ba 6 she pa'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na mi gnas pa'i sbyor ba dang / mi sbyor ba'i sbyor ba/zab pa'i sbyor ba sogs sbyor ba nyi shu yod/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba la brten nas skye med gsum bsdus te sgom pa la rang dbang du gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de lnga pa rtse mor phyin pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na sbyor lam drod rtse sogs bdun yod/ mkhyen pa gsum gyi shes pa'i rnam pa thams cad gcig char du skye ba'i rtogs pa brtan por bya ba'i phyir mkhyen gosum byi rnam pa rnams rim gyis sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de drug pa mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na sbyin pa'i phar phyin kyi mthar gyis pa sogs bcu gsum yod/ mkhyen gsum rim gyis sgo ma pa mthar thug pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor de bdun pa skad cig ma gcis gis mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ dbye na rnam par man pa min pa'i chos thams cad skad cig la rtogs pa sogs bzhi yod/ sbyor ba bsgom pa'i 'bras bu mthar thub pa zag med kyi yan lag du ma dang ldan pa de/ brgyad pa chos kyi sku'i mtshan nyid yin te/ bden gnyis las/ chos rnams kun gyi lus yin phyir/ /yon tan bsam yas kun rten phyir/ /rigs pa'i rjes 'thang ngo bo'i phyir// /skyobs pa rnams kyi chos sku yin/ /zhes so/ /dbye na ngo bo nyid kyi sku sogs ba'i yod do/ /de ltar na/sher phyin gyi mdo'i brjod bya'i dngos po'am/ mngon par rtog/sa pa ni brgyad po 'di las mang mi dgos shing nyung na mi 'du bas grangs nges pa yin no/ /'o na grangs brgyad du nges pa'i rgyu mtshan ci zhe na/ gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba la/ shes par bya ba'i yul mkhyen pa gsum dang / nyams su len pa'i lam sbyor ba bzhi dang 'bras bu'i mthar thub chos kyi sku dang gsum 43

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ga la / ༷ pa sa ༷ shā la mi ba — la ༷ ( du grangs nges pa yin te/ don bsdus sgon me las/ shes bya'i yul du mkhyen pa gsum/ /sgom pa'i dus su sbyor ba bzhi/ /'ams bu'i mthar thug chos kyi sku/ /zhes gsung / 'o na shes bya mkhyen pa gsum du grangs nges pa ci yin zhe na/dper na yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i yon tan thos na de thob pa'i thabs la brtson pa ltar/ dang por byang chub don gnyer gyi gang zag 'bras bu la brod pa bskyed pa'i don du/ rang ga na gyi don gnyis dang ldan pa'i rnam mkhyen bstan/ de thos nas de'i thabs la 'jug pas/ de 'thob pa'i thabs sam lam tshang la ma nor ba las shes bstan/ de'i mi mthun phyogs kyi gol sa shes nas spong dgos pas/ de'i ched du gzhi shes bstan/ de ltar na thob bya'i 'a sa bu/ thob byed kyi lam/ de'i gol sa mi mthun phyogs bcas legs par shes na lam thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i gnas skabs kyi shes bya thams cad de tsam du 'dus pa yin te/ jo bo rje dpal ldan sa nyi shas/ thos bsam dus su 'bras bu dang / /rgyu dang mi mthun phyogs dag tu/ /gtan la phab pa rdzogs pa yin/ /ces gsung / 'o na nyams len sbyor ba bzhir grangs nges pa ci yin zhe na/ mkhyen pa gsum gtan la phabs nas shes pa tsam gyis mi chog /'angs bu mngon du byed pa la sgom nas nyams su len dgos/ de yang mnyam bzhab tu zab mo'i nyams len spros bral rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rang rgyud la ma skyes pa skyobar byed pa'i rnam rdzogs sbyor ba dang / de nyid 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i sgom byung rab kyi ngo bor skyes pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba dang / rjes thob tu rgya che ba'i nyams len rnam kun mchog ldan gyi ting nge 'dzin la brtan pa thob par byed pa mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba dang /44

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/0 spyoX la la ༷༷ ༷ ba ༷ ༷ byu 0 mi da la ༷ ba de la brtan pa thob nas rgyu'am lam gyi mthar thug pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba ste/de bzhir grangs nges pa ni/ don bsdus sgo me las/ sgom pa'i dus su sbyor ba dang / /gnas skabs 'bras bu brtan byed pa/ /rgyu yi mthar thug dag gis rdzogs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / 'thas bu'i sgo nas kyang grangs nges te/rnam kun dang rtse mo gnyis kyis rang don du spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa mngon du byas te 'bad med lhun grub kyi chos sku thob cing / mthar skad gnyis kyis gzhan don gyi rten rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa mngon du byas nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob ste gzugs sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa zhar la 'thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /'bras bu ni chos kyi sku gcig tu grangs nges pa yin te/ gzhi thos bas ba gyis gtan la phab nas lam sbyor ngabazhi nyams su blangs pa'i mthar thug gi 'bras bu de kho nar nges pas so/ /gnyis pa don bdun cu'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa la/ yul mkhyen gsum gri la ma sbyor bzhi'i/ 'bras bu chos sku'i lus rgyas par bshad pa gsum las/ dang po la yang / rnam mkhyen/ lam shes/ gzhi shes kyi lus rgyas par bshad pa gsum las/ dang po rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mtshon pa'i chos bcu yod de/ gang zhe na/ gzhung rtsa ba las/ sems bskyed pa dang gdams ngag dang / /nges 'byed yan lag rnam bzhi dang / /sgrub pa yi ni rten gyur pa/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin dang / /dmigs pa dag dang ched dang gi/ go cha 'jug pa'i bya ba dang / tshog/sa ni nges par 'byung bcas rnamagathub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /des ltar mtshon tshul la sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis bzhed tshul mi 'dra ba gsum te/45

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ba la rte ༷ mi ༷ — ༷ — 0 0 nabacu po 'di ni rnam mkhyen thob pa'i rgyu yin pas rgyus mtshon nas 'bras bu bstan pa yin te/ jo bo rjes/ rgyu bcu rdzogs pa'i 'bras bu rnam mkhyen nyid/ /ces gsungs pa lta bu dang / yang ched du bya ba gsum gyis 'bras bu dang /lhag mas rgyu bstan/ de tsam du ma zad/dmigs pa chos rnams thams cad de/ /zhes shes bya'i chos thams cad bstan pas/ rgyu 'thas kyi rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa ni/ rnam mkhyen yin no zhes yul gyis yul can mtshon nas bstan par bzhed pa dang yang grol ba don gnyer gyi gang zag rnams kyi 'dod pa'i gtso bo/ shes bya gtso bo'i don bcu tsam bshad pas rnam mkhyen rdzogs par mtshon nus pa yin te/ rnam 'grel las/ 'diyis srin gu'i grangs mkhyen pa/ /nged la nyer mkho 'ba' yang med/ /blang dang dor bya'i de nyid ni//thabs dang bcas pa rig mdzad pa/ /gang tshe tshad ma nyid 'dod kyi/ /thams cad rig mdzad ma yin no/ /ring po mthong ngam min kyang rung / /'dod pa'i de nyid mthong ba yin//zhes gsung / —de lta bu'i rnam mkhyen mtshon pa'i chos rnams rgyas par bshad pa la /lam gyi rang bzhin sems bskyed bshad pa/ de nyid dag byed bdams ngag bshad pa/ gdams pa'i 'bras bu nges 'byed yan lag /gdams pa'i don phyin ci ma log par sgrub pa'i tshul dang bzhi las/ dang pos sems bskyed kyi ngo bo ni/ sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i nga chub 'dod/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sems bskyed skye ba'i thabs kyi rten ni/ spyir mi yin pa dang /bye brag so thar gyi sdom ldan sog/sa dgos pas khyab pa med de/lha klu gnod sbyin sogs thams cad la skyobar lam shes kyi mdo dang / mdo 46

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsang thor bu/la ༷ ba — bab la ba la baX ༷ — — bsha ba — pa gzhan las kyang gsung ba'i phyir/ sems kyi rten ni/ rgyal ba la dmigs pa'i dad pa/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ byang sems kyi spyod pa la slob par 'dod pa gsum yin te/ dkon mchog sgron me'i mdo las/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i chos la dad gyur cing / /rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod la dad byed pa/ /byang chub blan med la da gyur nas/ /skyes bu chen po rnams kyi sems skye'o/ /zhes dang / mdo sde rgyan las/ de yi rtsa ba snying rjer 'dod/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /sems bskyed kyi mtshan gzhi thos/sa med sku mched sems byung sems pa dang 'dun pa la bzhed pa ni btags pa ba yin la/ 'phags pa grol ste dang / slob dpon seṅge bzang po/ dkar chos kun gyi rten gzhi yid kyi rnam shes mtshan gzhir bzhed pa mtshan nyid pa yin no/ /mtshan nyid ni rtsa bas dngos bstan ltar/ched du bya ba bzhan sems can thams cad 'khor ba rgyu 'bras las bsgral nas byang chub gsum gyi go 'phang la skal ba bzhin 'god pa'i don du/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa'i gtso sems yid kyi rnam shes mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'i sems khyad par can yin no/ /de la dbye na/ngo bos sgo nas smon 'jug gnyis te/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ byang chub sems de mdor bsdu na//rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste/ /byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni//byang chub 'jug pa nyid yin no/ /'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yi/ /bye bras ji ltar shes pa ltar/ /de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyi/ /bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya/ /zhes gsungs pas rdzogs byang don gnyer gyi bsam pa gang zhig/lus ngag sga bya bas na ma zin dang / cho ga'i sgo nas sdom pa bzung ba dang /ma bzung ba'i bye ga las 'di ga/nyis kyi13da par bye ga smon pa sems bskyed 47

rdzog/sa chen mkhan chen padma ba gsung thor bu/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ba ༷ ༷ ༷ ba la la 0 ba nga ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ la sangs rgyas kyi sa la sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed bzhag ste rnam pa bzhi'o//bzhed tshul gyi sgoras dbye na/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sar bkod nas rang nyid grol bar 'dod pa phyugs ji lta bu dang / bdag ga'an mnyam du sangs rgyas par 'dod pa mnyan pa lta bu dang / rang sangs rgyas nas gzhan sgrol bar 'dod pa rgyal ba lta bu dang gsum du bzhed do/ /sems bskyed kyi phan yon ni/mthar thug na 'bras bu rgyal ba'i go 'phang 'thob cing /gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ming rgyal ba'i sras su 'pho zhing / don lha mi kun gyis phyag bya ba'i 'os su 'gyur ba'i tshul/ spyod 'jug las/ gser 'gyur ci yis rnam pa mchog lta bu/ /mi gtsang lus 'di blangs nas rgyal ba'i sku/ /rin chen rin thang med par bsgyur bas na/ /byang chub sems zhes bya ba rab brtan bzung / /byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag/ rnams/ /bde bshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing / /'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /mdor na sems bskyed pa'i bsod nams kyi tshad ni nam mkha' dang mnyam par bsam gyis mi ba pa ste/ dpal byin gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/ byang chub sems kyi bsod nams gang / /ga ba te de la ga/zugs mchis na/ /nam mkha'i khams ni kun gang yang / /de ni de bas bsod nams che/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar sems bskyed pa sa rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i spyod pa rlabs po che la 'jug pa'i sgo dang po yin pas mtshan nyid las 'phros pa'i don gyi dbye ba cung zad bshad nas/ da ni gzhung gis bstan pa'i sa mtshalas kyis dbye ba nyi shu rtsa gnyis ni/ gzhung rtsa bar/ de 49

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor sa cha ༷ ba ba 0 la ༷ bgos/sa su bden par zhen pa med pa ma lta bu'i tshul gyis bslab par bya bar gdams pa yin no/ /bzhi pa sgrub pa'i mi mthun phyogs snyoms las kyi le lo spong byed/sgo gsum gyi bde ba la mngon par zhen pa med pa'i brtson 'grus la bslab par gdams pa dang lnga pa sgyid lug pa'i le lo'i gnyen po mi ngal ba'i brtson 'grus la gdams pa dang / drug pa bdag nyid brnyas pa'i le lo'i gnyen por lam yongs su 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus la sadams pa dang /bdun pa sgrub pa'i yon tan mthar thug sangs rgyas thob pa dang / gnas skabs rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i phyir/ stong gsum gyi gzugs thams cad mthong ba sha'i spyan dang / phyogs bcu'i sems can rnams kyi 'chi 'pho ba dang skyob shes pa lha'i spyan dang / 'dusabyas dang 'dus ma byas kyi chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid shes pa shes rab kyi spyan dang / 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi dbang po rno rtul dang gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi tshig don rnams thogs med du shes pa chos kyi spyan dang / ji lta ji snyed thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon sum du shes pa sangs rgyas kyi spyan ste/ kun lnga thob pa'i rgyu phyin drug gis bsdus pa'i chos rnams la kun rdzob tu sgyu ma ltar bltas nas slob cing don dam par spros bral de bzhin nyid rtogs pas bslab par bya bar gdams pa dang / brgyad pa/sems can rnams chos mnyam pa nyid la 'bo/da pa dang / 'phags pa rnams kyi byams pa dang / yid 'ong gi yul rnams dang phrad pa dang / lha rnams kyis phyag bya ba dang / byang chub tu lung bstan pa thob pa sogs kyi ched du/ sa g.yo ba dang 'od 'gyed pa sogs rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon shes/ 'jig rten gyi sgra che chung 55

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i bsung thor bu/ba ༷ la la la sgo ༷ bsha ba 0 ba ba 7 ༷ ༷ ba ba byu la — 0ba'ag pa med de/ shes bya kun la khyab pas so/ /des rnam mkhyen mtshon pa'i chos lnga pa thal/gsum pa sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba ni/ gang zhig thob par bya ba'i ched du byang sems rnams sgrub pa la 'jug par 'gyur ba'i mthar thugagi 'bras bu de ched du bya ba'i mtshan nyid/ de la dbye na/ sems can kun mchog nyid sems dang / /spong dngasags dang gsum po ga/chen po gsum gyi rang 'byung gi /ched du bya ba 'di shes bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ sems can kun gyi mchog/ sangs rgyas ni mchog nyid chen po dang / sgrib gnyis ma lus pa spangs pa'i spong ba chen po dang / ji lta ji snyed thams cad gzis/sa pa'i rtogs pa chen po ste/ chen po gsum kyi bdas nyid can gyi sangs rgyas ni rang byung byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ched du bya ba yin par shes par bya zhes pa ste/ sa mtshalas ni sangs rgyas kyi sa kho na'o/ /des rnam mkhyen mtshon pa'i chos drug pa thal /bzhi pa sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo la/ theg chen la 'jug phyir go bsos pa so cha'i sgrub pa dang / zhugs pa 'jug pa'i sgrub pa dang / zhugs pa mthar phyin byed tshogs kyi sgrub pa dang / mthar phyin pa nges 'byung so sgrub pa bzhi las/dang po go cha'i sgrub pa ni/ theg chen sems bskyed la brten nas don ga/nyis sgrub pa'i bya ba gang zhig phar phyin drug re re'i nang du drug drug tshang bar bsdus nas nyams su len pa de go cha'i sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ de 4mi mthun phyogs kyis mi phyed pa'i phyir bo cha zhes bya la tshogs lam nas yod cing / dbye na/ de dag so sor sbyin la sogs// /rnam pa drug tu bsdus pa yis/ /go cha'i sgrub pa gang yin te/ /drug tshan drug gis ji bzhin bshad/ /ces pa ltar/ rang nyid 60

gsar mkha ga padma ba gas thor bu/ rjo ཿ — — — ཿ ཿ rjo ༷ ཿ ༷ ༷ de la gnas shing gzhan de la 'god pa dang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas nasasang ga tu bsngo ba ri so so'i sbyin pa/ rang don yid la byed pa'i nyan rang gi bsam pa dang ma 'dres pa so so'i tshul khrims/ rang gi mi mthun phyogs dang gzhan gyis log sgrub kyis sems mi 'khrugs pa so so'i bzod pa/ gzhan don du phyin drug sa pa la ches cher spro ba so so'i brtson 'grus/ ba/ na donadang rnam ma la sems rtse gcig pas bsgrub pa so so'i bsam gtan/ sa rdzob la brten nas byang sa tu bsngo ba dang / don dam la brten nas 'khor gsum du mi dmigs pas rlom sems med pa so so'i shes rab ste/ phan sa re re'i nang du drug drug bsdus nas nyams su len pa ste/bsdu na go 'a sa pa drug sa / rgyas par so drug go/ /des rnam ma 'a mtshon pa'i chos bdun pa thal/ gnyis pa 'jug pa'i sgrub pa la/ theg chen sems bskyed la brten nas bla med byang chub kyi ra du don gnyis sgrub pa gang zhis rṣa byung gtso bor gyur pa'i sgo nas theg chen la gog pa'i bya ba de cas sgrub gyi mas nyid /'jug/ sgrub tsam tshogs lam dang khyad par can sbyor lam chos mchog 'byung nas yod cing / dbye na 'jug yul thes chen dgu yod pas de la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa dgu yod de/ bsam gtan gzugs med sbyin sogs dang / /lam dang byams la sogs pa dang / /dmigs pa med dang ldan pa dang / /'khor gsum rnam par sbyin sogs dang / /ra du bya dang mngon shes drug /rnam a ma pa'i tshul la ni/ /'jug pa'i sgrub pa theg chen la/ /'dzeg pa yin par shes par bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ dang po ni/ sems yul la g.yeng ba las ldog nas 61

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor ku/ 'a ge rte / / ba ge 2 sha / rte / dmigs pa la brtan par bya ba'i don du/ bas gtan dang gzugs med pa'i snyoms 'jug la 'jug pa dang / gnyis pa ni/ sems brtan pa de tshos/sa gnyis la slob pas de'i 'og tu sbyin sogs phyin drug la 'jug pa dang / gsum pa ni/ tshogs bsags pa ni de kho na nyid kyi don la lhag par mos pa skye ba'i phyir/ de rtogs pa mthong ba dang sgom pa'i lam la 'jug pa dang / bzhi pa ni/'phags lam thob pa ni gzhan don byed par sbo ba'i phyir tshad med bzhi la 'jug pa dang / lnga pa sa/ gzhan don la 'jug pa na de'i 'ching ba ni mngon zhen yin pas/ chos thams cad dmigs pa med pa dang ldan pa la 'jug pa dang / drug pa ni/ ngo bo nyid med bar gas pa'i rnal 'byor pa de sa pa la 'jug pa na/ las dang bya ba dang byed po gsum la bden zhen med pa sgyu ma'i skyes bu bzhin du dngos po thams cad la 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i sgo nas 'jug pa dang / bdun pa ni/ de ltar bden pa gnyis dang mi 'gal bar spyod pa rnams/ rang gis bsgrubs mthar thug gi don la 'jug pa'i phyir chen po gsum ched du bya ba la 'jug pa dang / brgyad pa ni/ ched du bya ba la 'bad pa rnams de'i rgyu'i gtso bo gzhan sems shes pa sogs kyi phyir brtson pas mngon par shes pa drug la 'jug pa dang / dgu pa ni/ mngon shes thob pa rnams da ni bdag gis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa thob par bya'o snyam du mngon par 'tshang rgya ba la spro ba chen po skye bas rnam mkhyen la 'jus/ pa ste 'jug pa'i sgrub pa dgu'o/ /des rnam mkhyen mtshon pa'i chos brgyad pa thal/gsum pa tshogs kyi sgrub pa bshad pa ni/ theg chen sems bskyed la sko brten nas bla med byang chub kyi ched du don gnyis sgrub pa'i bya ba gang zhig 62

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gas thor sa/ ba ༷ ༷ ༷ 'a 'a ༷ ba / na ba — ༷ rka zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i myang 'das su nges par 'byung ba dang thob bya theg pa sasum gyi spang rtogs kyi rigs thams cad thob pa'i mtshan nyid can du nges 'byung ba dang / shes bya'i chos kyi rnam pa thams cad skad cig ma gcig la rnam par mi rtog par mkhyen pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du nges par 'byung ba ste bdun sa'i mthar thug pa sangs rgyas kyi sa dang /rnam mkhyen la dngos su sbyor ba'i khyad par gyi lam bar chad med rtser nges par 'byung ba ci lam kyi mthar thug tu nges par 'byung ba ste/ 'byung sa mthar thug brgyad po de yul du byas pa'i yul can thabs shes khyad par can gyi bya ba rnams ni nges par 'byin byed kyi sgrub pa yin pas nges 'byung gi sgrub pa brgyad du shes par bya'o/ /'byung sa snga ma bdun mi slob lam dang / phyi ma slob lam na yod do//des rnam mkhyen mtshon pa'i chos bcu pa thal/ /de yan chad kyis chos bcus mtshon pa'i rnam mkhyen sa/ thog mar thos bsam gyis gtan la dbab pa'i gnas skabs na/ shes bya'i yul gyi gtso bo dang / bar du nyams len sbyor bzhi'i gnas skabs na sgom bya'i rnam pa'i gtso bo dang / tha ma lam mthar phyin pa'i gnas skabs thob bya 'bras bu'i gtso bo yin pas cung zad rgyas par bshad pa yin ngo gzhan lam shes sogs kyi —skabs lhag ma rnams mdo tsam du brjodade/ gnyis pa lam shes mtshon pa'i chos la bcu gcig yod de/ mog mog por byed sogs/ de ltar bshad ces pa ltar las/ dang po lam shes kyi yan lag gi rten sa/ sems bskyed dang ldan cing nga rgyal spang ba dang / ga/nyis pa yan lag can gyi las la ga/sum las/ gang zag gi bdag med tsam rtogs pa'i nyi tshe ba'i mkhyen pa de slob ma nyan thos gyi 65

rdzogs chen mkha chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ ༷ zhe — — — ༷ — spyo ཿ ཿ — — ཿ ཿ — — ཿ rigs par slob dpon gyi ngag gis brda bkrol nas slob ma'i rgyud la go brda 'phrod nges su byed par gsungs pa las/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i gzhi rigs kyi rang bzhin/ bslab pa la sbyor ba'i gzhi sems bskyed kyi rnam bzhag /myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i gzhi byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang gsum gyi sgo nas nges par bya'o/ /de la dang po rigs zhes bya ba ni spyir khams dang sa bon dang rgyu rnams la 'jug pa las/ 'dir thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu'am sa bon te/ de lagrub mtha'i dbang gis nyan thos rnams kyis ni bsod snyoms dang / chos gos dang / gnas mal ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes shing spong ba la mngon par dga' ba'i gang zag rnams la 'phags pa'i rigs can zer te/ de'i rgyud kyi sems byung chog shes pa ste 'dod chags med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba la 'phags pa'i rigs su 'dod/ sems tsam pa la'ang chos can 'dus byas la rigs su 'dod pa dang / chos nyid 'dus ma byas pa'i rigs su 'dod pa gnyis yod de/ dang po ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa las/ de la rigs gang zhe na/ mdor bsdu na rnam pa gnyis te/ rang bzhin du gnas pa dang / yang dag par bsgrub pa'o// /de la rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i rigs ni/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi skye mched drug gi khyad par gang yin pa ste/ de ni gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de 'khor ba thog ma med pa'i dus can chos nyid kyis thob pa de lta bu yin no/ /de la yang dag par bsgrub pa'i rigs ni sngon dge ba'i rtsa ba goms par byas pa las thob pa gang yin pa ste zhes pa ltar/ thog ma med pa'i dus nas gciganas gcig tu zab pa'i sems can gyi shes pa'i rgyud kyi steng na yod pa'i zag med kyi ye shes 76

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor sa — — zhe ༷ba — sa lag ༷ — ༷ ཿ ཿ — — — ༷ 0 00 ༷bskyed pa'i nus pa skyemached drug po dang gcig dang tha dad pa gang du brjod du med pa chos nyid kyis thob pa zhes bya ba thos bsam sogs kyis gsar du bskyed pa ma yin pa de lta bu zhig la rang bzhin gnas rigs su 'dod/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyud bla ma las/ gter dang 'bras bu shing bzhin tu/ /rigs de rnam gnyis shes bya ste/ /thog med rang bzhin gnas pa dang / /yang dag blang ba mchog nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i rang bzhin gnas rigs de nyid las/ de bzhin yid kyi nang chud rin chen gter/ /dri med bzhag dang bsal med chos nyid kyang / /ma rtogs pas na dbul ba'i sdug bsngal ni/ /rnam mang rgyun du skyedagu 'dis myong ngo / /zhes bsal bzhag dang bral ba'i chos nyid 'dus ma byas la gsal bar bshad pa gang yin pa'o/ /dbu ma pa spyi'i lugs la/ sems can thams cad kyi chos nyid chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba ste/nyon mongs pa'i grubs na gnas pa nyid la bde gshegs snying po zhes grags pa la de nyid rang bzhin gnas rigs su 'dod pa yin te/ chos dbyings bstod pa las/ ji ltar bum nang mar me ni/ /phyi rol kun tu mi snang ltar/ /de bzhin chos kyi dbyings 'di yang /'khor bar 'od ni gsal ma yin/ /zhes dang / phal po tshelas/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag byang chub sems dpa'i rigs zhes bya ba ni chos kyi dbyings lhur len pa nam mkha' ltar yangs pa rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba ste/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /rgyas 'gyur gyi ris/sa ni theg pa chen po'i chos la thos bsam dang byang chub tu sems bskyed pa sogs kyi rnam par dkar ba'i rkyen gang yang rung bas rang bzhin gnas pa'i rigs la gsos dang por btab pa nyid yin te/ rgya mtsho'i sprin las/ sems 77

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ — — — zhe zhe — — she ba — ga bskyed pa ni gzhan yin par rig par bya ste/ rigs de nyid gnas skabs kyi khyad par gzhan du gyur pa la ming gzhan gyis bstan pa ni yang dag par bam sa pa zhes bya bas so/ /zhes dang sems bskyed kyi skabs su yang / de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /zhes pa'i don yin no//des na 'dir ni kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos/ phar pa dge ba'i rten ni rigs yin la/ /de yang sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /dri med khams te rang bzhin gnas pa'i rigs/ /de yi snang cha sku gnyis dpe rnams dgu/ /snying rje'i rang bzhin ye nas gnas pa ni/ /rgyas 'gyur rigs zhes bde bar gshegs pas gsungs/ /rtsa ba rig pa'i ye shes 'od gsal la/ /ngo bo dug gsum med pa'i dge ba yin/ /zhes pa'i 'grel par/ de'ang rang bzhin gyis dag cing ngo bo nyid dri ma med pa'i sems nyid sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dam pa ye nas gnas pa'i sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal ba'i snang cha las sangs rgyas kyi gzugs sku'i yon tan lhun grub tu yod pa dpe dgus bstan cing stong cha la chos sku'i yon tan nam mkha' lta bu'i dpe mdo dang rgyud thams cad nas bshad la de gnyis dbyer mi byed pa ni thog ma med pa'i chos khams dge ba ste/ 'gyur ba med pa'i gnas pa'i rigs dang / dri ma sbyangs nas yon tan rgyas par mngon pas rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs zhes btags kyang / rtsa ba rig pa'i 'od gsal ba nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sgra ji bzhin du 'dod de/ rigs gnyis su bshad pa'ang ngo bo gcig la ldog pas bye ba tsam las don la ni rang gi sems nyid spros bral rang byung gi ye shes gshis cir yang ma grub pa la gdangs 'gag med du 'char ba'i gnyug ma'i shes pa dwangs gsal rjen pa 'di nyid rnam pa thams 78

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bza'i gsung thor bu/ la ba ༷ la mi ba nga ༷ mi ༷ cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi sa bon nam bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po yin te/sems kyirdo rje la bstod pa las/ sa yi dkyil na yod pa'i chu/ /dri ma med par gnas pa ltar/ /nyon mongs nang nas le shes kyang / /de bzhin dri ma med par gnas/ /zhes dang / gsang ba'i snying po las/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi kun nas kyang /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnyed mi 'gyur/ /sems nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas te/ /sangs rgyasagazhan du ma 'tshol zhig /zhes dang /rdo rje gur las/ chos kyi dbyings mchog tu zhi/ /'di ni rin chen sems su brjod/ /'dod don 'bras bu rab ster ba/ /sems kyi de nyid rang bzhin dag /ces dang / do ha las kyang / sems nyid gcig pu kun gyi sa bon te/ /gang la srid dang mya ngan 'das 'phro ba/ /'dod pa'i 'bras bu ster bar byed pa yi/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes so//de lta bu'i bde gshegs snying po de ni 'gro ba thams cad la khyab gdal du yod de/ zla ba sgron me'i mdo las/ bde gshegs snying pos 'gro ba yongs la khyab/ /sems ni rgya chen mchog tu rab bskyed de/ /'gro ba 'di dag ma lus sangs rgyas rgyu/ /'di na snod min sems can gang yang med/ /ces gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /de ltar byang chub chen po'i rigs sam khams bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po de nyid rang la yod pa'i tshul 'di dag thog mar nges dgos/ de ma nges sangs rgyas sgrub par 'dod pa'i blo mi skye ste/ dper na sa 'og na gser yod par ma nges na gser rko 'dod kyi bsam pa mi skyeb lta bu'o/ /des na rigs de dag yod par gas kyi sgo nas kyang shes paras ste/rgyud bla ma las/ gal te sangs rgyas khams med na//sdug la skyobar mi 'gyur zhing /mya ngan 'das la 'dod pa dang / /don gnyer 79

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ mi ཿ ཿ ཿ la ཿ ba ༷ — ba ཿ ༷ ༷ ci sgo ཿ smon pa'ang med par 'gyur/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das la de'i/ /sdug bde'i skyon yon mthong ba 'di/ /rigs yod las yin gang phyir de/ /rigs med dag/ la med phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ srid pa'i sdug bsngal la skyo ba'i sems can deg thar ba'i bde ba la smon pa'i sems skye ba de yang ye nas rang gi rgyud sdug bsngal dang 'bral rung dang myang 'das 'thob rung du yod pa'i rtags yang dag pa yin par bshad do/ /de ltar bde gshegs snying po de nyid rang la yod kyang mi mngon pa ci zhe na thog ma med pa'i dus nas goms pa'i las nyon bag chags kyis sgrib pa'i phyir yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ thog med gyur kyang tha ma dang ldan pa/ /rang bzhin gyis dag rtag pa'i chos can ni/ /thog med spubs kyis bsgrib phyir mi mthong ste/ /ji ltar gser gyi gzugs ni bsgribs pa bzhin/ /zhes pa ltar dang / brtags gnyis las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs/ /de bsal na ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /ces so/ /de ltar gshis kyi gnas lus/sa shes pa tsam gyis mi phan pas sa pa spong ba'i tshul la 'bad dgos shing / de'i thabs kyi mchog ni byang chub tu sems bskyed pa kho na yin te/ sems ma bskyed par sangs rgyas pa'i thabs gzhan med pa yang / dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs kyis/byang chub sems ni ma bskyed par/ /sangs rgyas yang ni mi 'thob cing / /'khor bar bdag ba/shan don bsgrub pa'i/ /thabs ga na yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes dang / spyod 'jug las/ 'di nyid de bzhin gshegs pa mnyes byed yin/ /rang don yang dag 'grub pa'ang 'di nyid do/ /'jig rten sdug bsngal sel ba'ang 'di nyid de/ /de bas bdag gis rtag tu 'di nyid bya//zhes gsungs pa ltar ro//80

rdzogasachenasakhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ ga la ༷ ༷ ༷ mi la ma ༷byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa de yang dge rtsa goms pa las sam/ theg chen gyi sde snod thos pa las sam/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rjes su bstan pa las kyang rung ste rigs sad pa'i rtags dang ldan pa'i gang zab/ zhig la skye bas/de la rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs sad pa'i gas ni/mdo sde'i rgyan las/ /sbyor ba'i sngon du snying rje dang / /mos pa dang ni bzod pa dang //dge la yang dag spyod pa / /rigs kyi rtags su nges par bshad/ /ces dang / rang bzhin gnas rigs sad pa'i rtags ni/ dbu ma 'jug/ pa las/ so so'i skyebo'i dus na'ang stong pa nyid thos nas/ /nang du rab tu dga' ba yang dang yang du 'byung / /rab tu dga' ba las byung mchi mas mis/ brlan nas/ /lus kyi ba spu ldang bar 'gyur ba gang yin pa/ /de la rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i blo yi sa bon yod/ /ces pa ltar ro//de lta bu'i rigs sad pa'i rtags dang ldan pa dag gis/gzhung nas bshad pa ltar gyi cho ga yan lag tshang ba zhig gi sgo nas byang chub mchog gi sems rin po che ji lta ba bzhin du bskyed nas bslab pa la tshul bzhin du slob par byas na ring por mi thogs par chos kyi rgyal po thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang 'thob nas mtha' yas pa'i lus can thams cad kyi skyabs dang mgon dang dpung gnyen byed par 'gyur te/ kun mkhyen chos rjes/ma lus 'gro kun bde gshegs snying po can/ /glo bur dri mas g.yogs pa'i sbub nang na/ /'od gsal chos khams mar me ye nas sanas/ /sku dang ye shes lhun kyis grub pa'i chos//rang la yod de de nyid lhun gyis grub//stong dang snying rje'i snying po lhur len pas/ /khams de byang chub zhes bya'i ming thob nas/ /ma lus snyedagu'i tshogs la phan bde byed//ces so/ /81

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma batshu'i gsung thor sa/ — — — — — — — — — — — ཿ — — — ༷ don gnyis pa bslab pa la sbyor ba'i gzhi sems bskyed dngos kyi rnam par bzhag pa ga sems babyed skyoba'i rten/ brten pa byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin/ byang chub sems kyi phan yon bstan pa dang gsum las/ dang po rten la lus kyi rten ni sems tsam gyi lugs ltar na so thar rigs bdun gang rung gi rten la skyebs gling gsum gyi skyes pa dang bud med yin pa dgos kyang dbu ma'i lugs 'di la de ltar dgos pa'i nges pa med de/ mdo ste rnams las lha dang klu dang lha ma yin dang dri za dang nam mkha' lding la sogs pa 'gro ba du mas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bstan pas lus kyi rten la mi ltos par/ bsam pa'i rten gtso che/ de la rnam grangs mang yang / sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i dad pa/ sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ byang sems kyi phan yon thos pa dang gsum la 'du ba yin te/ dkon mchog sgron me'i mdo las/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i chos la dad gyur cing / /rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod la dad byed pa/ /byang chub bla na med la dad gyur na/ /blo dang ldan pa rnams kyi sems skye'o/ /zhes dang / mdo rgyan las/ de yi rtsa ba snying rjer 'dod/ /ces pa ltar/ de las kyang snying rje ni byang chub thob pa'i rgyu'i satso bo med na mi rung zhing yod na de kho nas kyang chog pa yin te/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ /nyan thos sangs rgyas 'breng rnams thub dbang skyes/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' las 'khrungs shing / /snying rje'i sems dang gnyis su med blo dang / /byang chub sems ni rgyal sras rnams kyi rgyu/ /zhes dang / /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las/ gsang ba'i bdag po thams can mkhyen pa'i ye shes de ni byang chub kyi rgyu las byung ba snying rje chen po'i rtsa ba can thabs kyis mthar phyin 82

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma brngo'i gsung thor gru/ la la mi na ༷ ༷ la ཿ ༷ la la ba 0 0 0 ༷ ༷ pa'o/ /zhes go /chos yang dag par sdud pa'i mdo las/ spyan ras gzigs kyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas chos mang po la bslab par mi bgyi yi chos gcig la bslab par bya'o/ /de gang zhen/ snying rje chen po'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po de 'khor lo rin chen gang du mchis pa der dpung gi tshogs thams cad mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i snying rje chen po gang du mchis pa der sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mchis pa lags so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'i bsam pa gtso che'o/ /gnyis pa brten pa sems bskyed kyi rang bzhin ga sems bskyed kyi mtshan nyid dang / rab tu dbye ba gnyis so/ /dang po la mtshan sa/zhi dang mtshan nyid ba/nyis las/ mtshan gzhi ni/ sems dang sems byung la bzhed pa mi mthun pa mang yang / 'dir ni gtso sems nyid bzung zhing / de yang sgo lnga'i rnam shes kha phyir bltas rtog med kyi rnam pa yin la/ nyon yid ni nang du kun gzhi la dmigs nas ngar 'dzin gyi rnam pa can yin pas de dag ni mtshan gzhir mi rung / des na 'dir dkar chos thams cad kyirten du rung ba yid kyi rnam par shes pa nyid mtshan gzhir 'dod pa yin te/de ltar yang nyi khri snang ba las/ sems bskyed pa zhes ba la sems ni rnam par shes pa ste rnam par rig pa'o/ /rnam par shes pa ga/nga yin zhe na/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa ste/ dgan po'i chos thams cad la dmig/sapa ni de la srid pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar kun mkhyen chen po tsong kha pa sogs mkhas grub thams cad kyis bzhed pa yin no/ /mtshan nyid ni/ gzhan sems can thams cad srid pa'i sdug bsngal 83

rdzogs chenasakhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ la ༷ ༷ — — — — ༷ ཿ ཿ — las bsgral te thams cad mkhyen pa'i bde ba bla na med pa la 'jog pa'i don gyi chen du byang chub thob par 'dod pa'o/ /de ltar yang mngon gas rgyan las/sems bskyed pa gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /ces so /gnyis pa dbye ba ga ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba/ skye tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba/grogs kyi sgo nas dbye ba/ sa mtshalas kyi sgo sa dbye ba/ bzhed tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba dang lnga las/ dang po la ngo bo gcig tu bstan pa dang / ldog pa gnyis su dbye ba'o/ /de lango bo gcig tu bstan pa ni thabs snying rje chen po'i dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas chos thams cad la rang bzhin med par gas pa'i shes rab khyad par can de la stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyi sems zhes bya ste/bslab btus las/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /bskyed pas bsod nams dag par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / mngon gas rgyan las/ shes pas srid la mi gnas shing / /snying rje'i zhi la mi gnas pa//zhes so//rgyud bla ma las kyang /bdagasred ma lus shes rab kyis bsal nas/ /sems can sred phyir brtse ldan zhi thob min/ /de ltar blo rtse byang chub thabs brten nas/ /'phags pa 'khor ba'am mya ngan 'da' mi 'gyur/ /zhes bshad do/ /stong pa nyid dang snying rje gnyis po ya bral bar gyur na ni rdzog/sa pa'i byang chub las phyir ldog par 'gyur te/ sdud pa las/ thabs med shes rab bral ba nyan thos nyid du nyung / /zhes dang / 'jam dpal rnam par 'phrul ba'i mdo las/ stong pa nyid la so sor rtog cing sems can yal bar 'dor ba yang bdud kyi las so//shes rab kyis rnam par mi dpyod cing snying rje chen po la dmibs par 'dzin pa yang 84

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma batsho'i gsung thor bu/༷ — ༷ mi — — — — — ཿ ༷ ཿ — ཿ la bdud kyi las so/ /zhesarang / sa ra sa kyang snyingarje dang la stong pa nyid kyis kyang / /des 'i lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin te//gal te snying rje 'ba' zhis/ sgom na yang / /'khor ba 'di nas thar pa yod dam ci/ /zhes mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad nas stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa la byang chub kyi sems su gsungs so/ /gnyis pa de la ldog pas dbye na smon pa byang chub kyi sems dngad 'jug pasang chub kyi sems gnyis so/ /de ltar yang spyod 'jug las/ byang chub sems de mdor bsdu na/ /rnam pa gnyis su shes bya ste/ /byang chub smon pa'i sems dang ni/ /byang chub 'jug pa nyid yin no/ /'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro bachag /byebag ji ltar shes pa ltar/ /de bzhin mkhas pas 'di gnyis kyi/ /byerag rim bzhin shes par bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ snying rje chen po yid kyis lus can thams cad srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral ba'i phyir sangs rgyas thob par bya'o snyam pa'i bsam pa rkyang pa zhig dang por skye ba ni yon pa'i sems yin te/ 'gro 'dod lta bu'o/ de nas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa blangs nas sbyor ba pha rol du phyin pa drug la slob par 'dod pas spyod pa phyogs gcig la zhugs pa nas bzung ste 'jug pa'i sems yin te/ 'gro ba dngos lta bu'o/ /de ltar shā ma shi la'i sgom rim dang po las/ byang chub kyi sems de yang rnam pa gnyis te zhug/sa pa'i sems dang smon pa'i sems so /de nyid 'gro ba de dag la phan pa'i phyir sangs rgyas su gyur cig /ces gang thog mar don du gnyer ba de pon pa'i sems dang / gang phan chad sdom pa bzung ste tshogs rnamasal zhugs pa de ni zhugs pa'i sems so/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ dang po tshogs lam chung dang /

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/༷ ༷ ba mi mi la la la ༷ ba ba gnyis pa tshogs lam 'byung po nas bzhag pa yin no/ /gnyis pa skyetshul gyi sgo nas rags pa brda las skyes pa kun rdzob sems bskyed dang phra ba chos nyid kyis thob pa don dam pa'i sems bskyed gnyis yod de/ sgom rim bar ma las/ byang chub kyi sems de yang rnam pa gnyis te/ kun rdzob dang / don dam pa'o/ /de la kun rdzob ni/ snying rjes sems can mtha' dag gdon par dam bcas nas 'gro ba la phan pa'i phyir sangs rgyas su gyur cig snyam du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa'i sems dang po bskyed pa'o/ /de yang tshul khrims gyi le'u las bstan pa'i cho ga bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la gnas pa mkhas pa pha rol po las bskyed par bya'o/ /de ltar kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas don dam byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i phyir 'bad par bya'o/ /don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems ni 'jig rten las 'das pa spros pa mtha' dag dang bral ba shin tu gsal ba don dam pa'i spyod yul dri ma med pa mi g.yo ba rlung med pa'i mar me'i rgyun bzhin du mi g.yo ba'o/ /de grub pa ni rtag tu gus par yun ring du zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi rnal 'byor la goms par sa pa las 'byung zhes gsungs so/ /de la dang po 1na 'jug gis bsdus pa'i kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems de rgyu lnga las skyeste/ de yang grogs byang chub sems dpa'i bshes gnyen dang 'grogs nas des byang chub sems kyi phan yon brjod pa sogs kyi rten las skyeb yod kyang grogs la rags las shing dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang bral na byang chub kyi sems brjed par 'gyur sla ba'i phyir mi brtan pa'i sems zhes bya'o/ /rgyu rigs sad pa dang dge rtsa rgyas par 'gyur ba ste snying sde chen po skyes pa dang /86

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ — — — — — ba ཿ — zhe — 4 ཿ theg pa chen po'i sde snod thos pa dang / dge ba goms pa ste byang chub kyi sems yun ring du bsgom pa las skyob bzhi ni ldog par dga' bas brtan pa'i sems ces bya'o/ /de ltar yang /mdo rgyan lagatsugs stobs rgyu stobs rtsa ba'i stobs/ /thos stobs dge ba goms pa las/ /mi brtan pa dang brtan 'byung ba//ga na gyis bstan pa'i sems bskyed bshad/ /ces so/ /'phags rgyud kyis bsdus pa zhi lhagazung 'brel gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i don dam sems bskyed ni/yongs 'dzin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mnyes par byas nas de las gdams rag nod parang / rgyu bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs dus yun ring por bsags pa dang / 'bras bu chos thams cad rnam par mi rtogs pa'i ye shes dang por skyob ste de gsum la brten nas sbyor lam chos mchog chen po'i rten las dang po thob pa dang mtshungs ldan du skyob yin te/de nyid las/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab mnyes byas/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab bsags//chos la mi rtogs ye shes ni/ /)phyir de ni dam par 'dod//ces so//gsum pa grogs kyi dbye ba la'ang / gsum du dbye ba dang / drug tu dbye ba dang / nyer gnyis su dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems bskyed gsu du bzhag ste/ yum bar ma las/gang khar ma tho ba sdom pa'i sems dang / dge ba'i chos sdud pa'i sems dang /sems can yin par byed pa'i sems bskyed pa 'di gsum la nan tan du bya'o//zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/pha rol tu phyin pa drug la ltos nas bzhag ste/ nyi khri las/pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i sems yangs pa tshad med pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cadadang thun mong du ma gyur pa ste/zhes bshad pa 87

rdzogasachen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thong bu/ — la ༷ ༷ ༷༷ — spyo ske ཿ na ཿ ཿ ཿ — ltar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ dpe nyer gnyis dang chos mthun pa'i grogs 'dun pa sogs nyi shu rtsa gnyis dang mtshungs pa ldan pa'i sems bskyed rnams te/ma na rtogs rgyan las/ de yang sa gser zla ba me/ gter dang rin chen 'byung gnas mtsho/ /rdo rje ri sman bshes gnyen dang / /yid bzhin nor du nyi ma glu/ /rgyal po mdzod dang lam po che/ /bzhon pa bkod ma'i chu dang ni/ /sgra snyan chu bo sprin rnams kyis/ /rnam pa nyi shu rtsa gnyis so/ /zhes pa ltar yin la/de rnams kyi dpe grogs sbyor ba'i chos mthun ji ltar brtsi ba'ang 'di ltar ste/byang chub la 'dun pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni sa lta bu yin te/ sangs rgyas dang de'i rgyu tshogs gnyis kyi chos dkar po thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pas so/ /de'i rgyun gnas pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni gser lta bu ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi sgo nas gzhan la phan bde sgrub pa'i bsam pa bzang po byang chub kyi bar 'gyur ba mi mnga' bas so /bsam pa de nyid ches cher 'phel ba'i lhag pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni zla ba tshes pa lta bu ste byang chub phyogs kyi chos sum cu so bdun sogs dge ba'i chos mtha' dag gong nas gong du 'phel bas so/ /rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes la dngos su sbyor ba'i zhi lhag gi sbyor ba dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni me lta bu yin te/ sgrib pa'i bud shing bsregs pa la myur bas so/ /sbyin pa'i phar phyin dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni gter chen po lta bu ste/ chos dang zang zing gi longs spyod kyisasems can thams cad tshim par byas kyang mi zad pas so/ /tshul khrims kyi phar phyin dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni rin po che'i 'byung gnas lta bu yin te stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs 88

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor sa/ ༷ na — — — lag ཿ ཿ la — — ཿ ༷ — pa'i yon tan kyi rin po che rnams 'byung bas so/ /bzod pa'i phar phyin dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni rgya mtsho chen po ste/ me mtshon sogs mi 'dod pa'i dngos po thams cad thog tu babs kyang yid mi 'khrugs pas so brtson 'grus kyi phar phyin dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni rdo rje lta bu yin te/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la yid ches brtan par 'gyur pas bdud bzhi rnams kyis skabs mi byed pas so/ /bsam gtan gyi phar phyin dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni ri yi rgyal po lta bu yin te/ mtshan ma'i rnam par g.yeng bas ting nge 'dzin las yid bskyong mi nus pas so/ /bdag med gnyis rtogs shes rab kyi phar phyin dang ldan pa'i sems bskyedasha sman chen po lta bu yin te/ chags sogs nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dang / gzung bar rtog pa sogs shes bya'i sgrib pa'i nad rab tu zhi bar byed pas so/ /thabs kyi phar phyin dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen lta bu ste/ snying rje dang thabs la mkhas pas 'byor rgyad gang gi dus su'ang sems can gyi don yongs su mi gtong bas so/ /smon lam gyi phar phyin dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni yid bzhin gyi nor byu lta bu ste/ yid la ji ltar smon pa'i 'bras bu mngon du grub pas so/ /stobs kyi phar phyin dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni nyi ma lta bu yin te/ ga/dul bya'i rgyud kyi dge ba'i lo tog smin par byed pa'i mthu dang ldan pas so/ /ye shes kyi phar phyin dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed3 dri za'i glu dbyangs lta bu ste/ gdul bya'i khams dbang dang mthun par yid 'dun par byed pa'i chos ston pas so/ /mngon shes drug dang ldan ba'i sems bskyed ni rgyal po chen po lta bu ste/gzhan don sgrub pa la mthu chen po dang ldan pas so/ /tshogs gnyis dang ldan 89

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/༷ ba ༷ ༷༷ ༷ ba la la — mi la la la ༷ ༷ ༷ ba pa'i sems bskyed ni bang mdzod lta bu ste/ bsod nams dang ye shes bsam gyis mikhyab pa'i gnas su gyur pas so/ /byang chub phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni lam po che lta bu yin te/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad gshegs shing rjes su gshegs par 'gar bas so/ /thabs shes gnyis dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni bzhon pa bzang po lta bu yin te/ srid zhi gnyis kyi mtha' la mi lhang bar mi gnas pa'i myang 'das kyi sar bde blag tu bgrod pas so/ /rang gi thos pa mi brjed par 'dzin pa'i gzungs dang gzhan la thogs med du 'chad pa'i spobs pa gnyis dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed sa/ bkod ma'i chu lta bu ste/bri ba dang zad pa med pas so/ /mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / bdag med pa dang / zhi ba'o/ /zhes ston pa'i chos kyi dga' ston dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni sgra snyan lta bu yin te snyan par bsgrags pas so/ /bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni/ chu bo'i rgyun lta bu ste/ gzhan gyi don du 'bad rtsol med par shes rab dang snying rjes ngang gis 'jug pas so/ /chos kyi sku dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed ni sprin lta bu yin te/ dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs ste/mdzad pa bcu gnyis kun tu ston pa'i sprin chen po las chos kyi char chen pos gdul bya'i lo tog min par byed pas so/ /zhes bshad par bya'o//bzhi pa sa mtshalas kyi sgo nas dbye ba la yang / bzhir dbye b.rang / lngar dbye bdang / nyer gnyis su dbye ba'i sa mtshalas bstan pa'o/ /dang po /rgyan lag mos dang lhag bsam dag pa dang / /rnam par yin pa ga na du 'dod/ /de bzhin sgrib pa spangs pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar/ tshogs sbyor kyi lam na 00

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma batshu'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ — — — — ཿ ཿ ཿ ཿ — ༷ mos pas spyod pa'i sems bskyed/ sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar du lhag bsam dag pa'i sems bskyed/ /dag pa sa gsum rnam par smin pa'i sems bskyed/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na sgrib pa spang ba'i sems bskyed dang bzhir bshad pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni nyi khri las/ las dang po pa'i sems bskyed dang / yongs su sbyang ba byas pa'i sems babyed dang / chos mthong ba'i sems bskyed dang /rnam par grol ba'i sems bskyed dang / bsam gyis mikhu bapa'i sems bskyed pa ste/ rab 'byor 'di la ma zhugs pa zhugs par bya'o/ /zhugs pa yongs su sbyang bar bya'o/ /lha'i mig bskyed par bya'o/ /'phags pa'i lam bden bsgom par 'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyan sgrib pa med pa thob par bya'o/ /zhes sa/sungs pa ltar ro/ /tshogs sbyor mthong sgom mi slob pa'i lam lnga'i dbye bas lngar shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa gong du bshad pa'i sems bskyed nyer gnyis po sa mtshalas gang dang gang la bzhag ce na/ rgyan 'grel don gsal las/ de la dang po gsum ni sang ngu dang 'bang dang /chen po nyid kyis las dang po pa'i sas bsdus so/ /de'i 'og tu gcig ni sa dang po la 'jug pa'i lam gyis bsdus go /de'i 'og tu bcu ni/ rab tu dga' ba la sogs pa'i sa bcus bsdus te/ mthong ba dang /sgom pa'i lam gyi spyod yul can yin no/ /de'i 'og tu lnga ni khyad par gyi lam gyis bsdus so/ /de'i 'og tu sems bskyed pa gsum ni sbyor ba dang dngos dang mjug gi sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus so/ /de ltar sems bskyed pa'i rab tu dbye ba ni/las dang po pa'i sa nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar gyis bsdus pa yin no/ /zhes pa'i don/ dang po gsum ni/ tshogs lam che 'dzing chung gsum dang / de nas gcig sbyor lam/ de nas sa bcu po so 91

rdzogasachen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ཿ ༷ ༷ la — na ༷ ༷ — — ཿ ༷sor sbyar/ de nas lnga dag pa sa gsum dang / de nas gsum sa bcu pa chos kyi sprin gyi sbyor dngos jug gsum la kun mkhyen chen pos gsungs go/lnga pa bzhed tshul gyi sgo nas dbye ba ni/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la bkod nas rang nyid 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa phyugs rdzi lta bu dpe med pa'i sems babyed dang / bdag gzhan thams cad dus mnyam du sangs rgyas par 'dod pa la mnyen pa lta bu ye shes dam pa'i sems bskyed dang / rang — nyid sangs rgyas nas gzhan dgrol bar 'dod pa rgyal po lta bu 'dod chen gyi sems bskyed dang ga/sum du yod cing / de mas kyang blo stobs che chung gis grangs med gsum dang / bdun dang / sum cu rtsa bdun nas sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur bar 'dod pa yin no/ /gsum pa byang chub sems kyi phan yon ni bas gyis mi khyab kyang /mdor bsdur/ spyod 'jug las/ gser 'gyur3 yi rnam pa mchog lta bu/ /mi gtsang lus 'di blangs nas rgyal ba'i sku/ /rin chen rin thang med par bsgyur bas na//byang chub sems zhes bya ba rab brtan bzung / /byang chub sems skyes gyur na skad cig gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bsdam pa'i nyam thag rnams/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing / /'jig rten lha mir bcas pas phyag byar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / dpal byin gyis zhus pa'i mdo las / byang chub sems kyi bsod mas gang / /gal te de la gzugs ma sa na/ /nam mkha' khams ni kun bkang nas/ /de ni de bas lhag par 'gyur//zhes dang /bzang po spyod pa las/ gang yang phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams mtha' yas pa /rin chen brgyan te rgyal ba rnams la phul/ /lha dang mi yi bde ba'i mchog 92

rdzogasachenasakhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ —— — — la la la ༷ ཿ — 0 ༷ ཿ ཿ rnams kyangad /zhing gi rdul snyed bskal par phul ba bas/ /gang gis bsngo ba'i rgyal po 'di thos sa/ /byang chub mchog gi sa su rab mos shing / /lan cig tsam yang dad pa baspyod par//bsod nams dam pa'i mchos/ tu 'di 'gyur ro//zhes gsungs pa ltar bsod nams mtha' yas so/ /gsum pa myur du sangs rgyas thob pa'i ga byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa bstan pa ni/ rgyas par gzhung las shes par bya'o/ /mdor na theg chen byang chub sems kyi sgor zhugs nas bzung / dge ba'i rtsa ba chaphra gang bsgrubs kyang rung ste/ sbyor ba sems bskyed/ dngos gzhi dmigs med/ rjes la bsngo ba gsum gyis zin par bya/ de yang kha tsam tshig tsam ma yin par snying thag pa nas sa/zhan don kho nar bsam pa ma gtogs rang 'dod kyi bsam pa spu'i rtse mo tsam zhig kyang ma 'dres par bya dgos te/ spyod 'jug las/ dngos sam yang na brgyud kyang rung / /sems can don las ga na mi spyad/ /sems can kho na'i don gyi phyir/ /thams cad byang chub rgyur bsngo'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /gal te rang 'dod kyi bsam pa skad cig ma zhib skyes na yang de ni byang chub sems dpa' la shin tu byu ba'i lhung ba yin te/ sdud pa las/ gal te bamakha pa bye ba mang por dge ba'i las las bcu/ /spyad kyang rang rgyal dgra bcom nyid la 'dod bskyed na/ /de ni tshul khrims skyon byung tshul khrims nyams pa yin/ /sems bskyed de ni pas pham bas kyang shin tu lci/ /zhes gsungs so/ /des na dus dang rnam pa thams cad du rang gi sems rgyud la brtag pa 'di kho na gal che ste/ spyod 'jug las/ de lta'i bdag gis sems 'di ni/ /legs bzung legs par bsrung bar bya/ /sems bsrung brtul zhugs ma gtogs par//brtul zhugs mang pos ci zhig bya/ /zhes 93

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i ga/sung thor bu/༷ la la la ༷ ༷༷ ༷ 0 la la ༷ — ༷ ma dang / lus dang sems kyi gnas skabs la/ /yang dang yang du brtag bya ba//de nyid khor 'dor na sa/ /shes bzhin bsung ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i gnang bkag thams cad kyi sa mtshalas rang 'dod kyi zhen 'khris yod med kho na la rag las pas rtsa ba sems la thug /sems mi nyams par bsrung ba'i thabs kyang dran pa dang shes bzhin gnyis srog gi phyir yang mi nyams pa zhigs da dgos pa lags te/ rgyal ba'isras po zhi ba lhas/ sems bsrung 'dod pa rnams la ni/ /dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dag /srog la babs kyang srungs shig ces/ /bdag ni de ltar thal mo sbyor/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di la sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa thams cad kyis khog pa'i nang gi snying bzhin du gces spras su mdzad dgos par bda' 'a sas/ /rgyal ba'i bka' gsang shin tu rgya che yang / /nges ba'i snying po byang chub mchos/ gi sems/ /gcig pu lags kyi 'di la chig dril du/ /nyams len mdzad na sangs rgyas lag ra yod/ /bdas ni thos nyung blo dman sbyangs pa phra/ /de phyir phyogs 'dir nyes pa gang bshad pa'i/ /sdig de thog med nas bsags las rnams dang / /lhan cig chos kyi spyan ldan rnams la bshags/ /gal te dam pa'i gsung gis bskyed pa'i cha/ /legs pa'i shas tsam 'di la yod srid na/ /de mthus mtha' yas ma rgan drin chen rnams/ /kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob phyir bsngo/ /zhing mang dag na rgyal sras bye ba'i bus/ /lham mer mdzes pa'i rgyal ba'i sku mchog dag /mthong nas chos mig rdul dang bral gyur te/ /kun bzang spyod pa rgya mtshor brtson par shog /ces pa 'di ni dge ba'i bshes 94

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ mi byed ཿ ke 4 4) — 0 — ཿ zu — ཿ gnyen dam pa gang gi gsung mi ldog tsam du theg pa chen po'i chos la mos pa thob pa'i btsun gzugs padma badzra du 'bod pas bris te phul bas bdag kyang theg pa chen po'i lam la tshul bzhin du slob pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa'i rgyur gyur cig //dge'o//maṅga ////7

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ ༷ ba ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ sa ༷ cha ༄7/ /dogs gnas kyi dris lan don rab gsal byed bzhugs/ /dogs gnas kyi bka' 'dri 'ga' re phebs par/ sngags dang rdzogs chen gang la zhugs kyang /snying sde dang byang chub kyi sems ma bsgom par thabs med pa'i tshul ni/ mdo rgyud rgya mtsho lta bu nas bshad pa smos kyis mi lang / bla ma'i man ngag kyang / mkha' 'gro snying thig gi mtsho rgyal zhus lan gser phreng las gsung tshul skyabs rje'i gsung sgos dgongs bzhin dang / paṇa chen bi mas/ mi rtag snying rje byang sems sbyang / kun mkhyen gyis/ snying rje byang sems bye brag sngon 'gro ste/ /theg chen lam du chos rnams 'gro bar byed/ /ces pa'i 'grel par/ theg pa chen po'i las ji ltar sgom yang de'i sngon du/ sems can la snying rje dang / de'i ched du sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa gces te snying rje phyogs med du bsgom pas theg dman du mi lhung ba dang / sems bskyed pas sangs rgyas myur du 'thob pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /de la thabs snying rje chen po dang / shes rab stong pa nyid gnyis ni theg pa chen po'i khyad chos te/ sdud pa las/ thabs med shes rab bral ba nyan thos nyid du thong / /ces dang / dbu ma rin chen phreng bar/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can//byang chub sgrub pa kha cig la'o/ /zhes dang / do ha las/ snying rje dang bral stong 96

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ba 4 ༷ ༷ ༷ la ༷ 00 0ba rsha da ga ba ba la cha sgepa nyid zhugs pa/ /des ni lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin no/ /zhes sogs gsungs/ sa ro'i theg chen rnal 'byor las/ /theg pa'i rang bzhin shes rab snying rje kho na ste/ /bdag dang sangs rgyas dbyer med rtogs pa shes rab yin/ /sems can kun la bu bzhin byams pa snying rje yin/ /de gnyis che chung dbang bis theg pa'icer par bstan/ /gang zhig de gnyis mi ldan theg chen khas 'che ba/ /long sprang nga nyid rgyal po yin ces zer bzhin rdzun/ /ces gsungs pa ltar lags pas/ snying rje byang sems bsgom pa ci nas gal ma snying rje med bzhin 'od phung du yal yang dgra bcom lhag med thob dang mtshungs pa de ltar lags/'on kyang rdzogs chen gyi gzhi'i bzhusas tshul la snying rje rang chas su yod tshul yang / rgyud bla las/ bde gsheg/sa snying po'i ngo bo'i skabs/ /chos snya de bzhin nyid dang rigs/ /rin chen nam mkha' chu dag bzhin/ /ces pa'i skabs/ snying brtse'i rlan dang ma bral bas chu lta bu gsung pa rnams de ltar yin kyang / de ni rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs kyi sa bon gzhi la yod pa ston pa yin pa'i tshul/ kun mkhyen gyis/ snying rje'i rang bzhin ye nas gnas pa ni/ /rgyas 'gyur rigs zhes bde bar gshegs pas gsungs/ /ma/sa pa ltar yin la/ rigs yod kyang de sad par byed pa'i rkyen snying rje yin pa dang / rigs yod pa'i rtags su lam la 'jug pa'i snga rol nas snying rje skye ba'i tshul/ mdo rgyan las/ sbyor ba'i sngon du snying rje dang / /sogs kyis bstan/ des na gzhi la snying rje 'byung rung yod pa tsam gyis mi phan/ lam kyi thog ma nas snying rje dang sems babyed mi sbyong ba'i thabs med de/ rgyal ba kun gyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam du nges pa'i phyir/ des na bde gshegs snying po 'bral rgyu dang / lam gyi shes rab dang 97
