rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badza'i gsung thor bu/ —4 ༷ zhe — — ༷ ཿ la ཿ ba — ༷ ཿ ba snying rje sogs bsal rgyu'am 'bral byed kyi rgyur bshad pa'ang yod la/ gsal rgyu brgyud rgyu gang yin kyang thog ma nas tha ma'i bar du bsgom dgos so/ /sangs rgyas kyi sa'i thugs rje dang phrin las 'dus ma byas yinan/lam gyi snying rje sogs 'dus byas kyi rgyu las 'byung lugs ma 'tshal gsung pa'ang / spyir 'dus byas 'dus ma byas kyi 'jog tshul bzhi bod de/ rgyu rkyen gyis byas ma byas dang / las nyon gyis bskyed ma bskyed dang / yid lus kyi skyob dang /bsam gyis mi khyab par bsgyur ba'i 'chi 'pho yod med dang / sems can gyi blo la skye/'gag ltar snang mi snang gi sgo nas bzhag pa bzhi las sangs rgyas kyi sa'i snying rje chen po dang /yon tan phrin las sogs rgyu rkyen gyis bskyed pa'i 'dus byas dang / las nyon dang / yid lus skye'achi gnyis kyi sgo nas 'dus ma byas su bzhag /skye'agag ltar snang mi snang gi sgo nas chos sku 'dus ma byas pa dang /gzugs sku phrin lasarang bcas pa 'dus byas su bzhag /dbyings ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang / chos sku la gnyis su bye ba'i zhi ba chos kyi sku gnyis ni bskyed bya skyed byed kyi rgyu rkyen gyis ma bskyed pas kyang 'dus ma byas su bzhag /bral rgyu dang bral 'bras/ bsal rgyu dang / bsal byed kyi rkyen sogs ni rgyu 'bras btags pa ba tsam las don la rgyu 'bras mtshan nyid pa ma yin no/ /des na sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus pa'i 'bras chos yin tshad 'dus ma byas yin pa'i khyab pa ma grub bo/ de ltar na bsal byed dang / 'bral byed kyi rgyu snying rje dang shes rab sogs 'dus byas la brtenanas/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bral 'bras sam bsal 'bras 'dus ma byas kyi cha rnams/ mngon du 'gyur ba mi 'gal bar ma zad/ med na mi 'byung ba'i 'byul ba grub ste/ dngul chu'i bsdus pa'i 98

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma batshulagasung thor bu/ ཿ ཿ — — — spyo — — gser gyi kha dog /mes ma sbyangs na snang du mi rung ba dang / shing sogs kyi pags pa dang sri ma bcad par snying po mi snang ba bzhin no/ /mdor na bde gshegs snying po la chos can rang bzhin du gnas pa'i rigs 'dus byas dang /chos nyid rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i rigs 'dus ma byas gnyis yod pa gzhi dbu ma bden gnyisacher 'jug chan la/ de nyid sngags bla med spyir/ rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes lus can kun byu snying la yod par bshad pa dang / rdzogs chen gyi gzhung las/ dbyings ga dag spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang du lhun grub nang gsal gyi ye shes ches phra ba/ shel 'od nang thim lta ra bzhugs pa/ gzhi lhun grub rin po che'i spubs su bzhed pa rnams/ 'dus byas 'dus ma byas sam/ stong nyid dang rten 'brel lam/ chos can dang chos nyid dam/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i bden pa dbyer mi byed pa'i mtshan nyid can du dgongs pa mthun pa can yin nam snyam du sems lags/ gzhi la de ltar yod pa dang rnam pa mthun pa'i lam bsgom pas/ 'bras bu yang / mos spyod du rjes mthun tsam dang / 'phags lam gsum du rtsal rim gyis rdzob/sa nas/ gzhi la yod pa'i yon tan thams cad dbyar ga'i chu bo bzhin rtsol med klong rdol du 'byung ba las/sa so//dge'o// //

rdzogasachen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gas thor ku/ ——— ༷ sa — ༷ — — ཿ — — zhe — ༄ga /dbu ma'i gtan tshigs lnga'i bsdus 'grel dri po sha ra'i zhal lung zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dpal shākya seng ge la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi rang bzhin spros pa kun bral ba/ /rtog pa'i yul min mtshan ma'i chos las 'das/ /don dam nyid de 'phags pa'i ye shes kyis/ /gnyis med tshul du ji bzhin gzigs pa lags/ /ye shes mchog de bskyed phyir rnal 'byor pas/ /thog mar tshogs kyi lam la goms byas nas/ /phyi nas nges 'byud drod sogs bzhir rim bzhin/ /zhi gnas bsgrub bya lhag mthong bskyed par bya/ /de la thog mar zhi gnas brtan bsgrub de yis chog par mi 'dzin cing / /khams gsum kun gyi skyoba'i 'byung gnas nyon mongs rtsa ba dbyung ba dang / /thabs shesazung 'brel tshogs gnyis mchog rdzogs srid pa'i pha rol 'gro 'dod pas/ /chos rnams kun la rnam par mi rtog lhag mthong le shes nyid bskyed bya/ /de rgyu thos bsam bsgom pa las byung shes rab te/ /de las re zhig sgom pa'i shes rab ces bya ba/ /phung po khams dang skye mched kyis bsdus chos rnams las/ /so sor brtags te de yi rang bzhin stong rtogs pa'o/ /brtags tshul de ya nga gang zhe na/ /lung dang rig pa man ngag go/ /lung dang 'brel ba'i man ngag las/ /byung ba'i rig pa mdor bsdu na/ /gtan tshigs chen po bzhi'am ni//lnga zhes klu sgrub yab sras kyi/ /rjes 100

rdzogasachen mkhan chen padma bza'i gsung thor gu/ — la ཿ la — ༷ la 0 ༷ ཿ ba ཿ ཿ ba la — ༷ 'brang dbu ma rnams bzhed la/ /de tshul 'dir sa nyung gas bri/ /de la 'dir skyes bu mkhas pa dag /lam dbu ma tshogs gnyis la brten nas/ 'ams bu dbu ma sku gnyis mngon du bya bar 'dod pas/ gzhi dbu ma bden gnyis gtan la dbab par bya'o/ /de yang don dam par bas pa thams cad bral zhing khas len med par dbu ma pa thams cad mtshungs kyang / kun rdzob 'di ltar snang ba'i chos thams cad tha snyad du grub par khas len mi len ga/nyis su yod/ mi len pa ni don dam stong pa nyid kho na yul du byas nas bshad pa dang /phyi rol pa dang rang sde dngos saba'i grub mtha' pa rnams dang rtsod pa'i tshe na dgongs pa dang dgos pa'i dbang las yin la/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ gal te ngas dam bca' 'ga' yod/ /de tshe nga la skyon 'di yod/ /nga la khas len med pas na/ /nga ni skyon med kho na yin/ /zhes dang / rtsod bzlog las/ gal te mngon sum la sogs pa'i/ /don gyi 'ga' zhig dmigs na ni/ /sgrub pa'am dgag par bya ba de/ /med phyir nga la than na med/ /ces dang / zla grags kyis/ji ltar khyod kyis gzhan dbang dngos 'dod ltar/ /kun rdzob kyang ni bdag gis khas ma blang / /zhes gsungs pa ltar kun rdzob tha snyad tsam du grub pa'ang zhal bzhes mi mdzad do/ /'dir lam shes rab kyi grol ba'i gnas skabs lam rjes thob pa tha snyad du yul du byed dus snang tshul tsam du mi 'gog par chos thams cad rten 'byung sgyu ma tsam du kun rdzob bden pa'ang khas blang bar bya ba nyid yin te/ klu sgrub kyis/ tha snyad la ni ma brten par/ /dam pa'i don ni rtogs mi 'gyu/ /dam pa'i don ni ma gas na//thams cad mkhyen pa'ang thob mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar don dam stong pa nyid gtan la 'bebs 101

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ba ba —— la ༷ ba ba ba mi ༷ ba da pa'i thog mar stong gzhi chos can nges dgos pa'i phyir yang khas blangs te/'grel pa tshig gsal las/ chu 'dod pas sgod ltar thog mar kun rdzob kyi bden pa sa ba/don mi za bar khas blang bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / 'jug 'grel las/ phyogs 'di ni mkhas pa dag gis skyon med cing yon tan dang ldan pa'o snyam du bsams te gdon mi za bar khas blang bar bya'o/ /zhes dang / zla grag/sa kyis/ tha snyad bden pa thabs su gyur pa dang / /don dam bden pa thabs byung gyur pa ste/ /de gnyis rnams dbye gang bi/sa mi shes pa/ /de ni rnam rtog lo / pa'i lam du zhugs//zhes gsungs pa ltar/ stong nyid la 'a ga pa'i thog mar kun rdzob kyi bden pa ji ltar snang ba bzhin khas blang bar bya'o/ /de nas don dam bden pa la 'jug par bya ste/ 'di ltar chos thams cad skye ba med cing rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid du gtan tshig chen po dag gi/sa gtan la phab cing chos thams cad stong pa nyid do snyam du bsgom par bya'o/ /de brtan par gyur mas stong 'dzin gnyen po'i blo de yang rang bzhin med par goms par bya'o//de ltarartas pa'i dgos pa yang /spyod 'jug/ las/ stong nyid bag chags goms pas ni/ /dngos po'i bag chags spang 'gyur zhing / /ci yang med ces goms pas ni/ /phyi nas de yang spang bar 'gyur/ /zhes bsungs so/ /de ltar yul gzung 'dzin byu shing bu mtha' dag yul can so sor rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi mes bsreg nas shes rab nyid rten med cing yid lakhyed pa med pa chos nyid bsam gyis mibs pa'i klong du zhi bar gyur pa de'i tshe 'bras bu chos kyi sku'i rgyu snang med ye shes kyi tshogs rlabs bo che yang rdzogs pa yin te/'jug pa las/ shes bya'i bud shing skam po ma lus pa/ /bsregs pas zhi de rgyal 102

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor gu/ — — — — — ཿ — — — ༷ — — zhe ༷ ༷ byu rnams chos sku ste/ /de tshe )ba med cing 'gags pa med/ /sems 'gags pa de sku yis mngon sum mdzad/ /zhes so/ de'i dus su dmigs pa dang yid la byed pa phra mo tsam yang yod pa ma yin te/ zhi ba lhas/ gang tshe dngos dang dngos med dag/blo yi mdun na mi ga sa pa/ /de tshe rnam pa gzhan med pas//dmigs pa med par rab tu zhi/ /zhes gsungs pa de nyid shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa yang yin te/ sdud pa lag gang tshe 'dus byas 'dus ma byas dang dan nag chos/ /'du shes rnam par bshigs te spang ba pha rol 'gro//zhes pa ltar ro/ /des na stong pa nyid mngon du byas nas bsgom par bya ba yang chos thams cad la so sor brtags pa sngon du 'gro bas yin gyig brtags min gyi 'gogs pa'i 'du byed btang snyoms dang shes pa lung ma bstan gyirang la bzhag/ pa tsam ma yin te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis/ gal te chos la bdag med so sor gas/ /so sor de brtags de ltar bsgomar ni/ /de nyid mya ngan 'das thob 'bras bu'i rgyu/ /rgyu ga na gang yin des ni zhi mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas thog mar so sor brtags pa'i shes rab 'di ltar bskyed par bya ste/ chos 'di dag mdor na gzugs dang gzugs can ma yin pa'o/ /de dag kyang rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa ste skyob med pa'i phyir ro/ /de cis shes/ gtan tshig chen po bzhi'am lnga dag gis so/ /de dag sa/nga zhe na/yod med skye'agog gi gtan tshig dang / rdo rje gzeg ma'i dang / gcig dang du bral kyi dang / rten 'brel chen po'i gtan tshig zhes bya ba'i bzhi po 'di dag gam/ yang na don byed 'gog pa'i gtan tshig dang lngago /de dag gis tshul ji ltar zhe na/ go sla zhing khungs btsun pa'i phyir/ slob 103

rdzogs chenasakhan chen padma badzra'i gaspyang thor bu/༷ ༷ 4 — la la ba la — la ba la rsha ba di 0 la dpon mkhas pa chen po di 2ka ra shrī lnga na'i gzhung 'di bzhag par bya'o/ /ji ltar na/ yod pa skyeb rigs min te/ /med pa'ang nam mkha'i me tog bzhin//nyes pa gnyis shar thal 'gyur phyir/ /ba/nyis na dag kyang 'byung ba min/ /zhes pas yod med ma'agogs kyi gtan tshig brte na te/ 'di na chos gang dag yod pa ni skyebar mi 'gyur te/ skyes zin pa'i phyir/ med pa'i chos kyang skyobar mi 'gyur te/ de dag rang bzhin nyid kyis ma grub cing spyoba'i rgyu med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis ga zhes pa'i phung po gsum pa ni 'di na 'ga' yang med do/ /de'i don zhi ba lhas kyang / dngos po yod par gyur pa la/ /rgyu rnams kyis ni ci zhig bya/ /'on te de ni med na yang / /rgyu rnams kyis ni ci zhig dgos/ /byu/sa gsungs so/ /tshul 'di kun mkhyen gyis mdzod 'grel padma dkar po na gsal bar gsung ste/ sna tshogs su snang ba 'di chos can/ ngo bo med par thal/ ngo bo yod med kyi skyob dang bral ba'i phyir ro/ /de'ang bum pa nyid bum par yod dus skye na bum pa grub zin pa'i phyir skyeb mi 'thad la/ med dus min med pa las yod par 'byung mi sod pas de mas 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /yang slob dpon gyis/ dngos po rang las mi skye zhing / gzhan dang gnyis ga las kyang min//rgyu med las min de yi phyir//ngo bo nyid ni rang bzhin med//ces bya ba 'dis rdo rje ga/zegs ma bstan te/ 'di ltar bdag /dbang phyug /skyes bu dang / gtso bo dang / las dang / rang bzhin dang / yon tan dang /tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / lha chen po la sogs pa phyi dang nang gi byed pa'i skyes bu dang / gzhan yang rang gi sde pa dag/ kyang rgyu drug dang rkyen bzhis dngos por skyebar khas len pa de dag sa log par rtog pa yin te/ de dag 104

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ la ༷༷ la la la la ba mi ba ba ༷ la la ba — dgag pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi zhal nas kyang / bdag las ma yin gzhan las min/ /gnyis las ma yin rgyu med min/ /dngos po gang dang gang la yang /skyobaram yang yod ma yin/ /zhes dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab las gsungs so/ /de'i don zla ba grags pas mtha' bzhi'i skyob 'gog pa'i rigs pa dam bca' bzhi mdzad de/ 'jug pa las/ de nyid de las 'byung min gzhan das/ las lta ga la zhig /gnyis na las kyang ma yin rgyu med pa ni ga la yod/ /zhes pa ltar las/ deng po rgyu rang las 'bras bu rang skye bar mi rung ste rang nyid sngar grub pas gsar du skyeba'i yon tan gsar thob med pa dang /rgyu 'bras gnyis su dus dang ngo bo rdzas rnams gcig pas rgyu skyed byed dang 'bras bu baspyod byar mi rung ba dang / nam yang rang las skyeb rang yin pa'i phyir sa bon srid mthar thug par skyeb las 'bras bu myu gu sogs mi skye bar thal te/ 'jug pa lag de ni de las byung na yon tan 'ga' yang yod ma yin//skyes par gyur pa slar yang skyebar rigs pa'ang ma yin nyid/ /skyes zin slar yang skye bar yongs su rtog par 'gyur na ni/ /myu gu la sogs skyob 'dir rnyed mi 'gyur zhing / /sa bon srid mthar thug par rab tu skyob nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /'di nyid mdzod 'grel las kyang / rang las skyob ma grub ste//bskyed bya skyed byed rdzas 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la rgyu gzhan las 'bras bu gzhan skye bar mi rung ste/ rgyu snang ba'i bdag nyid can me byu las kyang 'bras bu sgrib pa'i mtshan nyid can mun pa stug po skye ba dang / rgyu yin min thams cad las kyang 'bras bu yin min thams cad skye bar thal te/'jug pa las/ gzhan las gal ste ga na zhig 'byung bar 'gyur na ni/ /'o na 105

rdzogs ra mkha ra padma bas gsung thor sa/ — — — — — — — ga — — — me byu las kyang mun pa 'thug po 'byung 'gyur zhing / /thams cad las kyang thams cad skyebar 'gyur te gang gi phyir/ /skyed par byed pa ma yin ma lus la yang gzhan nyid mtshungs/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / mdzod 'grel las kyang /gzhan las gzhan nyid skyes me byu las kyang mun pa skyebar thal te ga na yin pa'i phyir ro//zhes so/ gsum pa bdag gzhan gnyis na'i cha las skyobar mi rung ba ni gong gi rigs pa gnyis kyis rim bzhin bstan pas chog pa yin te/'jug pa las/ gnyis las skyeba'ang rig pa'i ngo bo ma yin gang gi phyir/ /bshad na nyes par dag thog tu bab pa yin phyir ro/ /zhes gsung / mdzod 'grel padma dan por yang / rgyu yod med las skyeb rdzas 'gal bas ma grub pa'i shugs kyis gnyis las skye/ba kheg go/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa rgyu med pa las skye ba mi rung ste/ thams cad las kyang thams cad skye ba dang / sa bon ma btab bar skyeb dang / btab kyang mi skyeb dang / lo tog gi ched du zhing las kyi bya ba thams cad don med par thal te/ 'jug pa las/ gal te rgyu med kho nar skyeb lta zhig 'gyur na ni/ /de tshe mtha' dag rtag tu thams cad las kyang mi 'gyur zhing / /'bras 'byung ched du 'jig rten 'di yi sa bon la sogs ni/ /brgya phrag dag gi sgo nas sdud par byed pa yang mi 'gyur/ /gas te 'gro ba rgyu yis stong par gyur na nam mkha' dzi /ud pa la ni dri mdog ji bzhin bzung du med nyid na/ /zhes gsungs so/ /kun mkhyen gyis kyang / rgyu med las skyob ha cang thal te nam mkha' las utpa la skyebar thal ba'i phyir ro/ /zhes so//yang slob dpon gyis/ yang na chos rnams thams cad dag /gcig dang du mar rnam dpyad na/ /ngo bo nyid kyis mi dmigs pas/ /rang bzhin med pa 106

rdzogs chen ga ra padma badzra'i g.yo thor bu/ — ཿ — — — — byu ༷ ༷ ཿ — — — ci — chu nyid du nges/ /zhes bya ba 'dis gcig dang du ma la ba'i gtan tshog bstan te/ yang na zhes bya ba 'di'i donas bstan pa'o/ /gcig dang du mas rnam dpyad na/ /zhes pa'i don ni/ slob dpon zhi ba 'tshos bshad de/ bdag dang gzhan smras dngos 'di dag /yang dag don du rang bzhin med/ /gcig dang du ma bral ba'i phyir/ /rang bzhin med de gzug/sa brnyan bzhin/ /zhes ga/sungs so/ /de'i don ni/ rang 'grel rang bzhin yod par gyur na ni gcig pa'am gcig shos las mi 'da' 'o/ /de dag phan tshun spangs te gnas pa'i mtshan nyid yin pas phung po gzhan sel bar byed do/ /rang gi sde pa dang phyi rol pa dag gis smras pa'i phung po dang / gtso bo la sogs pa de dag yang dag par na medade/ rang bzhin gsal bar shes so/ /zhes gsungs/ de la thog mar dngos po 'di dag gcig pa nyid du med par shes na du mar med pa tshegs mi dgos par gas par 'gyur te/ du ma gcig bsags pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de skad du yang dbu ma rgyan las/ dngos po gang zhig rnam dpyad na/ /de dang de la gcig nyid med/ /gang la gcig nyid yod min pa/ /de la du ma dag kyang med/ /ces pa'i 'grel par/ gang la gcig pa'i rang bzhin mi 'thad pa de du ma'i bdag nyid du khas blang bar rigs pa ma yin pa nyid de/'di ltar du ma ni gcig bsags pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes so/ de ltar rags pa'i rtsom byed rdul phra rab rang bzhin med par bstan pa ni/ de nyid las/bsgrib dang ma bsgrib dngos sogs cir/ /rags pa rnams kyang gcig pu min//'byar ba'am ni bskor ba dang / /bar med rnam par gnas kyang rung / /dbus gnas rdul phran rdul gcig la/ /bltas pa'i rang bzhin gang yin pa/ /107

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor sa ༷ — ba — ba ba — — — ༷ba ༷ ༷ ཿ ཿ ༷ ga ༷ — ཿ ༷ ཿ — rdul phran ga na la blta bar yang / /de nyid gal te yin brjod na/ /de lta yin na de lta bu/ /sa chu la sogs rgyas 'a ra ram/ /rdul phran gzhan la blta ba'i ngos/ /gal tebashan du 'dod na di/ /rab tu phra rdul ji ltar bur/ /gcig pu cha shas med par 'gyur/ /rdulaphan rang bzhin med grub pa/ de phyir mig dang mas la sogs/ /bdag dang gzhan smras mang po dag /rang bzhin med par mngon pa yin/ /zhes pas so/ /rnam shes don dam du 'dod pa'i lugs kyis shes par yang gcig pu'i ngo bor med do/ /de nyid las/ bem min rang bzhin gang yin pa/ /de 'di'i bdag nyid shes pa yin/ /gcig pu cha med rang bzhin la//gsum gyi rang bzhin mi 'thad phyir/ /de yi rang ri rig pa ni//bya dang byed pa'i dngos por min/ /ces so/ /de yang shes pa'i skad cig ma de la 'phrad pa brtags pas/ skad cig ma rang bzhin med par shes so/ /yang yul gyi rnam pa bzhin shes pa'ang du mar 'gyur te/ rnam pa rnams dang ma bral bas/ /rnam shes gcig pu mi 'gyu ro/ /zhes so/ /de ltar gcig pu ma grub bo/ /de ltar gcig dang du ma bral ba de'i tshe de las ga na pa'i phung gsum pa ni 'ga' yang med do/ /de nyid las/ gcig dang du ma ma gtogs par/ /rnam pa gzhan dang ldan pa yi/ /dngos po mi rung 'di gnyis ni/ /phan tshun spangs tebasas phyir ro/ /zhes gsungag tshul 'di yang ma da 'grel las/don du snang ba chos can/ dngos dang dngos med gang du yang ma grub par thal/gcig dang du ma bral ba'i phyir chu zla bzhin/ zhes so/ /ga na yang slob dpon gyis/ stong nyid bdun cu'i rigs pa dang / dbu ma rtsa ba sogs las kyang dngos po rnams kyi rang bzhin ni/ /stong pa nyid du 108

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ཿ — ༷ spre — — ༷ — — ཿ — — ཿ ཿ — — ཿ 'grub par bshad/ /zhes bya ba 'dis ni rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i gtan tshig bstan te/ 'di'i don yang gzungade dag nyid du blta bar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de ltar yang / rtsa ba shes rab las/ rten cing 'brel 'byung ma yin pa'i/ /chos 'ga' yod pa ma yinano/ /de phyir stong nyid ma yin pa'i/ /chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin no/ /zhes pas/ 'khor 'das lam gsum gyi chos thams cad rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba 'ba' zhig las gzhan du med la rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gang yin pa de ni rgyu dang rkyen las skyob gzhan la rags las/ rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa snang dus nyid nas stong par gnas pa ste sgyu ma'i glang dang me long gi gzugs brnyan bzhin no/ /de nyid las/gzugs sgra dri ro reg pa dang / /yid dang chos dag 'ba' zhig ste// /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i phyir/ /dri za'i grong khyer lta bu dang / /mig rgyu mi lam 'dra ba yin//sgyu ma'i skyes bu lta budang //gzugs brnyan 'dra ba de dag las//sdug pa dang ni mi sdug pa/ /'byung bar yangs ga la 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /rgyu snga ma la rten cing rkyen rnams dang 'brel bar 'bras bu 'byung ba de ni rten cing 'byul bar 'byung ba yin cing / de la phyi'i rten 'brel dang / nang gi rten 'brel gnyis su dbye ba sogs rgyas par ni sa lu ljang pa'i mdo las shes par bya ba yin la/ 'dir ni lang nar gshegs pa las/ blo gros chen po ji ltar 'jim pa'i gong bu las sna ma byung ba de bzhin du thag pas snam bu dang / rtsid rkyang las re lde dang sa bon las myu gu dang / srub pa la sogs pa mi'i nan tan dang zho las mar 'byung 'di ni/ blo gros chen po phyi'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gam las phyi ma 'byung ba'o/ /nang girten cing 'grel bar 109

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma brdza'i gsung thor bu/ — — 4)sgo — — — — — — — — — ཿ — ཿ — ༷ ༷ — 'byung ba ni 'di lta ge ma rig pa dang sred pa las chos 'di dag la sogs sa nang girten cing 'byul bar 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i ming 'thob bo/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i rten 'brel gyi tshul legs par shes na chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i stong pa dang tha snyad tsam du brten nas gdags pa yang mi 'gal ba'i phyir lam dbu ma chen po rtogs pa yin te/ rtsa shes las/ rten cing 'byul bar 'byung ba gang / /de ni stong pa nyid du bshad//de la brten nas gdag pa ste//de nyid dbu ma'i lam yin no/ /zhes so/ /des gtan tshig bzhi'i mdo tsam smos nas/ lnga pa don byed 'gog pa'i gtan tshig ni/ kun mkhyen gyis/ shes bya rnams chos can/ dngos po ma grub par thal/ don byed pa ma grub pa'i phyir ro/ /skad cig gis don mi byed de/don byed par bzo dus 'gagasanas med do/ /rim gyis mi byed de/ skad cig rgyun khegs pas zhes gsungs so/ /slob dpon gzhan dag /rgyu la dpyod pa rdo rje gzegs ma/ 'bras bu la dpyod pa yod med skye 'gog /gnyis na la dpyod pa mu bzhi skye'agog /ngo bo la dpyod pa gcig dang du bral/ rten 'brel chen po'i gtan tshig dang lnga zhes kyang bzheng do/ /kun mkhyen gyis snga ma dag gi steng du rtag 'jig med pa dang / 'gyur mi 'gyur dang / chos bzhi 'gog pa'i gtan tshig gsum dang brgyad du bzhed de/ 'di dag ni mdor na rigs pa'i sgo tsam smos pa yin gyi gtan tshig bzhi'am lnga la sogs pa nges pa med de/gtan tshig 'di dag gis tshad mas gtan la dbab cing mthar thug gi don la mi bslu ba'i rigs pa'i tshig yin pas de skad ces 'o/ /de ltar na sngon gyi mkhas pa dag gi gzhung re re las kyang / rigs pa'i sgo 'pharayangs med pa /10

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gas thor bu/ ༷ —— — — — — — — — — — — — — ཿ — spyo — ཿ — dag 'byung bas so/ //'dir smras pa/ thub chen gsung gi ma dros rgya mtsho lag / /'ong ba'i legs bshad chu klung chen po bzhin/ /rgya bod mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs ches mang mod/ /nyung ngu'i gtam gyi zil thigs 'dis ci bya/ /'on kyang rang mnyam dang po'i las can 'ga'/ /rgya che'i gzhung la 'jug par mi bzod phyir/ /blo gros gsar bu'i sgo 'phar dbye ba la/ /phan snyam gtam gyi sbyor ba 'di byas so/ /'di la bdag blo rmongs pa'i skyon chags pa/ /nges par mchis mod mkhas rnams bzod par 'os/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i legs spyad gang mchis pa/ /rang gzhan shes rab skyeba'i rgyur gyur cig/ //ces pa 'di ni rmongs pa padma badzra pas so/ /bkra shis/ /dge'o// //111

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma brngo'i gsung thor bu/ — ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ — ༷ ༷ ཿ ༷ ཿ ba ཿ ༄ga /snga 'gyur rgyud 'bum gyis mtshon pa'i mdo rgyud spyi'i 'chad thabs ud pa la'i phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi mkhyen dang brtse ba'i ye shes kyis/ /shes bya'i chos khams mtha' dag cig char du/ /mnyam shing ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs pa ru/ /kun gzigs khyab bdag bla mas dge legs stsol/ /rnam dag thub pa'i gzhung lugs rgya mtsho la/ /sbyangs pa'i spyan ras yangs por gyur pa rnams/ /'di 'dra'i gtam gyi sbyor bas ci zhig mgu/ /'on tang blo gsar 'chad nyan spro ba dag /sbyor ba gtam gyis chos sgo 'byed pa la/ /thog mar dge ba 'chad bya'i chos ngos bzung / /greng gzhi ston pas ji ltar gsungs pa'i tshul/ /brgyud pa'i bab lugs 'chad pa'i go rim dang / /'chad pa'i slob dpon nyan pa'i slob ma'i tshul/ /'chad nyan bgyid pa'i bsam pa kun slong dang / /sbyor ba kun spyod dam pa gsum ldan gyis/ /phan yon dang bcas go rim ji bzhin bshad/ /de la 'dir snga 'gyur rgyud 'bum lta bus mtshon pa'i chos 'chad pa la zhugs pa'i tshe/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam mkhyen bla na med pa zung 'jug sku bzhi ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang sku tshe 'di nyid la 112

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/༷ ༷ la ba la ba ༷ ba ba ba ཿ 0 ༷ tha ga la la ༷༷ la — cha la mngon du bya/ de'i ched du zab gsang bla na med par rje'i theg pa'i rgyud sde zab morsha 4ma pa rnams gsan nas de dag gi brjod bya'i don rnams tshul bzhin thugs nyams su bzhes par bgyi'o snyam pa'i bsam pa byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang bcas pas chos nyan pa'i kun slong dang kun spyod rnams gsal gdab ste/ dran pa nye bar bzhag nas spang blang ma nor ba'i sgo nas gsan par zhu/ 'dir gang zhig gsan par bya ba skabs su bab pa'i chos ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po kun mkhyen shākya ser ge'i gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khya pa las gsang sngags rnying ma'i rgyud 'bum zhes yongs su grags pa snga 'gyur nang rgyud sde gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i rgyud sde rnams 'chad pa'i skabs yin/ de la spyir bdag cag gi ston pa gdul bya 'dul ba'i thabs la mkhas shing thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de nyid kyis gdul bya'i sems can rnams kyi khams dang dbang po bsam pa'i bye brag dang mthun pa'i chos kyi sgo dang theg pa'i rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa de thams cad spang gnyen gyi sgo nas bzhab/ na chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi ste/ kun byed rgyal po'i rgyud las/ nyon mongs 'dod chags 'dul ba'i gnyen po ru/ /'dul ba'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong gsungs/ /nyon mongs zhe sdang 'dul ba'i gnyen po ru/ /mdo sde'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong gsungs/ /nyon mongs gti mug 'dul ba'i gnyen po ru/ /mngon pa'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong gsungs/ /dug gsum cha mnyam 'dul ba'i gnyen po ru/ /sde snod bzhi pa nyi khri chig stong gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar la/ de thams cad rjod byed tshig gi sgo nas lung sde snod gsum dang brjod bya don gyi sgo 113

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapo'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ mi — — — ཿ — ༷ ཿ — — ཿ ༷ ༷༷ ༷ ཿ ༷ — ༷ ཿ ཿ ༷ ཿ ཿ ༷ nas mngon rtogs bslab pa gsum ste ngo bo lung rtogs gnyis kyi chos su gnas pa yin te/ mdzod las/ thub pa'i bstan pa rnam gnyis ma/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can/ /zhes gsungag 'o na gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa yang de dag tu 'du'am zhe na 'du mod kyi 'on kyang bsdu ba'i tshul la/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon rnams kyang 'chad lugs mi 'dra bar snang ste/ kha cig ni/gsang sngags mdo sde'i tshul du bshad kyis nyon/ /ces pa dang / mdo sde 'di yi gzi ba da kyis//zhes pa la sogs pa'i rjes su 'brang nas mdo sder 'chad/slob dpon bi ma la sogs kha cig ni/ sde snod rin po che gsum las mngon pa ste zhes lta ba dang shes rab gtso bor ston pa'i sgo nas mngon par 'chad/slob dpon kha cig ni sde snod gsum ga'i man ngag tu gyur pa gang zhig 'bras bu lam du byed cing thabs mkhas kyi khyad par spang gnyen tha dad du mi blta zhing lam gyi lus mi 'dra bar ston pa'i phyir thun min rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod ces sde snod zur pa zhig tu mdzad de sde sgod bzhi par bzhag go/ /de dag gang ltar yang don gyi ngo bo bslab pa gsum dngasang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i man ngag tu 'chad dgos pas na lam gyi ngo bo mthun cing thabs kyis khyad par 'phags pa kho na'o/ /de las skabs 'dir ni rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa lasabar par bzhi'i sgo nas 'phags pa 'bras bur rje'i theg pa nyid ston pa'i skabs yin/ de la lta spyod gtso bor ston pa'i byebrag gis bya ba'i rgyud dang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gnyis las/ bya ba'i rgyud la'ang bya ba'i rgyud dngos dang / de'i cha mthun spyod pa'i rgyud de gnyis yod/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la'ang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud tsam dang rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud gnyis te rgyud 4

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ — ༷ sko — — ༷ — ༷ — 4 ཿ ༷ ༷ — sde bzhir dbye ba dang / rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud la'ang nga gses thabs kyi rgyud dang / shes rab kyi rgyud dang / gnyis ga'i rgyud gsum du dbye bas rgyud sde drug tu 'gyur ba yin la/ de la kha cig bla med kyi rgyud la thabs shes kyi rgyud gang rung gis khyab pas gnyis med kyi rgyud cesacher du mi bzhed par snang ba / don la lam gyi ngo bo thabs shes ba/nyis las mi 'da' ba bden mod kyang / gdul bya'i da par las tshig yi/sa na tshod dang lam gyi dngos gzhi la thabs shes kyi phyogs re re dang / de dag cha mnyam pa'am lam derag las skyes pa'i ye shes gtso bor ston mi ston gyibye brag mngon sum grub pas rgyud sde drug tu bzhag pa la skyon med do/ /de ltar rgyud sde bzhi'am drug tu bzhag pa de dag las/ da res kyi skabs su bab pa ni gsang chen bla na med pa'i rgyud sde rin po che rnams 'chad pa'i skabs kun/ de la bod 'dir 'gyur snga phyi'i dbang gis bzhag pa'i gsang sngags gsar rnying gnyis su grags pa las/ 'dir 'gyur rnying ma'i ring lugs ltar sngags bla med kyi lam thams cad mdo sgyu sems gsum mam/ rgyud lung man ngag gsum du grags pa nang rgyud yo ga sde gsum du yongs su rdzogs par 'du ba yin la/ de las gsar rnying thun mong du bzhed pa'i bla med kyi rgyud sde rnams ni phal cher ma hā yo ga'i phyogs su gtogs pa yin no/ /snga 'gyur gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyud sde rnams phyogs gcig tu bzhugs pa la snga 'gyur rnying ma'i rgyud 'bum zhes yongs su grags pa 'di nyid do/ /gzhan kha cig phyi nang gi rgyud ste lnga'am drug tu bzhag pa rnams ni rgyud sde'i rim pa'i dbye ba las theg pa'i rim pa min no zhes rtsod pa ni tshig la rtsod pa tsam ste/ don la ni 'bas bu rdo rje'i theg/ pa 116

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ — — da ཿ da ༷ — — — ༷ — — ཿ ཿ ༷zhes gsang sngags mtha' dag theg pa gcig tu bzhag pa ni gsar rnying thun mong gi rgyud sde rnams dang / rgya bod kyi mkhas pa chen po thams cad la grags shing grub pa yin no/ /de ltar na spyis bye brag labs pa ni rigs par sab rnams bzhed pas/ sngar rgyud rnams spyir theg pa yin pa gang zhig /de la bye brag rgyud sde'i rim pa khas blangs pa'i phyir theg pa'i rim pa shugs kyis grub bo/ /'on kyang de la thegapa mchog dman du 'dod pa mi 'thad do zhe na/ de ni khyed rang rnams 'dod pa'i rgyud rje gur las kyang / dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de ltag ga /dbang po mchog la rnal 'byor rgyud//rnal 'byor bla medas ltag la'o/ /zhes rgyud sde bzhi po rang rang gi ched du bya ba'i gdul bya dbang po mchog dman gyi rim pa bzhi la dgongs nas gsung bar bshad pa'i phyir rgyud sde gong 'og tu grub phyin theg pas mchog dman du'ang grub pa nyid do/ /bla med kyi sde tshan nang rgyud sde gsum po'ang rig pa de nyid kyis theg pa'i rim pa yin pa dang / pha rgyud las ma rgyud nyid la zab pa'i khyad par yod pa rgyud nas bshad pa bzhin 'dir don gyi 'od ga/sal lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rdzogs pa chen por nye ba dang / shin tu nye ba dang /mngon du byed pa'i sgo nas dman mchog gi rim pa'ang grub bo/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir rang rang gi spyod yul du gyur pa'i mdo rgyud nyi tshe ba zhig lag theg pa rim dgu'i tshig zin dngos su ma byung ba tsam la brten nas nan gyis 'gog pa ni tshig tsam la rtsod pa kho na'o/ /de ltar theg pa rim pa dgu'i rtse mor gyur pa'i nang rgyud yo ga sde gsum po 'di nyid gang gis gsungs pa'i ston pa ni bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi 116

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ma ཿ — — ——ba — — — ཿ ཿ ga — cha — ༷ — — ma 0pa shākya seṅge nyid yin la/ de lasku gsum gyi snang tshul mi 'dra ba gsum las gleng ga 'i rim pa yang gsum ste/ 'jam dpal 'phrul bo ba'i bshad rgyud lag gleng gzhi rnam pa gsum yin te/ /'og min gnas dang ri rab rtse /'dzam bu'i gling 'dir grags pa yin/ /byang chub sems dpa'i lha rnams dang / /mi rnams kyi ni don du gsung / /ston pa yang ni rnam gsum ste/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen dang / /longs sku 'khor los ra ba dang / /shākya thub pa nyid kyis gsungs/ /dus ni gdulabya 'dul ba'i tshe/ /'khor rnams 'dus pa'i dus der gsung //zhes gsungs pa dang mthun par sangs rgyas nyid kyi ye shes chen po'i rang snang shin tu rnam par dag pa'i 'og min chen po na dbyings ngo bo nyid kyi sku dang ye shes chos kyi sku gnyis dbyer med pasang du 'jug pa'i bdag nyid ye shes kyi bye brag tshad med pa dang lhan cig zab zhi spros dang bral ba'i 'od gsal gyi dgongs pa las mi g.yo bar bzhugs pa ni dpal chos sku'i ston pa kun tu bzang pos 'khor nyid las mi ga na pa'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la chos 'od gsal brjod du med pa'i dgongs pa nyid dus gzhi rdzogs 'pho 'gyur med pa'i dbyings su sgra tshig rang mtshan las 'das pa'i gsung gis snang bar mdzad do zhes bshad de/ 'di ni gzhan ngor chos ston pa'i thog mar ston pa rang nyid ting nge 'dzin gyi bye brag du ma la snyoms par zhugs so zhes mdo rgyud rnams kyi gleng ga 'i skabs nas 'byung b.rang mthun pa ste/ ston pa'i rnam mkhyen gyis bltar thugs su chud pa'i ngos nas ba nag pa gleng gzhi'i dang por grub bo/ /de nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi rgyu dang dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po'i rkyen las gzugs kyi 117

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor ku/༷ ༷ la la ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ la ba ༷ ba ༷ la ༷ ba ༷ ༷ ༷ spyo ༷ sku rnam pa thams cad par snang bar mdzad nas chos kyi 'khor lo mtha' dag bskor bar mdzad pa las/ thog mar dag pa'i sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams la stug po'i 'og min dang / gtsang gnas kyi 'og min dang / ri rab kyi rtse la sogs par ston pa nyid longs spyod rdzogs pa rnam par snang mdzad chen po dang rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam pas rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg pa chen po bas gyis mi khyab pa rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lor ston par mdzad pa gleng gzhi gnyis pa dang / de'i bdag po'i rkyen dang gdulasa'i snod dag pa'i dbang las mkha' zla chu mtshor snang ba bzhin stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnams su ston pa thub pa'i dbang po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi mtshan dang sku'i rnam 'gyur mi 'dra ba du mar snang bas/ 'khor rnam pa bzhi dang dbang rnon sngags kyi gdul byar gyur pa rnams la dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs tshad med pa dang bye brag tu rdo rje'i theg pa nyid yang nas yang du rgya cher bsgrags par mdzad pa ni gleng gzhi gsum pa'o/ /de ltar gleng ga rnam pa gsum gyi sgo nas gsungs pa'i sngags kyi rgyud sde rgya mtsho lta bu de rnams spyir gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje dang bye brag rang rang gi sdud pa po rnams kyis bsdus te ji ltar brgyud pa'i tshul ni/ mdo dgongs pa 'dus pa las/ rgyal ba sems dpa' rnal 'byor pa/ /dgongs rig rna bar brgyud pa ste/ /gang la thug gi bar du'o/ /zhes pa ltar/ rgyal mchog kun tu bzang po'am rdo rje 'chang chen pos rgyal tshab rigs lnga sogs nyid las mi gzhan pa'i 'khor la dgongs pas brgyud de bshad/ rgyal tshab 1/8

rdzogs ra mkha byed padma ba gan thor bu/ — —byed — — byed byed — — — — — — sto ཿ — skyes bu rnams kyi rang rigs kyi byedas dpa' sems ma dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i byedas rnams la rig pas brgyudanas bshad/ rgyal sras rigs gabyed gyi sems dpa' dngabyed par gsang ba'i bdag po sogs kyis rang rang gi gdulabya rnams la rna bar brgyud pa'i byed gyis bshad/ de sa rim par chosargyal lung bstanardo rje'am byedaldan rgyal po dzaḥdang /byed pa'i ma dga' rab rdo rje sogs nas rim par brgyud nas bdag cag gi bla ma dam pa'i bar du byedacad dbang gi lag len ma nyams/bshad brgyud byed gi phreng ba ma byed/snyan brgyud gdams pa'i chu bo ma nub par byon pa yin no//brgyud pa de lta bu las byung ba'i gdams ngag ji ltar 'chad pa'i go rim byed byed gyi shibyed byed po dag gi phyag bzhes ltar gdul bya rnams babyed pa la rim gyis byedag pa'i byed gyis/ thog mar thun mong rgyu byedas kyi chos kyis blokha dbye zhing nges 'byung rnam dag gis drangs pa'i skyabs su byed ba gsum/babyed pa'ibyed lnga sogs so so thar pa'i khrims kyis rgyud bsdams/de nas tshad med bzhis blo sas te snying rjes drangs pa'i byang byed mchog tu sems babyed/ byedad rgyud sde nas bshad pa ltar gyis dkyil byed byed por bcug ste byed byed kyi rgyudabang legs par bskur/ de ltar byed pa gabyed la gnas shing rgyud dag pa'i gang zag de la blo nus dang mthun par rgyud kyi bshad pa 'bogs shing sngags byed gyi go ba byedas par bya/de nas snyan brgyud gdams ngag gi dmar khrid lag byed du thebs par gdams nas nyams len gyis byedas thog tu longs par / de dag gi rgyab rten du rgyud sde so byed bklag lung phog ste chos byedag rdzogasapar bya ba byed no/ /skabs 'dir khrid dang 9

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ — la ཿ — na — — — — — ཿ — — lung dang bshad pa gsum gyi khyad par dpyad na/ spyir btang tsam na de gsum ga don gcig dgos te/ thub pa'i bstan pa rnam gnyis te/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can/ /de 'dzin byed pa sabyed dang / /sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ /ces pa ltar lung gi bstan pa bshad pas 'dzin pa yin pa dang / sngon ston pas kyang bsam gzugs kyi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i gdam ngag gsan pa la de dang de'i lung blangs te zhes bshad pa dang / sde snod gsum gyi lung phog ces pa dang / lung nod pa dang / kha ton du byed pa dang / zhes sogs lung gis kyang bye brag ma bye bar bshad pa dang / rigs pas kyang lung ni lung nod pa'i don te/ rnam par dkrol zhing gsal bar bye nas don khong du chud par byed pa yin la/ khrid dang bshad pa yang de yin pas so/ /'o na lung tsam gyis kyang don nges par byed nus sam zhe na/ de ni ma nges te 'chad pa'i tshul dang dbang po'i bye brag gis bshad khrid kha cig lung byas pa dang 'dra bar don mnges pa'ang yod/ lung kha cig de dag dang mi 'dra bar don spyi nges pa tsam du 'gro ba'ang yod pa yinas/ /des na bshad pa dang lung gnyis gcig rgyun gcig gis 'dzin par nus sam snyam mo/ /khrid kyang gzhung lugs chen mo rnams gdams ngag tu shar ba dgos so zhes mkhas pa'i gsung las byung ba ltar na bshad pa dang don gcig tu 'gro mod kyang / sngags la tshogs dang slob ma la bshad pa'i tshul tha dad du yod pas de gnyis la khyad par yod cing gcig gis gcig dod mi thub pa'i skabs kyang yod srid dam snyam mo/ /de lta bu'i dbang khrid lung sogs gang yin kyang 'chad pa po rdo rje slob dpon gyi mtshan nyid ni/ mdo sde'i rgyan las/ bshes gnyen dul ba zhi ba nyer 120

rdzogasachen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor du/ — ༷ — — — ༷ ༷ — ཿ — ——— ༷ 00 zhi ba/ /yon tan lhag par brtson bcas lung gi/sa phyug /de nyid rab tu rtogs pa samakhas ldan/ /brtse ba'i bdag nyid skyo ngal spangs la bsnyen/ /ces theg pa chen po spyir ston pa'i slob dpon dang / bye brag tu sngags kyi slob dpon ni/rgyud las/ ston pa ma da ldan chu bo rdzogs/ /gnyer ldan rgyud dang las la mkhas/ /mnangag drod dang brgyad 'chang ba/ /zhes rang bzhin brgyad ldan du bshad pa rnams dang ldan pa zhig dgos so/ /nyan pa po slob ma'i mtshan nyid kyang dad pa brtson 'grus shes rab snying rje sogs gzhung sa bshad pa'i yon tan rnams dang ldan pa gal dza de nas slob mas ji ltar nyan pa'i tshul la thun mong gi kun slong mi dge/ ba dang 'dres ma'i bsam pa rnams dang /snod kyi skyon gsum dri ma drug bcas spangs shing /'du shes bzhi dang pha rol tu phyin pa drug tshang ba'i bsam sbyor rnam par dag pa'i ngang nas nyan/ thun mong ma yin pa ston 'khor gnas dus rnams la tha mal gyi snang zhen spangs nas phun sum tshogs pa lnga'i rang bzhin gsal bdab ste gsan pa dang / mdor na sbyor ba sems babyed/dngos gzhi dmigs med/rjes la bsngo ba ste dam pa gsum gyis zin pa'i sgo nas 'chad nyan gyi bya ba thams cad thog ma bar dang tha mar dge ba'i tshul gyis mthar phyin par bya'o//de ltar 'chad nyan tshul bzhin bgyis pa'i phan yon ni bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ thos pas las ngan gyi sgrib pa mdzad/ bsam pas shes rab kyi gter chen rdol/ bsgoms pas thar lam gyi btsan sa zin/ skyeb kun tu dam pa'i chos kyi snang ba dang mi 'bral/ gnas skabs su yang dkar phyogs kyi lhas bsrung / nad gdon dang bar chad zhi/ bsam dgu yid bzhin du 'grub/121

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapo'i gas thor ga — — — — — — — — — — — — sgo — — ༷ mthar thug chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang mngon du byas nas chos kyi rnga chen 'jig rten kun tu bsgrag par 'gyur te/ kun mkhyen bla mas/ chos rnga sgrog pa'i sgra thos sems can yang / /ngan song rnamagol nyan rnams smos ci dgos//zhes sogs gsungs pa'i tshul la bsam nas spro dga' mchog tu bskyed de nyan par sa /zhes sogs mtshams sbyar bar bya'o/ /rab dkar lhag bsam gangs kyi ri bo las/ /babs pa'i legs bshad phan bde'i rlabs phreng can/ /lhung lhung dpyod ldan rna ba'i dga' ston du/ /snyan snyan sgrog 'dis yid dbang sem gyur cig /gang zin tshig 'dis mkhas rnams ci mgu yang / /dam pa'i ces bu'i thugs kyi bzhed don bzhin/ /bris pas dam pa'i thugs dgongs yongs rdzogs shing / /skye bar chos kyi dga' bas dga' bar shog/ //ces pa 'di yang sprang btsun padma badzra pas smras pa dge'o//bkra shis//// 122

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor du/ — zhe — — ——ga zhe — zhe — — ཿ cha — — — — ཿ ༄ga /'khor lo gsum dang rig 'dzin sngags kyi sde snod bcas pa'i don bsdus bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'o lags/ bdag cag gi ston pas chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor ba ni/ bka' dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo/ gnyis pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo/ tha ma legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo gsum yin te/ de la dang po bden pa bzhi ni/ gang zag las dang po ba 'khor ba spangs nas/ thar pa thob par 'dod pa rnams kyi don du gsung ba ste/ 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid dang / de'i rgyu dang / thar ba'i mtshan nyid dang / de 'thob pa'i thabs dang bzhi'i dbang du byas nag bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di ni sdug bsngal gyi bden pago /sdug bsngal gyi bden pa ni shes par bya'o/ /'di di kun 'byung gi bden pa'o/ /kun 'byung gi bden pa ni spang bar bya'o/ /'di ni 'gog pa'i bden pa'o/ /'gog pa'i bden pa ni 'thob par byas /'di ni lam gyi bden pa'o/ /lam gyi bden pa ni rgyud la bsten par bya'o/ /gsungs pas/ sdug bsngal gyi bden pa zhes bya ba ni/ 'khor ba'i snod bcud gnyis yin/ de la dbye na khams gsum dang /'gro ba rigs drug yod de/ de thams cad phung po lngar ma 'dus pa med do/ /de ji ltar shes par bya / 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi mtshan nyid ni bzhi po 'di 123

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/༷ — — sa — — — — ༷༷ ba ༷ — ཿ mi yin te/ sdug bsngal ba dang / mi rtag pa dang /stong pa dang /bdag med pa'o//de la sdug bsngal ba ni/'khor ba spyi'i sdug bsngal la sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal dang / 'ag ba'i sdug bsngal/ khyab pa 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gsum yin/ bye brag 'gro ba rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal rnams so/ /mi rtag pa ni/ rags pa 'gro ba'i skye'achi/ snod kyi chags 'jig/dus kyi 'gyur ldog la sogs pa dang /phra ba 'dus byas thams cad skad cig skad cig gis 'gyur zhing mi sdod pa yin no/ /stong pa ni/ phung po lnga po 'di'i phyi nang bar gsum gang du btsal kyang nga'am bdag ces pa de med pasastong pa zhes bya ste/ dper na khang pa'i nangan mi med pas stong pa lta bu'o/ /bdag med pa sa/ phung po lnga la bdas gi mtshan nyid/ rtas pa gcig pu/ rang dbang can gsum med pas bdag med pa zhes ste/ dper na khang pa la mi'i mtshan nyid da pas/ khang pa mi ma yin pa bzhin no/ /de ltar sdug bden gyi mtshan nyid shes pa'i dgos pa ni/ /'khor ba la skyonas de las thar 'dod kyi blo skyob dang / bdag med pa la bdag tu 'dzin pa'i blo 'di 'khrul ba yin par shes pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /sdug bsngal gyi bden pa shes nas de mi 'dod pa'i tshe na/ de'i rgyu kun 'byung gi bden pa yin par shes nas de spang dgos pa ni/ dper na/ lus kyi tsha na sdug bsngal du shes nas de mi 'dod pa'i tshe/ de'i rgyu nad gdom spangs dgos pa lta bu'o/ /de la kun 'byung gi bden pa ni/ lasarang / nyon mongs pa gnyis so/ /las mi dge ba bcu dang / thabs kyis ma na pa'i dge ba zag bcas rnams dang / lhag mthong gis ma na pa'i zhi gnas rkyang pa rnams so/ /nyon mongs pa ni las de rnams kun nas slong ba'i rgyu ste/ rtsa ba dug gsum 124

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ — da — — — — da zhe — — — ba ༷ — — spre dang de las byung ba'i rtsa nyon nye nyon sogs nyon mongs pa thams cad do/ /nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba'am sa bon lta bu di bdag 'dzin te/ de la gas zagagi bdag tu 'dzin pa ces bya/ lhan skyes kyi bdaga'adzin cesakhya/rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi thogaca' ma rig pa yang de yin no/ /des na bdag tu 'dzin pa dang / de las byung ba'i las nyon dang bcas pa thams cad la kun 'byung zhes bya ste/ sdug bsngal mtha' dag bi rgyu yin par shes dgog kun 'byung gi mtshan nyid bzhi ste/ rgyu dang kun 'byung ba dang / rab tu 7ba dang rkyen zhes bya'o/ /de rnams rim pa bzhin/ dper na/ sa bon gyis 'bras bu bskyed pa bzhin/ las nyon gyis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' dag bskyed pas na rgyu yin no/ /dper na zhing sa las lo tog 'byung ba bzhin las nyon las sdug bsngal 'byung bas kun 'byung ba yin no/ /rma la khu tshul brgyab pa bzhin las nyon drag pos sdug bsngal chen po 'phral la bskyed pas na rab tu skye ba yin no/ /chu lud sogs kyi rkyen las ston thog 'grub pa ltar las nyon gyi rkyen las sdug bsngal 'grub pas rkyen zhes bya'o//de ltar shes pa'i gos pa ni/ nad kyi rgyu dug dang rim sogs yin par shes na de la 'dzemasashing spong 'dod skyeb bzhinas/ /las nyon bdag 'dzin dang bcas ba la spong 'dod kyi blo skyob yin no/ /kun 'byung spangs pas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las thar nas 'gogs pa'i bden ba mya ngan las 'das pa mngon du byas nas thob par 'gar bas na/ 'gog bden mngon dus 'dod kyi bsam pa skyedagos/ de la 'gog bden ni/ kun 'byung gi sa bon spangs pas sung po lnga dang bral ba'i zag 125

rdzogasachenas na chen padma badzra'i gas thor bu/—— — sto — — — — — — ཿ ༷ da — — med kyi dbyings 'dus ma byas pa yin te/ de'i mtshan nyid / zhi ba/ 'gog pa/ gya nom pa/ nges par 'byung b.rang bzhi'o/ /de la sngar yod kyi las nyon sdug bsngal zag bcas 'dus byas kyi chos thams cad nye bar zhi bas zhi ba'o//gnyen pos sa bon spangs pas phyis mi skye ba'i chos can du 'gyur bas 'gog pa zhes 'o/ /zhi ba'i dbyings te rtag tu mi nyamasashing zag med kyi chos dang ldan pas gya rnam pa zhes bya'o/ /gya nom pa ni skyon med cing yon tan dang ldan pa bzang po zhig la zer/ 'gog pa mngon du lan gcig byas nas phyis 'khor bar ldog mi byugapas nges par 'byung ba zhes bya'o/ /'gog pa/ thar pa/ rnam par grol ba/ myangan las 'das pa rnams don la gcig go/ /de shes pa'i dgos pa ni/ de'i phan yon ma yon tan mthong nas thar pa don du gnyer ba'i blo skye'o/ /de ltar 'khor ba sdug bden gyi nyes dmigs dang / thar pa 'gog bden gyi phan yon shes nas/ 'khor 'dasal blang dor byed par 'dod pa'i gang zag gi nyams su blang b.ras ba ni lam bden yin no/ /de la lam bden ni gang zag gi bdag med rnam par mi ga pa'i ye shes 'khor dad brtson dran pa ting 'dzin shes rab sogs dang bcas pa yin no/ /de'i mtshan nyid ni/lam rigs pa/ sgrub pa/ nges par 'byen pa bzhi'o/ /de la so so'i skyebo'i sa nas thar pa byang chub bar bgrod pa'i lam yin pas na las zhes bya/ de ni kun 'byung las nyon gyi gnyen por 'os shing rigs pas na rigs pa zhes 'o///des ni rang gi sems phyin ci ma log par yang dag pa'i lam du sgrub pas na sgrub pa zhes bya/ lam de nyams su blangar 'khor ba'i 'dam las gdon mi za 126

rdzogs chen sa chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ — — — ༷ — — — ཿ — — ཿ ཿ ༷ — — bar nges par dbyung ba'am 'byen pas na nges par 'byun pa zhes bya'o/ /de ji ltar nyams su len pa'i tshulas/ 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du shes nas de las thar 'dod kyi nges 'byung gi bsam pa drag pos lam phyin ci ma log pa ston pa'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhig btsal nas tshul bzhin bsten te/ de la gdam ngag zhus nas/ tshul khrims rnam par dag pa mig gi 'bras bu bzhin srung zhing / dben pa'i gnas su mtshan bcas mtshan med kyi zhi gnas la sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i gnas cha brtan por sgrub/ de nas bla ma'i man ngag bzhin lhag mthong btsal nas bdag med stong pa nyid kyi don la blo sbyangs/ zhi lhagazung 'brel gyi ngang nas sems nyid kyi gnas lugs gtan la phabs te rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la bskyed/ nyams zhen dang yid dpyod kyis ma slad pa'i mnyam bzhag gi ngang du/bdag 'dzin rtsa ba chod/ lta sgom gyi 'dzin stangs yal/ phra rags kyi rtog pa dag /rang mal gyi shes pa yul med rang gsal du rjen sang nge ma song gi bar du/ brtson 'grus drag pos nyams len la 'bad dgos/ de nas bzung ste rtsol med rang babs kyi ngang la/ yengs med gnyugs ma'i dran pas rgyun skyangs nas/ rig stong skye med kyi rang mdangs/ 'gag med ting 'dzin gyi rol par rtsal sbyang te/ byams dang snying rje/ dad pa dang dag snang / bskyed rdzogs dang bzlas brjod/ tshogs bsags dang sgrib sbyong / phyin drug dang bsdu bzhi/bsngo ba dang smon lam sogs don gnyis thab pa'i spyod pa thams cad/ sgyu ma mkhan sgyu ma'i rtsed 'jo la rol ba'am/ nam mkha' la 'byung bzhi'i cho 'phrul ston pa bzhin/ gshis )med las mdangs 'gag med sna tshogs su shar yang /127

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ — — — — — ༷ ཿ ཿ — spre — zhe ༷ — — ༷ ཿ ༷ — ཿ rol ba 'dzin med du grol bas/ bden gnyis nga 'jug gi spyod pa dbyer med kyi nyams 'kho/ tshogs gnyisar nga 'jug gi spyod pa/ thabs la mkhas pa'i sgo thams cad la/ chags med zhen med kyi ngang nas/ ji ltar padmo chu mi chags pa dang / /nyi zla nam mkha' thogs pa med ltar spyad/ /ces pa ltar chags thogs med par kyang par bya'o/ /de yang sngon 'gro'i khrid lta bu la mtshon na/ tshe mi rtag pa dang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bshad pa ni sdug bsngal bden pa shes byar bstan pa'i khrid/ las rgyu 'bras bshad pa kun 'byung bden pa spang bar bstan pa'i khrid/ thar pa'i phan yon bstan pa ni/ 'gog bden thob byar bstan pa'i khrid/ dal 'byor gyirten la bsam nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten pa ni lam bden la 'jug pa'i rgyu rkyen gyi rten 'brel bsgrig pa'i khrid/skyabs su 'gro ba nas bzung bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi mthar thug pa'i bar nas phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum la rim gyis bkri ba ste lam bden rgyud la bstesapa'i khrid yin no/ /des na bden pa bzhi 'di ni 'khor 'das gnyis kyi rang bzhin shes nas blang dor byed lugs bstan pa yin pas na/ lam thams cad kyi khog 'phub/ theg pa thams cad kyi spyi chings/ 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi lam po che yin pas mdo rgyud man ngag gi chos gang nyams su len pa yang 'di shes dgos pa'i gnad gal po che yin lags/ /de nas bka' bar pa'i skabs su chos thams cad rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum ste/ stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa gsum du gtan la phabs sa/ mtshan nyid med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i don yang / gdul bya theg pa chen po'i rigs can rnams la dgongs nas/128

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma banga'i gsung thor bu/༷ ༷༷ sa ༷ ༷ da ba ba rsha 0 ༷ ba — ༷༷ 0kun 'byung bden pa'i skabs su srid pa'i rtsa bar gyur pa'i bdag 'dzin nam bdag lta la/ gang zag gi bdag 'dzin dang chos kyi bdas/ 'dzin gnyis su bye nas chos la bdag tu 'dzin pa de srid pa'i rtsa bar bstan cing / de spong ba'i gnyen po lam bden gyi skabs su chos kyi bdag med rdzogs par bstan pa'i ched du/ zab mo stong pa nyid kyi don shin tu rgyas pa gtan la phabs nas gsungs so/ /de nyams su blang nas shes sgrib mtha' das spangs te/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mngon du mdzad nas nam mkha' ji srid bar sems can gyi don mdzad pa la rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong nyid bsgoms nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mtha' yas pa la slob dgos pas byang chub mchog tu sems babyed pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo mtha' yas pa bsgrub pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / tshad med pa bzhi dang bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi sogs thabs spyod pa'i phyogs shin tu rgya che ba bstan nas thabs shes ya ma bral bar nyams su len par gsungs pa yin/ /bka' tha ma'i skabs su yang / chos thams cad kun brtags gzhan dbang yongs grub gsum du legs par bye nas/ yongs grub don dam pa'i bden pa chos kyi dbyings 'dus ma byas rang byung gi ye shes nyid spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i mtha' bral dbu ma chen po'i rang bzhin du gtan la phabs nas bstan pa'i don yang / /dngos po bden grub tu lta ba dang / dngos med stong par blta ba'i dmigs pa dang / ba'i mtha' shin tu phra ba yang mtshan ma'i rtog pa dang yid byed phra mor bstan nas/ de lta bu'i lta gzhi mtha' dag spangs pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes sangs rgyas kyi 129

rdzogasachen mkhan chen padma bapo'i gsung thor bu/ ཿ — — — — — — ༷ ཿ ༷ — spyo ༷ ༷ dgongs pa'i spyod yul la'ajug par bstan pa yin te/ de yang kun 'byung gi gnasangan phra mo spangs pa'i phyir/ las bden zab pa'i mthar thug pa nyid bstan pa yin no/ /des bka' 'khor gsum ga yang spyir bden bzhi'i lam las mi 'da' zhing / de las khyad par du zu ba tsam du zad do/ /de nas gsang sngags bla med rje theg pa'i lugs la yang 'khor ba'i rgyu 'thas las ldog ste/ byu ngan las 'das pa'i rgyu 'bras la zhugs nas rnam mkhyen mngon du byed pa yin pag spyir bden bzhi las mi 'da' yang /nyams su len lugs la khyad par 'di yod / sdug bden 'khor ba'i snod bcud 'di rnams la/ gnas lugs dang snang lugs gnyis su phye nas/ gnas lugs kyi ngos sa 'jal na/ sna tshogs su snang ba 'di rnams la gzhi rang bzhin spros la rang byung gi ye shes snang stong bden pa dbyer med lhag pa'i chos sku chen por bzhugs pas gzhi lhun grub kyi sangs rgyas zhes ste/ dpe 'dam rab kyi nang gi nor bu bzhin du rang ngo rnam dag tu yod cing / sdug bden gyi dang bzhin 'gog bden du gnas pas 'khor 'das dbyer med ces bya'o/ /de nyid gzhi rgyud dam sbyong gzhi yin no/ /de ltar rtogs pa la 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba'am grub mtha' zer ba yin no/ /snang lugs kyi ngos nas 'jal na/ so so'i skyebos tha mkha rang rgyud du zhen pa'i snang ba la ji ltar snang ba'i phyi nang gi dngos po 'di rnams la ma rtogs 'khrul ba'i snang ba zer te sbyang bya yin no/ /de nyid sdug bsngal bden pa la bzhag go /las nyon kun 'byung gi bden pa la yang / rang bzhin shes pas lam du 'gro tshul dang / rang khar shor bas kun 'byung du 'gro tshul gnyis lag la du 'gro 130

rdzogasachen mkha chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ ༷ la la — mig — ༷ ༷ ཿ ༷༷ ཿ ༷ — ga ཿ — — ཿ ཿ ཿ tshul ni/ nyon mongs gang skyes kyang dgag sgrub med par kho rang gi thog tu lhod nas bzhag pas rtsal gzhi thog tu grol ba chab rom chur zhu ba'am/ rlabs rgya mtshor thim pa bzhin nyon mongs kho rang gi ngo bo spros bral gnyug ma'i ye shes su rjen lhang nge 'char/ de tsa na gnyen po gzhan ma dgos par nyon mongs nyid ye shes su shar bas kun 'byung lam bden du song ba la nyon mongs lam du byed pa zhes bya'o/ /lus ngag gi las rnams kyang ngo bo lung ma bstan yin cing / de dge rig tu sgyur ba'i byed po sems yin pas/ sems nyid gzung 'dzin ga'athas su ma zhen par gang shar gyi' bo ma bcos chos nyid stong pa'i rang 'gros kyirang du grol ba shes rab dang / sbyor ba sems bskyed khyad par can dngos gzhi lha sngags ting 'dzin gyi byed pas tha mal gyi snang zhen dag snang du 'char ba/ rjes su tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i nye lam du song ba ni thabs te/ thabs shes khyad par can de lta bus zin na las kyang lam bden du 'gro ba'o/ /kun 'byung du 'gro tshul ni/ thabs shes khyad par ba dang bral nas bsam sbyor gnyis na tha mal rang rgyud du shor na las bsas/sa nas 'khor ba mtha' med du 'phen pas kun 'byung gi bden par 'gro ba yin no/ /des na rdo rje theg pa'i gnad ji lta ba bzhin shes nas rtogs goms kyi gdeng dang ldan na/ sdug bden gyi rang bzhin 'gog pa don du shes nas/ kun 'byung lam bden du 'khyer nus pas 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras myang 'das kyi rgyu 'bras su 'gyur te/ spang bya gnyen por slong nas 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi rtogs pa mngon du 'gyur ro/ /de ltar shes na/ sor byang sngags gsum po lam bden gyi skabs spang bsgyur lam du byed pa'i rnam pa mi 'dra ba tsam las/3/

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ sa mi la la mi ༷ la — la ༷ la ༷༷ ma don la las nyon rangasatshan pa spangs nas/ sdug bden 'khor ba'isnang zhen dag ge 'gog bden mthar thug ma na du byed pa la gnad gcig pa canado/ /de'i phyir sngags lam yang bden bzhi'i lam las mi 'da' ba'i rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir bden bzhi'i don ston pa'i gzungs sngags rten 'brel snying po 'di nyid mdo rgyud man ngag thams cad na mchog tu bsngags shing yongs su grags pa nyid do/ /'khor lo dang pos dngos bstan bden pa bzhi/ /rten 'brel snying po tshig bcad gcig gi don/ /mdo rgyud man ngag kun gyi lam rim du/ /'gro ba'i legs bshad gsar pa 'di 'dra ba/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mkhyen pa'i chu gter las/ /dbyangs can lha mo'i sgyu rtsal gyis phyung nas/ /mkha bzang yid la rab dga' bskyed pa'i phyir/ /rgyud mang sgra las bdag la bsnyad pa bzhin/ /blo gros shar gyi ri bo'i ba gamanas/ /gdam ngag nyi gzhon 'od stong spros pa 'dis/ /dad dang shes rab 'dab stong 'tham pa las /nyams rtogs dri bsung phyogs brgyar g.yo bar shog/ //ces pa'ang padma badzra pas bris pa dge///132

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapo'i gsung thor sa — —— ཿ / ༷ mig ༷ — — — ༷ ཿ ཿ la ba༄ga /gsang sngags bla na med pa'i tant+ra'i don gyi rnam dbye gsal byed bzhugs so/ /brgyan rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang sngags bla na med pa'i tant+ra'i don gyi go ba 'di ltar shes par bya ste/ spyir rgyu'i theg pa las 'bras bu'i theg pa ni thabs mang ba dang myur ba dang shes rab zab pa dag gis bye la/khyad par sngags phyi pa las nang pa ni lta ba dang ting nge 'dzin dang spyod pas bye bar shes dgos/ sngags nang pa la yang pha ma gnyis med kyi rgyud gsum du dbye ba'ang / gtso bor rdzogs rim gyi khyad par las 'jog la/ de yang thabs rang lus la brten pa dang / shes rab gzhan lus la brten pa dang / thabs shes gnyis med kyi 'bras bu lhan skyes gtso bor ston pa'i sgo nas 'jog /gtso bor ston lugs kyang / ston pas rgyud de dang der dngos bstan rgya che chung dang / rjes 'jug lam pas mos pa dang dbang po'i khyad par gyis nyams len gyi gzhung shing gang la byed pa dag gi sgo nas 'byed pa las/ don la gang zag gcig gi nyams len du gsum kha rgyu 'bras kyi tshul du tshang dgos pa las gang rung gcig ya bral bas 'grub pa ma yin no/ /bskyed rim rgyas bsdus gyi sgo nas bye ba ni rags pa tsam las zhib par ni min te/ pha rgyud du grags pa gsang 'dus dang gshed skor/ ma rgyud du grags pa bde mchog /kye rdo rje//33

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma brdza'i gsung thor bu/ ——— — spre zhe — — — — — — ཿ 4 — — — — — sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ yang dag sogs dang / gnyis med rgyud du grags pa dus 'khor dang / 'jam dpal sgyu sa/ rdor sems rwa sogs la bskyed rim shas che chung gikhur par mi 'byung ba mngon sum pas gsal lo/ /de las snga 'gyur pa'i chos skad thun mong ma yin pa bskyed pa ma hā/ rdzogs pa a nu/rdzogs chen sa ti zhes gsum du bye ba yang pha ma gnyis med kyi rgyud gsum so sor thad drang du sbyar ba'ang 'ol spyi tsam te/ ma hā'i ta bco brgyad la yang nang gses kyi pha ma gnyis med kyi rgyud gsum du dbyer yod pa dang / de mtshungs ma nu dang ati gnyis la yang nang gses kyi rnam 'byed phra mo yod pa yin no/ /des na 'dir ni bskyed pa ma hā yo ga ni chos thams cad kyi gzhi lta bu/ rdzogs pa a nu ma ga ni chos thams cad kyi lam lta bu/ rdzogs chen gti yo ga ni chos thams cad kyi 'bras bu lta bu'o/ /zhes ji skad gsungs pa bzhin du/ pha ma gnyis med kyi rgyud sa/sum po re re bzhin yang bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gsum re yod par shes dgos so/ /sngags nang par gtogs pa'i lam tshang la ma nor ba zhig yin phyin/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed tshang ba'i bskyed rim zhig dang /gsal bde mi ga pa'i thabs la brten pa'i rgyu'i rdzogs rim zhig dang /thabs byung 'bras bu'i rdzogs rim mam rdzogs pa chen po ste lam gyi skyel so mthar thug zhig dang gsum med du mi rung ba'i phyir ro/ /'o na yo ga sde gsum la rgyud sde dang theg pa'i rnam bzhag so so ba mi rungasam zhe na/ rdo rje 'chang gis dngos bstan gyi lam rim rgya che chung dang / gang zag gis gnas skabs de dang de'i lam bgrod byed yin pas klan sa med do/ /lam gcig la yo ga gsum ga rdzogs dgos na rdzogs chen gyi rgyud las ma hā dang sa nu gol sar 134

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bza'i gsung thor sa — — — zhe — ཿ ༷ — — — — — — — ཿ bstan pa de gang snyam na mkhas de dang de'i lta bsgom la mchog 'dzin che na mthar thug gi lam la kha 'gyang ba dang / bya rtsol dngasal ba'i lam la slebs zin pa la bya rtsol gyi lam don med par ston pa'i ched yin te/ de 'dra ba de lam gyi thog mnges 'byung dang /grub mtha'i thog mkhye sab nas brtsams te/mthar thug theg mchog rgyal po 'di la thug gi bar du lam dang grub mtha'ikhye brag thams cad la thad ga thad po'i khyad 'byud re yod pa ni shes kyang gab yin no/ /de ltar spyir shes par byas nas lam dngos la 'jug pa / gdul bya'i gang zag rang rang gi khams dbang mos pa'i bye brag las pha ma gnyis med kyi rgyud sde gsum po gang rung zhig la zhugs te bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gsum gyi lam sa/nad tshang la ma 'khrul bar nyams su len shes dgos so/ /de yang de gsum nyams su len tshul la mtha' gcig tu 'dra ba ma yin te/ gang zag la dbang po sko rtul gyi khyad par dang / rnon po la yang rgyu dang sbyangs pa'i non po/ rtul po la yang rang bzhin dang las kyis sgrib pa'i rtul po sogs gdul bya'i khams dbang ni rgyal ba'i ye shes kyi yul ltar rgya che la/ de'i phyir slob ma'i rgyud la rtogs pa skyonges kyi gdams ngag 'debs pa la 'phags lam dang mngon shes thob pa'i slob dpon dgos par gzhung man ngag thams cad nas nan cher gsung ba yang gnad 'di gas yin no/ /de ltar gdul bya'i khyad par gyi lam bgrod tshul kyang mtha' yas pa zhig yod de/ mthar gyis 'jug pa dang thod rgal pa gnyis/ mthar gyis pa la myur bul gyi sgo nas rim gyis parang / gcig char pa gnyis/ thod rgal pa la blo stobs che chung gis thod rgal chung 'khrung chen po'i rnam bzhag dang / slob tshul gyi sgo nas mos slob dang 135

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ — — — — ༷ — — — ཿ la — ༷ khyu slob gnyis/ sa mtshalas gyi sgo nas zag bcas dang zag med gnyis sogs lam gyi dbye ba ni mang zhig yod la/ de thams cad lam gyir bo'i sgo nas thabs kyi lam dang / shes rab kyi lam gnyis su 'dus pa yin no/ /de gnyis kyi so skyes lam du gtso bor 'don lugs kyi sgo nas bzhag pa ma btogs gang rung ya bral ba'i lam gyis ni mchog 'a ba pa med do/ /thabs grol lam gyi thabs ces pa ni/ spyir thabs kyi phyogs su gtogs pa'i cha mang yang dngos ni dbang gsum pa'i lam yin no/ /shes rab ces pa la phyogs mang yang dngos di thos bsam sgom pa'i shes rab gsum chan no/ /des na thabs lam la shes rab kyis ma zin na 'dod chags chos su sab dbang phyug gi lam dngaltar med pa dang / shes rab thabs lam gyis ma zin na rgyu'i theg chen dang mtshungs pa las gsang chen thabs kyis che ba'i lam du mi 'grub bo/ /zhes rgyud las bshad pa ltar ro/ /thabs lam la dbang bzhi char 'jos dgos pa min nam/ ci'i phyir gsum pa kho na smos ce na bden mod de/'dir gtso bo ngos bzung ba yin gyi de'i rgyur bum gsang dang 'bras bur bzhi pa 'ong bas der bsdus pa'o/ /de bzhin du grol lam gyi gtso bo ya nga / dngos sgom byung gi shes rab mngon sum rang gsal blo'i yul dang bral ba yin kyang de'i rgyur thos bsam gyi shes rab dang grogs ting nge 'dzin dag bsdus pa yin no/ /de ltar na thabs lam ni lam gyi rgyu'am rkyen dang grol las ni 'bras bur 'ong ba yin no/ /thabs lam dang grol lam gnyis 'phags lam 'thob pa la gang myur zhe na rnam par bye nas lan gdabs par bya ba ste/ grol lam gcig char la ni thabs las gcig char ba las kyang myur la/ grol lam rim gyis pa ni thabs 136

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bza'i gsung thor bu/ —— — — — la ༷ — ཿ ཿ ba — ཿ — — rtsod bzlog bstan bcos mang zhig yod/ /brgal lan rtsod bzlog de rnams su//brtag pa gsum sogs tshad ldan gyi/ /lung rigs du mas ma dag tu/ /bsgrubs na pas na der ltos shig /de ltar lung dang rigs pa yig /rnying ma'i gzhung lugs mtha' dag kun/ /bka' dang bstan bcos ma dag tu/ /legs par grub par gyur pa na/ /de rjes chu brgya ma 'og dang / /lam brgya 'gag 'phrang gcig gi dpes/ /gzhung brgya rigs pa gcig nyid kyis/ /gsal bar grub pa ma yin nam/ /des na rigs drug ga sa 'dren dang / /rigs brgya'i tsaka gdub rab byung gi/ /rnam pa'i lha yis mtshon thogs sogs/ /las gyi gnad du mi che yang / /ga na don phrin las phran tsheg dang / /phyag bzhes mtshon byed drang don brda/ /cung zad mi 'dra'i khyad par dag /rnying ma'i gzhung las bshad pa yin/ /de yang rgyal ba'i bka' yin par/ /rigs pa snga mas bsgrubs zin to/ /rnying ma'i gzhung la grags na'ang / /gsar ma'i rgyud du ma bshad pas/ /de dag 'thad pa min ce na/ /rtags khyab gnyis na ma grub ste//ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud sogs nas/ /gnas nas drang ba bshad phyir dang / /ras bris sku gzugs bshad phyir dang / /mi 'khrugs chag bral sprul sku yis/ /mtshon cha rdo rje thogs phyir ro/ /gzhung lugs gcig la grags par/ /gcig dang mthun pa'i nges pa med/ /nyan thos pa yi bden pa bzhi/ /mu stegs pa yi lugs la med/ /theg chen pa yitshar chos rnams/ /nyan thos pa la ma grags shing / /rdo rje theg pa'i rim pa gnyis/ /phar phyin gzhung du bshad pa med/ /thabs shes rgyud kyi sbyor sgrol sogs/ /phyi rgyud rnams su ma bshad kyang / /des de log par ga la grub/ /de dang 'di dag mtshungs pas so/ /tsaka gdub dkyil 150

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor ga 0 mi ba na mi ba la la na / — rna 0 rsha na ba 0ba cha 'khor dod yin par/ /sems pa'ang spyod rang sa la bar zad/ /chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas/ /rabadabye theg dgur dpyad skabs kyi/ /tshig de deng sang sa skya pa/ /mkhas gru kun gyis cal sgrogs su/ /byed mod de yi go ba'i sa/nad/ /shes pa khyed kyi khrod na dkon/ /de'i don rdzogs pa chen po la/ /rtogs bya'i don dang rtogs byed thabs/ /rnam pa gnyis su dbye ba la/ /rtogs bya don gyi rdzogs chen ni/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes te//dmigs med brjod pa dang bral ba/ /de yi ngo bo'i rang ldog nas/ /ming tshig yi ge dang bral phyir/ /jod byed tshig bi theg pa ru/ /bzhag pa mkhas pa min ces gsungs/ /de rtogs pa yi thabs la ni/ /theg pa'i rim pa yod pa yin/ /ces pas rtog byed thabs kyi ni/ /theg rim dgu po shugs kyis bstan/ /'on kyang gsang sngags gsar ma la/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i ltag na ni/ /de bas mtho ba'i rgyud sde med/ /sgom pa'i dmigs pa nyid kyang ni/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i ltag na med/ /ces pas theg rim gong ma gnyis/ /gsar ma pa la med pa yi/ /rnam bcad dngos su bstan pa yis/ /de gnyis rnying ma'itshar chos su/ /yod pa'i yongs gcod shugs las bstan/ /rnying ma'i lugs la theg pa dgu/ /yod pa'i zhal bzhes ga nga 'di dang / /thub dgongs sogs su yang yang mdzad/ /de ltar rnam dbye legs phyes nas/ /mas na dam pa'i dgongs pa gas / /ga na du a ti yo ga nyid/ /ye shes yin par bzhed pa la/ /theg pa yin par cir bkag ces/ /khyed cag de ltar san ni/ /rgyan dang theg bsdus la sog/sa pa'i/ /gzhung lugs kun dang 'gal ba'i phyir//tsandan sol bar byas pa bzhin/ /mkhas pa'i legs bshad blo skyon gyis/ /dri ma can du ma byas sam/ /'di dang 'di 'dra'i rgal lan ni/ /rgyud lung man ngag 15/

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ la mi ༷ ༷ ༷ ke ཿ ༷ ཿ ཿ ཿ ba la ba 0 tha ཿ gsum sbyar zhing / /rigs pas 'thad par bsgrub pa yis/ /yid ches nges shes 'dren nus pa'i/ /shes byed dam pa'i zhal gyi lung / /mchis mod de dag shes 'dod na/ /rgyud sde'i zab gnad 'chad dgos pas/ /rgyud nas bshad pa'i 'chad nyan gyi/ /tshul rnams ji bzhin bsgrub dgos kyi/ /co 'dri rtsed mo'i rtsod len du/ /zab don gsang ba su zhig sgrogs/ /spyir ni snga 'gyur 'khrul med rnams/ /gsar ma'i dus su byon pa ga /lha cig jo bo chen porang / /kha che shākya shrī dang / /dam pa sangs rgyas la sogs pa'i/ /rgya gar grub thob mang po dang / /'gos lo gzhon nurapal ba dang / /thar lo nyi ma rgyal mtshan dang / /'bri kung rin chen dpal bzang po/ /rig ral jo nang kun mkhyen pa/ /grub thob 6rgyan pa dang ni//kun mkhyen tsong kha pa sogs kyi/ /mchog gzigs du mas rnam dag tu//zhal bzhes bsngags brjod mdzad pa mang / /so gshes rab 'chal ba 'gas//spyod parabyed pa snying rje'i gnas/ /de tsam du yang ma zad de//grub pa thob pa'i lag rjes su/ /sngon byon rje 'bangs nyer lngarang / /bar du socher gnubasadang gnyags/ /slob rgyud nam mkha'i skar tshogs tsam/ /phyis byon nyang ral chos dbang dang / /gling pa brgyad sogs gter ston dang / /na dpal rdzogs chen grub thob rnams/ /phung po 'od skur yal ba dang / /zung 'jug mkha' spyod grub pa dang / /gdung dang ring bsreg bzhag nas kyang / /sgra 'od me tog char dang bcas/ /rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing rnams su/ /phebs pa'i gang zag bgrang las 'das/ /grol rtags de 'dra mngon sum du/ /'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan nyams len chos/ /snga 'gyur yo ga sde gsum go /rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen gyi/ /nye lam zab mo yin phyir dang / /de la dam nyams bamakha rkun gyis/ /152

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ la / ༷ ༷ la la ༷ ༷ la mi ཿ ga ༷ — da ༷ ཿ la — rang bzos bamad pa ma zhugs dang / /rdo rje 'chang nas da lta'i bar/ /byin rlabs brgyud pa ma chad pa'i/ /rtags su mngon sum tshad ma'o/ /de phyir tshad ma du ma yis/ /tshad mar grub pa'i lam de la//tshad ma nyid du bzung byas na//gang zag nyid kyang tshad mar 'gro/ /lan ni 'di dang 'di 'dra ba'i/ /rtsod yig dri tshig spel ba'i rgyu/ /kun slong 'dra min mang yod kyang / /brtags na rnam pa gsum du nges/ /blo chung grags pa don gnyer dang / /snying nas chos la sdang ba dang / /rnam dag chos la sgro skur gyi/ /the tshom gcod par 'dod pa'o/ /gal te grags pa don gnyer na/ /grags skam snying po ma mchis kyang / /dam pa'i rnam thar gzhan dag gis/ /sgrub dang 'phral phug kun tu dge/ /chos dang chos min 'byed da lo'i/ /chos spangs las kyi sgrib pa 'dis/ /grags pa sgrub pa ya nga'i gnas/ /khe las nyen che spangs na legs/ /zhe nas chos la sdang yin na/ /chos la sdang pa'i gang zag la/ /thar lam med par thub pas gsungs/ /des na yang dag lung rigs kyi/ /thugs je'i dbyangs thag la brten nas/ /thar pa'i lam du zhugs na legs/ /cis kyang mi ldog spyod na ni/ /ston pa'i rjes su long ba bzhin/ /lha sbyin dang ni dpal 'dzin gyi/ /rjes la tsham tshom med pa ru/ /mchong ba sngon gyi las yin pas/ /rgyal ba'i phyag gis mi khog na//bdag dang bdag 'dras ci zhig bya/ /khyod la sdig par ma gyur ces/ /lhag pa'i bas pas smon lam 'debs/ /the tshom gcod par 'dod na ni/ /gong du bshad pa'i rtsod lan ga /yig cha de dag rnams dang ni/ /rnying ma'i gzhung lugs mtha' dag ga /shes rab gsum gyi mig sgrub dang / /som nyi'i gnas kun ldog pa yod/ /ga pa te de ltar brtag pa na/ /rgyal ba'i bga' lung dang 'gal zhing/ /gtan tshig rgya /53

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma brdza'i gsung thor bu/ — — — — — — — ཿ — — — — — ཿ she yis ma thebs pas/ /'grel pa bstan bcos ji snyed du/ /dgag bzhag spang gsum ma nus shing / /rtsod lan rnams su lung rigs kyis/ /legs par sgrub par ma gyur pas/ /yang dag lam du the tshom pa'i/ /gnas shig khyod la mngon gyur na/ /de tshe 'gal 'du'i rang bzhin gyi/ /grong tshig kha shag tsam min par/ /spyir btang dmigs gsal mas ldog dang /sel dang sgrub pa skabs byed pa'i/ /brgal brtags mkhas pas dpyad 'os par/ /sgrub par gyis dang de'i dus su//dpal ldan chos kyi grags pa yi/ /gzhung dang mthun pa'i lung rigs kyi/ /sgo 'phar 'byed par skabs phye'o/ /de las ga na du snga 'gyur gyi/ /gzhung lugs rnam dag ma mthong bzhin/ /blo gros cing pos dpyad pa'i gtam/ /hol rgyug byed pa dpyad 'os min/ /'phen ma mthong pa'i mda' 'phen dang / /dkyus sa ma bstan rta rgyug dang / /phyogs snga ma nges rtsod pa gsum/ /dpyod ldan rnams kyis khrel ba'i gnas/ /kye ma deng sang snyigs ma'i gnas skabs 'dir/ /rtog ge zol mas thub bstan dkrugs pas skyo /'byung bya mun pa'i smag la dgod mod kyi/ /nyin mo rtu sgra sgrog na ltas ngan yin/ /dpang gyur mkhas pa'i skye bo zad pa na/ /khyen pos bab col sgrog pa chos nyid kyang / /bstan 'dzin nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor bkrag 'bar zhing / /bshad sgrub 'od kyis phyogs kunakhu ba dus 'dir/ /'gal 'du'i rang bzhin gnag ji'i gtam zang ma/ /'dzem med gcer rgyug byed payem mtshang//deng 'dir log ga mun pa sun 'byen pa'i///brgal lan skya rengs dang po spros na gyis/ /ma brtags mu cor sarnams bag yod mdzod/ /phyis nas lung rigs nyin byed 'char tore/ /de skad yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag/ ske /mdo khams grub pa'i dbang phyug rdzogs 154

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ — — ཿ — — — — ༷ — — — — chen pa'i/ /bka' 'bangs yongs kyi tha shal snyom las pa/ /skyes thob skyangs pa'i blo gros na phra yang / /rang gzhan grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i mthar son pa'i/ /saba'i nyi ma rgyalasras chosarjedang //gtsug lag sgo brgya 'byud la zlasal ba'i//ga na nu 'jigs med chos kyi dbang po sogs/ /yongs 'dzin mkhas dbang du ma'i zhabs kyi rdul/ /spyi bar son pa'i mthu las legs bshad gtam/ /cung zad sal dbang ba'i klog pa ba//padma badzra zhes byar 'bod pa des/ /don gnyer can 'gas nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ /ru dam dpal gyi gtsug lag khang chen po'i/ /nye gam bsam gtan sgom pa'i khang bu nas/ /thun mtshalas gsum du shar mar sa nas springs/ /de las byung ba'i dge tshogs gangs ri'i tog /ston zla'i 'od kyis sa ltar dkar ba des/ /rang gzhan the tshom mun pa kun bsal nas/ /chos rab rnam 'byed blo gros 'phel gyur cig /ces pa'ang bgro gleng pa bsod nams bstan pas bris pa'i yi ge'i lan du sa sprel zla 12pa'i tshes1 la'o// //155

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapo'i gsung thor bu/ —— — —— ཿ — — — — — — sko — — — 0 — ཿ — — la — ༄za/ /rnying lugs bka' ma'i byin 'bebs kyi 'grel pa legs bshad sprin gyi rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /snang srid gdod nas dag pa'i dkyil 'khor du/ /yongs grub lhun mnyam rdo rje bkod pa'i rgyan/ /mi zad rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lo ru/ /ye bzhugs 'pho 'gyur bral ba'i dbyings la 'dud/ /srid zhi dbyer med mnyam pa chen po ru/ /dbang bsgyur ting 'dzin sngags rgya'i byed pa yis/ /rig pa chos sku'i klong nas ye shes byin/ /rtsol med rang babs rje theg pa'i lam/ /rgyud kyi dgongs pa grub pa'i man ngag gis/ /ji ltar bkral ba bla ma'i zhal lung bzhin/ /mdor bsdus ngag gi legs par bshad pa 'di/ /dam pa dgyes pa'i mchod par mos te rjo/ /de la 'dir snga 'gyur bana' ma'i sgrub phrin gyi yig/ rnying rnams las byung ba'i byin 'bebs babs drug 'das bzhir grags pa 'di nyid kyi dgongs pa 'chad pa la/ spyi don dang / yan lag gi don gnyis las/ dang po la'ang / byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub rnams gang gis 'bebs pa'i byed pa po dang / gang la dbab pa'i yul/ /gang zhig dbab bya'i byin/ /nam zhig dbab pa'i dus/ phebs pa'i rtags tshad/ ji ltar 'bebs pa'i tshul dang drug las/ dang po ni/byed pa po phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i bde bar gshegs pa thams 156

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/༷ ga — — — — —— — ༷ — ༷ ༷ ༷ — ཿ — cad dang rang bzhin dbyer mi byed pa'i rigs lnga zhi khro'i lha tshogs brgyud gsum gyi bla ma yidam mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas pa rnams so//gnyis pa ni/bdag ga sa yo byad gsum ste/ rgyud las/ ston pa mchod brtson gas pa gsal/ /dam tshig sngags dang phyag rgya rnams/ /ma nyams shes shing yo byad ldan//'grub 'gyur mi ldan don med brlag /ces gsungs pa ltar ston 'khor mtshan nyid tshang ba'i thab pa po dang bkra shis byin chags pa'i gnas su tshogs khang rim pa gsum pa sogs kyi gnas dang / dkyil 'khor thab mas sogs kyi yo byad rnams so/ /gsum pa ni/ bdag nyid chen po rnams kyi sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i byin rlabs dang ye shes rang snang gi ga la yas khang dgyes dgur 'char ba'i longs spyod dang bcas pa'i gzi byin dang bcud rnams so/ /bzhi pa ni/ cho ga lnga ni rdzogs byas shing / /yo byad lnga ni rdzogs par ldan/ /sngags kyi yan lag lnga rdzogs pas/ /ma nyams 'jug la rab brtson na/ /zhag sum bcu phrag drug gam/ /bcu gnyis bcu bzhi bcu drug gis/ /dbang bsgyur rigs kyi dam pa 'grub/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ stong chen/snying rje ma/ phyag rgya gcig pa phra rags gnyis/ phyag rgya spros bcas kyi cho ga lnga la gsal brtan gyi tshad rdzogs pas ting 'dzin las su rung bar gyur pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ bza' btung / gos rgyan/ bro gar/ gru tshig /sbyor sgrol gyi yo byad lnga tshang zhing rdzogs pa'i sgo nas/lha sngags 'phro 'du sngags kyi yan lag lnga dang ldan pas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig ma nyams par sgrub pa la 'jug cing zhugs nas kyang / rim gnyis kyi nyams len la rab tu brtson na dbang po'i khyad par gyis zla drug sogs kyis dngos grub thob pa'i dus bstan pa ltar/157

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ mi 'a rma cha — — la ༷ la sa ba byin dbab pa'i dus kyang de yin te/ dbang thob cing dam tshig la solam zhugs pa'i sgrub pa po mched lcag rnams kyis/ sgrub pa'i dal dang / rdzas rnams ga nga bzhin bshams te/ rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin la gsal brtan thob pas/ sgrub pa chen po'i cho ga yan lag ma nyams pa la tshul bzhin du zhugs pa na rgyal bsras dang bcas pasasras dang spun du dgongs shing /mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyis gas dang rje dpon du mthong nas byin gyis rlobs shing dngos grub ster ba'i dus yin no/ /dbang dus su byin dbab pa yangades mtshon te/ rdo rje slob dpon lta dgongs dang ldan pas/ slob ma sgod du rung zhing dam tshog gtsang ba la/ dbang gi cho ga yan lag ma nyams par gzhung bzhin du sgrub pa'i tshe na byin gyis rlob pa'i dus yin no/ /'di ni gal che ste tshig don gyi skabs su yang dus la babs so zhes lan drug tu gsol ba'i dus ni 'di kho na ste/ gzhan du ye shes pa 'bebs pa'i rgyu tshogs gang dang yang mi ldan bzhin du dus la babs so zhes yang dang yang du bamakha kyang lha dang mkha' 'gro'i thugs kyis khrel ba'i rgyu las ci yang med do/ /lnga pa ni/ sku'i byin phebs gas su lus 'phar g.yo dang zhi khro'i nyams gar gyi 'gyur ba 'char zhing 'byung bzhi'i rdzu 'phrul ston nus pa dang / gsung phebs rtags su sngags dang se skyo ta'i skad sogs bcos min byung rgyal du 'byung ba dang thugs phebs gas su bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams 'bar ba dang / ting nge 'dzin dang mngon shes kyi khyad par du ma 'char ba/ gzhan yang thub mas 'phel ba/ sman rag khol zhing gnas khang gzi byin dang ldan pa sogs 'byung ngo / /drug pa ni/ rnal 'byor pho mo rnams zhi khro'i gar chas dang ldan pas 158

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma batsha'i gsung thor bu/ mi la ba zhe ba ba ༷ ba ༷ ga ཿ la ba dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' nas bskor te/ g.yab dang hasta sos/sa kyis g.yob cing khyad par gyi spos lasogs brtul/ 'bud rdung dkrol ba'i rol mo'i bye brag rnams sbir/ bshugs pa'i glu dang gar gyi brdas bskul te/ mnyam pa chen po'i dgongs spyod la gnasapas byin dbab par bya'o/ /gnyis pa yan lag gi don la/ rdo rje'i glus bskulate/ snyan gsan dbab pa dang / byin dbab pa dngos gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ cha / zhes zhi khro'i gas mgo 'dren pa ste/ yig 'tha so sos sku lnga ye shes lnga sogs 'bas chos nyer lnga mtshon pas rang bzhin lhun grub kyi dkyil 'khor dbyings dang yeshes gnyis su med pa'i bdag nyid dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi 'char gzhi chen po'i dgongs pa rang gas gdab pa'o/ /ma la la ho zhes de la ngom zhing ngo mtshar ba ste zhi khro so so'i che ba'i yon tan la jom pa'am/ dbyings ye ji bzhin pa'i dkyil 'khor las ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor rtsol med rang byung bde ba chen por shar ba la ngo mtshar zhing nges pa skyes pa'o/ /snya ga lhan sa/bcom ldan 'das zhes dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag po la bod pa ste/bdud bzhi bcom pa spang ba'i yon tan dang / dbang phyug sogs dang ldan pa rtogs pa'i yon tan/ srid zhi'i mtha' las 'das pa che ba'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /sa ma ya ho/ zhes pa dam tshig la dgyes par mdzod ces thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba ste/ gdul bya 'dul ba'i phrin las dus las ma yol bar mdzad pa'i sngon gyi dam bca' la nye bar dgongs shig ces mkhyen par gsol bas /sa ma ya ste/ zhes pa khyod kyi dus la babs zhes dus gsol ba'o/ /de ltar bathal ba'i sgra byung ma thag tu/ chos kyi dbyings rtsol rtog 159

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gagang thor du/ la ༷ ba ༷ ༷ ba la ba la khye la 0 tha ༷ mi mnga' ba'i ngang las thugs rje chen po'i dbang gis ye shes kyi 'khor lo gang 'dul zhi khro'i rol gar nam mkha' khyab par 'char zhing sad par 'gyur ba ni rgyal ba rnams kyi ma 'dres pa'i chos nyid do/ /gnyis pa byin dbab pa dang / bsdu ba gnyis las/ dang po la/ dus gsol ba'i sgo nas thugs rje bags ba dang / nye ba'i tshig dang sbyar te 'dod don zhu ba/ don bsdus te gsol ba gdab pa dang gsu las/ /dang po la'ang / thugs rje spyir bskul ba dang / 'dod don khyad par can la bye brag rtsabaphal ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/'phags mchog sogs rkang pa gnyis te/ de yang spyir so so'i skyebo'i 'ching ba las grol ba'i 'das lam mngon gyur gyi 'phags pa la nyan rang theg chen gyi 'phags pa gsum/ theg chen 'phags pa la'ang slob lam sar gnas kyi byang sems 'phags pa dang / spang rtogs mthar phyin gyi sangs rgyas 'phags pa gnyis te/ bzhi las/ 'dir 'phags pa mchog bi/ sgras sangs rgyas 'phags pa yin zhing / de yang sku lnga le shes drug gi rang bzhin kha sbyor gyi yan lag bdun dang ldan pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang ngam te ru na ste dkyil 'khor gyi dbang phyug la bya'o/ /gtso bo bskul bas 'khor rnams zhar la bskul bar 'gyur te 'khor los ra rgyal gang du phebs pa der/ dpung tshogs bzhi shugs kyis lhags pa bzhin no/ /thugs rje la dbye na/ rim gsum las/ rtag rgyun rang bzhin shugs gsol dang / /yul dang phrad nas 'byung bar snang / /zhes pa ltar/rtag pa rgyun gyi thugs rje dus las mi yol ba chu bo'i rgyun lta bu/rang bzhin shugs kyi thugs rje rtsol rtog med par ngang gis 'byung ba nyi ma'i 'od zer lta bu/ bskul zhing gsol ba gdab pa'i thugs rje snying rje can la 160

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ 4 mi ༷ zhe la la ba la ༷༷ — ga ga la na mi 0 la ཿ — dza dbul pos nor slong ba lta bu/ gdul bya'i yul dang phrad pa'i thugs rje mdzangs pas spyod log byed pa mthong ba'am/ dpal chen pos ru tra la thugs rje skyes pa lta bu ste bzhi las 'dir bzhi ga ste/ gang bakhrul bar bya ba sangs rgyas rnams kyi rang bzhin shugs kyi thugs rje sems can gyi khams la rtag par rgyun gyis 'jug pa la/ gang gis bskul ba po gdul bya dus la babs pa/rma smin pa mtshon gyis brtol ran pa lta bu'i gang zag gas snying nas gdung shugs drag pos bskul zhing gsol ba gdab pa na thugs rje chen po mi skye ba'i dbang med de rgyu rkyen tshogs pa'i 'bras bu bzhin no/ /de yang gdulas dus la ma bab na 'dul byed kyi thugs rje mi 'jug pas dus la babs pa gtso che ste/rgya mtsho chu srin rnams kyi gnas/ /dus las yol bar 'gyur kyang srid/ /gdul bar bya ba'i sras rnams la/ /sangs rgyas dus las gol ba med/ /ces pa ltar ro///de la dus ni gong du smos pa ltar sgrub pa po dbang gis byun pa/ dam tshig dag pa/ bskyed rdzogs brtan pa/ ga rdzas tshang ba/ yo byad 'byor ba/ sgrub pa'i cho ga yan lag ma nyams pa sa le lo gnyid chang sogs kyi dbang du mi gtong bar brtson pas sgrub la 'jug pa rnams nang 'dzoms pa na byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub thams cad 'byung ba'i dus yin pas/ dus la babs so zhes brjod pa'ang skabs su bab par 'gyur ba nyid do/ /dus gsol ba 'og ma rnams la yangade bzhin du shes par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu 'phags pa mchog gi thugs rje bskulanas cis zhe na/khyad par bstan pa'i dus la babs//smos te/ khyad par can gyi 'dul bya'i yul gsang ba zab mo'i lam gyi snod du rung ba rnams kyis/ khyad par can gyi gdul byed zab mo bsnyen sgrub yan lag 161
