rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ཿ — ba ༷ la ༷ ཿ 0 ཿ ཿ ཿ chu ཿ bzhi'i gzhung bsrang bas khyad par can gyi mthu byin dbang dang dngos grub thams cad dus phyi mar mi sdod par da lta nyid du bstan pa'i dus la babs so zhes gsol ba'o/ /gnyis pa las/ khyad par bstan pa de'ang gang zhe na/ nus pa mthu yikhyad par/ byin gyis rlabs kyi khyad par/ yin pa dbang gi khyad par/'bras bu dngos grub kyi khyad par dang bzhi ste go rim bzhin/ dang po lam gyi 'gal rkyen bsal ba dang / gnyis pa lam rgyud la skyoba'i snod rung du byed pa dang / gsum pa lam la rang dbang du bya ba dang / bzhi pa lam des grub pa'i gnas ma sa dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu bstan pa ste/ de dag ni rgyu 'bras don gyi go rim yin no/ /de la dang po / mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la babs /zhes pa ste/ rgyal ba thugs rje'i bdag nyid can khyed rnams la mnga' ba'i spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul dang stobs la sogs pa'i mthu dang nus pa'i rtsal chen po dbyung ba ste phyung ba'i dus la babs so/ /zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ byin gyis rlobs pa'i dus la babs/ /zhes pa ste/ gser 'gyur gyi rtsis lcags khams gser du byed pa ltar rdo rje gsum gyi byin chen pos bdag cag gi sgo gsum rgyal ba'i gsang ba gsum du zla pa'i dus la babs so/ /zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dbang mchog bskur ba'i dus la babs/ /zhes pa ste/ gzhi dus kyi rtsa rlung thig le gnyug ma ye shes kyi khams dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi po lam bskyed rdzogs yan lag bzhi'i rim pas sbyangs te/ 'bras bu rdo rje bzhi'i rgyal thabs la dbang bskur ba'i dus la babs so/ /zhes pa'o/ /bzhipa ni/ dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la babs/ /zhes pa ste/ smin grol zab mo'i lam la bslab pa'i 'thas bu grub pa brgyad sogs thun mong dang / rig 'dzin bzhi 162

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ཿ — — — — —— ཿ 0 — ba ཿ ཿ — cha dang kha sbyor bdun sogs gnas skabs dang mthar thug mchog gi dngos grub thams cad dus 'di nyid du stsol ba'i dus la babs so/ /zhes pa'o//gnyis pa nye tshig dang sbyar te 'dod don zhu ba la'ang / dus gsol ba'i go rim dang mtshungs par bzhi ste/ 'gal rkyen bsal ba/ byin gyis rlabs pa/ dbang bskur ba/ dngos grub stsol bar zhu ba dang bzhi las/ dang po/ mthu chen bdud 'dul bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes smos te/ mthu stobs chen po'i rtsal gyis dngos grub la bar du gcod pa'i bdud dang dam sri phyi nang gsang ba'i ru tra'i sde dpung spyi dang bye brag dbang bzhi'i lam gyi sbyang byar gyur pa'i sgrib bzhi'i sa bon bcom ste gsang ba'i bdud bzhi thul bar mdzod cig bcom ldan 'das zhes nye ba'i tshig gis bos te thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba ni 'og ma gsum la yang shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ byin chen byin phob bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes pa ste/'bras chos nyi shu rtsa lngas bsdus pa'i mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i byin rlabs kyi dbyig chen po dang ldan pa khyod kyis bdag sa/nas yo byad thams cad la byin rlabs kyi char chen po phobs shig bcom ldan 'das zhes pa'o/ /gsum pa/ dbang chen dbang bskur bcom ldan 'das/ /zhes pa ste/'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la dbang bsgyur ba'i dbang phyug chen po'i bdag nyid du gyur pa khyod kyis/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i dbang bskur ba chen pos bdag la dbang bskur cig bcom ldan 'das/ bzhi pa ni/ dngos grub mchog stsol bcom ldan 'dag /zhes pa ste/ mkha' spyod la sogs thun mong gi dngos grub dang mchog gi dngos grub lam gyur gyi 'bras bu rig 'dzin bzhi dang / mthar phyin 'bras bu sku dang ye shes rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid lhun rdzogs 163

rdzogs chen mkha ra padma bapo'i gan thor bu/ — —— — — — —— — — ཿ ཿ — — — — zhe — stug po bkod pa'i rgyan nyid du bzhugs pa ste/de lta bu'i dngos grub kyi mchog dam pasgo ba bar mdzod cig bcom ldan 'das/ zhes pa'o/ /lamadang 'bras bus bsdus pa'i dngos grub zad du byung ba rnams kyang glo bur gyi dri ma bral stobs kyis rang ga sa kyi yon tan mngon tu gyur pa las gzhan byung dang /gsar thob ma yin te/ rgyud las/ ngo mtshar cho 'phrul rmad kyi chos/ /ga na na yod 'ong ma yin te/ /thabs la brten pa'i shes rab nyid/ /de lta bu yi ngang du byung / /zhesarang / rmad byung rgyal po lag sangs rgyas sku dang ye shes zhing khams dang / /ye shes yon tan zan las ji snyed pa/ /ye shes de nyid de ltar snang ba yin/ /ga na nas ma yin de ltar lhun gyis grub//ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa don bsdus te gsol ba gdab pa ni/ bdag cag 'cha 'bras mchis par mdzod/ /ces pa ste bdag cag sgrub pa mchog la zhugs pa'i mched dang lcam dral rnams kyis/ sgrub pa'i dal bkram/ mchod pa'i yo byad sbyar/rim gnyis kyi ting 'dzin sgom/ bsnyen sgrub gnyis kyi las ga nga bsras ste tshul bzhin tu sgrub pa'i las sa ba bya ba 'di la gnas skabs dang / mthar thug gi 'bras bu mchis pa ste don yod par mdzod cig ces pa'o/ /gnyis pa byin bsdu ba ni/———/ zhes brjod pa ni sdud par byed pa'i gsang sngags te/nam mkha' gang ba'i ye shes kyi 'khor lo thams cad bdag gnas yo byad dang bcas par rgya mtsho chen po la kha char 'bab pa bzhin du babs shing thim par gyur pas gsal zhing brtan la gzi byin dang ldan par mos par bya'o//de ltar bka' ma'i byin 'bebs kyi gzhung 'di nyid tshig bzang zhing don rtogs par dka' ba de ltar na'ang bka' drin 'khor mtha' dngabral ba'i 'dren 164

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gal thor du/ — — byed — — — — — — — — — — — — ཿ — — ཿ pa mchog gi gsung gsang spyi bor phebs pa ldog tu ma nus par snyom las pa padma badzra du 'bod pas g.yar khral du bris pa dge bar gyur cig /dam pa'i zhal lung ji bzhinas gas par/ /rang bzosarangs pa'i dri ma gang mchis pa//chos kyi spyan ldan rnams la snyinganas 'chags/ /chos sgong las kyi sgrib par ma gyur cig/lhag bsam chab las byung ba'i legs bshad cha'i/ /dge tshogs padma dkur po'i phon po 'di/ /dam pa'i lhabal dgyes pa'i do shal du/ /blangs nas rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //ces kyang smras so/////65

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ ༷ ke la 0 ༷ — ༷ la ཿ ཿ ཿ ཿ ཿ ba ཿ ༷ sngag /bla ma sku gsum ma'i gsol 'debs kyi tshig 'grel nyung bsdus bzhugs so/ /— mkha' khyab rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sku/ /gdul bya'i snang ngor gang 'dul der mthun pa'i/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis zhi bar 'dren mdzad pa/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la 'dir spyir thar pa'i lam du 'gro ba gdage ba'i bshes gnyen ma bsten par 'gro mi nus pas/ de bsten pa'i tshul mdo rgyud kun nas gsungs shing / khyad par rdo rje theg pa'i lam nas dngos grub brnyes par 'dod phyin/ lam gyi rtsa ba bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba'i mos gus g.yo sgyu dang zol zog med pa kha gting mtshungs pa zhig med na/byin rlabs dngos grub sde gcig mi 'byung bas mos gus bcos min gyis blo sna 'gyur ba zhig gal che ste/ dpal chen birlu pas/ bla ma dang ni rdo rje sems/ /tha dad par mi blta ste/ /bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang ni/ /de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te/ /dngos grub go 'phang mchog 'dod pas/ /kun nas bla ma mnyes par bya/ /sangs rgyas kun dngosardo rje 'chang / /rtsod pa'i dus 'dir bdag don du/ /kun dang mthun par ston mdzad pa/ /de ltar shes nas dngos kun gyis/ /bsnyen bya dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi/ /dngos grub rgya chen snod du 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs/ des na blo bla ma la bkal nas snying nas gsol ba 166

rdzogs chen mkha chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ba ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ la ༷ ma ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ — ༷dzi 'debs pa de gal che/ ji ltar 'debs na/ brgyan chen pos/ bla ma sku gsum gyi gsol 'debs de/ /skyabs bla ma nam dran dus gsol ba thob/ /ces gsung pa bzhin/ bla ma de rang dang mthun phyogs tsam dang zas nor kyis phan btags tsam dang / sde dgon gyi phyogs ris dang 'dod zhen tsam ma yin par rang la yin grol gyi ga/dmas ngag thob pa'i sku drin can gyi bla mde/ dgongs pa chos sku'i ngang las g.yo ba med bzhin/ rang snang longs sku'i rtsal las thugs rje'i sprul pa'i gzugs brnyan/ nam mkha'i zla gzugs chu snod so sor shar ba bzhin/ gdulasa'i sems can gyi blo dang mthun par/ dag dang ma dag gi mdzad tshul du mas/ 'gro ba'i kha lo thar ba'i lam du sgyur ba'i sangs rgyas dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus rkyen gyis mi 'gyur ba'i gdung shugs drag pos/ e ma ho/ /spros bral chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams suḥ sogs brjod/ de las ma ho zhes pa ni ngo mtshar ba'i don te/ gang la ngo mtshal na bla ma chos kyi sku'i tshon tan la ngo mtshar te/ ji ltar na yod med rtag chad sogs spyos pa'i mtha' brgyad dang bral ba'i chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam par dag pa ni chos kyi sku'i zhing khams yin te/ sems nyid ngal gso las/ chos dbyings pho brang zhin tu skyemed na/ /dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad rtag bzhugs kyang / /gcis/ gis gcig mi gzigs te chos nyid phyir/ /rang bzhin zab zhir bzhugs zhes gsungs pa yin/ /zhes gsung pa ltar/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad dgongs pa dbyer mi byed so so ma yin tha mi dad par chos nyid 'dus ma byas pa/ thog mar ma skyes/ da lta mi gnas/ tha mar mi 'ab/ga pas/ dus gsum skye 'gag 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngang du rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lor/ mtshan mdza 167

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor gab sa spyo ༷ ༷ ma ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ cha snye — rtsol rtog gi g.yo ba thams cad dang bral bas bya ba dang byed pa med par rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes dang / dmigs med 5 thugs rje chen po ngang gis 'jug/ cing lhun gyis grub pa'i bdag nyid la sku dang ye shes yon tan thams cad 'du 'bral med par rdzogs pa ni chos kyi sku'am/ bde ba chen po'i sku zhes bya ste/ nam mkha' lta bu'i coms can gyi khams thams cad du/ nam mkha' bzhin du dmigs med thugs rje chen po phyogs dang ris su ma chad par gdul bya'i khams la khyad par smad par khyab par 'jug pa'i rang bzhin shugs kyi thugs rje'am rtag pa rgyun byi thugs rje tshad med pa mnga' ba'o de ni dus gsum gyi bla ma thams cad kyi chos kyi sku yin te/ kun mkhyen bla mas/de nyid ngang du rgyal rnams dgongs klong gcig /bum mkha' snga phyi'i nam mkha' gcig pa bzhin/ /zhes so/ /de lta bu'i bla ma la yid khyed shes kyi gsol ba yid gnyis med par rtse gcig tu 'debs pa'o/ /de ltar chos sku spos pa dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang nas/ thugs rje phyir gsal gyi cha las/rang snang longs sku chen po dang / ga na snang longs sku'i zhing khams tshad med pa nyi 'od dang 'ja' tshon bzhin shar ba yin te/ kun mkhyen gyis/ de nyid ngang las rang snang longs spyod rdzogs/ gnas dus ston pa chos 'khor phun tshogs las/ /rang snang stong gzugs bzhin du bsam mi khyab/ /ces pa ltar/rtog pa'i zug rngu thams cad dang bral ba'i mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rtsal las rang shar ba'i lhun gyis grub pa'i zhing khams 'og min gyi gnas gzhi dang / rgyan dang / dbyibs dang / bkod pa tshad med pa'i khang bu brtsegs pa dang / mngon par dga' ba/ dpal dang ldan pa/ bde ba can//68

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/zhe shā mi la ba 0 ༷ la ba 'a ba ga ba che las rab grub pa rnams ga sarnam par snang mdzad/sa/sung snang ba mtha' yas/thugs rdo rje mi bskyod pa dang / yon tan rin chen 'byung ldan/ zin las don ched grub pa ste rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rnams rim pa bzhin thugs chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la sogs pa'i ye shes lnga re re yang lhag pa'i ye shesabazhi bzhi dang ldan pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i sku phyi nang gsang ba'i mtshan dpes brgyan pa/ thugs rje'i byi༄ga sna tshogs ༷pa ste/ kun mkhyen gyis/ de ltar rigs lngar nges pa'i rang bzhin yang / /gdul bya'i gti mug shas cher sbyong ba'i tshe /zhing ni 'og min ston pa rnam snang la/ /chos ni chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag /ces sogs dang / zhi dang khro tshul dpag med tshul 'char bas/ /'gro ba'i don nyid lhun gyis grub par mdzad/ /ces pa bzhin/ /rigs can lnga'i 'khor gyi rgyud la yod pa'i bag la nyal dang lhan skyes kyi sgrib pa sbyangs phyir de dang mthun pa'i thugs rje yang zhi dang khro chags sogs kyi rnam pa du ma so sor ston pas don mdzad pa ni/ dus gsum gyi bla ma thams cad kyi longs byed rdzogs pa'i sku ste de la gsol ba 'debs pa'o/ /longs sku'i ye shes kyi rtsal las gdul bya'i sems can gyi las snang dang mthun pa'i 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i ma sna tshogs pa 'char ba ni/ ngal gso las/ de nyid ngang las 'gro 'dul sprul pa'i sku/ /'gro drug gnas su rang rang ston par snang / /thub pa drug gis phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams su/ /'gro ba drug/ gi rgyud drug so sor sbyongs/ /de yang gtso bo'i grangs te sprul pa dang / /yang sprul rnams ni bsam gyis mitshal ste/ /lha yi gnas su'ang gnas ris so so ru/ /tshangs dang dbang byug 'og min bar snyed du/ /rang rang 'dul byed ston pa'i tshul du snang / /mi la'ang gang 'dul /69

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ke ba la cha cha sa — — sha nga 0 de la der snang ste/ /nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub sems dpa' dang / /rgyal po la sogs sprul nas mi rnams 'dul/ /lha min gnas su'ang so so'i 'dul byed dang / /dud 'gro'i gnas su bya la byar snang zhing / /ri dwags rnams la seng ge mchog la sogs/ /so so'i 'dul byed ston pa bsam mi khyab/ /de bzhin yi dwags dmyal ba'i 'jig rten du/ /rang rang mthun pa'i bzugs kyis don mdzad do/ /zhes dang / ston pa drug kyang 'gro sems rang snang ste/ /mi lam nang gi sangs rgyas sems can bzhin/ /ngo bo dag kyang rnam pa ma dag pas/ /sna tshogs snang la thugs rje'i rol par shar/ /'di ni tshad med thugs rje'i sprul pa yin/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sprul pa'i sku ni/ mi mjed kyi 'jig rten 'dis mtshon pa'i phyogs bcu'i dag pa'i zhing khams rnams su/ tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen pos gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus dang / gdul ba'i thabs tshul la dgongs nas 'gro ba 'dul ba'i don du/ sprul pa'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas/ gdul bya gang la daXs dang brgyud nas zhi dang khro bo/ chags can dang chags la/ spyod lam 'jam pa dang rtsub pa/ mkhas pa dang mi mkhas pa tshul gang dang gang gis 'dul ba'i thabs de dang des/ 'gro ba'i gnas skabs 'phral gyi bde ba dang thar pa'i sa bon btab nas/ mthar thug nges legs thar parsha lam la 'god pa'i sgo nas 'gro ba'i don rdzogs par mdzad pa ni/ 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi bla ma rnams kyi sprul pa'i sku ste/de rnams la yid gnyis the tshom med par gsol ba 'debs dgos so/ /de ltar rgyal ba sku gsum gyi ston pa de rnams dgongs pa dbyer mi byed/mtshan nyid tha mi dad/ mdzad pa ro gcig pa'i tshul du blta lugs 6rgyan rin po che'i rdo 170

rdzog/sa chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsang thor du/ — she sgo byed byed ༷ ba ba — she 0 ba sa ba ༷nga ༷ / rje'i gsung 'khrul ba med pa 'di'i tshig don la zhib du brtag nas gsol ba 'debs shes na/ ji skad du/ mos gus yod na bla mar ma gyur med/ /shes rab yod na sa steng chos kyis gang //zhes dang / snang srid bla mar shar bas dwangs re spro/ /das snang phyogs med 'byongs pas zhe re skyid/ /byin rlabs sprin bzhin 'thibs pas bag re dro/ /dngos grub char bzhin 'bebs pas skal re bzang//zhes pa de 'ong bas dag snang sbyong ba bal che/ /spyi dang 'dren pa'i slob dpon rnam pa gnyis/ /dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag lung sbyin gsum/ /nyams chags skong dang slob dpon rnams pa drug /rnam pa cha lugs gang ltar 'dug kyang rung / /sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba'i mos gus shig /med par gyur na sngags kyi dam tshog nyams/ /de phyir dag snang/deng ba'i thabs la 'bungs//bye ring nye dang nang 'dres mched rnams la/ /brtse ba'i gdung sems med na dam tshig nyams/ /de phyir mched lcam kun la dag snang sbyangs/ /de sogs dam tshig dag snang ldan gyuran//rdo rje theg pa'i lam bzang myur 'grub nas/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang go 'phang bde blag 'grub/ /de ltar bla ma sku gsum gyi/ /gsol 'debs tshig gi bsdus 'grel 'di/ /bla ma'i rnal 'khyor la brtson pa'i/ /kun nas dga' ba'i blo gros kyis//bskul ngor padma badzras bris//maṅga lo//dase/'o////17/

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/༷ spyo ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ cha sngag /sgyu 'phrul gyi mtshan nyid gsum gyi zin tho bzhugs so/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul da ba las mtshan nyid gsum bshad pa'i rim pa ni/ sems dang ye shes rang snang bden pa dbyer med du ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul bro ba'i rgyud don thams cad mtshan nyid gsum du drilanas 'chad na/ shes 'jug mtshan nyid sbyor bas gzungs/ /'bras bu man byed rgyu dang rkyen/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ /rgyu shes pa'i mtshan nyid lta ba/rkyen 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid ting nge 'dzin/ mngon du gyur pa 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid dang gsum las/ dang po lta ba rtogs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang /lta don dngos gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gang gis dmigs med mi shes pa/ /de yis chos kyi dbyings mi shes/ /de phyir dngos dang dngos med pa/ /'jig pas dmigs med shes par gyis/ /zhes pa ltar/ yod med rtag chad 'khor 'das sogs gnyis snang bden zhen gyis bcing ste/ dmigs med bsam brjod las 'das pa'i tshul mi shes pa/ de yi rtogs bya mthar thug gi don ni shes so/ /chos dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas lugs lta ba shes rab kyi mig gis ma mthong bar/ sgom pa ting nge 'dzin gyi lam du 'jug pa ni gol sa chen po ste/ lam rim las/ bsam gyis mi ba ma mthong bar bsam /72

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ — ༷ la — zhe ba ༷ na — — ཿ 0 0 ཿ ཿ — med dkyil 'khor 'jug byed pa/ /rmongs pa mun pa'i blo can te/ /long ba'i grong khyer chen por 'gro/ /zhesapa ltar ro/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na/ dngos po bden par 'dzin parang / dngos med stong par 'dzin pa'i blo thams cad 'jig pa ste gzhig cing blo dang bral ba'i dmigs med shes par gyis shig /ces lta ba blta dgos par gdams pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhi rtsa med pa'i sems nyid ni/ /pho mo ma yin ma ning min/ /mtshan med ma yin rigs rgyud min/ /kha dog ma yin dbyibs ma yin/ /gnas su ma yin gang yang min/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes te/ /thabs kyi phyag rgya kun gyi rgyu/ /zhes pa ste/ dang po bskyed pa'i gzhi dang / bar du gnas pa'i rtsa ba'amasan med pa'i sems nyid stong pa 'di la pho mo ma ning dang mtshan med gang du gdags pa'i sa/zhi ma grub pade bzhin du bram ze dang rgyal rigs lta bu'i rigs dang / pha mes bu tsha sogs kyi rgyud pa med cing min pa dang / sngo ser dkar dmar sogs kyi kha dog dang / gru bzhi skum po sogs dbyibs min pa dang / chos thams cad kyi gnas sam rten gyir bor yang ma grub/mdor na 'di zhes ngos bzung gang du yang ma grub cing / gang yang min pas/ dngos por dmigs pa thams cad kyis stong / dngosamed ma grub ste sems nyid de bzhin nyid ni 'khor 'das kyi dbyings sam 'byung khungs te rig pa rang byung gi ye shes yin la/ de nyid thabs kyi phyag rgya dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi rgyu yin pas na/ chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin de nyid ji lta ba bzhin shes pa ni rgyu shes pa'i mtshan nyid lta ba'o//gnyis pa la/ rkyen 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid ting nge 'dzin sgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / sgom bya ting nge 'dzin dngos gnyis las/ dang po / dngos rnam 173

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/༷ ba ba mi ༷ cha mi ༷ ༷ ཿ — banyid na dngos med pa/ /rtog pa'i dbang bsgyur ting 'dzin chan/ /ces pa ltar/rtog pa rang dbang thob par bya ba'i phyir ting nge 'dzin sgom dgos par bstan pa'o/ /gnyis pa la stong pa chen po'i rnal 'byor/ snying rje ma/ phyag rgya gcig pa/ phyag rgya spros bcas/ tshom bu tshogs sgrub dang lnga las/ dang po ni/gang gi glang chen myos 'dra'i sems/ /mnyam par bzhag pas brtul nas su/ /zhes pa ltar/ glang chen skyon pa khrom 'dul dang / /rgyan 'dul gnyis kyis 'dul ba ltar/ /sems kyi bzhag thabs shes pa mthong ba'i rjes su 'jog pa dang / rig pa spyi blugs su 'jog pa gnyis gang rung gi sgo nas dbyings spyos bral gyirang du mnyam par bzhab/ pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhi rtsa med pa'i sems nyid de/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ /zhes pa ltar/ stong chen de bzhin nyid kyi ngang nas rtog pa gang shar thams cad bden med sgyu ma ltar rtsal sbyongs pa ste/ 'khor ba'i chos la log rtog ma/rten 'brel sgyu ma/ rig pa sgyu ma/ 'das pa'i chos thams cad phyag rgya ma/ thabs sgyu ma/ ye shes sgyu ma ge ma drug gi rang bzhin du shes pas mkha' khyab kyi sems can rnams la sgyu ma lta bu'i snying rje mkha' khyab tu sgom pa'o/ /de ltar rtsa ba med pa'i sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu'i nganganas rang rtsal 'gag med sgyu ma lta bur shar ba ni/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyis rtsa ba ste snying rje sgyu ma'i sbyor ba'o/ /gsum pa phyag rgya gcig pa ni/ sems nyid yi ge'i rang bzhin te/ /yi ge yid bzhin rin chen sprin//zhes pa ltar/ snang stong bden pa dbyer med kyi ngo bo sems nyid sadakar po'i rnam par sgom pa phra ba yig 'bru dang / de nyid phyag rgya gcig pa'i skur sgom par dag pa lha sku la bslab pa gnyis su bye ba ste rtsa ba'i thabs zhes 174

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ 0 bye ma ༷ ༷ ba ba ba ༷ ma 0 ba pa ༷ byu sa pa'o/ /bzhi pa phyag rgya spros bcas ni/ thabs las thabs byung thabs bsam yas/ /tha dad min las tha dad pa'i/ /nang dang nang gi phyi rol gyis/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thabs byung 'byung ba lnga gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa dang / thabs bsam yas ces pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cadade/ de gnyis ga'ang rig pa nyid las don tha dad min kyang nang gi lha dang phyi rol gzhal yas khang tha dad pa lta bu snang ba'i dkyil 'khor sems su sgom pa'o/ /lnga pa tshogs sgrub ni/ye shes rol/ ces pa'i don te/bza' btung gos rgyan gru gar sbyor sgrol gyi yo byad gang la yang yul dang yul can thams cad lha dang chos nyid ye shes su rtog/sa pa gnyis su med par rol pa'o/ /gsum pa 'bras bu la/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'jigs med kun bzang phyag rgya'i mchog /ces pa sa/ mnyam bzhag chos nyid kyi dgongs pa mngon du gyur pas/ rjes thob tu gang la yang 'jigs pa med cing snang spyod thams cad dag pa 'ba' zhig tu shar bas kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa bongs su rdzogs nas ye shes sgyu ma'i phyag rgya rang shar bar gyur pa bstan to/ /gnyis pa mngon du gyur pa 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid dngos ni/ sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu gnyis/ /da ba'i dkyil 'khor mngon rdzogs pag/phyogs bcu dus bzhir rdzogs pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar/ snang cha sgyu 'phrul gyi lha bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis so/ /dru ba stong nyid khros pa dang bral ba'i dbyings su rdzogs te/ lhun grub rang gnas kyi ye shes mngon du gyur pa na phyogs bcu dus bzhir rdzogs pa'i rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad gcig char du 'grub par 'gyur te/ rgyal ba thams cad ye 175

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra gsung thor bu/ cha ba cha ba ba 0 la 0 ba la — ba ba pa 0 0 ga pa pa shes kyi klong na tha dad med pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar rgyud don bden pa dbyer med du ga/nas pa lta bas gtan la phab nas/ sgom pa ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams su len zhing spyod pa tshogs kyi sgrub pas bog dbyung bas 'bras bu rang gnas kyi dkyil 'khor mngon du gyur pa la rgyud don thams cad 'dus pa yin no// //ces pa'ang mkhan chen rdo rje 'dzin pa padma badzra gyis mdzad pa'o/ /dge'o/ /— dge'o// // rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul dru ba'i rgyud kyi don thams cad mtshan nyid gsum du dril te 'chad na/ ji skad du/ shes 'jug mtshan nyid 'byor pa'i gzugs/ /'bras bu yin byed rgyu dang rkyen/ /zhes pa ste/ rgyu shes pa'i mtshan nyid lta ba/ rkyen 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid ting 'dzin/ mngon gyur 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid dang gsum las/ dang po la'ang lta ba rtogs dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / lta ba dngos gnyis las/dang po ni/ gang gi dmigs med mi shes pa/ /de yis chos kyi dbyings mi shes/ /de phyir dngos dang dngos med pa//'jigs pas dmigs med shes par gyis/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhi rtsa med pa'i sems nyid ni/ /pho mo ma yin ma ning min/ /mtshan med ma yin rigs rgyud min//kha dog ma yin dbyibs ma yin/ /gnas su ma yin gang yang min/ /de bzhin nyid dbyings ye shes te/ /thabs kyis phyag rgya kun gyi rgyu/ /zhes pa'o/ gnyis pa rkyen 'jug pa'i mtshan nyid ting nge 'dzin la'ang sgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan dang / sgom byang ting nge 'dzin dngos gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dngos rnams nyid na dngos med pa/ /rtog pa'i dbang bsgyur ting 'dzin kun/ /ces pa'o/ /176

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ la /de — sna byed ༷ sa zhe — / ga ( gnyis pa la'ang stong pa chen po/ snying rje sgyu ma/ phyag rgya gcig pa/ phyag rgya spros bcas/ tshom bu tshogs sgrub dang lnga las/ dang po ni/ gang gi glang chen myos 'dra'i sems/ /mnyam par bzhag pas btul nas sa /zhes pa'o//gnyis pa ni/rtsa ba med pa'i semasanyid ni/ /chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba yin/ /zhes so/gsum pa ni/ sems nyid yi ge'i rang bzhin te/ /yi ge yid bzhin rin chen sprin/ /zhes so/ bzhi pa ni/ thabs las thabs byung thabs bsam yas/ /tha dad min las tha dad pa'i/ /nang dang nang gi phyi rol gyis/ /dkyil 'khor bsam yas/ /zhes so/ /lnga pa ni/ ye shes rol/ zhes dang / lam gyur kyi 'bras bu ris/ 'dzin bzhi ni/ 'jigs med kun bzang phyag rgya'i mchog /ces so/ /sasum pa mngon du gyur pa 'bras bu'i mtshan nyid ni/ sgyu 'phrul dkyila'akhor bzhi bcu gnyis/ /da ba'i dkyil 'khor mngon rdzogs pas/ /phyogs bcu dus bzhir rdzogs pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'o//de ltar mtshon dpe dang sbya ra na mdung ltar sked pa nas bzung ste 'chad pa zhes bya'o/ /ces pa'ang pad rdor pas bris pa'o// //ga bka' sde zur pa'i bshad sol la chen po lnga ste/ rang bzhin dngos po'i gnas tshul/ ma rtogs 'a la ba'i snang tshul/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i gzigs tshul/ brtse ba'i thugs rjes skyong tshul/ 'gro don ji ltar mdzad tshul dang lnga las//dang po ni/ gzhi bden gnyis dbyer med snang stong zung 'jug rtogs na myang 'das dang / ma rtogs na 'khor ba dang gnyis na'i gzhir gyur pa'o/ /sa/nyis pa ni/ don la bzhi 'bras dbyer med sku dang ye shes kyi chos ji 177

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/༷ la la ba la la 0 pa ༷ ba ba mi 00 — ༷ bsha rsha ba snyed pa rang chas kyi tshul du yod kyang ma rtogs pa rgyal phrug srung la 'khyams pa bzhin snang tshul log par zhugs pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ 'brel ba gsum ste yul dang yus rkyen gyis 'brel ba gnyis snang dag pas gcig char du snang ba'o/ /chos dang chos nyid kyis 'brel ba chu la chu bzhag pa ltar gnyis med/ las dang smon lam thugs rjes 'brel ba sems can rang gi las pon dang thugs rje rgyun chad med pa dang gsum mo/ /bzhi pa ni thugs rje bzhi ste/ rtags pa rgyun gyi thugs rje nam mkha' lta ku/ rang bzhin shugs kyi thugs rje 'bad rtsol mi dgos pa chu bo'i rgyun lta bu/ gdul bya'i yul dang 'phrad pa'i thugs rje sbyin 'dod pa dang long sprang 'phrad pa lta bu/ bskul zhing gsol ba btab pa'i thugs rje rnga la dbyug gus bsgrun pa lta bu/ lnga pa ni/ gdul bya 'dod pa la zhen cing thar lam ma btsal ba rnams/ 'dul byed 'khor lo rgyun gyi theg pas 'dul thabs rang bzhin shugs kyis 'dul ba'o/ /gdul bya thar 'dod nges 'byung gi blo can rnams la/ 'dul byed don dam nges pa'i theg pas/ 'dul thabs gnyen po sna tshogs pa'o/ /gdul bya las ngan 'dul dka' ba rnams la/'dul byed cho 'phrul mngon byung gi theg pas/ 'dul thabs las ngan las rgyun gcod pa'o/ /de ltar gdul bya'i yul gsum 'dul byed theg pa gsum gyis mthar thug don dam nges pa'i theg pa la drangs nas 'bras bu rnam mkhyen gyi go sar dbugs dbyung ba'o/ /padma badzra pas bris pa'o/ /bkra shis/ / dge legs 'phel// ///78

rdzogs chenanakhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ ba ༷ la la ba la ༷ la mi ༷ la nga mi ༷ sngag /dam chos zab mo bdud kyi gcod yul las 'phros pa'i gtam pad dkar phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / na ma pra pa ra mi ta ye/ /chos kun rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab kyig /bdag rtog dbyings su bcad pa'i nyer zhi ba/ /thabs mchog snying rje bsod nams tshogs chen gyi/ /rnam pa kun ldan rgyal ba'i yum der 'dud/ /thub dbang rdo rje 'chang chen nas bzung ste/ /mdo rgyud gdams pa'i snying po ma nor pa/ /rim brgyud gang la babs de mkhar chen bza'/ /lab kyi sgrol mar grags des shis pa stsol/ /don brgyud dgongs pa'i gsang mdzod klong nas brdol/ /bshad brgyud lung rigs saba'i spobs pa mtho/ /gangs can mdzes pa'i rgyan gyur rgyal ba'i sras/ /mtshungs bral 'khor lo'i mgon de snying dbus rol/ /'di na thos nyung sbyangs pa dman gyur pa'i/ /rmongs pa'i blo gros sbrang bu'i gshog rlabs ltag /chos tshul nam mkha' dbyings la 'jal 'dod pa/ /mkhas pa'i skyebo bzhad gad slong ba'i rgyu/ /de ltar mod kyang chos mthun grogs kyi bkas/ /bskul ba'i phyir dang rang blo thos pa la/ /goms phyir zab mo gcod kyi gdams pa las/ /brtsam ste ji ltar byung ba mdo tsam gleng / de la spyir gdul bya'i blo rim dang mthun par rgyal bas chos tshul kyang de ltar bstan pas theg 179

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/༷ la la la ༷ — cha la mi ༷ — pa'i rnam grangs grub mtha'i rim pa bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ lang nar gshegs pa las/ ji srid sems ni 'jug pa'i bar/ /theg pa'i mtha' la thug pa med/ /ces pa ltar yin la/ de rnams spang bya dang gnyen po'i sgo nas chos kyi phung por bzhag pa'ang / chos mngon pa'i mdzod las/ spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni/ /chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs/ /zhes bshad/ chos kyi phung po'i grangs nges ni/ kun byed las/ nyon mongs 'dod chags 'dul ba'i gnyen po ru/ /'dul ba'i sde snod nyi khri chig stong gsungs/ /zhes pa la sogs pa ltar chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong du gsungasapa de das/ kyang / rjod byed tshig gi sgo nas sde snod gsum dang / brjod bya don gyi sgo nas bslab pa gsum du 'du ba yin cing / de'i nang nas kyang lam gyi gtso bo ni shes rab kyi bslab pa kho na yin te/ zhi ba lhas/ yan lag 'di dag thams cad ni/ /thub pas shes rab don du gsungs/ /de yi phyir na sdug bsngal dag /zhi bar 'dod pas shes rab bskyed/ /ces dang / mdo sdud pa las/ sa bon btab nas sa la gnas te 'byung 'gyur ba/ /tshogs pa rnyed nas rnam mar gzugs dag rnam par skye /pha rol phyin la byang chub yon tan ji snyed pa/ /de dag kun kyang shes rab pha rol phyin las gle /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ srid par 'khyam pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo bdag 'dzin chan cing / de ga/cod pa la shes rab kho na mchog yin/ shes rab rnam par dag pa skyeba'i na du bsam gtan dgos te/ phan tshun med na mi 'byung gi rgyu yin pa gang zhig /mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ shes rab med par yang ni bsam gtan med/ /bsam gtan med par yang ni shes rab med/ /gang la de gnyis mchis pas srid pa yi/ /rgya mtsho gnag rjes lta bur 'tshal bar bgyi/ /180

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ba ༷ ba ༷ — 4 ba bsha ༷ snye ba bsha da rte ba ༷ la ༷ ba la zhes pa ltar la/ de gnyis ga'i gzhi na du tshul khrims rnam par dag pa ni shin tu'ang gal che ste/bshes byung las/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du//yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten legs par gsungs/ /zhes pas bslab pa gsum rten dang brten par bcas pa gang zag gcig ci/ lam gyi cha rkyen du dril nas nyams su len shes dgos pas/ de la 'jug pa'i go rim yang / dbyig gnyen gyis/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pag /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /zhes pa ltar/ thog ma nyid du/ bslab tshigs gsum gang rung gi so sor thar pas rgyud bsdams pa zhig dgos shing / de'i nang nas kyang byang sems kyi rten du rab byung mchog yin pa bzhin sngags kyi rten dge slong ma ga tu gsungs te/dus 'khor las/ gsum las dge slong mchog yin 'bring / /dge tshul ces bya de dag las/ /khyim na gnas pa tha ma'o/ /zhes bshad pa ltar/ rab dbe/ tshul slong bi sdom pa dang / mtha' na'ang dge bsnyen gyi sdom pas brgyud legs par bsdams shing / de nas bsam gtan dang shes rab 'grub pa'i rgyu thos pa yin pas/ thog mar bla ma mkhas pa dag la bsten nas thos pa btsal bar bya dgos te/ sdud pa las/ lhag par bsam pas sangs rgyas byang chub mchog zhugs pa/ /slob ma bzang po bla mar gus ldan de dag gis/ /bla ma mkhas pa rnams la rtag tu bsten par bya/ /ci phyir zhe na mkhas pa'i yon tan de las 'byung / /de dag shes rab pha rol phyin pa rjes su ston/ /sangs rgyas chos mas dge ba'i bshes la bsten to zhes/ /yon tan kun gyi mchog mnga' rgyal bas de skad gsungs/ /zhes pa ltar bla ma las thos pa btsal zhing / thos pa tsam gyis chog par mi sems par/ bsam pa dang sgom pas nyams su blang dgos te/ kun mkhyen bla 8/

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ba ༷ ༷ cha byu ༷ 0 ༷ shā 0 0 ba 0 ༷ ma ba bas 0byu mas/ ji srid bdag 'dzin dbyings su ma nub par/ /de sred sna tshogs thabs kyis bsgom par bya/ /zhes gsungs/ /bsgom bya'i ngo bo ni zhi lhag gnyis te/spyod 'jug las/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis/ /ston mongs rnam par 'joms pa shes byas te/ /thog mar zhi ga sa btsal bya de yang ni/ /'jig rten chags pa med la mngon dgas 'grub/ /ces pa ltar/ thog mar dben pa'i gnas su kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems la dmigs nas zhi gnas la bslab pa ni bsam gtan gyi ngo bo yin te/ de las/ de la sogs pa'i rnam pa yis/ /dben pa'i yon tan bsam byas nas/ /rnam rtog nye bar zhi ba dang //byang chub sems ni bsgom par bya/ /bdag dang gzhan du mnyam pa ni/ /dang po nyid du 'bad de bsgom/ /zhes pa ltar/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa dang / brje ba byang chub kyi sems dag rtsa ba'i dmigs par byas nas/ nyes pa lnga spang / 'du byed brgyad bsten pa'i sgo nas/ sems ga sa pa'i thabs dgus sems las su rung bar byas nas/ /don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems baspyod pa'i phyir lhag mthong la bslab pa ni shes rab kyi ngo bo yin te/ byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi mdo las/ byang chub sems dpa'i zhi gnas ni yang dag pa'i bsam pa ste zhi ba'i 'du shes la yang ma gnas pa'o/ /lhag mthong gi lta ba/ mthong ba ste lta ba nyid kyang mi mthong ba'o/ /gang gis de ltar mthong ba de nyid yang dag pa mthong ba'o//zhes 'brel ba shing rta chen mor drangs pa bzhin no/ /de ltar na bsgom bya'i chos thams cad kyang zhi lhag gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i byang chub kyi sems sgom pa'i rim pa 'dir ma 'dus pa med cing / de sgom pa'i tshul yang byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod dag las rgya 182

rdzogs chen mkha chen padma bza'i gsang thor bu/ ba ba la ༷ ༷ ba ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ba cher bstan mod/ de ltar na zab mo gcod kyi gdams pa zhes pa 'di yang byang chub kyi sems sgom pa'i rim pa nyid yin cing / de yang mdo sngags gnyis kyi zlas bye ba'i gang yin ce na/ gzhung sde snod gsum las mngon pa'i sde snod/'bum rgyas 'byung bsdus gsum sogs kyis dngos bstan gyi stong nyid zab mo'i don gang zhig bla mas brda thabs zab mos mngon sum du ngo sprod du yod cing / bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i thabs kyisakhur par can du byas pa'i phyir man ngag rdo rje'i theg pa nyid yin la/ de la yang sngas/sa byi nang gnyis las 'di nang rgyud/ de la'ang nang rgyud babyed rdzogs gnyis kyis bye ba'i rdzogs pa /rdzogs pa la'ang / mtshan bcas mtshan med dam rdzogs pa tshechung gi zlas bye bas 'di ni gsang ba bla na med pa dam chos rdzogs pa chen po'i phyogs su gtogs pa yin pas/ spyir mdo sngags gnyis ga dang sgo bstun nas bshad pas chog ste/ sher phyin ltar bkral na/ ma gcig gi zhal nas/ ci yang yid la ma byas / /bar chad mi 'byung sa lam rdzogs/ /ces gsungs pa'i don/ sdud pa las kyang / gal te mi shes bzhin du gzugs su 'du shes shing / /tshor ba sems pa rnam shes phung por dpyod byed na/ /phung 'di stong zhes rtogs na'ang byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /mtshan ma la spyod skyemed gnas la dad ma yin/ /ces dang / gang zhig gzugs la mi gnas tshor la mi ga/nas shing / /rnam shes gang mi gnas pa chos nyid gnas pa ste/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin mchog spyod pa yin/ /ces dang / gang tshe 'dus byas 'dus ma byas dang dkar nag chos/ /shes rab rnam par bshig nas rdul tsam mi dmigs tshe/ /'jig rten dag na shes rab pha rol phyin grangs 'gro/ /nam mkha' gang la'ang cung zad 183

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ cha ga la khye 7 ༷༷ — mi gnas de dang 'dra/ /ces dang / ting 'dzin dam pa'i mdo las/ ji bzhin pa yi chos nyid la/ /de bzhin pa 4blo bzhag na/ /ming du mi thog nyamasastong 'byung / /de ni ting nge 'dzin ces bya/ /ces dang / spyod 'jug las/ gang tshe dngos dang dngos med dag /blo yi mdun na mi gnas pa/ /de tshe rnam pa gzhan med pas/ /dmigs pa med par rab tu zhi/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs shing /de ltar yum don la mnyam par bzhag pa'i tshe bdud bzhi po rnams lhong ba dang / tshar ba'i tshad rnams rim gyis 'byung ba'ang / sdud pa las/ de yi tshe na bdud ni zug gru ldan par 'gyur/ /mya ngan nyam thag sdug bsngal yid mi bde nyam chung / /ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' 'di yid nur 'gyur zhes/ /'jigs pa bstan phyir phyogs rnamasasreg cing skar mda' gtong / /gang tshe mkhas pa de dag bsam pa rab ldan zhing / /nyin mtshan shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog don lta/ /de tshe lus sems dag ni mkha' 'gros ltar rgyu/ /nag po'i rtsa lag rnams kyis glags rnyed ga la 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /lus sbyin pa'ang de nyid las/ mgo dang rkang lag gtong zhing zhum pa'i sems kyang med/ /bdos pa thams cad gtong zhing rtag tu zhen pa med/ /chos rnams rang bzhin bdag med ya ma blar shes nas//bdag gi sha yang gtong la zhum pa'i sems med na//de tshe phyi rol dngos po gtong ba smos ci dgos/ /zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs so/ /sngags kyi ma sa su'ang gnyan sar phyin nas brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa skyong ba 'di nyid mthong lam phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub la sbyor ba'i nye rgyu'i spyod pa/mgon po kun tu spyod pa'am spros med kyi spyod pa zhes grags te/mi zad pa'i gter mdzod man ngag gi glu las/ res 'ga' dur khrod zhugs /84

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i sasung thor bu/ la ༷ ༷ mi na la 6 ba ༷ da pa nasashā pa dag la spyod//nyamang med pa'i sems kyis 4dwags gnas su nyal/ /gdol ba rnams dang 'grogs te ro yi 'khor lo drangs/ /'di bya 'di byed med pa'i spyod pa tshad du gzung mi bya/ /zhes dang / bya min mi bya min pa'i spyod pa rang shugs kyis/ /glang chen mtsho ru 'jug 'dra ga tu rgyan sems kyis/ /—smad pa'i chos rnams spyod na grol ces mda' bsgrun smra/ /zhes gsungs/ rdzogasachen gyi gzhung du yang / spyod pa'i dus grangs nges pa bdun bshad pa las/ byu phag lta bu'i spyod pa/ smyon pa lta bu'i spyod pa/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi spyod pa rnams kyang 'di nyid do/ /de ltar na tshul 'di bzhin nyams su len pa ni mdo sngag/sa kun gyi dgongs pa mthar thug gcig tu 'bab pa'i tshul te/ kun ma/pen chen pos/ bla ma'i byin rlabs rang byung ye shes ni/ /tshig dang bsam brjod 'das tshe mthong ba ste/ /de lta bu nyid dus su sus mthong ba/ /dus gsum dus med phyi nang dbye bsal med/ /shes rab pha rol phyin yin dbu ma ste/ /spros dang sdug bsngal zhi byed phyag rgya che/ /snying po'i chos nyid rdzogs pa chen po ste/ /gdod ma'i zad sa gshis kyi ga sa lugs yin/ /ces pa ltar ro//'dir mdo sngags gnyis saltar bshad pa 'gal ba ma yin nam zhe na/ gzhung dang man ngag gi sgo nas dgongs pa gcig tu sgrub pa mi 'gal bar ma zad mkhas pa'i gzhung dang 'brel ba'i khyad chos kyang yin te/ kun mkhyen bla mas/deng sang phal gyi blo mig ma dag pas/ /sngags dang pha rol phyin gzhung so so'i lam/ /'gal bar 'dzin pas gcig tu sdud mi shes/ /de phyir de dag phyogs re'i mig can yin/ /'di ni rgyu 'bras theg pa'i zab don mchog /gcig tu bsdus nas nyams su len pa'i thabs/ /ces gsungs pa lta bu'o/ /'o na de lta 185

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/༷ ༷ 0 la ba ba ༷ / ༷ ba rsha ma 'a rsha pa she rsha —— byubu'i gcod yul gyi gdams pa 'di nyid gsang sngags gsar rnying gang du gtogs ce na/ sngags rnying ma'i phyogs su gtogs te/ gzhung phar phyin gyi dbar du byas na spyir sde snod gsum ga snga 'gyur dang / bye ga sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa sogs yum sras bcu bdun gyi skor rnams lo chen bai ros bsgyur ba mang zhing / man ngag yi/ dbang du na nang rgyud sde gsum dang / khyad par rdzogs chen gyi skor rnams snga 'gyur pa kho na'i khyad chos so/ /de sas kyang zab mo gcod kyi gdams pa zhes yongs su grags pa ni/ ma gcig ye shes mkha' 'gro ma lab kyi sgrol ma zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar gsal ba de nyid kyis rgya cher pel ba yin la/ de yang ma gcig sprul pa'i sku de nyid ni/ nges pa'i don du rgyal bawas dang bcas pa bskyed pa'i yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'am/dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas chos nyid kun tu bzang mo zhes nang dbyings gzhon nu bum sku'i nang khams su thabs bde ba chen po'i ye shes dang lhan cig tu bzhugs pa gang zhig /phyi gsal longs spyod rdzogs pa rigs lnga'i zhing na/ 'byung lnga dag pa dbyings kyi yum lnga'i phyag rgyar shar ba las/rang bzhin mkha pa'i zhing dang / gnas yul dur khrod so sor sprul pa'i rnam rol bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig /bcig dang du ma rim dang rim min sna tshogs su bstan par mdzad pa las/ 'dir bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mo'am/mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mo che zhes grags pa de nyid/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir gsang ba bla na med pa'i bstan pa spel zhing gsang sngags bka' yi bsdu ba mdzad phyir bsam bzhin du srid pa bzung ba mkhar chen ye shes mtsho rgyal zhes grags pa de nyid kyi sprul pa'i zlos gar yin te/ de yang gang du /86

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ byu ba ༷ ༷ la ༷ ba ༷ ba byu ga ru ba ba ༷/ 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ g.yo ru'i smad kyi e zhes ba'i yul gru lab ces bya ba'i lung pa/ skyid grong me re bya bar sku 'khrungs shing dgung lo lnga nas 'bre klog mtshalas sbyor sogs legs par mkhyen cing / dgung lo brgyad pa la brgyad stong pa'i bshad pa mdzad pas/ mkhas pa'i go sar 'gying ba rnams kyang spa bkong bar mdzad/ ga na yang 'khrungs pa'i ma ngo mtshal ba'i ltas byung ba sogs lo rgyus mang yang 'dir yi ge mang gis dogs nas ma bris/mdor na ma gcig gi skyeb brgyud pa'i lo rgyus/ sku che ba'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab kyang don bsdu na ma gcig nyid kyi zhal nas/ nga nyid phyi ltar lha mo sgyu 'ag ste/ /nang nyid ltar na rje btsun sgrol ma yin/ /gsang ba ltar na rdo rje phag mo ste/ /dbyings nyid ltar rgyal ba'i yum chen yin/ /thub bstan thog mar gaṅgā'i lha mo ste/ /bar du mkha' 'gro bde ba'i dngos grub yin/ /phyis 'byung bod du ye shes mtsho rgyal ma/ /da ltar nga nyid yin no bshad mi lang / /'dzam blang bye ba phrag brgya'istong phyogs su/ /nga nyid bye ba phrag brgya byung nas kyang / /ma rungs gdug pa 'dul ba'i dus su bab/ /ces dang / der ma zad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid kyis kyang / 'khrul med kyi sprul skur rtsod med kyi lung gis bsngags pa yin te/ mdo sde dwangs snyigs 'byed pa'i le'u brgyad cu rtsa gnyis pa las/ snyigs ma rtsod pa rgyas pa'i dus/ /byang phyogs kha ba can ljongs su/ /rgyal ba'i yum gyi sprul pa sa/ /sgrol ma'i mtshan can 'byung bar 'gyur//zhes dang / 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ nga yi bstan pa'i snyigs ma la/ /kha ba can zhes byang phyogs ljongs/ /shes rab yug gyi mas pa ni/ /lab kyi sgrol ma bya ba 'byung / /)med snying po'i don rtogs shing / /gong dang grong khyer ri 187

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ la da la la la la spyo la ཿ ཿ ༷ 0 ཿ — — la ཿ sul dang / /dur khrod bas mtha' khyab par nyal/ /de yi dam chos rgyas par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ de yang chos rgyud kyi dbang du byas na/ spyir ma gcig gis zhi byed dbu phyag sogs gsan pa'i bla ma mang yang / bla ma'i gtso bo ni/ gter chen grwa pa mngon shes dang / skyo ston bsod nams grags pa/ snga sgom chen mo sogs sngags rnying ma'i bla ma rnams dang / pha gcig dam pa sangs rgyas sogs yin la/ de'i nang nas kyang sa/tsug gi rgyan gcig tu gyur pa ni skyo ston bla ma bsod nams grags pa yin te de nyid kyis mkha' 'gro ma'i dbang bskur mdzad pa'i tshe/ ma gcig gi sku zhi ba'i gar stabs nyer bzhi/ gsungs se skyo ta'i brda skad/ thugs rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin sogs brnyes nas/ dbang bzhi'i ye shes de nyid du ngo 'phrod de mthong lam gyi yon tan mngon du gyur pa sogs kyi lo rgyus ches mang ngo / /skyo ston bsod nams bla ma de ni snga 'gyur rnying ma'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen yin te/ ji ltar na/ snga 'gyur bstan pa'i babs so rnam gsum zhes pa/ rgyal ba'i dbang po padma se bha was/bod yul rgyal bstan gyi khri gdugs brdal nas/ ja yab srin po'i gling du gshegs khar bstan pa dang po gnyags la ga/tad de/ gnyags chen ye shes gzhon nu la slob ma dpal gyi ming can brgyad bcas mkhas grub du ma byung /de nas bstan pa gnubs la babs te/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes la slob ma thugs sras bu chen ba'i/ sras kyi dam pa gcig bcas mang du byon/ de nas bstan pa zur la babs te/ gsang bdag zur po che'i slob ma rtse mo bzhi'i nang tshan/ skyo shākya ye shes kyi rigs dbon du 'khrungs pas skyo ston bsod nams bla ma zhes gras/sa/ skyo ston khu dbon zhes pa yang khor rnam gnyis /88

rdzogs ra mkhan ra padma bas gsung thor bu/ ༷ — — — — — — ཿ — — ཿ la zer ba 'dug des na ma gcig sprul pa'i sku 'di yang spyir sngags rnying ma'i chos brgyud du ma pa yin pa dang / phyis dam pa'i drung nas dam chos sdug bag zhi byed sogs gsan nas/ dbu phyag zhi rdzogs sa gyi zab gnad thugs la 'khrungs shing / zab mo gcod kyi gdams pa'i srol 'byed kyi shing rta chen por byon pa yin no/ /ma gcig 'di la slob ma mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa mang du byon te/ sras thod sbyon bsam 'grub sogs rang dang mnyam pa'i thugs sras bcu drug /la mdos rje sgron ma sogs sras mo rgyan bzhi/ grwa ba har thon sogs mkhas pa mi brgyad/ gzhan yang slob ma tshogs lam thob pa ni zhin tu mang zhing / sbyor lam thob pa stong dang nyis brgya drug cu rtsa gsum/ dang po'i sa thob brgya dang zhe drug sogs grub thob pho mo bsam gyis misdus pa byon ba yin cing de'i nang nas kyang mdo lugs kyi brgyud 'dzin thod skyon bsam 'grub/ sngags lugs kyi brgyud 'dzin rgyal ba don 'grub/ mdo sngags nga tsog gi brgyud 'dzin chos kyi seṅge sogs ga la/ de las brgyud pa'i rnam grangs 4 / pha brgyud thabs kyi brgyud pa/ ma brgyud shes rab kyi brgyud pa/sras brgyud nyams kyi brgyud pa zhes grags pa dang / gzhan yang ring brgyud dang nye brgyud sogs brgyud pa 'dren lugs mang yang / 'dir ni brgyud pa thams cad chu bo gcig 'dres kyi tshul du babs pa dang / gzhan yang brgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i thugs bcud gter kha yo/nga 'og du ma nas byon pa'i gcod ga gyi brgyud pa mas dang bcas te/ bdag cag gi 'dren pa mtshungs med chos kyi rgyal po/ mas brjod par dka' yang / don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na/ rig pa'i rdo sde ba ro tsa na rtsal zhes grags pa gang la 189

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ — — — — — — — ཿ ཿ — ba ༷ ༷ — babs shing / rje de yi zhal snga nas bdag cag slob ma'i tshogs la thugs brtse bas gdams shing rjes su gtad pa lags so// //e ma/ sngon rabs du mar goms pa'i legs pon kyis bsdus te/ /thar ba'i lam gyi ded dpon gcib/ nyid la bsten nas/ /theg mchog gru gzing gcig la lhan cig tu zhugs pa'i/ /chos don rin chen gnyer ba'i don mthun gyi grogs tsho/ /srid 'byor ma'i bslu da mchil snabs bzhin dor la/ /nags tshal da bas g.yogs pa'i ri sus du phebs nas/ /gcig pur sgrub pa'i srog mkhar brtan po zhig tshugs dang / /don gnyis sgrub pa'i nor mchog phyag mthil du gda' 'o/ /tshad med rnam bzhi'i blo yi chu gter las 'thon pa'i/ /bdag pas ga na gces 'byongs pa'i chu 'dzin kyi phreng ba/ /rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa'i gru char du min nas/ /srid khams gdul bya'i zhing sar 'bebs pa zhig mdzod dang / /zhi mtha' spangs pa'i gzugs sku dpag bsam gyi snye ma/ /bsdu bzhi'i 'bras bus dud pa'i phrin las kyi me tog /slob tshogasarang drug dgyes pa'i rnam grol gyi yon tan/ /phun tshogs sbrang ci'i rgyal mtshan mi ring bar 'khrungs 'ong / /rnam 'byed shes rab rdo rje'i chos khams las grub pa'i/ /bdag med stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi ral gris/ /srid rtsa bdag 'dzin drung nasagacod pa zhig mdzod dang / /srid la mi gnas zhi ba'i pha rol tu 'gro'o/ /srid pa'i mtha' las rnam grol spros bral gyi chos sku/ /mi rtog zhi ba'i ye shes rnam mkhyen gyi 'char gzhi/ /bas pa gyis mi khyab sangs rgyas chos khams kyi gter mdzod/ /yid bzhin nor 'dra'i myang 'das mngon gyur du mdzod cig /'gro ba'i ded dpon zhi ba'i gser gling du gshegs zin/ /yon 'jug 190

rdzogs chen mag chen padma bapa'i gan thor bu/ ba ba — ༷ 4 — ba — ཿ ༷ ཿ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ba — bsems kyi gru gzing legs lam du sgyur ba/ /yongs 'dzin bshes sa/nyen mkhas pa'i mnyan pa la rag pas/ /ma nor lam ston bla ma mig 'a sa ba'i/na bsten mdzod/ /gtan 'dun byang chub sgrub pa'i bshul lam du zhugs ma/ /'asal rkyen yul gyi 'tshe ba nyi rdul las mang bas/ /spang dang gnyen po'i lam gyis gdul bas ni mi lang / /rkyen ngan lam slong sa/dmas pa'i snying po ru dril cig /'gal rkyen grogs su shar ba'i rnal 'byor gyi rgyal por/ /sna tshogs yul gyi bar chad dngos grub tu 'gugs shing /ltas ngan g.yang du 'khyil ba'i rtags mtshan zhis/ shar tshe/ /bdud bzhi'i sayang sa ma brgal chig chod du 'gro'o/ /spo mthon 'jigs lta'i brag ri rtse rgyal la brten pa'i/ /chos brgyad ba dan g.yo ba'i bdud bzhi yi dpung tshogs/ /gcig char bdag med rtos/sa pa'i gnam lcags kyi thog mdas/ /cheg med rlog pa'i phaṭaḥsgra chems chesas su sgrogs shig/'khor ba'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i rig rtsal gyi dpa' bo/ /lhan skyes stong nyid bde ba'i dpal mo dang 'grogs shing / /bde chen dga' bzhi'i zhabs bro 'ur 'ur du brdung ste/ /nyams rtog/sa rig pa'i rgyangs glu lhang lhang du longs this /de skad zab mo'i gdams pa'i bcud/ /snyan pa'i dbyangs su blangs pa 'dis//mched lcag dgyes pa'i dga' ston du/ /chos byed sprang po ston pas blangs/ /dung ltar dkar ba'i dge ba des/ /mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i tshogs rnams kun//mkha' ltar dag pa'i gzhi dbyings su/ /'bad pa med par grol gyur cig /ces sprang ban padma badzra pas so/ /dge'o// / /191

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/༷ ༷ ༷ mi la ༷ ༷༷ ༷ ༷ 4༷ ba chu ga zhe la ba༄7/ /tshe sgrub dmigs gnad dogs slong dgongs pa'i gsal byed bzhugs so/ /phyogs re tsam min thub bstan 'dzin ma'i khyon/ /bshad sgrub rgyal thabs gcig gis skyong mdzad pa'i/ /grags pa don ldan ngag gi dbang po dngos/ /kun gzigs chos kyi rgyal po des skyongs shig /gang la 'chi med sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gnad/ /rgyal ba'i dbongs pa ji bzhin ma rtogs pa'i/ /blun sgom bzang brdzu'i grub rgya dkrol pa'i phyir/ /dgos dbang dogasarākha skya rengs snga nas spros/ /dgos don dogs pa sel ba'i nyin byed zhig /lung rigs lha lam bgrod la gzod brtson yang / /gnad don ba ku la yi 'dab ma'i rgya/ /rnam dpyod mdzes ma'i 'gram chang kho nas dbye/ de la 'dir rgyalasras thams cad mkhyen pa'i zhal snga nas/ tshe sgrub kyi dmigs gnad la dog/sa slong 'ga' zhig gnang 'dug pa'i dgongs gzhi ni/ deng sang gi sabs 'dir skyebo phal cher shes rab dang brtson 'grus zhan pa'i dbang gis rdo rje'i theg pa'i lam gyi gzhung ji lta ba bzhin snyegs par ma nus nas gsang sngags kyi cho ga tsam lag tu blangs pa'i mngon rlom gyis rig pa 'dzin pa chen por nga rgyal ba dag gis las rab 'byams la sbyar ba phal che ba zhig /sbyor ba kun slong / dngos gzhi ting 'dzin/ rjes las sbyor gyis phan gnod ji ltar 'grub pa'i gnad rnams 192

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ga cha ༷ spyo la ༷ 0 ༷ ༷ sa ba ༷ rmongs par gyur pas ri mo'i mar me bzhi na du cho ga'i gzugs brnyan 'ba' zhig tu song zhing dgos don gyi gtso bo stor bas rgyal ba'i phrin las gnas ma yin par chud gzon par bgyid pa dang / khyad par tshe sgrub lta bu la mtshon na/spyir deng sang gi gang zag phal cher rnam g.yeng dang chos brgyad kyis dus 'da' ba las snying po'i sgrub pa la ga la ba ches dkon zhing brgya la ba na lo zla re tsam la sgrub pa'i zol du zhugs tshe'ang mchog dngos sgrub pa'i lam gyi gtso bo rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin la rtsal sbyo nga ba bzhag nas/ tshe 'di'i bsam sbyor snying khongs su bcang ba'i mngon rtags su/ tshe sgrub dang / nor sgrub/ 'dre 'dul la dmigs pa'i drag bsnyen/ dkor nor bsags srung gi ched du srung ma'i sa/sol mchod sogs la brtson pas dus 'da' ba mthong chos su gyur pa'i skabs 'dir/ lam gyi na byang khyad par can dang bral zhing rang gi zhe 'dod dang / cho ga'i sgras zin tsam gyi dmigs rim la che thang du 'bad pa 'di dag ming tshe sgrub sogs su btags kyang don rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bzhin du ma gyur pas/ dngos la ba ba sems dang gnod sems sogs kyi bag chags brtan par byed pa las ma 'das mod/ de ltar gyur tshe don gnyis sgrub pa'i 'bras bu ha cang ci cha/ 'phal don tsam yang mi 'grub par ma zad/ brnab sems kyi 'bras bu yid la re ba mi 'grub cing spun dang 'bras bu go ldog tu 'byung ba lta bus mar sgrub 'bras phyin ci log tu 'byung bar 'gyur bas/tshul de dag la dgongs nas thugs brtse bas kun nas bslangs te phyin ci ma log par sgrub pa lhur len pa'i bstan bcos 'di mdzad do/ /dogs pa ji ltar slong tshul mdor bsdus nas smos na/ spyir tshe sgrub kyi dmigs zur mi 'dra ba /93

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ rsha ༷ ba la ba nga sa — bzhi tsam bkod nas/ dang po ltar na sgrub po rang nyid tshe ring bar 'dod pa'i gang zag yis/ dmig/sa pa 'khor 'das kyi tshe bsod bdag gir bgyi ba mngon zlog dang bcas par yang yang sgom pa'i thad so'i blo rnam de ba ba sems su 'gyu min gyi dogs pa/ brnab sems la mi dge bas khyab min gyi dogs pa/ rang gzhan gyi tshe la phan gnod sanyis na yod med kyi dogs pa/yod tshe theg chen gyi bye gzhung dang 'gal ba'i dogs pa/ rang gi tshe la phan kyang ga na gyi tshe la gnod pa med na/ de gnyis dmigs pa gcig la phan gnod kyi 'gro ldog mtshungs min kyi dogs pa ste dogs pa lnga slong bar mdzad do/ /gnyis pa ltar na don gnyis byas pa'i bsod nams kyi rgyus tshe bsring bar 'dod tshe mdo lugs las 'phags pa'i sngags kyi zab myur gyi khyad par thon min gyi dogs pa/ lha'i rnal 'byor yod pa tsam gyis de'i khyad par thon min gyi dogs pa dang gnyis slong bar mdzad do/ /phyi ma gnyis ltar na 'ol spyi tsam du sgrol ba'i tshe lung dang mthun kyang zhib par 'dra min gyi dogs pa shugs kyis slong bar mdzad pa yin no/ /de ltar dogs pa bslang ba'i dgos pa ni/cho ga'i lag len phra mo re tsam gyi 'dor len las/ dgos gal shin tu che ba'i ting nge 'dzin kyi gnad 'di dag la spom yor dang ji mi snyam du bzhag pa'i rigs can gyi gang zag rnams la don 'gyur dang don min 'gyur gyi the tshom ji rigs bskyed nas/ da gzod rang rang gi rnam dpyod kyis dpyad pa dang /mkhas pa'i gang zag gzhan la 'dri zhing brtags pa'i sgo nas/ the tshom thams cad bcad cing dogs pa mtha' dag bsal te rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin tu phrin las phyin ci ma log par sgrub pa la sbyor ba yin no/ /dogs pa de dag 194

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i bsung thor bu/ — — ཿ — — — ཿ — 0 spyo ji ltar sel ba'i tshul rje nyid kyi dgongs bzhed la ji ltar gnas pa zur gyis 'phang ba'i don la gsum ste/ dogs slong snga ma'i skabs su/ sems babyed khyad par can de ci lta bu zhig yod pa yang smrarabos so zhes pa dang / gnyis pa'i skabs su 'dir yang sngags rgyud las bshad pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor khyad par can zhig 'chagargyu yod dgos so zhes pa dang / phyi ma sa/nyis kyi skabs su de thams cad kyang gsar rnying gi tshe sgrub tshad ldan rnams su rigs par bshad 'dug pa'i phyir 'gal med du 'chad shes pa'i gnad khya/ga ni yod dgos par snang ngo zhes gsungs pa rnams kyi tshul las dpas na/ sbyor ba sems bskyed kyi gnad la mkhas pas rang 'dod yid byed dang bral zhing brnab sems rang mtshan par mi 'gyur ba dang / dngos gzhi ting 'dzin gyi gnad la mkhas pas mdo las khyad par du 'phagasacing dngos grub bde myur du 'grub pa dang rjes su las sbyor gyi gnad la mkhas pas ga na la mi byu gnod par rang la phan pa 'grub pa'i tshul gsum gyi sgo nas shes dgos par bstan te/ de ladang po sbyor ba sems bskyed kyi gnad la don sems dang stongs sems gnyis don sems ni ga na sems can gyi don kho na'i dbang du byas te 'chi med kyi rig 'dzin sgrub ste rnam bzhi'i phrin las kyi sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa sgrub par 'dod pa yin la/ de nyid gzhir bzhag nas gnas skabs su las 'grub pa la phan pa'i stongs sems ni 'dir 'khor 'das kyi tshe bcud bsdus nas bdag gir bgyi ba'i sems pa de nyid yin te/ rgyud las/dwangs bas dga' bas chags pas dang / /khros pas ga li rab tu brtsams/ /zhes bshad pa bzhin no/ /de ltar don stongs kyi sems gnyis ya bral du ma 195

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ shā mi la ༷ ༷ ༷ ga la song ba'i steng du rang bzhin shes pa'i lta bas zin na rdo rje 'chang gi gsang lam ste/ rdo rje khros pas zhe sdang gcod/ /cesarang / chags pa nyid kyis chags bral byed/ /ces dang e ma ho/ ngo mtshar ngan 'gro thar ba'i thabs ces sogs mtha' yas par bshad pa rnams kyis mtshon no/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir na spyir ba ba sems la mi dge'i las kyisaces kyang 'dir thabs la mkhas pas stongs sems su song ba yin no// —gnyis pa dngos gzhi ting 'dzin gyi sa/nad la/ 'dir lha sngags ting 'dzin rdzas dang bcas thabs khyad par can la brten nas 'a sa bu mthong ba'i chos la bde myur du sgrub pas mdo las 'phags thing / 'phags chos kyi gtso bo'ang lta ba dang ting 'dzin ga/nyis kho na ste/ rgyud las/ shes 'jug mtshan nyid 'byor pa'i gzungs/ /'bras bu min byed rgyu dang rkyen/ /nus mthu can du gang gyur pa/ /rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du grags/ /zhes dang rdo rje phung po'i yan lag ni/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas lnga ru grags/ /zhes dang / sgrub thabs kun bzang las/ tha ma rnam rtog rgyun las gzhan pa yi/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal zhes bya gang yang med/ /de dag rnam pa 'gal bar gyur pa'i semag//'dis ni mngon sum nyid du byed par 'gyur/ /ces pa la sogs gsungs pa rnams te zhib sgos dgos pa'i gnas mang yang don la dag sbyor shes pa dang mos pa tsam min par 'du shes gnas 'gyur nas tha mal gyi nga rgyal lha ru 'phos pa zhig dgos pa yin no/ /gsum pa rjes las sbyor gyi gnad gzhan gyi tshe la mi gnod par rang la phan pa 'grub pa'i tshul la/ dmigs zur bzhi pa rang gi tshe nyams 'phrog yang 196

rdzogasachen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ 'a ༷ ༷༷ ༷ la ba sa ༷ ༷ la lo — ba rnams bsdud pa sa dgag bya chung zhing / dmigs zur gsum pa sgrol ba'i tshe lung dang hang spyir mtshungs kyang zhib tu brtags na sgol ba'i tshe lung gis ni bzas po'i tshe la gnod kyang tshe sgrub kyi dmigs pas ga na gyi tshe la cung zad kyang mi gnod pas mi mtshungs so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan tshe sgrub dus ga na 'khor 'das yongs kyi tshe bcud sdud pa dmigs pa'i yul de'i tshe bstung ba'i 'du shes dang dmigs pa gtad sa med pas so/ /gzhan gyi tshe la dmis/sa pas rang gi tshe la phan tshe de la mi gnod pa 'gal zhe na/mi 'gal te/ mar me dang /me shel dang / sgyur dang / zla ba rnams kyi yul rkyen las/ sgon ma dang / me/ 'gram chu khams rnams 'phel zhing ldang yang yul de la bri god med pa bzhin te rten 'brel gyi nus pa dang chos nyid kyi rigs pas so/ /dmigs pa'i rnam 'byed phra mo 'di ni gal che ba zhig ste mkhas pa dag gis kyang dmigs par 'dra yang phan gnod mi mtshungs pa'i dper bde sdug gtong len dang sangs rgyas la log lta byas pas 'bras bu myong tshul 'khor 'das sems kyi cho 'phrul du bshad pa'i phyir zhes sogs snang la ma nges pa'i rtags ltar snang ba 'ba' zhig 'phen tshul la brtags na thugs dmigs ji 'dra gnang gi yod ma 'tshal to/ /de ltar dmigs gnad mtha' dag 'gal med yon tan dang bcas par phyogs gcig tu sgrub pa 'di ni rgyalasras thams cad mkhyen pa'i dgongs pa'i gsal byed du yang 'gyur bar sems te/ rje nyid kyis sngar drangs pa ltar lugs thams cad gsar rnying gi tshe sgrub tshad ldan rnams tsu ji rigs par bshad 'dug pa'i phyir 'gal med du 'chud shes pa'i sa/nad cig ni yod dgos par snang ngo / /zhes dang / 'dir dpyad pa byas pa'ang gzhan dgag /97

rdzogasachen mkha ra padma bapo'i gsung thor bu/༷ ༷ ba baX ༷ ༷ ༷ pa mi — 0 — la cha — she pa'i ched du byas pa ni ma yin te/ dogs slong lta bur brjod pa yin pa'i zhes sa/nang 'dug pas so/ /de yan chad kyis gar dbang tshe sgrub las 'phros pa'i dogs slong gnang ba'i dgongs don dpyis byin par rtogs dka' rung rang blos gang dpog mdo tsam zhig bshad grub bo/ /gzhan dogs sel 'od kyi thur mar/ ba ba sems la sogs las min kyang / /yid kyi nyes spyad rnam gsum mo//zhes mngon par drangs nas/ yid las gsum kun 'gro'i sems pa yin pa dang / de las min par bshad pa dang / gzhan yang 'khor sgyur la brnab sems med par bshad pa dang / mdo lam du nyan thos kyi spyod pa yod kyang skyon du mi 'gyur zhes nyan thos kyi lam mdo las dgar ba dang / don dam de kho na nyid dang ma 'gal na kun rdzob thabs kyi spyod pa cir yang rung zhes sogs kyi ma sa 'dir mngon pa las/ sems pa yir kyi las yin no/ /ces dang / dge dang mi dge ci rigs par/ /las kyi lam ni bcur gsungs so//zhes pa la sogs pa'i skabs kyi rtsa 'grel dang sbyar nas rim bzhin dpyad na lung rigs kyi nyag phran 'gro ba'i lam shin tu yangs par mngon kyang rtsod pa lhur len gyi bstan bcos la dgos pa chung zhing nyesadamigs mang bar mthong nas ma spyos pa lags so// //gar dbang tshe thab skabs kyi dogs pa'i gnas/ /gal chung cho ga'i 'don lugs phran tsheg re'i/ /gtam gyis dam pa'i thugs dgongs ma rangs nas/ /de las 'phros te dogs slong gtam 'di byung / /'di yi dgongs don gsal bar smras shig ces/ /gsung len 'dor du phangs pa'i dam pa 'gas/ /dngos dang brgyud nas nan cher bka'alhas phyir/ /blo nus dman kyang gang 198

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ba na — la ba da — la la ri da sa laX la ri gshes 'dzem med bris/ /de la dgongs gzhi dogs pa slong ba'i tshul/ /dgos pa dang bcas gsum gyis gzhung bkod do/ /sbyor ba dngos gzhi las sbyor 'grub pa'i tshul/ /sa/sum gyis dogs bsal dgongs pa ji bzhin sgrub/ /'phros don nyams mtshar lung rigs zlos gar zhig /rtsen par 'os kyang grong nyul mu to'i glu/ /mkhas dang chen po'i lha mang mdun sa ru/ /mdzes pa min snyam spro ba'i blo gros babyungs/ /de skad mkhas grub gdong lnga'i dbang po'i brgyud/ /rim byon da lta'i dus na'ang mang po yis/ /nyer srung snga 'gyur ri bo'i mthar nyal ba'i/ /mkhos chung ri bong rgan pos bris te phul/ /lung rigs mtsho dang spyon na/nga bskyong pa'i sgras/ /nges pa ma 'tshal cal byung dril bsgrags pa'i/ /gtam 'dir nyes pa'i nongs pa gang mchis pa/ /blo gos ldan pa'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzod/ /dge'o// //199

rdzogs chen mkha ra padma bas gsung thor bu/ spyo rna na byu ཿ ༷ ga — 4 nga // na 0 — rjo spyo ༄/ /dam tshig bsdus don gyi le'u'i zin bris gsal byed me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mtshon byed tshig gi me long gis/ /gsang ba sngags kyi ngo bo nyid/ /sems kyi dam pa 'od gsal ba/ /ston mdzad rdo rje'i lam mkhan rgyal/ /sa grol lam gyi srog gyur cing / /gzhi 'dzin srung bya'i dam tshig rnams/ /shes shing nyams chags sbyong ba'i phyir/ /dam pas bsdus don le'u das/ de la 'dir rdo rje theg pa'i lam 'go nyan sa par bya ba gang gi dus su'ang dam tshig rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung ste rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi rgyud dag pa gal che/ de'i yan lag tu dam tshig ji rnam grangs shes nas dran shes kyis bskyangs te nyin mtshan kyi drug cha la ltung ba'i bsngo ba grang byed cing gso sbyong gi thabs la 'bad dgos pas spyir dam tshig gi rnam par bzhag pa rgya che ba dang phyi nang gsang ba'i nyams pa skong ba'i thabs mtha' yas pa yod pa rnams shes par bya dgos mod/ 'dir las dang po pa blo gros gsar bur gyur pa rnams la phan pa'i rgyun bshags su 4ga pa bde bas bshags rgyud le'u bcu drug pa nyi tshe zhig gi don bshad par bya'o/ /de la khungs shes par bya ba'i phyir ga byung gi lo rgyus brjod pa/ gnas skabs kyi 200

rdzogasachen mkha chen padma badzra'i gsung thor du/ ༷ sa ༷ ༷ ༷ —ke ༷ ༷ ༷ ba ༷ ༷ 0 ༷ la ༷ ༷ gleng ga 'god pa/le'u dngos kyi don bshad pa dang gsum las/dang po ni/ bcom ldan 'das rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag dpal rje 'chang chen po rgyal tshab kyi skyes bu rigs lnga dang bcas pas 'og min dang rang bzhin sprul pa'i zhing so sor gsungs pa'i gsang ba bla na med pa'i rgyud sde chen po rnams mi yul du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul la/ bdag cag gi ston pa mchog gi sprul pa'i sku mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po nyid skye dgu'i tshe lo brgya pa la byon/ yun ha cang mi ring bar bzhugs te yongs su mya ngan las 'das par dgongs nas yul yangs pa can zhes bya bar 'khor mang po dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs par dbyar zla ba gsum 'das nas slob ma rnams la gdams ngag gsum bzhag pa'i slad du 'khor 'dus pa rnams kyi nang nas rdzu 'phrul cher spyod la/ 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcu na chos 'di par gtogs pa'i nga'i slob ma ji snyed yod pa rnams bsdus shig dang / nges par bzhag par bya ba dag yod do/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / thu 'phrul can des thams cad kyis go bar/ rgyal ba'i zhing gyur rigs drug gang su dag /'di par nges shing phyog pa kun nyon cig/ /deng 'dir rgyal bas bdud rtsi gsum 'jog gis/ /dug gsum 'joms par 'dod pa kun 'dus shig /ces bsgrags pas dam pa'i rigs can lnga ma gtogs pa thams cad 'dus par gyur sto/ /de la ston pas nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das pas su dag the tshom ma chod pa rnams dri ba kyis shig ces bka' bci ba pa dang / 'khor gyi nang sa rig 'dzin gyi rgyal po ku dza ra zhes bya ba de rang gi stan las langs te seṅge'i lta stangs kyis ston pa'i zhal du bltasanas/ khyod ni nam mkha' rang bzhin te/ /'da' dang mi 201

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ — ༷ — — ཿ ཿ — — — sgo ཿ 0 zhe ga 'da' yongs mi mnga'/ /'jig rten pa dang mthun 'jug tu/ /'da' bas yongs su 'dul bdagongs/ /sa dang rnam thar la spyad pas/ /byang chub thob par 'gyur ba yi/ /'dren pa'i theg pa rnam gsum las/ /gang dag rim par bkod lags par/ /mnyam pas blang dor med spyod cing / /byang chub gzhan nas mi 'tshol ba'i/ /thabs chen dpag gis mi lang ba/ /nges pa'i theg chen yongs ma gsungs//ces pa la sogs pa zhus pa'i lan du ston pa'i zhal nas/de kho na nyidanges pa'i theg pa chen po gnas skabs bcu gnyis su 'byung ste/rmongs pa gdung ba sel ba na yang 'byung / 'jig rten gyi sgron ma yongs su bkod pa na yang 'byung / gang gis nges pa rnyed pa na yang 'byung / snying po byang chub tu nges par yang 'byung / dgongs pa nges par 'grel par yang 'byung / gdul bya skabs la babs pa na yang 'byung / byin gyis rlabs las snang bas yang 'byung / brgyud pa thabs kyis grags pa na yang 'byung / gang gis ched du mdzad pa na yang 'byung / lung chenanges pas bstan pa na yang 'byung / las rgyun yongs su gcod pa na yang 'byung / dgongs pa rnam par bgro ba na yang 'byung / zhes gsang sngags 'byung ba'i dus bcu gnyis gsungs pa'i nang nas dang po rmongs pa gdung ba sel pa na yang 'byung /zhes lung bstan pa ltar ston pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'das pa na dam pa'i rigs can sems dpa' chen po lnga nang du yang dag 'jog las langs pa dang / 'jigarten gyi ston pa nub par gyur pasathong nas yid gdung ste rang rang na/ mngon par shes pas lang ga' yul gyi grong rdal gyi mtsho gling ri ma la yasaganam lcags yod pa'i rtser 'dus te/ e ma 'o kyi hud che ma'o klong / /202

rdzogs chenasakhan chen padma batsho'i gsung zor bu/ — ཿ — — ma ba — ༷ — — ཿ — ཿ ཿ — ༷ — — ston pa sgron ma'i 'od nubar/ /'jigarten mun pa gang gis sel/ /ces pa la sogs pa'i gdung ba bston pa'i tshig de rnams phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyis gsan nas lcang lo can gyi phobang du 'dus te gsang ba'i bdag po la/gsang pa po yi bdag po khyod/ /sngon gyi go cha yal lam ci/ /'jigarten sdug bsngal mi shes sam/ /snying rje'i sa la babs nas kyang / /'jig na gdung ba bsalabar rigs/ /cesabaskul ba dang / gsang ba'i bdag po gdan las bzhengasanas/ rgyal bas 'byung bar lung bstan pa'i/ /bsod nams chen bo'i skal can rnams/ /sprul pas ji ltar lung bstan bzhin/ /da lta dus la 'dir babs kyis/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /ji ltar bshad cing lung bstan bzhin/ /skal ldan can la bgro bar bya'o/ /zhes gsung nas rmad du byung ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang bcas te ri bo ma la pa' rtser dam pa'i rigs can lnga dang / rig 'dzin 'dus pa phal mo che'i dbus su byon nas sngar 'og min du ston pa rigs drug pa'i rnam pas gsungs pa'i gsang ba bla na med pa'i rgyud sde mtha' dag slar yang bshad par mdzad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ dus 'di'i tshe na bo ga rnam pa gsum gyi sgor zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi spyi khrus chen po zhes gsung ba'i man ngag ngan song dong sprugs kyi rgyud ji ltar byung ba'i gleng gzhi ni/ gnas phun su tshogs pa ri bo ma la yoganam lcags yod pa'i rtse mo/ seng ge'i za 'tham lta bur gyur pa'i gnas/ dus gsum gyi rgyal b.rams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i rin po che'i khang pa rang byung du grub pa na zhes pa ste spyi mdo las/ mi yi ba/nas kyi 'jig rten khams/ /gling bzhi pa las 'dzam ming gi/ /drag shul can zhes bya ba'i ri/ /203

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ ༷ ༷ — ༷ ༷ ༷ rdzog la ཿ — — ཿ — — ཿ gnod sbyin 'du ba'i sa yin te/ /chos 'dzin rigs kyi grub gnas su/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /ston pa phun sum tshogs pa bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje/ sku gsum gyi ston pa rnams kyi gsung gi tshogs ma lus par sdud cing / byang chub sems dpa' dang 'gro ba rnams kyi bla ma chen por gyur pa ste gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'o/ /'khor phun sum tshogs pa ni theg pa chen po'i rigs can/ lang ga'i bdag po blo gros thabs ldan/ klu'i rgyal po gtsug na rin chen blo gros rgya mtsho/ tshangs pa gtsug phud 'dzin blo sa mtha' yas/ gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong blo gros dad sel/ dri ma med par grags pa blo gros rab zhi la sogs te rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs mtha' yas pa rnams so/ /de ltar yang / drag shul can zhes bya ba'i rtser/ /grogs kyi sems dpa' dman pa'i lus/ /laṅka'i bdag po la sogs la/ /lag nas rjes snang bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /chos phun sum tshogs pa ma/ bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med pa'i/ /rgyud la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i/ /gzhi 'dzin srung ba srog 'dra yi/ /nyams chags bskang bshags cho ga rnams/ /ces pa ltar yo ga gsum gyi sgor zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi spyi khrus chen mo lung dang mthun pa'i mtshan dam tshig thams cad kyi nyams chags bskang ba'i lung / rgyud dang mthun pa'i mtshan bshags pa thams cad kyi rgyud man ngag dang mthun pa'i mtshan dri ma med pa'i rgyal po ste/ mtshan gsum dang ldan pa'i bshags pa rnams kyi rgyud chen po le'u bcu drug pa'i bdag nyid can 'di nyid do/ /dus phun sum tshogs pa ni/ nga ni 'di nas mi snang nas/ /lo ni brgyad dang bcu gnyis na/ /zhes pa ltar ston pa gshegs nas lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad song ba ma la 204

rdzogasachen mkha ra padma bapo'i gtsang thor bu/ —— — — —— — ——— — — — — — — ༷ zhe ——ka — ཿ — — ༷ ya'i rtse mor ston 'khor tshogs pa'i dus su'o/ /gsum pa / de'i tshe 'khor minang nas rig 'dzin gyi rgyal po kudza ras stan lasalangs te phyag la 'byor gyi lugasasu byas nag kye ho/ dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag /ces pa la sogs pa zhus te gleng bslang ba'i lan du gsang ba'i bdag pogakye ho dam pa'i rigs can rnams/ /dam tshig sa ga lta bu la//thams cad 'bras bu lo tog smin/ /gzhi srung so nam thabs 'bad pa/ /khyod la bshad kyis legs par nyon/ /zhes gsungs nas bshad par dam bcas te/sngon 'og min la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su rgyud dag pa'i sems dpa' dang ma dag pa'i ru tra la sogs pa'i ngor bde gshegs zhi khro dang / rig 'dzin pho mo rnams kyis gsungasapa'i bshags pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus te/ theg pa lam zhugs kyi bshags pa dang / na rag dong sprugs kyi bshags pa dang brjod med dang / dam tshig nyer brgyad/ rdo rje dpal chen/ ye shes mkha' 'gro/zhi ba sangs rgyas/ khro bo khraga'abyung / ru tra'i glebashags/ rgyud lung man ngag gi bshags pa/lta ba'i klong bshags/ thabs lam dbang gi bshags pa/ 'bras bu'i don gas sku gsung thugs su byung ba'i bshags pa'i bar gyis rgyud kyi gzhung don le'u bcu gsum gsungs pa dang / de'i sngon du gleng gzhi gleng bablang gi le'u gnyis te le'u bco lnga pa yan chad rdzogs pa'i rjes su/ rgyud rdzogs pa'i bya ba ston pa le'u tha ma bcu drug pa 'di nyid gsungs te/ de la yang ston pas 'khor la rgyud gtad pa dang / 'khor rnams kyis rjes su yi rang ba'i bshags pa phul ba gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma 'chad pa la 'khor gyi gtso bo rnams mnyesanas sku gsung thugs la bshags pa gsungs pa dang /205

rdzogasachen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor du/ ༷ ཿ zhe zhe — — — — ཿ — — — — — — — sa ༷ ཿ 'khor phal pa rnams kyis bye bshags gus ba gnyis las/ dang po la/ bshags yul mngon du bya ba dang / bshags pa dngos gnyis las/ dang po ga'adas pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da lta'i dus gsum du gshegs shing 'byon par 'gyur ba'i ston pa lam bde ba nas 'bras bu bde bar gshegs shing bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i sangs rgyas bcom lngan 'das 'khor sa la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang rdo rje'i theg pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i dam tshig can mi dang ma ma yin pa'i rigs pa 'dzin pa rdo rje chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad bdag la dgongs shing dam tshig nyams chags thams cad bshags pa'i dpang po mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas tshogs zhing rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar mngon sum du bzhugs par bsam pa'o//gnyis pa la/ spyi dang yan lag gi don gnyis las dang po la/ rten gzhi byang chub kyi semag bsgrub bya mthar thug gi 'bras bu/ bsrung bya'i dam tshig gi rnam bzhag /nyams pa'i nyes dmigs dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ gsang — sngags dam tshig rtsa ba dbang la thug/dbang ga rgyud la 'dzin pa dam tshig/ ste//zhes pa ltar dam tshig dbang la brten nas 'thob dgosashing dbang gi sgor 'jug pa'i dang por byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa ci nas kyang gal che zhing med du mi rung ba ste/ lag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud las/ lag na rdo rjes smras pa/ 'jam dpal gang dag byang chub kyi sems sgom pa la zhugs pa dang / gang gi tshe de dag gis byang chub kyi sems grub par gyur pa de'i tshe/206

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ ༷ ba ༷ ༷ ༷༷ ༷ rsha ba ba nga sgo 0 ༷ ba 0'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa gsang sngags kyi sgor spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag ye shes chen por dbang bskur ba'i gzungs sngags kyi dkyil 'khor du gzhug par bya yi/ gang dag gis byang chub kyi sems rdzogs par ma gyur bde dag ni gzhug par mi bya ste/ derag sa dkyil 'khor yang bltar mi ga ga go /dedag la phyag rgya dang gsang sngags bstan par mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ched du bya ba sems can thams cad kyi don du thob par bya ba blan med pa'i byang chub/ dus kyi khyad par tshe lus gcig la mngon du bya'o snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po chani dbang dang ma tshig kun gyi gzhi rten du gyur pa'o/ /ba/nyis pa ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam la bsnyen cing sgrub pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi mthar thug gi bsgrubs ni bla na med pa'i byang chub chen tha rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang ste/ de yang sku gsung thugs dbyer mi byed pa'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rang bzhin te de nyid bsgrub pa'i phyir ro/ / gsumapa // dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i tshe rang gi me tog gang la phog cing slob dpon gyis gtad pa'i yi dam gyi lha mi spong ba dang / gsang ba'i don ston pa'irdo rje slobadapon mi chod pa dang / gsang ba bcu la sog/sa pa'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam mig grangs su bcad nas bla mas gnang zhing rang gis tshul bzhin du mnos nyi blangs pa de las 'das paras ba ma yin no/ /bzhi pa ni/ ji ltar dam bcas pa'i bka' las 'da' bar mi bgyi ste nyams par mi bya'o/ /gal snya nyams par gyuran rgyu dam 6ga/ nyams pa'i las dang 'bras bu rnam par smin pa'i skal bas 'dir yang tshe thung zhing nad mang 207

rdzogs chen mkha chen padma badzra'i gsung thor ku/༷ ༷ la ༷ 0 mi ba ༷ ba ba ༷ — ba ba la nga ༷ / ༷ ba sogs dang phyi ma sems can dmyal ba chen po'i gnas rnams su brgyud cing skyebar 'gyur ro/ / gnyis pa yan lag gi don la rtsa ba dang yan lag gi nyams chags bshags pa gnyis/ dang po la yang gsum las/ sku nyams chags bshags pa ni/ kun slong 'dod yon rnyed bkun sogs la chags pa'i 'dod chags dang /bla ma dang mched la khong khro ba'i zhe sdang / bkri drang dgongs ldem gyi don sogs la rmongs pa'i sa/nyi mug /sdegs gzugs dbang thang sogs kyis snyems pa'i nga rgyal/ ga na gyi phun tshogs mi bzod pa'i phrag dog la sogs pa gnyen pos ma non pa'i nyon mongs drag po'i dbang du shor nas tsangs pa ste nyams pa bgyis nas/ rdo rje ltar gnyis su mi byed pa'i rig pa byang chub kyi sems lha dang dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa thams cad par 'char ba'i brjod bya rjod byed kyi rgyud don mtha' dag rang la ston cing slob pa'i rje dpon yang dag pa'i lam ston pa'i sgron me lta bur gyur pa dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag ston pa'i bla ma rnams la snying thag pa nas ma dad cing log par lta bas re ltos kyi sems thag bcad de dngos su brnyas bcos dang lkog tu smad pa sogs byed cing dam tshig nyams pa dang / dus snga phyi la ma ltos par bla ma gcig dang dasal 'khor gcig pas mtshon rdo rje theg pa'i bsrung bya'i dam tshig gcig gis bsdus pa'i rdo rje'i spun du gyur pa'i mched lcam rnams ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar du sdong bu dang me mar gyi 'od bzhin gcig la gcig ltos kyi sgo nas 'grog cing lam sgrub dgos pa de la kun slong ngan pa'o dbang gis rgyu mas la ba ba sems dang lus srog la gnod sems mdzad spyod la log par 208

rdzogs chen mkha chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ཿ ཿ ༷rna ༷ ༷ ༷ spyo — — — ཿ — ཿ ཿ lta ba'i dbang gis ngan smras skur 'debs ra za khyadagasod bdeg btsog la chags rang gis bgyis pa dang gzhan la bgyid du sal kyang rung ste snying thag pa nas ltos med kyi 'du skos3)sa sa brtse gdung gyi 'brel thag gcod pa ste/'di gnyis pos rdo sde sku yi dam tshig las nyams shing rtsa ba'i lhung bar 'gyur te/ tshe 'dir yang lus la ma shu la sogs pa'i nad dang sdug bsngal 'byung zhing phyi mar rdo rje'i dmyal ba chen po'i yang gting du thar ba'i dus med par lus gshags gtub dang bsregs bcad kyi tshor ba drag postong ba dang / gal te mir skyes kyang dbang po dang yan lag ma tshang bar 'gyur zhing rigs dman pa dang / lus la nad dang mtshon gyis 'debs pa sogs kyis sa/dungs shing / sku'i byin rlabs dang dngos grub mi 'thob par sku rdo rje 'grub pa'i rigs dang skal ba chad par 'gyur ro/ /de lta bu'i nyes dmigs dran pas 'jigs sems dang 'grod pa drag pos mi gsang mi sbed par ngag tu bsgrags pas mthol zhing phyin chad mi bgyid pa'i sdom sems brtan pos nyes pa dang rang rgyud so sor phral te bshags par bgyi ba'o/ /gnyis pa gsung gi nyams chags bshags pa ni/ rang gis dbang thob cing yi dam du bcas pa'i lhag pa'i lha gang yin pa de'i sku phyag rgya'i mngon rtogs nyin re bzhin gsal bar ma bsgom pa dang / snying po sngags skye bsnyen pa grangs tshang zhing rgyun mi 'chad par ma bzlas pas grangs dus las chad pa dang de yang brtson 'grus rab kyis nyin mtshan gyi thun drug /'dzing gis zla ba gcig gi nang yar ngo mar ngo'i nya stong gnyis brgyad gnyis tshes bcu gnyis dang dus drug /tha mas kha cig girang du dus drug de rnams su tshogs 209

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor ga — mi mi ༷ ཿ — ༷ ཿ ༷ 0 dang sbyinasreg sogs las kyi mchod pa bya ba dang / khyad par du bsnyen sgrub gnyis kyi las gzhung bsrangs te/ phyi yo byad tshogs kyis bskang ba/ nang phung po rten gyis bskang ba/ gsang ba byang chub sems kyis bskang ba'i cho ga rnams ma bgyis te ston pa'i bka' ltar ma spyogs pa dang / gsang sngags kyi gzhung nas gsungs pa bzhin ma ma thogs te lag tu ma lon pa sogs gsung gi dam tshig/ nyams par gar pas/ 6 'dir yang ngag la nus pa mi 'byung zhing phyi mar dig lkugs su 'gyur ba dang / gsung gi byin rlabs dang dngos grub mi 'thob par gsung jo rje 'grub pa'i rigs dang skal ba chad par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar shes nas gnong 'thod drag pos mthol zhing bshags par bgyi'o/ /gsum pa thugs kyi nyams chags bshags pa ni/ bla ma rdo rje slob dpon rnyed bkur sogs la mi gzigs pa'i thugs byams pa chen po dang ldan pas bka' drin gyis sdes su bzung ste/ rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du zhal nas snyan khung du brgyud de sems kyi dkyil du bzhag pa'i thugs kyi snying khur gyur pa'i gsang ba'i man ngag zab mo rnams rang la byin nas dam tshig gcig tu 'dres par gyur pa na/ slar yang gsang bar bya ba'i mtshalas las 'das nas/ lta ba zab mo/ spyod pa brlang po/ yi dam lha yi mtshan dang sngags/grub pa'i rtags mtshan rnams te gsang bzhi/ sgrub pa'i gnas dus grogs dang mas te/ bar gsang bzhi/ gsang 'os gnyer gtad gnyis te gsang ba bcu sogs gsang bar bya ba'i don rnams snod ma yin pa rnams la 'chos bar smra ba la sogs rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pas/ tshe 'di dang phyi mar sems skyo 'bog tu 'gyur zhing /thugs kyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub mi 'thob par/210

rdzogasachen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ba sa ༷zhe ༷ sa sa ༷ ༷ sa sa rdo ༷ ba sa cha ༷ ༷ ba thugasardorje'i rigasarang skal ba chad par 'gyur ro/ /de lta bu'i nyams chags rnams la snying nas 'gyod pas mthol zhing bsdams pas bshags par bya'o// gnyis pa yan lag gi nyams chags bshas/sa pa ni/ 'khor ba dang myang 'dag bdag dang lha/ gtsang ba dang che ba/ spang bya dang gnyen po'i chos rnams dag mnyam chos nyid gcig gi rang bzhin du ma gas pa'i dbang gis yan lag gi dam cig rtogs bya lta ba'i dam tshig lnga/ bsgom bya sgrub pa'i dam tshig lnga/ spyad bya dzad pa'i dam tshig bco lnga ste nyi shu rtsa lnga po rnam par nyams shing 'das pa thams cad mthol zhing bshags par bya ba'o/ /mdor na lus kyi sgo nas bsrung bar bya ba srog gsad ma byen len dang log/ par g.yems pa sogs spang bya las 'das pa/ bla ma mched lcam la gus pas bkur ste rim gro ma bgyis pa sogs sgrub bya las 'das pas sku yi dam tshig las nyams pa dang /ngag gisgo nas rdzunapha ma tshig/ rtsubarag 'chal sogs spang bya las 'das pa/bla ma mched lcag la bsngags pa brjod pa kha ton bzlas brjod sogs ngag gi sgrub bya las 'das pas gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa dang / yid kyi sgo nas brnab sems gnod sems log lta sogs spang bya las 'das pa/ bla ma dang mched lcam la dag snang dang mos gus sems can la byams dang snying rje sogs sgrub bya las 'das pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa ste — phyogs mthun gyi nyes cing thams cad mthol zhing bshags par bgyi'o/ /zhes gsungs te rtsa ba yan lag gi dam tshig rnams nye bar bsdusanasade dag dang 'gal ba'i nyams chags bshags pa'isgo nas rgyud gsung ba la rjes su yi 211

rdzogs ra mag ra padma ba g.yo zor bu/ — —— sgo — — — — — — — — rangs par mdzad pa'o/ /de nas 'khor phal pa rnams kyis kyang spyi bshags 'di ltar gsungs te/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma ste sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo rnams kyis rje dpon rgyal po ltar bkur pa'i gnas su gyur cing brgyud pa la dam tshig gi sel ma zhugs pas rigs kyis btsun pa bla ma rdo rje slobadapon rnams kyi spyan lam du/ chos kyi sku drin zhu zhing gso ba'i snyan maṇḍal dang me tog tshogs dang zang zing gi mnyes pa'i yo byad kyi 'byor ba'i rgyu tshogs chung zhingangan par gyur pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /dngos grub kyi ba yi dam ste/ mos pa'i lha dang babs pa'i lha dang lhag pa'i lha zhes grags pa'i yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan lam du/ lha la rang rgyud du bltas pa'i dbang gis mchog dman dang khyad par du bzung nas mngon par rtog/sa pa'i rim pa 'ga' zhig spong zhing 'ga' zhig len par bgyis nyi dam bca' mi brtan pa'i nyams pa thams cad mthol zhing bsha sa go /phrin las kyi rtsa ba mkha' 'gro dang ཿsa skyong ste/ spyir rdo rje mkha' 'gro bla ma/ ye shes mkha' 'gro longs sku/ las kyi mkha' 'gro pas sku/ dam tshig mkha' 'gro rig 'dzin pho mo/ sha za mkha' 'gro gnas yul dur khrod kyi zhing skyong srung ma rnams la mkha' 'gro sde lngar grags pa ltar na bla ma sngon du song bas lhag ma mkha' 'gro sde bzhi po rnams so/ /yang na rigs lnga ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro'i 'khor du gartogs pa'i 'chag 'das ji ltar rigs pa'i tshul can/ dam tshigamakha' 'gro/ 'jig rten mkha' 'gro/ sha za mkha' 'gro/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ste sde bzhi po rnams kyi spyan lam du/ dkyil 'khor gnyen po'i sgor spyi dang bye brag gi dam tshig khas blangs zhing dam bcas pa las nyams shing tshul bzhin 212
