rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor sa — — — — la — sa mi — mi ཿ — — zhe ༷ sogs kyi sgo nas sgrib pa de dag dang bral bar byas te sems gsal dwangs byed pa'i ngang nas bsgom par bya'o/ /de yang dang po rang nyid gtso bo'i rnam par gsal ba'i zhabs kyi gdan khri nas dbu'i gtsug tor man chad kyi rnam pa de la sems bzhag ste sems gnas pa'i thabs dgus zhi gnas sgrub par bya'o/ /sems gnas pa'i thabs dgu / yum bar ma las/ sems 'jog par byed/ rgyun du 'jog par byed/ baman te 'jog par byed/ nye bar 'jog par byed/ dul bar byed/ zhi b.rabyed/ rnam par zhi bar byed/ rtse gcig tu byed/mnyam par 'jog par byed do/ /zhes gsungs te/ de la sems 'jog pa ni lha sku zhal phyag rgyanadang bcas pa'i rnam pa blo yul du wal le gsal ba la sems rtse gcig tu gtad pa'o/ /rgyun du 'jog pa ni dmigs pade nyid las sems gzhan du mi g.yengs bar de'i rgyun mthud de 'jog pa'o/ /bgan te 'jog pa ni de ltar bzhag pa las sems ga na du 'phro na de ma thag shes par byas nas rnam rtog 'og 'gyur mi gtong bar sngar gyi dmigs pa de nyid la hril gyis 'jog pa'o/ /nye bar 'jog pa ni de ltar rnam g.yeng zhi bar byas nas dmigs pa shin tu gsal ba la yid rtse gcig tu bsdus nas gong nas gong du gtong bar byed pa'o/ /dul bar byed pa sems zhum pa sogs kyis ting nge 'dzin la mi mos par 'gyur ba de'i tshe ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul sogs gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'thas bu la brod pa bskyed de dmigs pa la sems 'jog pa'o/ /zhi bar byed pa ni 'dod pa'i dngos po yid du 'ong ba'i gzugs sgra sogs dang sngon rtses pa dang bgad pa dang / dga' mgur spyad pa rjes su dran pa sogs kyis sems rgod par gyur 369

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ la 'a 4 mi ༷ ba ba byed da — byu 4 ཿ 0 ༷ — ༷nas dmigs pa la sems mi 'jug na rnam gapar gi nyes dmigs shes pa dang / 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid dran pa'i sgo nas rgod pa zhi b.rabyed pa'o/ /rnam par zhi bar byed pa ni de las gzhan pa'i gnyid chugs dang ba ba sems yid kyi bde ba sogs byung na gnyen pos bsal nas sngar ltar 'jog pa'o/ /rtse gcig tu byed pa ni de ltar 'bad pa du mas sems gnas pa bsgrub pas dmigs pa de las gzhan du mi 'gro bar rtse gcig tu rang gi ngang gis 'jug pa thob pa'o/ /mnyam par 'jog par byed pa ni/ /bying rgod dngasal te sems mnyam pa nyid thob pa de'i tshe rtsol ba glod nas btang snyoms su 'jog pa yin no/ /de las sems gnas dgu pa 'di grub pa de ni 'dod sems rtse gcig pa yin la de'i steng du lus sems shin pas gi bde ba skyed par gyur pa na bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdog gis bsdus pa'i zhi gnas mtshan nyid pa thob par 'jog go/ /de lta bu'i sems gnas bsgrub pa la/ ting nge 'dzin thams cad la gegs byed pa'i nyes pa lnga yod pa de dag gi gnyen por spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad bsten parabyed dgos te/ dbus mtha' las/ nyes pa lnga spong 'du byed brgyad/ /brten pa'i rgyu las byung ba'o/ /le lo dang ni gdam ngag rnams/ /brjed dang bying dang rgod pa dang / /'du mi byed dang 'du byed de/ /'di dag nyes pa lngar 'dod do/ /gnas dang de la gnas pa dang / /rgyu dang 'bras bu nyid du'o/ /dmigs pa brjed par ma gyur dang / /bying dang rgod pa rtog pa dang / /de spong mngon par 'du byed dang /zhi tshe rnal du gnas pa'o/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /de la nyes pa lnga ni/ le lo dang / gdamangag brjed pa dang /bying ba dang rgod pa gnyis dang / mi rtsol ba dang /rtsol ba'o/ /de dag gi gnyen 370

rdzogs chen mkha chen padma badzra'i gsung thor sa sa la ཿ la 4 ཿ ba ཿ ༷ ཿ ༷ — ཿ ཿ ༷por spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad las/ rim pa bzhin/ sbyor ba'i tshe na le lo nyes pa yin la de'i gnyen por gnas te ting nge 'dzin gyi rten du gyur pa brtson 'grus yin zhing de la gnas par byed pa 'dun pa dang de'i rgyu dad pa dang /brtson 'grus kyi 'bras bu shin sbyangs te bzhi yin no/ /de la dang por ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan la mngon par yid ches pa'i dad pa lung dang rigs pa gtam rgyud sogs kyis rgyud la bskyed par bya'o/ /dad pa skyes par gyur na/ de don du gnyer ba'i 'dun pa drag po skye bar 'gyur ro/ /'dun pa yod na ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la myur du 'jug cing de la dka' 'tsher gyi snang ba med par spro ba'i shugs kyis brtson 'grus brtsom mo/ /brtson 'grus dang ldan pa des lus lci ba dang sems las su mi rung ba sogs kyi gnas ngan len dang bral nas dmigs pa la ji ltar 'dod par bkol du btubs pa'i shin sbyangs thob ste le lo chos la 'bebs par byed do/ /de nas ting nge 'dzin la 'jug pa'i gnas skabs na dmigs pa brjed pa nyes pa yin te de'i gnyen por rtsa ba'i dmigs rnam gang yin pa dang de ji ltar skyong ba'i gdam ngag dran pas bzung ste mi brjed par byed pa'o/ /mnyam par bzhag nas yod pa'i gnas skabs na bying rgod zhugs pa ngos ma zin pa nyes pa yin te/ de'i gnyen por shes bzhin gyi bya ras rtag tu me tshe byasanas bying rgod skyobar phyogs pa dang ngos bzung ste 'gog par byed pa'o/ /bying rgod ga/nga rung skyes par gyur pa'i tshe na de spong ba la mi rtsol ba nyes pa ste de'i gnyen por skyo bar 'gyur ba dang dwangs par 'gyur ba'i sems pa mngon par 'du byed pa'o/ /bying rgod dang bral nas sems las su rung ba'i tshe na skyon yon la dgag sgrub byed pa sogs 37/

rdzogasachen mkha chen padma bapo'i gsung thor bu/ — ga — — — — — — — — — — — — — — ༷ ga rtsol ba drag po nyes pa stede'i gnyen por grim slod ran par btang snyoms su bya'o/ de lta bu'i sgo nas dmigs thun yun thung la grangs mang ba gsal la dos drag par byas te sems 'dul ba'i thabs la mkhas par bya'o/ /sems gnas dgu po de stobs drug gis rim par 'gyub ste/ sems gnas dang po thos pa'i stobs kyis 'grub/ gnyis pa sems pa'i stobs kyis 'a ba/ gsum pa dang bzhi pa dran pa'i stobs kyis 'a ba/ lnga pa dang drug pa shes bzhin gyi stobs kyis 'gyub/ bdun pa dang brgyad pa brtson 'grus kyi stobs kyis 'grub/dgu pa 'dris pa ste gosas pa'i stobs kyis 'gyub pa yin no/ /yid byed bzhi'i sgoras 'grub parabyed pa'i tshul yang yod de/ sems gnas dang po gnyis kyi skabs su bying rgod shas che bas bsgrigs te 'jug pa'i yid byed dgos so/ /gsum pa nas bdun pa'i bar la ting 'dzin dang bying rgod shed mtshungs lta bur 'ong bas 'chad cing 'jug pa'i yid byed do/ /brgyad pa'i dus su ting 'dzin stobs su gyur pas chad pa med par 'jug pa'i yid byed do/ /dgu pa la ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du lhun grub tu 'byung bas rtsol ba med par 'jug pa'i yid byed bya ba bod do/ /de'i gnas skabs na nyams lnga 'byung ste/ sems gnas dang po'i tshe rnam ga mang du song snyam pa'i rnam rtog ngos zin gyi nyamasa'ong / gnyis pa'i tshe rnam rtog res zhi res skyoba'i rnam rtog ral gso'i nyams 'ong / gsum pa nas bdun pa'i bar la sems gnas mi ga sa 'gal rkyen yod med kyi rjes su byed pas rnam rtog thang chad kyi nyams 'ong brgyad par sems mi gnas snyam byed dus nas gnyen po'i stobs kyis rang yal du 'gro bas rnam rtog 'du byed kyi nyams 'ong / dgu par rkyen gyis mi 372

byedas byed mkha ra padma babyed gas rsha ga — — — — — — — —— zhe — sto ཿ — ཿ — ba ba'i ting nge 'dzin rang babs su 'byung ba'i rnam rtog mngon par 'du mi byed pa'i byedas 'byung pa byed no//de dag la g.yo thob goms brtan mthar phyin gyi nyams lnga zhes byed bshad de/g.yo ba'i nyams ri gzar gyi 'bab chu lta bu/thob pa'i byedas rong khung dog mo nas 'babs pa'i chu lta bu/byedas pa'i nyams chu bo byed po'i rgyun dal gyis 'bab pa lta bu/brtan pa'i nyams rgya mtsho byed ba'am ri bo lta bu/ mthar byed pa'i nyams rgya mtsho byedas dang bral ba'am mar me byed gi ma babyed pa lta bu'o//de ltar byed lam rim las/g.yo thob goms brtan mthar byed pa//mu lngas yongs su rdzogs par 'byed //gang dag gzar byed byed gnas ga/byed brtags gom pa'i rdza mabyed gyis//mi sdod byed bas skyo b.rabyed//de tshe mgo la me 'bar bzhin//cung zad yod la de dag nyung //de tshe dal bus 'byung byedag babyed //de goms ched du byed sogs //btang snyoms dang por blang bar bya/ri bo lta bur mi babyed bar//thun rkyang nus nas su mi bya//ro myong dor bas de mthar byed//shugs snang mthong la dga' brod med//ces dang /gabyed lnga lhar gsal cung zad g.yo//bar byed 'byung b.rang po'o//de gabyed thun gyi gzhi cha gabyed/gabyed la mi g.yo sa/nyis pa ste//thun rkyang nus pa gabyed pa'o//de nyin rkyen dbang mi byed ba//bzhi pa'o byed par gang gnas pa//shin tu mi 'phrog lnga pa gle/zhes bshad pa ltar ro//de ltar 'bad pa du mas babyed rim la sems rtse gcig tu bzung ba na byed ba'i byed du gragasapabyed de lagabyed par rab rib mag mog grib//gang byedadamigasal byedabyed byed/grangabyedang cha lugasamadogadang dbyibag/kha dog 'ba' zhig rim par nub//de ltar byed ba tshor byas te//'du byed —37

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor ga la ༷ ༷ ༷ mi mi cha ba na ༷ la rlung gis bskyod mi bya/ /zhes pa ltar rnam par rtog pa'i skyon de dag gi sa su mi gtong bar rtsa ba'i dmigs pa rang nyid kyis ji ltar 'dod pa'i rnam par 'char ba la bam par bya'o/ /de ltar rim gyis goms par dang por lhar snang ye mi gsal yang phyis je gsal du gyur nas tha ma mig gis bltar yod pa lta bu'i bar du gsal bar 'gro ste/ de nyid las/ smig rgyu du ba srin me khyer/ /mar me nyi ma'i tshul dang sbyar/ /zhes so/ /tshul des gtso bo la legs par sems zin pa dang lus dkyil gyi lha la sems bzung / de nas rim gyis 'khor rnams la'ang bslab nas tha ma dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs snga phyi med par dus gcig tu yid ngor 'char thub par bya'o/ /nang du ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal rdzogs pa'i rim pas/ lha sku chu zla lta bu'i mthong nyams dang / dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis lung ston pa dang / mngon shes 'char ba dang / mi ltas ngo mtshar ba mi ba sogs lam rtags kyi snang ba mtha' pas pa 'byung yang / de dag la dga' brod dang mchog 'dzin byed pa dor te rig stong mnyam pa chen po'i klong du re dogs dbyings su gcod pa ni man ngag go/ /de ltar tshul sna tshogs pa'i sgo nas zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor brtan par byed pa ni dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs rmad du byung ba yin par/ rtsa rgyud gsang ba'i snying po las/gang gis glang chenacas 'dra'i sems/ /mnyam par bzhag pas btul nas su//sngags dang phyag rgya rab brtan na/ /dngos grub ya mtshan chen por 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa'i don te/ 'di lta bu'i lha sku phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor gcig la yang gang zag gi rtogs pa'i bye brag las sna tshogs par 'gyur te/lam gyi yan lag gzhan dang bral ba'i zhi gnas kyang pa bde gsal mi rtog 37

rdzogs chenayas chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ — — ཿ — — — ཿ ཿ — — — ༷ — ཿ — ཿ ཿ ༷ pas brgyan pa mngon shes dang zu 'phrul gyi rten du gyur pa tsam sa phyi rol pa rnams dang yang thun mong ba yin/ nges 'byung dang stong nyid don spyi'i ma par shes pa tsam gyis na na thar ba'i lam du rung ba tsam yin/ byang chub sems kyis zin thams cad mkhyen pa'i 'jug ngogs su 'gro/ snang ba lhar shes pa'i lta ba dang / bzlasabarjod dang / rnal 'byor ga na gyis na nardo rje'i theg par 'gyur/ mnyam pa chen po'i lta spyod dang ldan pas dag rdzogs yin gsum gyi yan lag gzhan tshang bar gyurar bla med kyi rim pa dang por 'gyur/ rlung sems dbu mar thim pa'i rjes su byung ba'i bcos min kyi rnal 'byor yinan rim pa gnyis par 'gyur/ rim dang gcig char gang yin kyang rig pa'i rang bzhin gnyug ma'i de kho na nyid mngon sum dusas pa'i rang gdang lhar shar ba yin na zung 'jug rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor du 'gyur ba yin no/ /rim gnyis kyi la 'byor gang la 'jug na'ang shesarab dang gdam ngag gi stobs kyis blang dor gyedamigs bye nas nan tan du sgrub dgos kyi gya tshom dusngags kyi theg pa ni zab mo'o snyam du ri bong cal 'drogs kyis zhugs pa la don med par ma zad nyen yang che ste slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang bas/ ji ltar ral gri'i so la nan tan du/ /legs par ma bzung lag pa gcod par 'gyur/ /de bzhin nan tan med pa'i gsang sngags la/ /phung ba'am yang na 'bras bu med par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /tshul bzhin du legs par nyams su blang na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi legs pa thams cad 'grub ste/la rim las/ rnal 'byor las su rung rnams kyig/phyag rgya chen po rdzogs 'gyur zhing / /gsal la yid gnyis med pa na/ /dkyil 'khor chen por 375

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma brdza'i gas thor ga ༷ — — — ma — — — — zhe ——— — — — — — — — ༷ — — 'bar bar 'gyur/ /'di ltar bsgoms shing sgrub byas na/ /'bras bu mngon du ma byung yang / /tshe rabs skyob thams cad du/ /lha mi mtshan rdzogs sdug bsngal theg /bde gshegs 'byung dang mi bkol cing / /theg pa dman par 'jug mi 'gyur/ /byang chub gzungs la zhugs pa yin/ /de bas lam 'di 'bral mi bya/ /zhes so/ /de ltar thun gyidangos gzhi la lha'i rnal 'byor skyong tshul mdo tsam bshad nas/ gal stedes skyobar gyur na ngag sgrib sbyong zhing yi dam gyi thugs rgyud bskul ba'i phyir bsnyen pa bzla ba la brtson par bya'o/ /de'i tshul yang /lam rim lag yan lag ma nyams sngags bzlas pa'ang /skyon bcu spangs te rnam gsum gyis/ /bzlas pa grangs bzhin rdzogs par byang / /spro bsdu bdag dang gzhan don rdzogs/ /phyi nang gsang ba gang mos su/ /bzlas pa tshad du phyin par bya/ /dub na ye shes thig le blta/ /zhes pa ltar lag 'dir ni thugs gar sngags kyi 'khor lo gsal ba las spro bsdu'i sbyor bas snod bcud sku dang ye shes kyi rol bar blta zhing sgra grags thams cad sngags kyi rang sgrar shes pas bzlas pa spyi'i lugs su bya ba dang / rang gzhung las/ 'dzab kyi snying po byang chub sems/ /zhes sogs gsungs pa bzhin mngon sum 'od gsal gyi dgongs pa las mi g.yo bar chos nyid don gyi bzlas pa gtso bor bsten par bya'o/ /thugs dam bskul/ ba/ tshogs kyi mchod pa sogs kyi don ni yi ge mang bas ma bris so/ /gshegs gsolarang nyer bsdu sogs 'dir mi 'byung ba di zung 'jug lhun gyis grub pa chu bo'i rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la thun mtshalas kyi rtsis gdab bral ba'i dbang du sa pa'o/ /dzinan du rang blor 'tshalas par de ltar byas kyang 'gal ba ni ma mthong ngo / /de'i rjes su zhi rgyas dbang drag sogs kyi 376

rdzogasachen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor ga — — — — — — — — — — ཿ — ཿ — — phrin las ji ltar sgrub pa dang 'od gsal snying po'i lam la ji ltar bslab pa'i rim pa yang / rang gzhung du/ lha dang dkyil 'khor lhun grub ste: lha nyid rang la rang nyid lha: gnyis med lta ba'i gdengs skyed cing: phrin las sngon 'jug sems bskyed dang :gsang ba'i snying thig yid la bcags: rig pa chos zad klong du bskyar: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya:zhes pa ltar ro/ /'dir smras pa/zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal chen po las/ /ma g.yos bzhin du kun grub mtshan dpe'i ga /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i ngo bor yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang du/ 1 /sgrod byed thabs tshul gzhan las rmad byung ba'i/ /nye lam mthar thugardo rje'i theg pa ni/ /rgyal kun thugs kyi gsang ba zab mo zhes/ /rgya bod pa grub yongs kyis gcig tu gleng/ 2 /de yi nang nas tshe 'dir lhan skyes kyi/ /bde chen na shes 'dren pa'i gar mkhan mar/ /brten nas snang gsum phra ba'i bag chags kun/ /sbyangs te mchog gi 'od gsal la sbyor ba'i/na /lam mchog bla med sngags kyi tant+ra yi/ /lam gnad mtha' dag dbang bzhi'i nyams len gyi/ /lam la 'du zhes rgyud don 4bzhin du/ /lam kun yongs rdzogasagazigs pa'i mgonades gsungs/4/bskyed rim lam gyis tha mal zhen snang sbyongs/ /rdzogs rim lam gyis sgyu ma'i 'dzin rtog spangs/ /rdzogs chen lam gyisazung 'jug chen por sbyor/ /'di las gzhan pa'i nye lam bod masan/5 /'di ru ma 'dus theg pa gzhan medade/ /'di la ma brten sangs rgyas ji ltar 'thob/ /de bas 'di phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs kyi/ /bsgrod pa gcig pu'i la ba du rgyal bas gsungag 6 /grogs dag rnyed dka'i dal ba rnyed gyur cing / /yid bzhin nor ku lta bu'i gdams pa mchog /dam 377

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bsgo'i gsung thor bu/ — — zhe — — — — ༷ — — ཿ — pa'i drin las ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin/ /nyams su len byar yod pa'i gnas skabs 'dir/ 7 /mnog chung tshe 'di'i bya ba'i so tshis la/ /g.yengs nas don chen 'dor ba ji ltar rigs/ /de bas de ring nyid nas sgrub pa la/ /snyinganas brtson pa drag pos gzhol bar ma da/ 8 /btsan byug khas drag gzugs kyis rgyags pa sogs//sngon chad ljongs 'dir mang po byung mod kyang /deng sang dus na ming tsam lus la ltos/ /rang re rnams kyang de las 'das sam kye/9 /chos la long yod byas nas phyi bshol du/ /bzhag pas nyin gcig tsamar 'chi bdag gis /thog babs tshul du bzung ba'i dus shig 'byung / /de dus 'gyod kyang 'phyis so snying gi grogs/10 /da lta rang dbang yod pa'i gnas skabs na//dam pa'i zhal lung zab don bdud ci'i bcung/ /rimaganyis lang tsho rgyas pa'i bcud len du/ /blangasanas 'chi med rdo rje'i sa la 'gro/11 /galalte skye'adir mchog dngos ma grub kyang / /gzhan du 'pho tshe dpa' bo rnal 'byor mag / mdun bsus te ru mdzayi gnas bcu ru/ /'gro ba 'di la the chos ci zhig yod/12 /de phyir brtson pa'i rta pho la zhon nas/ /nges 'byung lcag bskul dad pa'i srab kyis bsgyur/ /grub gnyis nor bus brgyan pa'i grong khyer der/ /rnam g.yeng phyi bshol ma mdzad 'byon par sa 1 /'di ltar rdo rje'i mched kyis bskul byer dang / /zab mo'i lam la rang blo goms phyir dang /gsang chen lam la slob pa'i rten 'brel phyir/ /gsang ba snying thig lam 'dir bdag gis 'bad/ 14/brgyud ldan sama'i man ngag gabyung byas shing / /dam pa du ma'i gsung gis legs brgyan te//khung bas me tog rtsi bcud blangs bzhin bsdus//de lta na'ang bdag blo mthu zhan pag15/ma gas nyams dang ma tshang phyin ci 378

rdzogasachen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor gu/ — 4 sa — ༷ ༷ mi 4 — ཿ ga 0 ba ༷log /rdo rje'i tshig gi rgya mdud ma khrol ba'i/ /nyes pa ci mchis rtsa gsum srung ma'i tshogs/ /chos spyan ldan pa rnams la'ang bzod par gsol/ 16 /'dir 'bad dge ba gangs ri'i tog lta bur/ /rnam par dkar ba gang zhig thob pa des/ /lus can kun gyis rdo rje 'chang gi gnas//zung 'jug dri ma med pa thob par shog17 /bdag cag rdo rje'i theg par zhugs so 'tshal/ /mnyam rdzogs chen po'i dam tshig la gnas shing / /sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du gnas gyur nas/sgyu 'phrul dru ba'i ngo bor mngon rdzogs shog 18 /skyezhing skyeb dag ni thams cad du/ /rgyud don mtshan sum gzigs pa'i bla ma yis/ /rjes bzung sngags kyi lam gnad kunalhags te/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i lam bzang rnyed par shog19 /rang don zhi bar gzhol min 'gro ba'i phyir/ /tshe gcig lam gyi sangs rgyas don gnyer ba'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' sngags kyi theg pa yi/ /bzhon pa mchog gis rtag tu 'gro bar shog20 /bdag kyang 'di nas ga na du 'phos tshe zhing skyes sngags skyes lhan skyes kyi/ /pho nya'i tshogs dang lhan cig nyid du bde stong sgyu ma'i rol rtsed kyis/ /rnga yang dpal ri sprul pa'i zhing der mig 'phrul bzhin du bgrod nas kyang /te ru sadapal mtsho skyes rdo rje'isras kyi thu bor 'gyur bar shog /ces rig 'dzin nyi ma grags pas khams srin mo rdzong nas spyan drangs pa'i rtsa gsum gsang ba snying thig gi las byang yid bzhin nor bu la brten nas bsnyen par byed pa'i rnal 'byor pa dag la nye bar mkho ba'i lha'i rnal 'byor byed tshul nyung ru 'di ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa rgyal ba'i sras po gzhan phan pha mtha' yas pa'i 'od zer can gyi zhabs rdul la spyi bos reg pa'i skal bzang thob kyang / rang rgyud snyom las dang rmongs pa'i khur gyis non 379

rdzogs chen mag chen padma bapo'i gagang thor ga — — — — — — — — spyo — — — — — — — — pa'i btsun pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam 'dzin pa padma badzra du 'bod pas dpal gyi seṅge rir sbyar bas gsang chen snying po'i bstan pa phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas par gyur cig/dge'o//bkra shis////380

rdzogasar mkha ra padma btso g.yo thor ku/ — — — —mdo — — — — — — — — — — — — ༷rag /legs bshad gtam gyi sbyor ba blo gsal mgul rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi spyi gzugs/ 6rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i rgyal tshang/ gsang chen snga 'gyur bstan pa'i srog shing / lhar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs mgon/ mchog gi sprul pa'i sku rin po ches gtsor mdzad/ rnam gsum ngur mig gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin zhing / lam bslab pa gsum dang lung sde snod gsum gyis thugs rgyud gang ba'i 'phags tshogs 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i snyan sgron du zhu rgyur/ spyir yul gong ma la bsngags pa/ 'og ma la shis brjod/ bar ma la lugs gnyis gtam gyis mdun bsus nas/ yas gtam dam pa chos kyi lo rgyug mas gtam 'jigarten 'khor ba'i lo rgyus/ bshad pa'i yal ga rgya che ba/ tshig gi lo ma grangs mang ba/ don gyi me tog mdangs mtshar ba'i gtam gyi sbyor ba du ma zhig gleng du yod kyangadad res kyi gnas skabs 'dir/ skabs su bab pa'i gtam/ dus su babs pa'i char/ cho 'phrul zla ba'i lo dar gyi dus mchod bum sa chen mo dang 'brel ba'i gtam/ ji skad du/ slob dpon dpa' bos/ ya rabs rnams dang phrad skyes kyi mchog /tshogs kyinang du mkhas pa mgu byed yin/ /ces pa ltar/ gdul bya'i zhing khams kyi chags tshul/ 'dul byed ston pa'i byon tshug bstan pa dam chos kyi dar tshug bstan 'dzin dge 381

rdzogasachen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ la 4 ba la la ba la mi ༷ ཿ ba ཿ ༷ — ཿ — ཿ 'dun rnams phebs tshul/ tshom bu tshogs kyi sgrub pa'i lo rgyus bcas nyung bsdus re rang blos shes tshod tsam zhig zhu ba la/ sdud pa las/ mkha' la rlung brten de la chu yi phung po brten/ /de la sa chen 'di brten de la 'gro 'di brten/ /zhes pa ltar/ bcu gsum mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams 'di chags pa'i thog mar/ yid mkha' rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba'i nam mkha' dkar gsal rgya khyon ku mtha' med pa'i dbyings su/ shar rlung nub tu g.yos pa dang /lho rlung byang du g.yos pa'i rkyen gyis rlung ru nag po rdo rje rgya gram zhes pa'i rlung gi kyil 'khor ljang skya rgya gram gyi dbyibs can lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa sra zhing 'thas pa rgya khyen stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi tshad dang mnyam par chagag de'i steng gi nam mkha' la sprin gser gyi kha dog can 'dus pa las khams sna tshogs pa zhes bya ba'i char gyi rgyun chen po shing rta'i srog shing tsam bar mtshalas med par babs pa las zhi ba gsal dag gi rgya mtsho zhes bya ba'i chu'i dkyil 'khor chags/ de nas rlung gi byed las kyis rgya mtsho chen po dkrug pas 'o ma las mar gyi tshul du rin po che sna tshogs pa'i khams kyi dwangs ma rnams bcud du smin nas 'og gzhi gser las grub pa'i dbang chen gser mis gzhi rgya khyen mtha'i lcags ri dang mnyam par chagagade yi dbus su ri dbang lhun po 'phangs su dpag tshad brgyad khri yod pa/ shar shel/ sgo beeḍūrya/ nub padma rā ga /byang gser lasagrub pasaphyogs bzhi'i nam mkha' rin po che'i rang 'od du bsgyur nus par grub/ de'i mtha' bskor du gser gyi ri bdun/rol pa'i mtsho bdun/rin po che'i gling bdun rnams dang /de'i phyi rol lan tshwas khyab pa'i rgya mtsho la/ gling chen bzhi/ gling phran brgyad 382

rdzogasachenasakhan chenapadma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ —— ཿ — — — — — ཿ ༷ 0 ཿ 0 ༷ dang bcas pas bskor ba'i 'khor durdo sol gyi ri la rta gdong rgod ma kha'i me 'bar ba'i lcags ris bskor ba/ lhun po'i phyogs kyi bang rim rnams la rgyal chen bzhi'i rigs kyi lha rnams kyi phobang dang / rtse mo na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i grong khyer lta na sdug pa rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dang bcas pa legs par grub/ ming bzhi'i steng gi bar snang la nyi zla gza' skar gyi poyang me shelarang / chu shel dang zangs lcags mkhar ba sogs las grub pa spyi mthun gyi las las byung ba/ri rab kyi steng nas gyen du pag pa'i nam mkha' la/ 'thababal dang dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga'/ bzhin 'phrul dbang byed de 'dod lha bzhi dang / tshangs ris dang / tshangs pa mdun na 'don/tshangs chen sogs gzugs khams gnas ris bcu bdun gyi gnas rnams rgya theb brtsegs pa bzhin dwangs ma 'od kyi rang bzhin can du grub/ de dag gi steng gi nam mkha' na gzugs med skyomached su bzhi'i gnas res thogs dang bral banam mkha'i cha tsam du gnas/ de ltar phyi snod kyi 'jig rten mas nas yar chags pa'i rjes la/ nang bcud kyi sems can yasanas mar grub ste kun gzhi lung ma bstan gyi dbyings nas gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa je rags su gyur pa las/ srid pa'i rtse mo nas tshangs gnas rnams kyi bar du rim par mched/ de nas ming bzhi'i mi dang / ngan songagasum gyi 'gro ba sogs rang rang gi las kyi snang ba dang mthun par grub/ de la bskal pa dang po rdzogs ldan nas brtsam ste/sum ldan/gnyis ldan/rtsod ldan bzhi'i rings la/rgyal posngagam mang bkur rgyal poras bzung / gling bzhi nas gcig so/ bar la dbang byed pa'i gser dngul zangs lcags kyi 'khor losasgyur ba'i rgyal po 383

rdzogasachen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ — — — — — — — — — ཿ — ཿ — rim can du byon pa'i rgyal rigs las rgyal po bu ram shing pa'i gdung brgyud rgyal po zas gtsang ma yan chad dang / de nas kyang chos skyong ba'i rgyal phran sol bu sna tshogs dang bod gangs can gyi ljongs su 'od gsal lha yi gdung rgyud rgya gar shākya dang li tsa bi'i rigs las byon pa'i rgyal po gnya' khri btsad ponas bzung/ gnam la khri bdun/ bar gyi steng gnyis/ sa la legs drug dang lde brgyad sogs kyi gtso byas phyogs kyi rgyal po dang rgyal phran rnams kyi mnga' 'og tu 'khod pa'i skyodagu dad pa'i mig dang ldan pa mtha' dag ni gdul bya'i gtso bo yin la/ de yan chad kyis gdul bya'i zhing khams kyi chags tshul mdo tsam zhus nag da 'dulabyed ston pa'i byon tshul3/ sngon 'jigarten chags pa'i gnas skabs na rgya mtsho'i nang du gser gyi padma stong dang rtsa gnyis shar ba'i rten 'grel la 'od gas gyi lha rnams kyis bskal pa bzang po zhes btags pa'i bskal pa 'di la mdo sde bskal pa bzang po las gsungs pa ltar/ rnam 'dren rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong 'byon pa las/ da res kyi skabs su byon pa bdag cag gi ston pa bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po 'di nyid nges pa'i don du bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas su na kyang / slar yang 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i gdul bya'i don las brtsams te shākya thub pa chen po'i drung du thugs bskyed pa nas bzung bskal pa grangs med gsum du bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs par mdzad/ srid pa tha ma'i gnas skabs su dga' ldan gyi gnas na lha'i bu dam pa tog dkar po'i skyeb bzhes/de nas rtsod ldan tshe lobargya pa'i dus snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i sems can rgyal ba 384

rdzogs chenasakhan chen padma badzra gsung thor bu/ — — ༷ — ༷ — — — — ཿ — ཿ ga ཿ gzhan gyis 'dul bar ma nusapa'i gdul bya dmu rgod rnams gdul ba'i dus la babs par mkhyen nas gzigs pa rnam pa lngas gzigs nas/ glang chen thal dkar ma ba drug ldan gyi rnam par sprul te lha las babs/ yum sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i lhums su zhugs pa dang / lum bi ni'i tshal du ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mis ba pa dang bcas pas sku blta pas pa dang / skye bo dregs pa can rnams khengs pa bcom pa'i phyir gzhon nu'i rol rtsed dang sgyu rtsal sbyangs nas/ lhas sbyin sogs skye bo log lta can gyi skur 'debs spang phyir btsun mo'i 'khor gyis dgyes par rol ba/ gdulas rnams skyerga na 'chi'i chu bo bzhi las sgrol ba'i phyir khyim nas khyim med par rab tu byung nas ngur smig thar ba'i rgyal mtshan bzhes pa/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub dka' spyad dang brtson 'grus chen pos sgrub dgos zhes ston pa'i ched du lo drug tu dka' ba spyad pa/ skyes bu chen po'i nyams rtsal bstan pa'i phyir bdud dpung dang bcas pa bcom pa/bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bskal pa grangs med du mar bsags pa'i 'bras bu mi bslu zhing 'jig rten na dkon mchog gsum gyi snang ba rnam par bkod pa'i phyir ma ga rnya byang chub kyi snying por mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par mdzad pa sogs mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor ba yin te/ de yang yul wa ra ṇa si drang srong lhung ba ri dwags can gyi nags su 'khor lnga sde bzang po lha brgyad khri dang bcas pa la bka' dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ gnas rgyal po'i khab kyi bya rgod gung po'i ri la 'khor rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la bka' bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor bskor/ gnas yangs pa can 386

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra gsung thor bu/༷ ༷ ཿ — — — ༷ — ཿ — — ཿ ཿ — ཿ ཿ ཿ ༷ dang lang na'i yul rtsa mchog drung sogs nas bka' tha ma legs par rnam par bye ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba ste rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa gsumarang /'bras gu gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa yang 'og min dang / dga' ldan dang /ri rab lhun po'i rtse rnams su byang chub sems dpa' dang / lha rnams kyi ched du gsungs shing /mi yul du'ang / 6rgyan dang / sham bha ladang / rgyasatsho'i 'gram sogs su las dang mkha bar ldan pa'i gang zag 'ga' zhig la gsungs kyang khyab brdal du mi sgrogs pa'i bka' rgyas gdab/ de nas skudangos kyi gdul bya rdzogs pa dang / gyad yul rtsa can gyi shing drung du mtshan dpe'i gzugs sku zhi ba'i dbyings su zim pa'i tshul bstan pa ste/ de ltar ston pa sangs rgyas kyi byon tshul mdo tsam zhus nas/ da bstan pa dam pa'i chos kyi dar tshul ni/ ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su byu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa la/ theg dman nyan thos kyi sde snod ni/ bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun zhes grags pa/ 'od srung chen po dang / kun dga' bo sogs sangs rgyas dang 'dra ba'i nyan thos chen po bdun las rim par brgyud cing / bka' bsdu rim pa gsum du mdzad de dgongs 'grel bstan bcos sogs kyi sgo nas dar rgyas su mdzad/ theg chen pha rol phyin pa'i sde snod rnams ni/ rgyalasas 'jam dpal dbyangs dang / byams mgon sogs kyis rjes su bzung ba'i slob dpon chen po klu sgrub dang / thogs med/ zhi ba'i lha sogs 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis rmad du byung ba'i slob dpon bzhi rnams kyis dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa rnams ni/ ji skad du/ rgyu la mos par rgyu'i chos kyi/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor byas nas/ /rdo rje theg pa'i nye 386

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gagang thor bu/ ba ༷ ba mi 0 ma lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ rgyal ba mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyer brgyad lor pa na/lha grags ldan mchog skyong /gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong / klu rgyal 'jog po/ srin po blo gros thabs ldan/mi'i rig 'dzin li tsa bi dri med grags pa ste dam pa'i rigs can dra ma lngas nang du yang dag 'jog pa las bzhengs te/ ri bo ma la ya'i rtser rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pas 'dus te mgrin gcig tu/ kye ma kye hud kye ma klong / /ston pa sgron ma'i 'od nub nas/ /'jig rten mun pa gang gis sel/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i gdung tshig nyer gsum bton pas gsang ba'i bdag po dngos su phebs te/sngar lha gnas gsum du gsungs pa'i rgyud sde mtha' dag dam pa'i rigs can dra ma lnga la tshang bar gsungs/ de'i dus su srin po blo gros thabs ldan gyis bee ḍūrya'i shog bu la gser zhun ma'i yi ger bris te dgongs pa'i rtsal bdun gyis rgyas gdabs te nam mkha' mdzod du byin gyis brlabs/de'i mthu las/sa hor ra'i rgyal po dza la mis ltas ngo mtshal can bdun byung nas/ sgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad pas mis ltas dang mthun par bskyed pa ma hā yo ga'i tant+ra chen po sde bco brgyad kyi glegs bam rnams sgra dang 'od du bcas te pho brang gi steng du babs/de dang dus mnyam par rdzogs pa gnu yo ga'i rgyud rnams siṅga la' yul gyi gas tshal du babs/ rdzogs chen masati yo ga'i rgyud rnams nub phyogs ma rgyan gyi yul nas sprul pa'i sku mchog dga' rab rdo rjes ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' las dngos su gsan/ bya ba'i rgyud rnams wasar ṇa sir babs/rnam 'byor rgyud rnams me ri 'bar ba'i rtse mor babs/ de nas gsang sngags phyi nang gi rgyud sde mtha' dag/ mi yul du yongs su grags par gyur te/ rgyud sde 387

rdzogs chenas chen padma bapa'i gsung thor ga — — — — — — ༷ — — — ཿ — — — rang rang gi bdag por gyur ba'i slob dpon so sos dgongs 'grel sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas ba mdzadade/ gsang chen sngags kyi bstan pa mkha' la nyi ma shar ba lta bur gyur/ khyad par gsang chenanang gi ta rnams lha'i yulasadu 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis lha grags ldan mchog skyong la bshad/de nas rim par brgyud de lha yi dbang po brgya byin 'khor tshom bu 'bum dang bcas pa tshogs kyi sgrub pas rdo rje 'chang gi sar gshegs/ klu yi yul du rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyis klu rgyal mgrin pa nag po la bshad/ denas rim par brgyud de klu rgyal 'jog po 'khor tshom bu 'bum dang bcas pa rig pa 'dzin pa'i sar gshegag gnod sbyin gyi yul du gsang bdag phyag na rdo rjes kun tu bzang po la bshad/ de nas rim par brgyud de gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong 'khor tshom bu 'bum dang bcas pa rig 'dzin gyi sar gshegs/ mi yi yul du li tsa tha dri med grags pas chos rgyal lung bstan rdo rje la bshad/ de nasasras mo go ma de ci'i bar du brgyud de thams cad kyang rang rang gi 'khor tshom bu 'bum dang bcas pa tshogs kyis bsgrub pa'i sgo nas rig pa 'dzin pa'i sar gshegs pa yin te/ de yang rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du mdo sngags kyi bstan pa dar tshul mdo tsam zhig zhus pa lags/ /de nas gangs can bod kyi rgyal khab chen po 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po 〉ji ltar dar ba'i tshul ni/ byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying bo'i sprul pa bod kyi rgyal po lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyi sku ring ga ma cig lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang yum bu bla mkhar gyi rtse mor mdo sde za ma tog dang /spang skong phyag rgya/ shā tsha'i skor phor bcas babs te dam pa'i chos kyi dbu 388

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ — ༷ — — zhe — — — — —— — ཿ ༷ sto — — 0 brnyeg de'i rgyal rabs lnga nas mgon po spyan ras gzigs bod kyi rgyal po'i tshul bzung ba sprul pa'i chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos dam pa'i chos kyi srol gtod/ de nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs khri srong lde'u btsan gyi ring la bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad pa yin te/ de yang rgya gar 'phags pa'i yulanas sargyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa dang / mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho gnyis kyis gtso mdzad paṇḍi ta brgyadang rtsa brgyad bod yul mun pa'i gling du spyan drangs/ lo tsā chen po ska cog zhang gsum sogs lo tsā ba brgya dang rtsa brgyad kyis sgra bsgyur nas dam pa'i chos kyi sgon me sbar te/ bod khams dkar por btang ba yin zhing / de'i nang nas kyang bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir bka' drin lhag par che ba ni sargyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa yin te/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i slob pon chen po 'di nyid spyir 'dzam bu'i gling gi 'gro ba mtha' dag dang / dgos gdong dmar bod kyi sems can rnams 'dul ba'i phyir thub pa'i dbang po mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgyad lon pa na rgyal ba 'od mtshan stong 'bar gyi gsang gsum ye shes sgyu ma'i rol gar tshargyan snya na ko sha'i mtsho gling du bsgyur ba las/me tog padma'i snying po la rdzus te 'khrungs pa'i tshul bstan/ masargyan rgyal po ind+ra byu ti'isras kyi skal ba mdzad/ thabs la mkhas pas rgyal srid spangs te dur khrod chen po brgyad du brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa bskyangs/ pa grub rig 'dzin du mas rjes su bzung nas smin grol gyi gdams pa thugs nyams su bzhes pa'i tshul mdzad/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyi spyod pas brgyan/za hor/ ma ga rnya/ gser gling / zangs gling sing ga la'i nga sogs yul/ gru bas gyis mikhu bapar 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad/ mdor na mi lo sum 389

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapo'i gsung thor bu/ mi — mi la mi ba ༷ ༷ ཿ ༷༷ ༷ spyo ༷ — stong drug brgya'i bar la rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad pa'i mthar gangs can bod kyi yul 'dir phebs te/ lha srin gdug pa can rnams dam la btags/ bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs shing rab tu gnas pa mdzad/ sgrub gnas ri brag thams cad byin gyis brlabs/ chos dang nor gyi gter kha bsam gyis mi khyab pas bod yul mtha' dbus med pa phyur bur bkang / bka' babs snying gi bu dgu dang / las can rje 'bangs nyer lnga sogs gdulabya min grol gyi lam la bkod/ mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho las 'dul 'dzin sad mi mi bdun rab tu byunganas/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i gzhi bting gle mdo sngagasacheng 'jug gi bstan pa dar bar mdzad/ de nas bstan 'dzin dge 'dun gyi phebs tshul ni/ bod du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba nas bzung snga 'gyur gyi bstan pa rin po che dang po gnyags la babs/ /gnyags chen 1 na ku ma la slob ma dpal gyi ming can brgyad sogs grub pa thob pa mang du byon/ bstan pa'i babs so gnyis pa ba/nub la babs/ ga/nub chen sangs rgyas ye shes la slob ma thugs zin gyisas bzhi/ sras kyi dam pa khu lung pa yon tan rgya mtsho dang lnga/ga na yang brgyud 'dzin gyi skyes bu du ma byon/ bstan pa'i babs so gsum pa zur la babs/ zur po che shākya 'byung gnas la slob ma rtse mo bzhi/ rtse lkog brgyad/ sgom chen brgyadang rtsa brgyad byung / zur chung shes rab grags pa la slob ma na ba bzhi/ gdung ma brgyad/ phyams bcu drug/gral ma sum cu rtsa gnyis/sgom chen mi gnyis su grags pa rnams byung / zur sgo phug pa shākya seng ge la slob ma nag po bzhi/ ston pa bzhi/ mes bzhi dang bcu gnyis kyis gtso byas 390

rdzogs chen mkha chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ spre ༷ — — zhe — ཿ — — — — — ཿ ཿ — ཿ ཿ ༷ ཿ rsha — gdugs thog pa'i bshes gnyen stong phrag gcig byon te/ de gsum la zur pa mes dbon rnam gsum zhes gragag ga na yang gsar rnying kun gyi khrod na zla med pa'i mkhas grub chen po rong zom chos kyi bzang po dang kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer te mkhas mchog rong klong rnam gnyis/ mnga' ris paṇḍi ta padma dbang rgyal/ gter ston gyi rgyal po nyang chos rgod gsum sogs dang / gter chen 'gyur med rdo rje/ lo chen rnyarma 1 rig 'dzin padma phrin las/ kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa sogs sa'agyur gyi bstan 'dzin 'gran zla dang bral zhing mtshan nyi zla ltar grags pa rnams kyi slob brgyud dang / chos brgyud kyis deng sang gi skabs su dbus gtsang khams gsum du khyab nas yod pa 'di ltar yin te/ de yan gyis bstan 'dzin dge 'dun gyi phebs tshul mdo tsam zhus grub/ /da bye brag tshom bu tshogs kyi sgrub pa chen po 'di nyid kyi lo rgyus cung zad cig zhu na/ phun sum tshogs pa lngas gzhi bzung / bsnyen thab yan lag bzhis gzhung bsras / 'bras bu rig 'dzin 'grub pa'i dus bstan/ smon lam bkra shis zab mos mtha' brgyan pa dang bcas pa rnams las/ dang po ni/ ston pa gnas dang 'khor tshogs tshe/ /dus dang sdud pa shugs las shes/ /zhes pa ltar/gleng gzhi phun sum tshogs pa lnga'i khog phubanas zhu ba la/ dang po ston pa phun sum tshogs pa ni/ rdzogs chen rin po che nyid sngon bskal pa grangs med dang po'i tha ma la bde gshegs rin chen gtsug tor can zhes grags pa sems can 'chi kha ma rnams kyi rna bar mtshan lan gcig thos pas kyang / ngan song gi sdug bsngal las skyo cing thar pa'i sa bon thebs nus pa stobs bcu mi 391

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapo'i gsung thor bu/ — — — — zhe ༷ — — ༷ — — ༷'jigs bzhi sogs sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bdag nyid can du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas zin kyang / slar yang mkha' khyab kyi 'gro ba mtha' dag srid pa'i rgya mtsho las bsgral ba'i ched du dag chen ye shes kyi rol pa chu zla'i rol gar gyi rnam pa bzhin shar ba/ rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mdzod la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba'i grub thob ku ku ra dza/ spros bral phyag rgya chen po'i de nyid mngon du gyur pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sa ra ha/'ja' lus 'pho ba chen po'i sku mchog brnyes pa'i paṇa chen dri med chos kyi bshes gnyen/ sde brgyad bran du 'khol ba'i rlangs chen dpal gyi seng ge /thog chen mda' ltar 'phen pa'i lang gro dkon mchog 'byung gnas/ thub bstan nyin mor byed pa'i mnga' bdag khri ral pa/ gti mug lam du slong nas nyin mtshan 'od gsal gyis 'da' ba grub chen phag tshang pa/ rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rje'i sras kyi thu po ngan rdzong ston pa bo rnyi rā dza/ ma 'ongs pa na skal bzang rnam 'dren drug par 'tshang rgya ba rgyal ba seṅge'i nga ror 'gyur ba na pa dus gsum mkhyen pa/rtogs pas rang rgyud grol pa'i grub thob gling rje ras pa/ bla ma'i mos gus lam du slong nas snang srid chos skuragrol ba'i rje btsun stag lung thang pa/ brtul zhugs spyod pas myos pa snang ba zil gyis gnon pa'i grub thob 7rgyan pa/bshad sgrub gser gyi 'khor los thub bstan gleng bzhi'i khyon la dbang bsgyur ba'i kun mkhyen blo bzang grags pa sogs dag pa'i rol gar 'a mas mas pa'i mthar/ spyir snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa dang yang dgos 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i bstan pa'i bdag por gyur pa/ mdo khams grub pa'i dbang byug rdzogs chen padma rig 'dzin zhes mtshan snyan gyi ba dan srid pa gsum gyi khyon 392

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor sa/ —— — — — — — ༷ ཿ — — — ba ༷ 0 ཿ ladu grags pa de nyid byon te/ de yang skyes bu dam pa 'di nyid sku chung ngu'i dus na rig gnas dang bzo rigs la mkhas pa'i rtse mor son/ sku'i lang tsho dar la babs par skyo shasanges 'byung drag pos thugs rgyud bskul te/ bya btang rnal 'byor chen po'i brtul zhugs bzung ste/ phyogs med kyi ri khrod rnams su phebs nas rig 'dzin chos kyi rgya mtsho dang / mkhas grub sa chags med sogs bla mar bsten te smin grol gyi bdud ci bzhes/ de nas grub thob chen po nyid kyirdo rje'i gsung las/ ngas sgrub gnas de bsam yas mchims phur byas//spyod pa de rtsa ri rong du bskyangs/ /rten 'brel de lho ga mkhar chur byung / /'gro don de yul 'brog kun la byas/ /gsungs pa ltar/ dpal kyi bsam yas mchisas phur nges don snying po'i sgrub pa mthar phyung / ma dang mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas chen rtsa ri ye shes kyi 'khor lor spros med nye rgyu'i spyod pa bskyangs pa la brten nas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ lho brag mkhar chur bzhugs tshe lha lcam manda ra bas sku lus de nyid kyis mkha' spyod la phebs pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs kyang / bdag cag gdul bya'i don du lhag par brtse ba'i thugs rje chen pos dang du ma bzhes/ khyad par 'od gsal gsang ba snying thig gi dgongs pa mngon du gyur nas rig pa tshan phebs kyi snang ba rdzogs te chos nyid zad pa'i snang ba la 'khyol du nye ba'i lam gas kyi yon tan mtha' dag mngon du gyur pa yin te/ rgyal dbang lnga pa rin po che nas phul ba'i chang shog kun bzang zhal ngom las/ /longs mdza zhing mang nyul ba thod rgal gyi/ /dkar ser khra men sgron ma drug gi gnad/ /nan tan bgyid khyod rang rig kun tu bzang /rang zhal mjal ba'i bar du dar yol tsam/ /zhes kun tu bzang 393

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ — — — — — ཿ ཿ — — — — — — bo dang dgongs pa dar yol tsam las khyad med par gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang /tshad phebs rdzogs nas chos nyid zad sa ru//'khyol la cang mi ring pha rol na/ /skyon bral yon tan kun rdzogs rang gi sems/ /khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang du btags pa yod/ /ces pa sogs bsngags brjod me tog gi phreng ba char du bsnyel ba'i grub dbang rin po che de nyid la/ rgyud 'dzin gyi slob ma gsang chen zab mo'i gter gyi 'khor los bsgyur ba gter chen nyi mkhrags pa/smra ba'i seṅge tshad ma'i skyes bu rab 'byams pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ rdzogs pa chen po gzhi la ba gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa'i grub chen nam mkha' 'od gsal gsum gyi gtsos mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i skyes chen du ma byon/grub chen rin po che de nyid kyi skyes rabs ra bu'i phreng ba gnyis pa/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin ni byang phyogs mtsho sngon por sog po 6gur dkar po'i sde par sku 'khrungs gdan sa chen por phebs nas 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad pas rgyal ba'i bstan pa la bya ba rlabs po che mdzad/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che'i bklag lung gi rgyun spel ba sogs mdzad pa rgya che/skyes rabs nor bu'i phreng ba gsum pa/ ati bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nam nges don bstan 'dzin bzang po ni/ zla klung sngon mo'i rgyud du sku bltams khrir phebs nas thos bsam sgom gsum/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum/ mkhyen brtse nus gsum sogs dam pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pas brgyan cing / khyad par snga 'gyur bstan pa'i snying po bka' ma mdo sgyu sems gsum gyi srol/ btod nas/ 'og min margyan smin grol gling gi phyag bzhes ji lta ba bzhin chog gra bcu gsum gsar du 'dzugs par mdzad pas/394

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/༷ la — la mi — ba ༷ sa na — ba la ཿ shā pa — la la la cha 0mdo khams smad phyogs kyi bstan pa'i mig rgyan du gyur par mdzad/ rje de nyid kyi yang srid 'khrungs rabs nor bu'i phreng ba bzhi pa zhabs pad gser gyi 'khor lo'i mtshan pa mi 'jigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i khri la 'khod de gsang chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bzhin du bzhugs shing da res kyi skabs su ston pa phun sum tshogs pa'i ngo bor gyur pa mchog gi rdo je slob dpon mtshan brjod par dka' yang / don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na grub pa'i dbang byug mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje tshe dbang grub pa rtsal zhes mtshan snyan gyi gling bus 'dzam gling gi sum cha gnyis khyab par byon pa 'di nyid ni/ rgyud las/ ston pa mdzod ldan chu bo rdzogs/ /gnyer ldan rgyud dang las la mkhas/ /man ngag drod dang brgyad 'chang ba/ /gsang sngags bla ma'i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lta spyod ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi mdzod dang ldan zhing /dbang bzhi'i chu bo rdzogs pa/ gdams ngag gi gnyer kha dang ldan zhing / gzhi lam 'bras bu'i don la mkhas pa/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las rab 'byams la byang zhing man ngag gi drod tshad brnyes pa ste rang bzhin kyi yon tan dang ldan zhingakhur par du yang lta ba'i phu thag chod pas chos nyid zad sar 'khyol/bsgom pa klong du gyur pas 'od gsal la g.yo 'gul med pa/ spyod pa tshad du phyin pasatshogs drug rang sar grol ba/ rtogs pas bdag rgyud grol bas chos brgyad kyi 'dor len dang bral ba/ thugs rjes gzhan rgyud grol bas 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa gang gi gser zhal rin po che mngon du gyur pa 'di ni ston pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / gnyis pa gnas phun sum tshogs pa ni/ 'og min rnam snang chen po'i zhing khams/ bcu gsum mi mjed 'jig rten gyi 395

rdzogasachen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor ku/ — — — ༷ — — ཿla ཿ — ཿ — ༷ — ༷༷ ༷khams las bye brag shing 'dzam bu prikṣas mdzes par byas pa'i gling chen po de las kyang / byang phyogs gangs ri'i ljongs sgo ṭa hor gyi rgyal kha chen po las smad mdo khams sgang drug tu grags pa'i nang tshan 'bri zla zal mo'i sgang gi char gtogs pa srid pa'i lha rabs yongs kyi gtso bo ri dbang rgyal po spun dgu'i ya gyal/ lha gnyen la khrom rdo rje g.yung drung gi g.yon zhol/ 6rgyan chen pos bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub gnas/ yar lung shel gyi brag phug rdzong padma brtsegs pa'i gnas kyi cha lag tu gyur pa ru dam dpal gyi dben gnas zhes grags pa'i gnas mchog chen po 'di nyid rgyud sde rnams nas bshad pa'i sgrub pa'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa ste shar byes/ lho spungs/ nub 'dan/ byang yol ba bres pa 'dra ba gnam sa bar gsum gyi sa dpyad phun su tshogs pas bkra shis shing byin chags pa/ shar gyi stag skya bo/ lho yogayu 'brug sngon mo/ nub kyi bya dmar mo/ byang gi rus sbal rgya bo bcas pa'i bsrung bzhi tshang ba/ nyi zla'i 'od zer 'char snga zhing sdud phyi ba/ mdun du de'u seng dang me tog gi gling chags pa/ gangs ri 'gyur med g.yu mtsho gtan 'khyil sogs gsang sngags bsgrub pa'i ga sa rgyal ba'i lung dang mthun pa/ rig 'dzin grub thob du mas byin gyis rlabs shing mkha' 'gro dang dam can sprin ltar 'du ba'i gnas/ margyan bsam gtan chos gling gi gtsug lag khang chen po thub bstan yongs 'dus dga' tshal du grags pa 'di nyid ni gnas phun sum tshogs pa dang / gsum pa 'khor phun sum tshogs pa ni/ gsang chen bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang thob cing dam tshig gtsang ba bskyed rdzogs yan lag dang bcas pa la mkhas shing brda dang brda len la byang ba'irdo rje'i 396

rdzogs chen gag chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/la — zhe — — — — — — ༷ — — ཿ — — ༷ ཿ — — — ཿ mched lcam spyi dang khyad par rdo rje slob dpon dang dgongs pa cha 'dra zhing 'chad phrin la mkhas pa'i rdo rje rgyal theb/ sbyor ba'i rtsal shes shing rtse gdung chaba'i las bzhi'i ga ngas/ phyi nang gi bgegs tshogs skod pa'i rdo rje kiṅka rā/ drod 'dzin pa'irdo rjes rog/mthong ba zlog nus pa'i rdo rje spyan pa/skad snyan zhing phrin las kyi go rim la mkhas pa'i rdo rje byang 'dren/ bza' btung g.yo bskol la mkhas pa'irdo rje byan po/phyi nang bad sbyor la mkhas pa'i rdul phyags skyes bu la sogs pa 'du bar 'os pa'i 'khor 'dus pa rgya mtsho ni 'khor phun sum tshogasapa/ bzhi pa chos phun sum tshogs pa ni/don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po rnon po'i dbang byas nas/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes pa ltar/ rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa las khyad par rnam pa bzhi'am bco lngas khyad par du 'phags pa 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa yin zhing / de la yang snga 'gyur rnying ma dang / phyi 'gyur gsar ma gnyis las/ 'dir bsgyur ga gnas kyi che ba/bsgyur bya chos kyi chab/ sgyurakhyed lo tsa'i che ba/ bla mchod paṇḍi ta'i che ba/ spyan 'dren yon bdag gi che ba/ zhu rten maṇḍal gyi che ba bcas/ che ba drug gis khyad par du gyur pa snga 'gyur rnying ma'i chos de la yang / zhal nas gsung ba'i bka' ma/ rjes su gnang ba'i gter ma/ byin gyis rlabs pa'i dag snang ma ste brgyud pa'i bka' srol chen po gsum du yod pa las 'di di rjes su gnang ba'i gter ma yin te/ thang yig las/ lho kong byang kong sbas pa'i gter kha 'di/ /mi bzhag 'don pa'i gas de bstan nas byung / /sargyan las 'phro gling pa zhes bya 'byung /zhes gsungs pa ltar slob dpon chen po'i zhal slob lhag 397

rdzogasachen mkhan chen padma bapo'i gsung thor bu/ zhe ga — — — — — ༷ — — ༷༷ ཿ ཿ — — med 'od lus grub pa'i grub thob brgya dang rtsa brgyad kyi nang nas nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po'i skyematha'/ rig 'dzin 'ja' tshon snying po/ sngags 'chang sa nag me 'bar/margyan las 'phro gling pa zhes mtshan gyi rnam grangs du mar grags pa de nyid kyis nyang wa rā ṇa ngos ham 'phrang lcags kyi sgo mo nas spyan drangs pa'i yang zab dkon mchog spyi 'dus su grags pa 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i chos sde lhun grub snang stong du shar ba zab mo'i bskyed rim dang / mtshan med ye shes chen po'i rdzogs rim gtso bor ston pa/ byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma thams cad rgyal dbang padma 'od 'bar gyi ngo bor sgrub pa/dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam zhi khro thams cad drag po dmar nag me 'phreng gi ngo bor sgrub pa/ phrin las kyi rtsa ba ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma'i ngo bor sgrub pa ste/ rtsa ba gsum gyi dril sgrub khyad par can/ steng na rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gral ma zhig /sa la dkyil 'khor gru bzhi'i bkrag ma yal/ bar du sman gtor rakta'i mtsho ma skam/ bsnyen sgrub phyag bzhes kyi brgyud pa zam ma chad pa/ 'di nyid ni chos phun sum tshogs pa/gzhan yang sku gsung thugs kyi sgrub pa'i rten rab gnas can dang / phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas sogs sgrub rdzas gsang ba'i yo byad/ sha lnga bdud ci lnga sogs mchod mas gsang ba'i yo byad/ nad sel gyi sman/ dgra bzlog gi mtshon/bgegs bzlog nyul le skyod pa pho nya kun thub rgyal mo sogs rkyen bzlog rdzas kyi yo byad/ bza' btung gos rgyan sogs nyer mkho'i yo byad/ rgyud lung man ngag zhal shes sogs nyams len la the tshom gcod pa'i yo byad de/ sgrub pa'i yo byad phun sum tshogs pa zhes grags/ lnga pa dus phun sum tshogs pa ni/ rgyud 398

rdzogasaras ra padma batsho g.yo thor bu/ 0zhe sa ma ma tshul tsang sa tshu 'a ba ba tsa ma ༷ tsa las/ dus ni dbyar dgun ston dbyed kyi/ /ra ba dag la rab tu shis/ /brgyad nas nya yi bar la gtad/ /bkra shis gza' skar shis pa blangs/ /zhes pa ltar/phun tshogs dbyed kyi rgyal mo'i zla ba dang po ston pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ngo mtshar cho 'phrul chen po'i dus ston rnam dkar gyi dge ba gang byas 'bum du 'gyur ba'i dkar phyogs dga' ba dang po'i tshes nas rtsom pa dus phun sum tshogs pa ste/ sgrub gzhi phun sum tshogs pa lnga mdo tsam zhus nas/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i gzhung sgos ba 'di spyi dang bye drag gi khyad par mang yang 'dir sgrub pa chen po'i skabs dang sbyar na/ thog mar sa brtags pa dang /bslang ba la sogs pa'i cho ga dang / phyi mtshalas rgyal chen sde bzhi'i tho 'dzugs pa dang nang mtshams 'bar ba lta bas mtshams bcad pa/ bar mtshalas dam mimanan pa dang sgo byang phyi nang gdags pa sogs bsnyen pa/ dkyil 'khor chen po thig dang tshon gyis bris nas rgyan dgod cing byin 'bebs pa mchod rdzas byin kyis rlob pa sogs nye bsnyen/ dus bzhi'am drug tu gzhung bsrang nas gsal ba gsum dang ldan pa'i 'dzab bzlas la gtso bor brten nas tshogs kyi mchod pa dang / nyul le bskrad pa sos/sa zhag drug tu byed pa sgrub pa/nub tha ma la dngos grub blangs shing gzhan don du dbang bskur ba sogs sgrub pa chen po dang 'brel ba ste/ bsnyen bsgrub yan lag bzhi tshul bzhin du bsgrubs pas gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu rig 'dzin bzhi 'grub ste/ dpal gsang ba snying po las/ zhag ni sum cu phrag drug gam/ /bcu gnyis bcu bzhi bcu drug gis/ /dbang bsgyur rigs kyi dam pa 'grub/ /ces pa ltar/ dbang po'i bye brag gis rnam par sa pa'i rig 'dzin dang / tshe la dbang ba'i rig 399

rdzogasachen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gas thor bu/ — —— — — —47 — ༷ — ཿ ཿ ༷ — — ༷'dzin gang rung 'grub sa phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin la mtshalas sbyar nas/mthar thug lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang mngon du byed par 'gyur ba yin pas na/ mchog dman thams cad nas tshom bu tshogs sgrub chen po 'di'i dbu tshugs nas ma grol gyi bar du le lo dang rnam g.yeng spang ste rnam pa gas la/ rnam dag dran pa/ nga rgyal brtan pa gsum gyi nganganas/ sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gsu du shes pas rab kyis bzlas pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du bar mi chad par mdzad pa dang / phal pa rnams nas kyang don med kyi ngag 'chal dang ku co ha bgad/ rtsed mo/'khor 'dzing rnams spangs nas/ mgo zhwa 'greg /rgyab gos 'grig /rkang lham 'grig /byon lugs bzhugs stangag rtse zhwa/ rdor dril/ gdangs dbyangs/'don sogs gang gi thad nas kyang / zhe med chog bsam/ skyid med sdug zad du ma song bar/ 'dir bzhugs dbu mchod gon rim rnams kyi mdzad spyod la kha mig par ltos kyi lugs gas/ bya mig gyen ltas/ sgrog rus 'phred bcing gis/ spyir rgyal ba'i bstan pa/dgos gsang sngags rnying ma/ yang dgos grub dbang rdzogs chen pa yabasras kyi bstan pa'i mig rgyan du 'gyur ba'i mdzad pa mi dman pa'i sgo nas/ dad ldanarwangs pa 'dren pa'i mig rgyan/'byor ldan bsod nams bsags pa'i zhing sa/ mkha bzang thar lam ston pa'i ded dpon/ zhes gas pa'i gtam tshig dang don mthun pa zhig gnang ba'i bgos drin mi chung bar zhu/ de ltar legs bshad gtam gyi sbyor ba cung zad 'phags mchog mkhas dbang rgya mtsho'i snyan lam du phul ba'i mthu la brten nas/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i lung gas kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus 00

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapo'i gsung thor bu/gnas skabs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas pa dang / bstan 'dzin byi skyes bu rnams kyi zhabs pad bskal brgya'i bar du brtan cing / mdzad phrin yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba dang 'dus sde rin po che dbyar gyi mtsho ltar 'phel zhing thos bsam sgom pa'i bya bas dus 'da' ba dang / de'i mthus 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du yang /char chu dus su 'bebs/lo phyug rtag tu legs/mi nad dang phyug nad thams cad rgyun chad de/ rdzogs ldan gyi 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la longs spyod pa'i rten 'brel dang / spyon lam bzang pos mtha' brgyan pa de tsam du zhu lags/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsang chen mdzod/ /bla med mchog gi bstan pa 'di/ /ji ltar mkha' la nyi shar bzhin/ /rgyal khams bongs la dar rgyas shog/ //dge bskos mas kyis ji ltar bskul ba ltar/ mkhan mang padma badzra pas bris pa dge'o//maṅgas/// 01

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badza'i gas thor bu/༄ga /sa zla'i bum sgrub chen mo'i zhal bkod stong thun dngos grub mchog gi sgo 'byed bzhugs so/ /de la 'dir bdag cag gi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thabs mkhas shing thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de nyid kyis gdul bya'i sems can rnams kyi khams dang dbang po bsam pa'i bye brag dang rjes su mthun pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg pa'i chos tshul ji snyed cig gsungs pa las/'dir skabs su babs pa ni rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa las khyad par du 'phags pa 'thas bu'i theg pa'am rdo rje'i theg pa ste/ tshul gsum sgron me las/don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa dang / /dbang po non po'i dbang byas phyir/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mdo sngags kyi theg pa gnyis ga mthar thug gi 'bras bu don gnyis lhun grub kyi sangs rgyas sgrub par don gcig pa yin na yang / snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad snang dus nyid nas bsal bzhag 'gro 'ong med par spros bral rang byung gi ye shes gnas lugs don dam pa'i bden pa'i ngo bor gnas shing / de las shar ba'i rtsal snang brtan gama'i dngos po thams cad sku dang ye shes kyi rol pa 'ba' zhig tu lhun gyis grub pa lhag pa'i bden pa dbyer med chen por gtan la 'bebs pas rtogs 402

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor gu/don lta ba la ma rmongs pa'ikhur par dang / 'bras bu sgrub pa'i thabs byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i sgo rgya mtsho rnams kyang phyi lus ngag gi rtsol ba kho nas bamakha pa du mar thub pa la ma ltos par/ nang bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin spros bcas dang spros med kyi sgo du ma'ang re res skad cig re la yang bskal pa du ma'i tshogs 'dum par byed pas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i thabs myur la mang ba'i khyad par dang / 'jug sgo yangs shing dka' thub kyis mi gdung bar 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la ci bder spyod pas 'grub pas dka' ba med pa'i khyad par dang / ched du bya ba'i gdul bya dad brtson shes rab gsum gyis khyad par du byas pa'i gang zag dbang non ma gcig gis sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang sgrub pa'i lam yin pas skal ldan gdul bya'i khyad par bzhi dang ldan pa'i gsang ba sngags kyi theg pa yin/ de lta bu'i khyad par can gyi lam 'di la 'jug par byed pa la/ sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa gsum las/ thog mar sngon du 'gro ba'i chos ni/ gangs ri'i khrod kyi bstan pa'i shing rta pa chen po rgyal ba'i dbang po klong chen rab 'byams pas/ dang po sngon du 'gro ba'i chos bstan pa/ /mi rtag skyo shas spyi yi sngon 'gro ste/ /tshe 'di'i zhen pa gting nas ldog par byed/ /snying rje byang sems bye brag sngon 'gro ste /theg chen lam du chos rnams 'gro bar byed/ /de phyir thog mar sngon 'gro rnam gnyis sbyongs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lam sgrub pa'i rten khyad par can dal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa u dum wa ra'i me tos lta bu rnyed par dka' zhing / snyed na'ang yun du gnas pa'i mthu med par myur du 'jig cing mi ga pa'i tshul la bsam nas/ 'jig rten tshe 'di'i bya ba la ma 403

gsar mag ra padma bas g.yo thor bu/ — byed— — — — — — — — — — — na ཿ 4 — byedas par dam pa'i chos la gtso bor /shi ba'i tshe na dge sdig gi las gang byas pa byed mi za bar dbyed nag gi 'bras bu so sor byed pas las rgyu byedas la yid ches babyed/ mi dge ba dang dge ba zag bcas kyi byedas bu ngan song gabyed dang mtho ris rnam pa gabyed ste byed ba rigs drug gang du skyes kyang sdug babyed las ma 'das pa la babyed nas snying nas skyo shas drag pos rgyud babyed te/nges 'byung gi babyed pa brtan pos phyi ma'i bde byedas la mi chags par dkon mchog gsum la skyabs gnas su bzung nas thar ba sgrub pa'i thabs la 'bad dgogade thun mong spyi yi byed byed lags/de nas byebrag theg byed byed gyi byed byed ni/nam mkha'i mthasabyed pa'i sems can thams cad tshe rabs thog med kyi pha mar ma byed pa med la / pha ma byed pa ngo shes pa'i byedas byed 'di thams cad 'dod pa bde ba 'dod kyang / bde ba'i rgyu thar pa dam pa'i byed sgrub mi shes par/sdug babyed gyi rgyu sdig pa mi dge ba'i las la nan gyis 'jug pa'i las ngan byedal ba'i sems can 'di thams cad sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgyu byedas thams cad dang bral na ci ma rung snyam pa'i snying rje'i bsam pa shugs drag pos byed drangs nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mabyed pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che myur ba nyid du thob par bya/ de'i ched du spyir byang byed byedas dpa'i byed pa rgya byed dang / byed par du g.yo byed rdo rje'i theg pa'i a grol gyi lam la byed bzhin du babyed par babyed snyam du byang byed kyi sems rin po chababyed pa ni/theg pa che chung sems babyed khyad//ces pa ltar/theg byed byed gyi rtsa ba byed/ de nas rdo rje theg pa'i byed gyi na byed thun mong ma 404

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ — — — — — ཿ — ༷ ཿ spre ༷ ༷ ༷༷ ba ༷ yin pa ni/ kun mkhyen chen pos/ de rjesakhur par mchog gi sngon 'gro ni/ /dbang rdzogs thob nas bskyed pa'i rim gnyis te/ /rang lus lha dang snod bcud lhar gsal bas/ /tha mal 'dzin pa'i zhen pa zlog par byed/ /lam zab bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa yis/ /byin rlabs tshad med thugs rje shugs las 'char/ /bar chad kun sel dngos grub rnam gnyis thob/ /de phyir de rjes sngon 'gro rnam gnyis bsgom/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin/ dbang legs par thob nas dam tshig rnam par dag pas rgyud bsdam ste bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa la dang por zhugs pa ni/ rdo rje'i theg pa'i lugs kyi tshogs lam chung ngur tshud nas thar pa'i lam sde na pa yin par 'dod pas lam gyi gzhi dbang yin la/ thos mar dbang thob pa gal dza dbang de yang / sbyang bya sgo gsum cha mnyam gyi sgrib pa bzhi sbyangs shing / sbyong byed bskyed rdzogs yan lag bzhi sgom pa la dbang / sbyangs 'bras gnas skabs rig 'dzin bzhi dang mthar thug sku bzhi'i go 'phang thob pa'irten 'brel sgrig byed du/ bum pa gsang ba shes rab ye shes tshig dbang bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa legs par thob pa zhig dgos/dbang ma thob par sngags kyi lam la zhugs na 'bras bu med cing ngan 'gror sang bas nyes pa che ste/ gsang snying las/ slob dpon mnyes par ma byas shing //dbang rnams thob par masas par/ /nyan pa la sogs rtsom pa rnams/ /'a sa bu med cing brlag par 'gyur/ /ces dang / sgyu ma bde mchog las/ dkyil 'khor 'di ni ma mthong bar/ /rnal 'byor pa ni dngos grub 'dod/ /mkha' la khu tshuradeg pa dang / /mongs pa phub ma rdungarang mtshungs/ /zhes gsungs/dbang thob pa'i phan bon ni/ /gsang ba mdzod las/ /dbang skur yang dag 05

rdzogs chen mkha chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/༷ ༷ ༷ 0 la ༷ khye ba ༷ ༷ ga ༷ ba ༷ la ༷ sbyin ldan ni/ /skyezhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ /de yi skyeb bdun na di/ /ma 'bad par yang dngos grub thob/ /ces gsungs/ de yang dbang thob pa tsam gyis mi chog dam tshig rnam par dag pa mig gi 'angs bu bzhin du srung dgos te/ sdom 'byung gi rgyud las/ ci ste dngos grub mchog 'dod na/ /srog ni yongs su gtong yang ga /'chi ba'i dus la babs kyang sla'i/ /rtag tu dam tshig bsrung bar bya/ /ces dang / mnyam sbyor las kyangasha dkyil 'khor dag tu ma zhugs dang //dam tshig rnams ni spang ba dang / gsang ba'i de nyid mi shes pas//bsgrub kyang ci yang mi 'grub po/ /zhes gsungs pas/ gsar rnying spyi la grags pa'i rtsa ba'i lhung ba bcu bzhi dang / yan lag sgom po'i lhung ba brgyad sogs kyis ma gos pa dang / khyad par snga 'gyur rang lug/sa su grags pa/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg chen sa/nyis sa'i spyi don du gyur pa'i rigs lnga'i dam tshig la spyi'i dam tshig tu bzhag pa dang / khyad par du gyur pa'i rigs lnga'i dam tshig la drang don bskyed rim dang sbyar nas bshad pa/ nges don rdzogs rim dang par nas bshad pa/ mthar thug rdzogs chen dang sbyar nas bshad pa'i tshul gsum dang rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig la nyi shu rtsa bdun du bye ba dang / yan lag lta sgom spyod pa'i dam tshig la nyi shu rtsa lngar phye ba rnams dang / sgrub pa khyad par gyi dam tshig nyi shu dang bcas pa la khyad par gyi dam tshig ces bzhed pa dang / spyod pa rgyun gyi dam tshig bzhi/ rang bzhin lta ba'i dam tshig bzhi/ gral mdo nges pa'i dam tshig gsum/ ye bsrung chen po'i dam tshig bzhi ste bco lnga la lhag pa'i dam tshig zhes gsungs pa rnams/ legs par shes nas lag len du thebs par bya dgos/ de ltar dbang thob cing dam tshig 406

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma brdza'i gsung thor gaX ༷ la ༷ la la la la ༷ sa ༷ 0 da gsungs pa ltar/ sgrub bya zhi khro'itshar par las/ bgo ba gos dang gdag pa brgyan gyi yo byad/ zhi ba'i rgyan chas bcu gsum dang / khro bo'i chas brgyad rnams dang / bza' ba zas dang btung ba skom gyi yo byad/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang / bā la dang / ma dra na sogs bza' bca' btung ba'i rig/sa dang / bro gar 'du 'phro'i yo byad/ lag pas gar dang phyag rgya/ rkang pas bro dang stangs stabs sogs gar 'chal dang / glu tshig sgra yi yo byad/ glu yi 'dren stangs drug /sha ta pa ga rta pa/ cang ga de dang pad na de'u//zeng nge ba dang dung nge ba/ /zhes pa ltar drug dang / dbyangs kyi nga ro/ 'brug ltar zab pa'i sgra sgrogs dang / /rdo rje srin po'i ngur sgra dang / /'khur ba dbugs kyi rlung 'byen dang / /'khun cing gdung ba'i sgra 'byen dang / /tshangs pa dbyangs kyi 'dren tshul dang / /rdo rje khro bo'i bzhad sgras so/ /zhes pa ltar drug ste/ glu dbyangs kyi 'gyur ba bcu gnyis la brten nas/ ye shes kyi lha la snyan gsan dbabs pa/ ma mo dang mkha' 'gro grogs la bskul ba/ chos srung dam can las la rbad pa sogs tshigs su brjod pa sna tshogs pa ste/ dbyangs rol gyi bya ba la mkhas pa/ sa li shes rab dang ga li thabs te gsang ba'i yo byad gnyis dang bcas te/ yo byad lnga dang ldan par bya ba dang / gzhan yang dngos grub rten gyi yo byad/ mchod pa rdzas kyi yo byad/ 'tsho ba zas kyi yo byad/ dgra bzlog mtshon gyi yo byad/ nad bzlog sman gyi yo byad/ bgegs bzlog rdzas kyi yo byad rnams so/ /bzhi pa sgrub pa po phun sum tshogs pa la/ ston pa dang / 'khor gnyis las/ ston pa ni/ rang bzhin brgyad dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon te/ ston pa mdzod ldan chu bo rdzogs/ /gnyer ldan rgyud dang las la mkhas/ /man ngag drod dang brgyad 411

rdzogasachen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ — ༷ — spyo — ༷ — — ཿ — — ཿ ཿ ba ཿ byu ཿ ཿ chen ratna gling pa'i thugs sgrub kyi zhal gdams las/ kye ho 'dir tshogs /mi lus snyed/ /ces gsungs pa'i don/ rang cag dkyil 'khor gcig tu tshogs pa'i skal ldan 'dus pa lcam dral 'di thams cad bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas tshogs gnyis sngon du song zhing / thos bsam sgo gsum la blo sbyang / smon lam rnam par dag pas mtshalas sbyar ba la brten nas/ da res dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang mjal/khyad par gsang chen rdo sde theg pa'i chos dang 'phrad de/ tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i rang dbang yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ le lo dang bag med kyi dbang du ma song bar sgrub pa la snying rus bskyed dgos te/ kun mkhyen chos rjes/'khor ba'i 'khrul snang 'jigs pa'i lam 'phrang 'dra/ /'di las thar thabs dgos so sems lazung / /da res 'khrul na gtan du 'khrul bar 'khyams/ /de bas brtson pa skyed cig snying la zhog /nyon mongs rgya mtsho bdag 'dzin brgal dgazhi tsho/ /dal 'byor gru bos da res brgal bar bya/ /thar lam byang chub brgya las res 'ga' zhig /bsod nams dbang gis snang ba'i sanas skabs 'dir//snying nas brtson pas phan bde sgrub par bya/ /ces dang / dri med rgyal po bshags pa'i rgyud las/ 'di lta bu'i bka' zab mo 'di di bamakha pa dpag tu med pa'i gong rol nas byung sbyangs pa'i las 'phro dang / skal bar ldan pa 'ga' dang 'ga'ispyod yul yin gyi/ gang rung rung kun gyi thun mong ni ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs/ gsang sngags bla med / srog dang brdo dgos skal ldan rnams/ /ces gsungs pa'i don yang / gsang sngags bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhal phyes/ tshom bu gcig tu tshogs nas sgo gsum dkyil 4/6

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ ཿ — — spre — — — she zhe — zhe — zhe zhe thams cad dngos grub la bar du gcod pa'i bdud kyi las yin bas/ dran shes bzhin bag yod gsum kyi gnyen po bsten nas 'go ba'i nad bzhin du spongs shig /lam sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen/ bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha la dang ba dang mos gus/ bskyed rdzogs zab mo la brtson 'grus/ 'khor ba'i chos la nges 'byung dang skyo shas/ lha sngags kyi bzlas sgom la thun drug dang thun bzhir mi chags pa'i blo stobs bskyed par mdzod cig ces ga/sungs/ 'di 'dra'i dbang / bro bor skal ldan rnams/ ces pa'i don ni/ 'di 'dra ba'i rdo rje'i theg pa'i dbang dang sgrub pa ni 'jig/ rten gsum na dkon pas yang yang rnyed par dka'/ da res brtson 'grus bskyed pa gal che'o/ /snying nas brtse ba'i bslab bya 'di rnams ni thar lam gyi ded dpon/ byang chub kyi sa mkhan/ rdo rje rgyal po'i bka' yin pas gus pas nyon la dang du longs shig /gal te bka' las 'das na tshe 'dir dngos grub mi thob cing / phyi mar ngan song gi gnas su rang gis rang brlag pa yin pas/ blang dor gyi gnas las mi 'da' bar rang rang bi snying la dam bca' gyis la bro bor cig /de ltar byas na tshe 'dir bsam pa 'grub cing / phyi ma dag pa'i zhing khams khyad par can rnams su tshom bu gcis/ tu sangs rgyas pa la the tshom med pa rgyal dbang mtsho skyes rdo rje'i bka' yin par 'dug pas kun gyis thugs la 'jog par zhu/ rgyal ba kun gyi gsang chen mdzod sogs nas/ dar rgyas shog /byang 'dren pas/ masabs// skyabs gnas ma lus sogs mthar/ snang grags rig gsum sogs kyis grol lo/ /tshogs gtam ci dgos skabs dang bsan/'ga' yang zer rgyu las rgyu ma mang na dga'/ skyabs mgon gong ma de 417

rdzogasachen mkhan chen padma bapo'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ — zhe — — da — — she ༷ ཿ byu ཿ rag /rdzogs chen sgrub mchod chen mo'i zhal bkod kyi yi ge dngos grub rnam pa gnyis kyi gter zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /'o 'dir 'dus pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum dang rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor gyis thugs rgyud legs par gang zhig lung rtogs yon tan gyis brgyan pa'i tshogs pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i snyan 'ag du/ dam pa'i skyes bu snga ma rnams kyis zhal bkod re gnang ba'i lugs srol yod pas/ sa bcad mi nyams tsam du nyung bsdus zhig zhu ba'i dbang du byas na/ ji skad du/ yid ches nges pa sbyin pa'i phyir/ /thog mar brgyud pa'i lo rgyus bshad/ /nyams len srang du 'dzud pa'i phyir/ /stong thun snying por dril te bshad/ /bsnyen sgrub mtha' ru phyin pa'i phyir/ /rgyun gyi bslab spyod bsdus te bshad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ thog mar brgyud pa gang las byung ba'i lo rgyus smos pa'i dgos pa ni/ kun byed rgyal po'i rgyud las/ lo rgyus don gyis ma bshad na/ /gsang chen nges pa'i bka' 'di la/ /yid mi ches pa'i skyon du 'gyur/ /de phyir lo rgyus bkrol te bshad/ /ces gsungs pa bzhin/ brgyud pa'i bab tshul mang yang / 'dir rgyud las/ rgyal ba sems dpa' rnal 'byor pa/ /dgongs rig rna bar brgyud pa ste/ /gang la thug gi bar du'o/ /zhes pa bzhin 419

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor ga ba la la ༷ la ༷rgo ༷ cha la mi ༷ la ༷ — ཿ mi mi ba ཿ ba brgyud pa'i bab srol chen po gsum las/ dang po rgyal ba dgongs pas brgyud pa ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po 'di nyid/ nges pa'i don du bskal pa grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gong rol nas rang byung gi ye shes gzung 'dzin gyi grubs las grol te thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes brnyes nas/ gnas rnam dag 'og min stug po bkod par sku dang le shes 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang la/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi 'char gzhir bzhugs pa la dpal chos sku'i ston pa kun tu bzang po zhes mtshan gsol/ phyogs bcu dang dus bzhir byon pa'i rgyal ba thams cad dgongs pa gcig dang tha dad med par gnas pa la 'khor ye shes rgya mtsho zhes bya/ chos zab zhi spros pa dang bral ba'i dgongs pa las mi g.yo bar bzhugs pa la chos kyi sku'i gleng gzhir grags/ de nyid kyi ngang las 'khor sar gnas kyi sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi snang ngor/ gnas nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' klas pa/'og min khang bu brtsegs pa dang / mngon par dga' ba la sogs pa'i rigs lnga'i zhing khams bsam gyis mi khyab par/ ston pa rnam par snang mdzad dang /rdo je sems dpa' la sogs rigs lnga gangs chen mtsho'i rnam par rol bas/chos dgongs pa brda sgo nas ston par mdzad pa la longs spyod rdzogs sku'i gleng gzhi zhes grags/ de nyid kyi ngang la nam mkha'i zla gzugs chu mtshor snang ba bzhin/ thun mong 'jig rten pa'i snang ngor sprul pa'i gzugs brnyan ji ltar snang tshul ni/rigs lnga gangs chen mtsho'i sku'i ba spu'i khong bu re re na'ang /sprul sku'i zhing khams bas gyis mi khyab par snang ba las/ bye brag tu phyag mnyam bzhag gi mthil du spos chu'i rgya mtsho 'phro ba las 'khrungs pa'i snying 420

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ — — — ༷ — — — ye — ཿ ga ཿ — — — — ཿ ཿ ཿ ཿ po me tog gis brgyan pa'i zhing khams kyi nang tshan ze'u 'bru dbus ma'i steng du zhing khams nyi shu rtsa lnga brtsegs mar gnas pa'i bcu gsum pa mi mjed thugs kyi zhing khams 'di nyid kyi dbang ducos na/ zhing khams snga ma zhig chags nas zhig pa'i rjes su/ nam mkha' stong pa'i dbyings su rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang nag rgya gram gyi dbyibs can stong gsum gyi rgya tshad dang mnyam pa'i steng du/ zhi ba gas dag gi rgya mtsho 'khyil pa'i khar/ dbar chen gser gyi sa gzhi zho'i spris ma ltar chags pa'i gzhi la/ gling bzhi ri rab lha gnas dang bcas pa bye ba phrag brgya so sor lcags ri mu khyud dang bcas pas bskor nas yod pa 'di la mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams zhes bya ste sangs rgyas mchog gi sprul pa'i sku thub pa chen po gcig gi gdul zhing du snang der 'dul byed sprul pa'i sku'i snang tshul yang / ji skad du/ gtsang ma'i gnas dag spang ba yi/ /'og min ces bya nyams dga' ba/ /yang dag sangs rgyas der sangs rgyas/ /sprul pa po zhig 'dir sangs rgyas/ /zhes pa ltar/ bdag cag gi ston pa 'di nyid 'og min stug po bkod par dpal rnam par snang mdzad chen po mngon par byang chub pa'i rjes su lho 'dzam bu gling gi lte ba yul dbus rdo rje gdan snying po byang chub kyi shing gis brgyan pa'i drung du slar yang 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan nas/ thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor/ khyad par du gyur pa gsang sngags rdo rje'i theg pa rnams ni rgyal ba nyid dang dgongs pa tha mi dad pa'i thugs kyi sems dpa' gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje/ gsung gi sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs/ sku'i sems dpa' 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs la sogs pa rnams la 'og 421

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapo'i gsung thor ga ༷ ba sa ༷ ༷ ༷ sa min gyi zhing / dga' ldan gyi gnas/ri rab kyi rtse mo/ brgya byin gyi pho brang te/lha gnas gsum dang / gnas yulab dur khrod sogs mkha' 'gro dang grub pa can gyi gnas rnams su gsungs shing gsang bar bka' rgyas btab/ phyis gdul bya dus la bab pa na mi yul du grags shing rgyas par 'gyur bar lung bstan te/ spyi mdo dgongs pa 'dus pa las/ ngas 'di nas mi snang nag /lo ni brgyad dang bcu gnyis na/ /lha gnas gsum du grags pa yi/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /dzam gling shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi/ /mi las mkha ldan rigs can te/ /rgyal po dzaḥzhes bya ba la/ /sngon du ltas snang snang 'gyur te/ /drag shulacan zhes bya ba'i rtser/ /grogs kyi sems dpa' dman pa'i lus/ /laṅka'i bdag po la sogs la/ /lag na rdo rjes snang bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ ston pa sku gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyis rgyalams rigs gsum sems dpa' sogs la brgyud pa ni rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa/ de nas/'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis tshangs pa dang brgya byin sogs lha'i 'khor la gsang sngags rdo rje'i theb/ pa bstan pas/ tshom bu 'bum dang bcas pa rig 'dzin gyi sa la gshegs te bstan pa lha yul du grags/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzugs kyis klu rgyal 'jog po sogs klu'i 'khor la gsungs pas/ tshom bu 'bum dang bcas pa rig 'dzin gyi sa la gshegs te bstan pa klu yul du dar/dpal gsang ba'i bdag pos ri rab kyi byang phyogs lcang lo can du gnod sbyin gyi 'khor la bstan pas/ tshom bu 'bum dang bcas pa rig 'dzin gyi sa la gshegs pas bstan pa gnod sbyin gyi yul du rgyas/ de rnams la rig 'dzin mi ma yin gyi brgyud pa zer/ de nas mi yul du ji ltar byung tshul ni/ thub pa'i 422

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ 4) — — ༷ ༷ — — zhe shā — — — — ga — ba rsha dbang po sku mya ngan las 'dasanas lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad tsam na/ dam pa'i rigs can dru ma lnga ri bo ma la ya'i rtser 'dus nas ga/dung tshig gis gsol ba btab par/ bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis gsang ba'i bdag po la bskul bas/ gsang ba'i bdag po dngos su byon nas ma lnga sogs rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs la rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ de'i byin rlabs kyis sa hor gyi rgyal po dzaḥl ngo mtshal ba'i mis ltas dang bcas te glegs bam gyi char babs/ phyag na rdo rjes dbang bskur nas don gyi brgyud pa gtad/ rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal mthong / tshig gi brgyud pa li tsa ba dri med grags pa las gsan ga sasarā dza dang / u pa rā dza sogs nas brgyud de/ sras mo go ma de ci'i bar du tshom bu 'bum dang bcas pa rig 'dzin gyi sar gshegs te bstan pa mi yul du babs/ de rnams ni rig 'dzin mi yi brgyud pa ste/ de yan chad la rig 'dzin brda' brgyud dam/ sems dpa' rig brgyud du grags/ de nasawas mo go ma dre li'i slob ma slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba dang / pa chen bishā la/ margyan rdo rje 'chang sogs nas brgyud de 'phags bod gnyis gar dar zhing rgyas par gyur pa la gang zag snyan brgyud ces bya/ de la bstan pa snga dar gyi dus su/spyir rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che sde snod gsum dang /rgyud sde bzhi bcas thub pa'i bstan pa phyogs lhung gi ris su mi gcod par phyogs thams cad nas bshad sgrub las kyi 'khor lo gsum gyis bzung nas nyams len snying por mdzad pa yin/ khyad par du yang bstan pa'i snying po tshe gcig gis 'tshang rgya ba'i nye lam/ mdo dgongs pa 'dus pa/ rgyud sgyu 'phrul zhi khro/ rdzogs pa chen po byang chub kyi sems kun byed rgyal po ste/ de rnams rgyud 423
