rdzogs chen mkhan chen pa dma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ la ba la ༷ ༷ ༷ /0 — rsha pa rsha ba rsha ba ba mo gter gyi bka' babs rig 'dzin nyi ma grags pa/ grub chen me long rdo rje'i rnam 'khrul rdzogs pa chen po rang snang ris med kyi dgongs pa mngon du gyur nas nyin mtshan 'od gsal gyi snang ba khor yug tu brdal ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug nam mkha' 'od gas / bde gshegs mya ngan med pa tshur mthong gdul bya'i snang ngor mi yi zol du bstan nas lung rigs brgal brtags kyi 'khor los/ log pa'i rgol ba bye mar 'joms shing / thub bstan nyin mor byed pa rab 'byams pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rnams kyi gtsos bshad sgrub las kyi 'khor los rgyal bstan gsal bar mdzad pa'i slob tshogs nam mkha'i rgyu skar ltar bkra bas phyogs thams cad du khu / de nas rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' lung gis bskul nas/ mdo khams smad kyi phyogs su zab gsang rdzog/sa pa chen po'i bstan pa spel phyir chibs kyi kha lo bsgyur ba na//bsod nams stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po/ gnam bskos song ma chen pa'i lung gis bsngags pas/mdo khams sa yi bdag por dbang bskur ba/gnam sa'i dbang phyug chen po sde dge chos rgyal chen po'i gdung rabs rim par byon pa'i nang nas/ 6rgyan dus bsum mkhyen pa'i bkas lo tsā ba chen po cog ro klu yi rgyal mtshan gyi rnam 'phrul du lung yis zin pa'i khri chen sangs rgyas bstan pa zhes grags pa de nyid kyis/ rnam gsum dad pa'i sri zhu chen pos zhabs pad spyi bor bzhes te dbu'i mchod gnas su bkur/ gzhan yang gling dpon chen mgon po lhun grub/ sa sbyong sde dge rgyal po'i khrims kyi kha lo 'dzin pa gad thog gnyer chen lha lu la sogs pa'i mi chen mang po dang / 'byor ldan gyi khyer bdag du mas bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mdzad de/ mdo smad zo dor 45/

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ba ba ba da ba la ༷ spre ba cha la ༷ ༷ la / sa 0 0 yongs kyi gtso bo gnod sbyin ri dbang spun dgu'i ya khrul/ lha gnyen zil khrom rdo rje g.yu nga drung gi g.yon zhol/ 6rgyan rdo rje 'chang gi zhabs kyis bcasas byin gyis brlabs nas bdud ci sman gyi sgrub pa mdzad pas/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'du zhing / mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub rang bzhin gyis 'grub pa'i gnas ru dam skyid phram gyi lung pa zhes/ phu gangs dkar gyi la thod 'dzin pa'i ri rgyal po sadan la bzhugs pa lta bu/lho phyogs nags tshal gyi 'dab gur 'khrigs pa'i klung nas/ bdud ci 'o ma'i chu rgyun lta bu'i rgyun 'babs kyi mchod yon bgreng ba/ rgyab ri dar dkar gyi yol ba sbos pa lta bus kun nas bskor zhing / mda' sgom chen gyi skyil krung bcas pa lta bur shar byang gi ri sna bsnol bas ting 'dzin rang shugs kyis skye ba/ mdun du de'u seng me tog bi/sa brgyan pa gser gzhong mar khus bkang ba lta bus 'dod yon gyi gter kha rdol ba/ phyogs bzhir sa yi srung bzhi tshang zhing / mtshalas bzhir sa yi dpal bzhi ldan pa/ gzhan yang 'gyur med kyi gangs ri brtan chags/ dngos grub gyi g.yu mtsho gtan 'khyil/ dbang thang gi brag ri rtse rgyal/ bsod nams kyi thang chen mtha' rgyas sogs bkra shis kyi dge mtshan du mas phyogs thams cad nas brgyan pa/ rgyud dang bstan bcos nas bshad pa'i sa'i dpyad phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas 'di nyid du sargyan bsam gtan chos gling du grag/sa pa'i chos grwa chen po 'di btab/ 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lam gyi rnal 'byor pa sha stag tshogs pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde chen po stong byed lnga brgyar longs pas dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde rgyas/ de nas rim par sku rabs gnyis pa/ byang phyogs gur dkar po'i bdag po sog po pharod kyi sde par 452

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ cha cha shā ba nga 〉 la ba spyo zhe ba nga ༷ 0 0 'khrungs pa/ 'gyur med theg mchog bstan 'dzin mthu stobs dbang po phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde nyid khrir 'khod pa nas/ sa skyong chos rgyal chen po bstan pa tshe ring dang blo gros rgya mtsho bcas par mchod yon du 'brel bas/ bka' gter bshad sgrub kyi rgyun dang / bstan srid kyi phrin las gong 'phel du gyur/ de nas sku rabs gsum pa/ byang zla klung sngon mo dal gyis 'babs pa'i klung 'gram/ zla rgyud ho pa'i sde par sku 'a ngas pa/ nges don bstan 'dzin bzang po sa ti bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan du grags pa de nyid khrir 'khod/ mi dbang bsod nams bzang po yab sras dang mchod yo na du 'brel/rje 'di'i sku ring la snga 'gyur bka' ma mdo sgyu sems gsum sogs bshad sgrub kyi phyag bzhes gsar spel dang bstan pa'i bya ba rgya che/ de nas sku rabs bzhi pa/ chu bo gser ldan du grags pa/ 'bri klung sngon mo'i rgyud 'dan chos 'khor du sku 'khrungs pa/ bdag cag rnams kyi rigs kyi bdag po/ khu bdag gdod ma'i mgon po mi yi gzugs su byon pa/ mtshan brjod par dka' yang don gyi slad du mtshan nas sgos na/ grub pa'i dbang byug mi 'gyur nam mkha'i rdo rje tshe dbang grub pa rtsal zhes mtshan gyi ba dan dkar po srid pa'i rtse mor g.yo bde nyid khrir phebs/ mi dbang sa yi tshangs pa/ 'jigs bral tshe dbang rdo rje yab sras dang mchod yonazung du 'brel/ chos ser gnyis kyi mdzad pas rgyal khams thams cad bde skyid kyi dpal la bkod/ rje 'di nyid kyi ring la/thugasasras brgyud 'dzin yongs kyi gtso bo khyab bdag bka' 'gyur pa chen po rgyal sras gzhan phan mtha' yas 'od zer kyi thugs bskyed dang 'brel bar/bstan pa'i gzhi ma dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i phyag bzhes dang / rgyud kyi rgyal po 453

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor du/ ༷ ༷ la la 4 ༷ cha she ༷ 4 ཿ dpal ldan gsang ba snying po'i bshad pa sogs mdo sngags bshad grub kyi snang bas phyogs thams cad du khyab par mdzad/ skyabs mchog 'khor lo'i mgon po 'di nyid kyi ma 'dres pa'i mdzad pa/ dus rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lor/ thusas 'od gsal chos nyid kyi ngang du tshogs drug gi snang ba thams cad shar grol rjes med du dag pas/ sa dag gdod ma'i dbyings la rtsol rtog gi g.yo ba mi mnga' bar bzhugs bzhin du/ rjes thob ye shes kyi rtsal snang dmigs med kyi thugs rje chen por shar bas mchog dman bar ma'i 'gro ba thams cad la nye 'khon med par ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen por gyur pa'i ngang nas/bstan 'gro'i don chen gyi phrin las thams cad 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung bas rgyal ba rnams kyi mdzad pa dang dbyer med pa zhig ste/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ zhi sku dpag bsam shing ltar gsal gyur cing / /yid bzhin nor bu ji bzhin rnam mi rtog /'gro sgrol bar du 'jigarten 'byor slad rtag /'di ni phros dang bral la snang ba yin/ /zhes ba/sung ba rje 'di nyid kyi don gyi rnam thar du song bzhin/ don gnyis lhun grub ngang la sku tshe mthar phyin nas/ dgung grangs bdun cu rtsa brgyad bzhes pa lcag/sa pho rta'i lo'i smin drug zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba dang po'i tshes la gzugs sku'i bkod pa gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings nang gsal chen por 'khyil bar gyur pa de lta na'ang / dmigs mtha' bral ba'i thus/sa sde chen po'i 'phen pas 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phrin las rgyun mi 'chad cing 'gogs pa med pa ni rgyal ba rnams kyi chos nyid yin pas/deng gi dus 'dir yang / rtsod med kyi sprul pa'i gter ston chen po/ yorgyan mchog gyur bde chen gling pas spyan drangs pa'i/ 6rgyan rdo rje 'chang chen po'i 454

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ la ༷ — ༷ dzi cha mi mi ༷ ba ba na mi zhal lung dri masad pa las/ ltashug sogs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ma rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pa'i rgyal tshabs/ bsar rnying ris med kyi bstan pa'i bdag po/ deng sang tsam na khams dbus gtsang gsum tsam du ma zad rgya gar chu bo ga/da tshun chad dang rgya nag bkra shis khri sgo yan chad na/ mkhas dang grub pa'i rnam thar la 'gran zlar gyur pa 'ga' yang ma mchis pa don gyis thams cad mkhyen pa/ mtshan brjod par dkar ba/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'am/ kun mkhyenajo sde gzi ba da rtsal gyis lung don gsal bar mdzad pa ltar/ sngar gyi grub thob chen po'i 'khrungs yul dang gcig par/ khams kyi ri bo che'i phyogs su rnam par dkar ba'i bsod nams dang bsha lam gyi mthu las grub pa/ brgyan rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sgrib med ye shes kyi gzigs pa'i spyan ras kyis btsal ba'i/ ya mgon po rgyal dang / yum bsod nams g.yang mtsho gnyis kyisas su 'khrungs pa'i/ skyabs mgon mchog bi sprul pa'i sku 'a la med rdo rje'i lung gis tshad mar grub pa 'di nyid/ zhwa ser bstan pa'i mnga' bdag /lha gcig gangs ri'i mgon po 'phags mchog phyag na padma'i thugs rje ye shes sgyu ma'i rnam rol/ rgyal ba 'phag/sa pa lha zhes mtshan gyi yi ge srid pa gsum na gsal zhing grags pa gang gi zhal snga nas tshad med pa'i thugs rje dang bka' drin chen pos bskyangs pa'i bdag rkyen las/ da res 'dir mdo khams rdzogs chen pa'i gdan sa/ ma rgyan bsam gtan chos gling gi gtsug lag khang / thub bstan yongs 'dus dga' tshal gyi khyams chen po theg pa gsum dang khyad par 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun chad med par bskor ba'i gnas/ mi 'jigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i khri 45ba

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'igasung thor bu/ mi mi cha mi la la zu 7 'a ༷'phang mthon por/ sprul pa'i nyi gzhon gsar du 'char ba'i mtshan dpe'i dkyil 'khor lham mer 'bar zhing / zhabs kyi chu skyes rnam par bzhad pa bkra shis gser byi 'khor los mtshan pa nye bar bkod pa'i dge mtshan mngon du gyur pa'i skabs 'dir/ ston 'khor phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'byul dus su babs pa bzhin/ rim byon skye ba'i phreng ba rnams dang nyi ma dang 'od zer gyi tshul dunam yang 'du 'bral med pa/ dpon slob sprul pa'i sku 'jigs med chos dbyings 'od gsal/ rab 'a mas sprul pa'i sku padma 'gyur med rgya mtsho/nam mkha' tshe dbang mchog grub kyi yang srid gnyis pa kun bzang theg mchog rdo rje/ khyab bdag bku' 'gyur ba'i yang srid rin po che thub dbang bstan pa'i nyi ma/ 'gyur med phyogs las rnam rgyal sogs rgyal ba'i ye shes kyi rnam rol thugs rje yas sprul gyi gang zag rnams dang / bslab gsum yon tan gyis mngon par mtho zhing bshad sgrub phrin las kyi khur chen 'dzin pa'i zhal slob rnams dang / bskyed rdzogs snying po'i nyams len la gcig tu brtson pa'i ri sul gyi sgrub po rnams dang / lnga rig smra ba'i mchog lung dang risas pa'i mgrin rnga ldir ba'i mkhas pa rnams dang / bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen po/ sa chen chos bzhin skyong ba'i mi dbang chos rgyal mchog gi zhabs pad khrims kyi kha lo sgyur ba gnyer chen mdun 'khor lhan rgyas dang / dpal cha mdo byams pa gling gi sku zhabs rgyal ba mchog gi zhal snga nas kyi drung 'khor lhan rgyas dang /dad 'byor phun sum tshogs pa'i sbyin bdag gi tshogs dang bcas pa'i lhan gcig tu tshogs pa'i dus bzang po 'dir/ ji skad du/ 'jig rten skye bo nor gyis mgu/ /dam pa legs bshad gtam gyis dgyes/ /mkhas pa tshogs pa'i lha 56

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ — la la la ba ga ba ཿ 7 — kyigral na/ /legs bshad 'dra ba'i dga' ston med/ /ces grags pa ltar/ legs par bshad pa'i gtam cung zad cig gleng na/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba yongs kyi 'dren pa kun mkhyen rgyal ba shākya seṅge'i gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ dang po thos nas yid ches kyi dad pa byu bar du bsam na nges shes kyi spro ba 'phel/ tha ma bsgom na yang dag gi rtogs pa rgyud la skye ba'i rgyu yin pas na/ mgon po byams pas// dad dang spro dang blo rnams kyi/ /rgyu phyir chos 'di dge ba yin/ /zhes sasungs pa ltar/ thos/ mtha' bar gsum du dge ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs tshad med pa las/ 'dir skabs su babs pa zhes/ gang dang gang 'os de brjod par bya'o/ /mjug tu/legs par grub pa lags/ de ltar legs bshad gtam gyi sbyor ba cung zad/ 'phags mchog/ mkhas dbang rgya mtsho'i snyan lam du phul ba'i mthu la brten nas/ sa gsum gyi skye rgu mtha' dag gi phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyi lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus gnas skabs kun tu gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / bstan 'dzin kyi skyes bu bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi thugs kyi bzhed don thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya che zhing rgyun mi 'chad par bskor bzhin du/ zhabs pad bskal pa rgya mtshor brtan pa dang / dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde rnams thubs mthun cing longs spyod kyi 'du ba rgyas la bshad sgrub kyi bya bas dus 'da' ba dang / yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad du yang / char chu dus su 'bebs/ lo phyug rtag tu legs/ bde skyid kyi dpal phun sum tshogs pa la spyod pas rdzogs ldan gyi bskal pa gsar du 'char ba dang / chos ldan gyi rgyal po rnams lugs 467

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ da — — ཿ — 0 ཿ sa ga ༷ — — 2 ༷ gnyis kyi khrims btsan zhing / chang srid 'jam dar che bas rgyal khams chos bzhin skyong ba dang / dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i lha klu gzhi bdag rnams dbu 'phang mtho zhing gzi byinadang 'byor pa rgyas pas/ yul phyogs thams cad du bkra shis dang dge mtshan gyis khyab pa sogag bde legs kyi snang ba chen po dus rtag tu 'char bar gyur cig /zhes pa'ang mkhan ming padma rdo rjes smras pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ //dge'o// //458

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ sa ma ma zhe la cha ba nga nga — she — da pagag /snying thig dpal 'dus sman sgrub skabs kyi rtags gdab dang mar me smon lam gyi stong thun bcas bzhugs so/ /de yang / dus gsum thog mtha' dang bral ba'i 'og min khyab brdal chen po'i zhing na/ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal kun tu bzang po nyid chos nyid mnyam pa chen po'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du dras/ po la sogs pa'i gdul bya gdug pa can rnams kyi snang ngor dpal khrag 'thung chen po'i skur bzhengs nas 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor mngon par 'du mdzad de/ mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las kyis phyi nang gsang ba'i ru tra'i sde dang dpung du bcas pa bsgral ba'i tshe rgyal byed dpa' rtags kyi mtshan ma dur khrod chas brgyad sku la gsol zhing dpal gyi chas bcus mngon par brjid pa de bzhin du/ deng 'dir rig 'dzin sgrub pa po rnams kyang dug gsum ru tra'i sde las rnam par rgyal zhing /dpal te ru ga'i gdung 'tshob pa dang / ye shes dang 'jig rten gyi ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams kyis tshogs kyi rje bor mthong zhing dam can bsrung ma rnams las la 'khol bar bya ba'i phyir/ dpal gyi chas bcus mnga' gsol ba'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di rnams rjes zlos gnang bar zhu/ /459

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/༷ ༷ ༷ 0 cha ༷ ༷ ༷ba shā 0 byu spyo sa baX — kyi 00 0 rsha yang 'dzab kyi nang gses thug/sa dam gnad bskul kyi sngags kyi sgo ni/masacas( badzra asadza ta / ཿṭhaḥ sku gsung thubasardo rje'i bdud ci bsdus ba(ma brtan par mdzod/a ra li maḥkun tu rol khos/sngags don la/ kun tu rol ba'i mdzad pas sku gsung thugs kyi rdo ja'i bdud rtsi bsdus nas dam tshig gi bdud rtsi la bstem nas brtan par mdzod/ de ltar ma mdzad na sngon gyi thug/sa dam dang 'gal bas khyed rnams kyi dbu khos shig ces pa'o/ /de la 'dir/ sgrub pa chen po'i rjes kyi bya ba la/ sgrub pa'i mched lcam dang sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams tshom bu gcig tu mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i phyir mar me smon lam kyi skabs 'dir/ sto nga thun nyung ngu re bshad pa rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag srol du bda' bas/ snying por dril te zhu na/ spyir mchog thun gyi dngos grub gang sgrub kyang bsgrub pa'i gzhi/ sgrub byed kyi thabs/ bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu dang gsum gyi sgo nas shes par bya dgos pa las 'dir bsgrub pa'i gzhi ni/ rig pa byang chub kyi sems rtsal gdangs rol pa dang bcas pa ye nas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gdod nas dag pa'i bdud ci chen po'i rang bzhin du gnas pa nyid yin te/ rang gzhung las/ srid gsum gdod nas bdud rtsi lnga: ma bcos rang bzhin lhun grubarang : de nyid rgyal ba'i snya gsung thugs: 'bad rtsol med par ye sangs rgyas: ces pa ltar lags kyang / glo bur gyi sgrib pa dang / gtsang che'i rtog pas bcings pa'i dri ma bsal thabs bcas sgrub byed cho ga'i rim pa ni/gzhung las/rdo rje 'chang gi thabs tshul ni:sgyu ma mkhan gyis bde blag bzhin:'dul ba'i zin las tshad med pas: gnyis su 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog bdud:460

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gas thor bu/ mi ༷ ༷ la ba ༷ ༷ ba ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ — rsha ga — ga ye shes ci yis 'jom pa'i thabs: rmad du byung ba 'di bstan to: zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin sgrub pa la/ phun sum tshogs pa lngas gzhi bzung/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhis gzhung bsrangs/'bras bu rig 'dzin grub pa'i tshad dang phan yon bcas bstan pa las/ dang po ni/ sgrub pa'i gnas dus grogs dang mas/ /zhes pa ltar/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa ni/ rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ ston pa mdzod ldan chu bo rdzogs/ /gnyer ldan rgyud dang las la mkhas/ man ngag drod dang brgyad 'chang ba/ /zhes rang bzhin brgyad ldan gyis rje slob dpon dang / ston pa mchod brtson rtog pa ga/sal/ /dam tshig sngags dang phyag rgya rnams/ /ma nyams shes shing yo byad ldan// zhes yon tan lnga ldan gyi 'khor kun sum tshogs pa dang / sgrub pa'i gnas ni/ji skad du/ gnam sa bar gyi dpyad legs shing / /ljon shing chu klung me tog bkra//bkra shis bya tshogs skad snyan sgrog /grub pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sngon tshe dpal chen pos ru tra bsgral ba'i tshe 'dzam bu'i gling gi yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / dur khrod chen po brgyad te ru ga'i gnas su byin gyis brlabs pa dang / khyad par du dpal te ru ga dang gnyis su med pa grub pa'i rig 'dzin chen po rang byung padma rgyal pos gangs can bod kyi sa gzhi thams cad sgrub pa'i gnas su mdzad nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang tshan mdo khams smad kyi gangs rwa nyi shu rtsa lngar grags pa'i ya gyal/ yon tan gnas kyi gtso bo ru dam gangs kyi ra ba'i gnas kyi lte ba/ phu gangs dkar rdo rje slob dpon gdan la bzhugs pa lta bu/ mda' ri gnyis phan tshun bsgos ba rdo rje'i dkyilakrung bcas pa lta bu/ bar byin rlabs dngos grub kyi chu rgyun 461

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ khye mi ༷ sgo la ba ཿ ༷ zhe shā'o ma'i mchod yon byung ba lta bu sogs dge zhing shis pa'i rtags mtshan du mas brgyan pa/ sngon 7rgyan chen po dag pa'i 'khor lnga dang bcas pas de seng me tog bkra ba'i dbus su dar dkar gyi gur phub nas bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa mdzad de sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir dang / bdud rtsi cha brgyad du bsgos te phyogs mtshalas rnams su gter du sbas pa sogs chos dang dam rdzas kyi gter kha du mas gtams pa'i gnas/ zhing sbyong lha'i dge bsnyen chen podo rje g.yung drung rtsal la gnyer du gtad pa'i sa phyogs 'dir/ dus phun sum tshogs pa ni/ chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor rgyu skar gyi lha mo chu stod kyis nya ba'i dus tshes dge bar/ sgrub pa'i yo byad rgyan dang bgo ba/ bza' ba dang btung ba/ sngags dang glu tshig /bro gar 'du 'phro/ a li ga li ste lnga tshang ba'i sgo nas/ sgrub pa'i thabs phun sum tshogs pa ni/ mnga' bdag tshangs pa lha'i me tog gi ye shes sgyu ma'i zlos gar grub pa'i rig 'dzin chen po kun mkhyen 'jigs med gling pa'am padma dbang chen ye shes rol pa'i rdo rje'i dgongs gter nam mkha' mdzod kyi chos sde las byung ba che mchog bdud ci 'khyer ༷ pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas bdud ci sman gyi sgrub pa ste/rang gzhung las/'jam dpal rnon po'i thugs bskyed dang : bdag nyid chen po padma yi:klong byang ḍakki'i brda ris kyis: rgyud don ji bzhin gtan la phabs: zhes pa ltar phun su tshogs pa lnga dang ldan pas/ dngos gzhi bsnyen sgrub rnam bzhi'i ga nga bsrang ba la'ang nyin dang por sa'i cho ga dang / phyi nang gsang ba'i mtshalas bcad pa/ lha bum slob ma sta gon dang / chu tshon gyis dkyil 'khor bkra nas dal gyi rdzas 'god pa sngon du btang ba bsnyen pa dang / sgrub 462

rdzogs chen mkha chen padma badzra'i gsung thor ku/༷ la la ba mi ཿ na la ༷ ཿ la la rka 4 pa chen bo'i khog nang dbyung : zhes gsungs pa bzhin du bdag mdun sgrub pa'i rdzas rnams dbyer med du bskyed rim gyi las gzhung bsrangs/ 'dzab khang dbye nas bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gyi bzlas pa mthar chags su btang ste rtsa ba'i sgrub pa zhag gsum/ de nas gsang chen rigs bsdus bdud rtsi 'khyal ba'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas khrol bu'i sgrub pa zhag gsum/ sman btag btsag sbol gsum/ bdud rtsi dkyil 'khor du 'god pa sngon du 'gro bas/ dkyil 'khor drug dang sbyor ba brgyad ldan du zhal bsgyur te phye sgrub kyi dbu 'dzub pa zhag gcig sngon du btang bas zhag gsum du sgrub pa/ nyin tha mar bdud rtsi 'bebs bskyil dngos grub blang ba/ kha skong gi sbyinasreg dang bcas pas sgrub chen mthar dbyung ba bcas spyir sgrub zhag bcu gcig gi khongs su bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa phyag bzhes 'jung po ltar la/ de ltar bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu ni/rang mkha dang 'tshalas par zhi sogs las bzhi dang / 'dod gzugs kyi lha dang skal ba mnyam/ phra yang gi yon tan brgyad de thun mong na/ grub pa brgyad dang / mchog gi dngos grub 'phags lam gyis bsdus pa'i rig 'dzin bzhi/mthar thug mchog gi bdud ci bde ba chen po'i sku kha sbyor yan lag bdun gyi bdag nyid can du 'grub cing / zhar byung du thob pa'i phan yon yang gzhung las/ tshe ring da med bde ba dang : lang tsho kha dog stobs gzi brjid:'phel zhing dbang po rnam rig gsal: mkha' la 'gro zhing sbyor ngan gyi: nus pas mi tshugs ting 'dzin gsal: khyad par yon tan bsam mi khyab: lus la gnas pa'i bdud ci lnga: dwangs mar gyur nas 'chi med 'grub: 'du ba'i nad sel bdud bzhi 'joms: bcud len kun gyi rgyal po yin: spangs 63

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor ku/༷ mi mi ༷ la ༷ ༷ la ba la ༷ mi ༷ ba la ༷ mi mi rtos/sa yon tan ngang gis 'phel: 'di sgrub rgyal bas sras su dgongs: rtog la ye shes sman sbyar bas: dug lnga ye shes lnga ru rdzogs: gang du sgrub pa'i gnas phyogs de: nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul dang mnyamaḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro shugs la 'du: bkra shis byin chags ting 'dzin 'phel: sa dgra zhi zhing char chu 'bebs: lha klu dga' bas snod bcud rgyas: rtsi shing lo thog phun sum tshogs: de phyir rnal 'byor che rnams kyis: sems bskyed ting 'dzin dam rdzas kyi: cho gar ldan pas 'di sgrubs shig: de yis bsod nams brjod mi lang: rdo rje dam tshig gnas la'ang : rang bzhin spyod pa'i yon tan las:bsgrubs pa'i yon tan de lta'o: zhes gsungs pa ltar yon tan bas ba gyis mi khyab par 'grub par 'gyur ba yin no/ /de nas sgrub pa'i mtha' rgyas su mar me la brten pa'i smon lam dang bkra shis kyi me tog char du bsnyil ba/ 'khor gsum yongs dag gi bsngo bas rgyas gdab pa/ tho 'grol dang gnas bsrung bcas mthar chags su bya ba las/ 'dir mar me la brten pa'i smon lam gdab pa'i tshul la'ang mtshon bya don gyi mar me ni/ snang srid thams cad bden gnyis dbyer med byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gnas pa gang zhig /bsgoms byung gtso bor gyur pa'i shes rab gsum gyis gtan la phab pa'i lta ba rnam par dag pa dang / de dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnal 'byor lnga'i rim gnyis kyi ting 'dzin bying rgod kyis g.yo ba dang bral ba'i shes 'jug zung du 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin yin la/ de mtshon byed dbyings spros bral gyi kong bur lhan skyes bde ba chen po'i mar khu bskyil ba la rang byung ye shes kyi sgron me sbar bas 'od gsal chen po'i snang ba mtha' dbus med 464

rdzogasachen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/zu ༷ la —— 0 ༷ la sa la ༷ — ba ༷ cha par brdal bas sgrib gnyis kyi kun khams ma lus lhag med du bsal te srid pa dug gsum gyi g.yang sar nyam mi nga zhing / rgyu 'bas sa lam gyi yon tan thams cad rtsol med du rdzogs nas/ mthar thug gdod ma'i nang dbyings chen por mngon par byang chub ste sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i ngang nas lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las rgya che rgyun mi chad pas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i lus can mtha' dag dpal kun tu bzang po'i bo 'phang la 'god pa'i kyon 'dun rtse gcig pas 'di bzhin rjes su zlog te gsung bar zhu//rig pasang chub sems sogs so/ /zhes pa 'di ni padma'i thang du sman sgrub 'tshogs dus mkhan rin po che padma badzra gyis gung seng thun mtshalas zhig tu shar mar spel ba bzhin bas pa'o// //sa /mtshan mo gnyid kha sogs nam yang / snang ba lha/ grag pa lngas/sa/ dran rtog chos nyid ye stong thugs su shes pa zhig la dus rgyun bslab phyir/ 'di kher bus las byang gi go chod/thun bzung dus yang 'di kho nas chog /zhes gsungs/ // stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ /phyogs bcu stong gi 'jigarten na/ /ma'agro rtsi shing nasas tshal rnams/ /kun kyang dpal chen rol pa'i lha/ /sku la dur khrod chas brgyad gsol/ /gsung gi 'dzab dbyangs 'brug ltar sgrog /thugs ni mi rtog chos dbyings bzhugs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs kyis/ /lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlobs/ /padma badzra pas dpal chen mtshan thun las byang gi tshab 'di kho nas chog rgyur dmigs nas bris pa dge'o// //465

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ la ༷༷ mi — ba ཿ la ཿ mi ༷ sa ཿ ༄ / /zhal gdams gnad kyi sgron me bzhugs so/ /na mo gu ru rgyal ba'i ye shes sna tshogs gdul bya'i ngor/ /shar ba'i drin can bla ma'i tshogs rnams kun/ /bde chen 'khor lor mdzes pa'i rgyan du bzhugs/ /grub brnyes rig 'dzin du mas rjes bzung zhing / gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis nyer 'tsho ba'i/ /rtogs pa'i lus stobs rgyas pa'i dam pa la/ /bdag 'dras mang du gsol la dgos pa ci/ /'on kyang ring mo'i lam nas dag snang gis/ /bong ba gser du gzigs nas bskul ba'i gsung / /ldog par ma phod yid la gang dran pa'i/ /'chol gtam dam dum 'dzem med spel la dgongs/ /kye lags srid pa'i chos la yid dbyung zhing / /srid par 'gas pa'i 'gro la thugs brtse bas/ /tshe 'dir chos sku'i rgyal sa 'dzin bzhed na/ /skal bzang skyebo'i 'jug ngogs dam pa di/ /thog mar dge ba byang chub sems mchog bskyed/ /bar du dge ba rim gnyis lam la sbyang / /tha mar dge ba 'od gas rdzogs pa ches/ /'bras bur sbyor ba snga 'gyur lam gyi srog/ /khyad par dbang bzhis lam gyi rgyud smin cing / /dam tshig rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung ste/ /lta bas thag bcad sgom pas nyams su blangs/ /spyod pas bogs dbyung 'bras bu mngon du bya/ /lta ba'i rim pa rgya che grangs mang yang / /nges pa'i snying 466

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ la ༷ ba la ba la ba — ba ba ba 00 ༷ mi ba — spyo ba po rang byung ye shes te/ /bdag dang phung po sems dang sems byung kun/ /gzhi med rtsa la stong par thag bcad de/ /rang yal rjes med nam mkha'i ngang la bzhags/ /de tshe phra rags rtog pa kunastsol nas/ yid dpyod nyams dang myong bas ma bslad pa'i/ /nang gsal rjen pa yul med zang thal le/ /rig gdang 'gags med nam mkha' ngang du bzhag /dngul chu dkar mo rdul dang mi 'dres bzhin/ /sems dang rig pa shag gis dbye ba ni/ /lta ba'i rgyal po rang gnas ye shes lags//de sa'i ngang la ma bcos rang babs su//lhod de shig ge bya rtsolabral bar skyongs/ /bying rgod 'gyu 'phro'i rtog pa ci shar yang / /rig pa rjen la byung nas rang thog tu/ /lhod pasade kun rig pa'i rtsal yin phyir/ /rig pa'i gshis su bzang ngan med par grol/ /de las bzhan yang chags sdang skyed sdug dang / /dgra gnyen rnam rtog ri mo ci shar yang / /dgag sgrub blang dor med par de thog sa /lhod la ltos dang de kun rig pa gle /ris/ pa nyid las gzhan pa'i 'khor 'das chos/ /btsal kyang rgyal ba nyid kyis mi rnyed gsungs/ /de phyir rdzogs pa chen po'i gsang lam ni/ /rig pa rkyang ded lam 'di khora'o/ /rig rtsal dbyings rig thod rgal nyams len gyis/ /brtson 'grus rab rnams 'od skur grol ba dang / /tha ma'ang chos nyid bar do'i grol tshad kun/ /tshe 'di nyid la nyams 'og tshud par byed/ /ga na yang lha sgom sngags bzlas byams snying rje/ /sgom sogs lus ngas/ dge sbyor gang byed kyang / /rig pa'i ngang du lhod nas bgyis tsa na/ /me long dbyings la gzugs brnyan shar ba dang / /mkha' la 'ja' tshon chu la ri mo bzhin/ /shar yang rang gi ngang las ma 'das pas/ /rig pa'i rtsal 'byongs tshogs gnyis zung 'brel yin/467

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma brdza'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ ba — ཿ — — — 0 ༷ ba — ༷ 0 — ཿ ༷ dzu chos sku'i ngang la gzugs sku lhun grub bo/ /kha cig rig pa'i ngang la bzhag tsa na/ /lha sgom sngags bzlas la sogs mi yong ma /de 'dra mnyam rjes don la rmongs pa ste/ /mnyam bzhag ngang la mkha' bzhin spros pa med/ /sdes thob dus su 'khor 'das snang sems kun/ /rig pa'i ngang du rtsal sbyangs don dang bsre//de la goms tshe mnyam rjes sa/nyis med 'dres/ /gnas 'gyu khyad med rig pa'i ngang du mnyam/ /spang gnyen dbyer med 'khor 'das chos skur grog /zhen 'dzin med na 'khor ba'i bag chags stong / /dge sdig dkar nag sprin gyis mi gos so/ /nyin snang mtshan snang mi 'dra'ibar par dang / /bzang rkyen ngan rkyen ngos na mi zin ga /khyad par go yang goms pa'i lag rjes te/ /brtson 'grus drag pos rgyun ring goms pa na/ /nyin mo'i nyams len mtshan mo'i dus su ba sa/ /rkyen snang je mnyam je mnyam mnyam par 'gyur/ /khyad par 'od gsal mi lam dge sbyor 'di//dkor grib nyams grib sdig zas grogs kyi grib// grib kyi rigs 'dis shin tu sanod pas na/ /'di 'dra'i rigs la shin tu gzab dgos so/ /nyon mongs lam khyer rim pa grangs mang ste/ /mtshan nyid theg par stong nyid snying rjes sbyongs//nyon mongs chu lud rnam grol zhing la phan//sngags kyi theg par lha dang thabs mkhas kyis/ /zin pas nyon mongs rnam pa mi bsgyur yang / /ngo bo tshogs gnyis lam du khyer ba yis/ /spyod sgrol sogs byas kyang las chasogs tshogs bsod nams ye shes su 'gyur ro gsungs/ /rdzogs chen lugs la gong du bshad pa bzhin/ /rnam rtog lam khyer nyid dang gnad gcig gle /chags sdang gang yang rnam rtog bye brag yin/ /de phyir rnam rtog chags sdang gang shar yang / /shar dus nyid nas rang ngo rig pa las/ /ga na du ma g.yos 468

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ ba ༷ sa da la ༷ ༷ ༷ byed la ba ༷ tha — 00 sa rka 0 ba shar grol dus mnyam yin/ /des na chags sdang gang skyes zhen 'dzin med/ /zhen 'dzin med pa'i nyon mongs ye shes yin/ /dgas/ sgrub mi dgos rang sor lhod pa na/ /nyon mongs rang grol rig pa'i gsal 'debs yin/ /de la brtan pa ma thob bar du ni//lta sgom thos tu nyon mongs ye shes su/ /la zla spang blang mi dgos lam du khyer/ /spyod pa shan 'byed rgyu 'bras zhib tu bya/ /brtan pa cher thob skyebos ma tshor bar/ /ba/sang spyod bya zhing nyon mongs rtsal byung bya/ /de la rig pa brtul zhugs spyod pa zer/ /ga na snang bsgyur nus spang gnyen ro gcig tu/ /'dres tshe grub chen sa ra ha pa dang / /pad 'byung la sogs grub pa'i rnam thar bzhin/ /sbyor grol la sogs brtul zhugs mngon spyod bya/ /de la phyogs las rnam rgyal spyod pa zer/ /de ltar lta sgom sgro 'dogs chod pa na/ /spyod pa dus tshod 'brel bar nyams su blang / /'bras bu mngon gyur gol sgrib 'phrang las grol/ /zung 'jug rdo rje'i sa mchog mngon du gyur/ /da ni yun ring long med tshe 'jug/ 'dir/ /nyams len snying por dril ba'i dus la bab/ /skyabs kun ngo bo drin chen bla ma de/ /spyi bo'i gtsug gam snying gi dkyil du bsgom/ /snying nas gsol gdab dbang blangs thugs yid bsre/ /bde ba'i stan la lus gnad drang por bsrang / /da lta'i sems la bcas bcos med par bzhag /lta sgom grub mtha'i zhe 'dod thams cad shigs/ /yod med snang stong gang du'ang ma 'dzin par/ /rang bab ngang der lhod de bzhag pa na/ /kun rtog sems kyi rtogs ma dwangs pa'i tshe/ /rang byung ye shes rang gsal rjen sang nge /dus gsum 'pho 'gyur bral ba rang gis 'char/ /de yi rtsal du rtog pa ci shar yang //sngon bsu rjes dpyod blo yis bcos mi gzhug /'gyu ba rang sar bzhag 469

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ spyo ༷ ༷ ba ༷ ༷ ཿ 7 ༷ ba spyo ༷ ༷ pas chos skur grol/ /rig pa rang grol bla ma de yin gsungs/ /rgyun gyi nyams len 'chi ba'i dus su yang / /'da' ga'i gdam ngag gcig chog de rang chag/ /de tsho thugs la 'thad na de bzhin mdzod/ /gzhan ni ci yang bdag gis mi shes so//de skad rkang ban padma badzra pas//bla ma dam pa sangs rgyas ye shes kyi//bzhed pa mi ldog tsam gyi yi ge 'di//ru dam yang dben padma'i thang nas bris//dge bas bdag sogs mkha'aces sems can kun/ /'du 'dzis dben pa'i nags khrod nyams dga' bar/ /nyin mtshan 'od gsal ngang las mi g.yo bas//kun bzang chos sku'i gtan sridachen par shog///dge'o//maṅga lo// //470

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ba ba la mi mi ༷ la ༷ rka ༷ ༷ ཿ ༷ — sngag/gdams ngag skyabs kun 'dus gzugs/na mo gu ru/ skyabs kun 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs rdo rje 'chang / /bslu med rigs kyi bdag po rgyal ba'i sras/ /ga/zhan phan pha mtha' yas pa'i mabo/na po des/ /byang chub bar du thugs rngos skyongs mdzod cig /kye ho/ /rnyed dka'i rten bzang dal 'byor lus thob cing / /rgyal ba'i bstan pa yid bzhin 'dod dgu'i mdzod/ /bla ma'i drin gyis ci dgar spyod dus 'dir/ /'bad pa drag pos snying po len dgos so/ /tshe la long med nam 'chi gtad so ci/ /lang 'tsho'i 'du byed rga bas zil mnan cing / /nad dang rgud pas bran bzhin bgyis pa na/ /de dus ci bya la 'ur chos la brtson/ /chos zhes bya ba gzhan na yod min te/ /kha tsam min par srid pa'i gnas ris kun/ /sdug bsngal bsum gyis mnar ba'i tshul bsam nas/ /snying nas thar ba'i lam bzang don gnyer dgos/ /tshe 'di blos btang nges 'byung sems bskyed de/ /thog med dus nas drin gyis bskyangs bskyangs pa'i//ma rgan 'gro 'di'i snang tshul la gzigs nas//tshad med rnam bzhis rang blo sbyor par mdzod/ /rang nyid gcig pu zhi la gzhol 'dod pa'i/ /theg dman byis pa'i lam dang mi mdza' ba'i/ /skyes bu chen po'i 'jug ngogs 'phags pa'i lam/ /byang chub sems gnyis bsgom la nan tan mdzod/ /snying rjes drangs pa'i ga na phyir sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang 47/

༷ — spyo laX ཿ — ༷ rdzo ga sa po maXn cheX ༷hraḥ ba ༷ ga su nga ( ra buḥ/ ཿ na sgrub 'dod blo ni kun rdzob ste/ /shes rab zab mos drangs pa'i chos kun gyi/ /rang bzhin gnas lugs rtogs pa don dam sems/ /'di gnyis mnyam rjes pa'am dus gcig tu/ /mnyam par sbyor zhing nyams su len pa ni/ /stong dang snying rjecheng 'jug lam zhes pa/ /mdo sngags chos tshul rgya mtsho'isrog shing yin//'di yod phar phyinadrug dang bsdu dngos bzhi/ /bskyed rdzogs bsnyen sgrub phrin las rnam bzhi sogs/ /kun kyang nyi ma dang di 'od zer bzhin/ /gcig tu 'dus shing lam gzhan gol mi 'gyur/ /'di med lus ngag chos spyod ci brtson yang / /'bras gru rgya chung dman pa'i lam du gol/ /mdo sngags gang yang seng ge'i gsob 'dra zhing / /rnam pa tsam las dngos don 'grub mi 'gyur/ /rgyu mtshan de'i phyir stong nyid snying rje gnyis/ /zung 'brel lam gyi〈〈ga tu bzung ba ni/ /rgyal dang grub thob kun gyis yang nas yang / /bsngags phyir 'dir yang bzlas shing bzlas pa lags/ /de phyir man ngag rdo rje'i theg pa ste/ /de yi snying po bskyed rdzogs rnam pa gnyis/ /de yi snying po 'od gsal rdzogs pa che/ /blo 'das rig pa sgos dngasal ba lags/ /'di yi dgongs pa ji bzhin skyong 'dod na/ /'du 'dzi dben pa'i ri ngogs nyams dga' ba/ bya dang ri dwags grub pa'i bste gnas su/ /sgo gsum rnam g.yeng 'khrul ba rgyang bsrings nas/ /snying thig snying po'i las bzang ji bzhin par/ /dbyings rig 'od gsal ngang las mi g.yo zhing / /gnad gsum chos nyid 'khor lo'i rgya bcing ste/ /sgom pa nyin mtshan kha sbyor gcig tu dril/ /sgo lnga rang yan rgya mtsho'i gza' skar 'dra /rig pa ga bral nam mkha'i dbyings dang mtshungs/ /snang sems 'brel med byis pa'i tha snyad bzhin/ /tha mal shes pa gcer bur lding ba la/ /snang bas ma 472

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ da — — ༷ byed la byed ༷ — rsha pa ga ཿ — — bamad 'dzin pas ma bcing zhing /sgom blos gzeb dang rtog pa sgro mi gdags// /rang bab ngang du rang bzhag ta le ba/ /'di ga rdo rje sems dpa' gsang lam ste/ /tshogs drug yul gyi snang ba ji shar yang / /bzang ngan da / sdig rtog pa ci byung yang / /gzhi med ngang du rang grol gnad shes na/ /nam mkha'i bya lam chu yi ri mo bzhin/ /rnal 'byor sems la 'ching grol yod mi srid//sems kyi rgyal po gang shar rang yal ngang / /rig pa'i rgyal po dus gsum 'gyur med klong / /rnal 'byor rgyal po rtag tu mnyam bzhab/ na/ /chos sku rgyal po tshe 'dir 'grub par nges//de skad yid la gang dran 'tshal gtam 'di/ /sgrub brtson bla ma padma'i mtshan can gyi/ /thugs bzhed skong phyir padma badzra pas/ /bris te phul bas snying po'i don rtogs shog/ //dge'o////473

༄ga /gdams ngag skyabs kun ma/skyabs kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba'i bag chags rang dag nas/ /sems nyid 'od gsal rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /'di ltar 'khor 'das snod bcud snang srid kun/ /sems la snang zhing sems kyis btags pa ste/ /sems nyid gzhi med rtsa bral stong pa nyid/ /mkha' 'dra'i spros pa bral ba shes par bya/ /de nyid ngang la rang bab sgo pa pa'i tshe// /bla mar gsol btab thugs yid dbyer med bsres/ /lus gnad bsrang la sgo lnga rang yan bzhag /yod med snang stong yid la mi bya bar/ /da lta'i shes pa rang babs bcos med ngang / /bying rgod rtog pas ma bslad dwangs seng nge / /gsal stong shes pa rang gsal rjen par skyong //de nyid ngang las rnam rtog rig pa'i rtsal/ /ji ltar shar yang dgag sgrub spang blang dang / /sdes mthud med par rang thog ba'as pa na/ /shar dus nyid nas gshis la ma grub pas/ /rang shar rang yal rtsal snang gzhi la dag /'od gsal gnyug/ ma'i gshis la gos mi 'gyur/ /rjes thob chos kun bden med sgyu ma dang / /mi lam lta bur shes pa'i zhen med blos//dad dang dag snang byams dang snying rje dang /lha sgom sngags bzlas rtog pa'i rtsal sbyang bya/ /dge tshogs gang sgrub sems can kun don du/ /rnam dkar bsngo ba 0na lam 474

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor sa/༷ — ༷ ༷ — — ༷ — — ཿ — ཿ 0 'a pa ga rgya yis thob/ /rnam g.yeng 'khrul ba'i rjes su mi 'brang bar/ /dben par zhi ba'i ting 'dzin sgom nus shog /ces pa 'di'ang padma badzra pas/ /brtse bas gdams pa chan gyis thugs la zhog /mang po'i spros pa dor la 'di kho na/ /brtson dang sgrub 'bras tshe 'dir men par 'gyur// //dge'o// //475

rdzogasachen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor gu/ ༷ ༷ — 'di da mi — — ༷ — byed ཿ sa sngag /nges don rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod las gtso bor brtsams pa'i gtam/ man ngag snying po'i yang bcud ces bya ba bzhugs so//lha dang bla ma dbyer med rdo rje 'chang / /snying dbus mi shigs dwangs ma'i thig le ru/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bor rtag bzhugs nas/ /gsang chen snying po'i de nyid bstan du gsol//rig pa'i rang bzhin blo bral bde ba che/ /gnyug ma'i gshis dang ro gcig gyur pa las/ /shes sgrib 'pho ba'i zhen rtog kun bcom ste/ /'od gsal lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'char/ /bsam gyis mi khyab ye shes chen po yi/ /rtsal gdangs shin tu phra ba'i dri bzhon gyis/ /bapyod pas zung 'jug ye shes chen po'i sku//rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan par bzhengs//lhan skyes stong pa'i rang gzugs lha mo dang / /kha sbyor zag med bde ba chen po ni/ /mkha' mnyam rgyun mi 'chad par dkyil 'khor dang / /ribs rnams kun gyi khyab bdag chen por bzhugs/ /de ni sngags rgyud dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho yi/ /bsgrub bya'i 'bras bu mthar thug gyur pa ste/ /dus 'khor kye rdor rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /nye ru ga dpal kun tu bzang por grags/ /de ltar sgrub bya'i dmigs pa rnyed pa na/ /de 'dra de dang rnam pa mthun pa yi/ /nyer len rgyu dang lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen/ /tshogs pa'i sgrub byed lam gyi nges pa gces/ /de yang 476

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i bsung thor bu/ ba byed — ba la la pa 0 ༷ ba ba cha — ga — ji — ba la ༷ spyo ༷theg chen sngags dang mtshan nyid mi//so so'i gzhung las ming tsam mi 'dra yang //don la ga lam 'bras bu'i rnam bzhag kun/ /zung 'jug ngo bor shes thob 'brel bar gcig /rgyu yi sde snod sasum gyis bstan pa'i don/ /bslab gsum mi tshe gcig la mthar phyin pa'i//nye lam bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po gsum/ /gzhung dang man ngag yin par shes pa gnad/ /nyes thong kun gyi rtsa ba tha lam gyi/ /snang zhen snod bcud dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ru/ /rtogs shing goms pa'i gsal snang nga rgyal gnyis/ /brtan pas sdom pa sngags kyi tshul khrims yin/ /rlung sems dbu mar bcing ba'i byed pa las/ /mtshan ma'i rnam par rtog pa kun spangs te/ /bde gas mi rtog ting 'dzin mchog brnyes pa/ /gnas byung sems kyi bslab pa khyad par can/ /de yi stobs las gnyis snang zad pa yi/ /so so rang rig mtshan med ye shes kyis/ /stong nyid mngon sum mthong ba'i 'od gsal ni/ /lhag mthong shes rab pha rol phyin ces bya/ /yan las brgyad ldan 'phags lam bslab gsum du/ /'dus pa'i ngo bo dag pa'i sgyu lus dang / /bde stong gnyis med don gyi 'od gsal che/ /zung 'jus zab gsal gnyis med rnal 'byor ste/ /tshul 'dis rig 'dzin gsum mam bzhi'i go 'phang / /bgrod nas mthar thug dag pa gnyis ldan gyi/ /zung 'jug chen po'i go 'phang mngon byed pa/ /rdo rje theg pa'i las gyi mdo ching yin//khyad par 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i lam/ /rig pa'i ngo bo ga dag zang thal du/ /skyong bar mtshungs kyang dbyings rnang lhun grub kyi//ga ngas las rgyan du shar ba'i dbyings rig/ gnyis/ /rtsal du bton te snang mun khra khrid kyis/ /nyams su len dang mi len khyad par las/ /khregs chod thod rgal ces grags mi slob pa'i/ /zung 'jug mngon du 477

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma brdza'i gsung zor bu/ cha cha ༷༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ spyo la ga la spyo ༷ ༷ mi 0 la byed pa'i nye lam gle /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg chen mtha' dag gi /lam gnad kun tshang mthar thug 'bas bu'ang gcig /'on kyang mtshan bcas spros pa'i 'bad rtsol dang / /bral zhing gnad la brten pas khyad par 'phags/ /thun mong theg par stong dang rten 'byung gnyis/ /gzhir bzhag chos dang gzugs kyi sku gnyis ni/ /bsod nams dang ni ye shes zung 'brel ba'i/ /tshogs gnyis lam gyi rgyu las sgrub par 'dod/ /sngags lam gzhan du de lasakhyad par du/ /'bras bu'i rnam pa lam du byed na'ang / /sgyu ma'i sku dang bde ba'i ye shes kyi/grub gzhi shin tu phra ba'i rlung sems/ 'di mchan/ rgyu las 'thas bu'i zung 'jug sgrub par mtshungs/ /'di ni rgyu 'bras bral ba'i theg pa ste/ /chos kun rig pa'i rtsal dang rol pa ru//snang phyir ye nas mngon sangs rgyas pa ste//da gzod sgrub par bya ba'i chos las 'das/ /rig pa'i ngo bo spros pa kun bral ba/ /na dag chen po 'od gsal chos kyi sku/ /rig pa'i rang bzhin lhun grub mtshan dpe'i bdag /cha phra gting gsal gzhon nu bum pa'i skur/ /ye nas zung 'jug chen por bzhugs pa ni/ /nges don 'khor lo tha ma'i zab mo'i gnas/ /mngon du phyung ste gsang ba bla med kyi/ /rgyud sde dag las shin tu gsal bar bshad/ /de nyid nyams su len tshul rdzogs chen sgo /sngon 'gro dngos ga rjes kyi rim pa yis/ /rgyas spro'i sgo nas thun mong lam gyi gnad/ /sdud pa'i bshad tshul mang mod mdor bsdu na/ /'dir ni man ngag gzigs pa'i bla ma yis/ /byin rlabs mos gus kho nas 'dren nus pa'i/ /dad brtson shes rab ldan pa'i slob ma la/ /rig pa rtsal gyi dbang gis ngo sprod de/ /mi g.yo gsum ldan cog bzhag bzhi'i ngang nas/ /yul med rig pa zang na rjen pa ru/ /bskyangs pas rlung sems 478

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor du/༷4) 4) na mi bsha ༷༷ ba 6 mi zhe rags pa kun thim nas/ /shin tu༄ ba'i rlung sems snying dbus na/ /gnas pa'i 'od rtsa ye shes cu nyi ru/ /zhugs tshe thun mong dang ni thun min gyi/ /snang stong shes nyams bsam mi khyab dang bcas/ /dbu phyag rdzogs chen gsum gyi grub pa'i mtha'/ /gcig/ tu byum pa'i thig le chen po ni//rgyal ba kun gyi gsang ba'i snying po ste/ /zab zhi spros dang bral ba'i 'od gsal 'char/ /de tshe gnyis snang rtog pa kun nub cing //yid dasbyor grub mtha'i tshig gi rdzun phugs gib/ / sgra rtog rjes su dpag pa'i tha snyad stong / /sna tshogs nyams la zhen pa'i shun pa bral/ /rig stong rjen pa chos sku zang ma ste/ /so ma gnyug ma ma bcos lhag pa'i ngang / /phyal ba bar med nyin mtshan phyad pa ru/ /yengs med chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor skyongs//de tshe rtsal las shar ba'i rol pa ru/ /sna tshogs rtog pa'i cho rol ci shar yang / /mi dgag mi dpyod rjes su mi 'brangs par/ /rig pa'i ngang skyong snang ba thad gar chod/ /bde gsal mi rtog ngang la yun bsrings tshe/ /nyams la zhen pa'i dmigs gtad skye srid pas/ /gnas pa'i 'phro yi sgom sa shig gis bshig/ /ngos bzung bral ba'i zang thal rjen pa ltos/ /rjes thob chos kun rig pa'i rol rtsal du/ /shes par gang snang thug phrad lam du khyen/ /rig pa'i rang ngor re dogs zhig na yang / /gzhan la phan phyir spyod pa mdo ltar spyad/ /de ltar brtson pa chen pos nyams blangs na/ /'di'am 'chi kha dang ni bar do ru/ /khyad chos drug dang ldan pa'i mthar lam gyis/ /lhun grub rin chen spubs su mngon 'tshang rgya/ /ji ltar gnam stong zla ba dbyings 'khrul bzhin/ /thim la ma mug phra ba'i ye shes ni/ /shin tu mthar thug 'bras bu'i zung 'jus ste/ /dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i 'char gzhi bla med pa'o/ /de ltar theb rtse shin tu 479

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor ga ༷༷ — — — — ༷ — — ༷ pa ༷ ༷ na spyo ཿ rnal 'byor gyi/ /gzhi las 'bras bu thun mong min pa'i gnad/ /rig na nges don theg pa 'di gcig pur/ /dkri ba'i don du theg chen bsdu bar shes//tshul 'di nges don man ngag snying po'i bcud/ /rnam gsum shes rab byu yis myong ba'i ro/ /ji bzhin bshad pa'i dge tshogs gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /kun bzang dgongs pa'i rgya mtshor gcig tu ga la/ /de skad grub dbang rgyal sras chos kyi rje/ /gzhan phan mtha' yas de yi zhabs kyi rdul/ /gtsug tu thob pa'i bya bral byu su ku//padma badzra ming gis bris pa dge///

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapo'i gsung thor bu/ mi mi ga ༷ mi na ba ba ༷ ba ཿ ༷snga / /dpal sprul rin po cher phul ba'i zhu yigadaka' drin mtshungs med sprul sku rin po che'i zhabs drung du/ gus gsol/deng gi char nyid rin po che sku khams dwangs shing thugs dam 'phel bar bzhugs pa nas rjes brtse'i gsung bris rten bcas nyams med gnang 'byor snying nas dad spro 'phel lags/ /'dir yang rang ngos nas 'du ba snyoms bzhin pal sku gnyis la rnying rgyud kyi bklag lung 'bul byin yod skabs lasas//mtshalas zhus/ na ning 'dir slebs nas skyabs rje grub pa'i dbang po de nyid kyis thugs brtse sngar nas yun ring 'dris pa lta bu'i nang nyams kyi bka' mchid lhug par stsal ba sogs kyis rjes su bzung bzhin snying thig gsar rnying gi dbang lung ji rigs dang sngon 'gro'i khrid bcas zhib rgyas thob/ de skabs nas rgyun du ni lo shas bzhugs rgyu lta bu'i gsung phros gnang bzhin pa la/skabs skabs su ni stag lo 'dir khong la sku gegs shin tu che bas ci 'gyur mi shes gsung ba'i gsung yang lan grangs mang tsam gsungs/ phran la ni khyod zla ba dgu pa las mi 'gyang bar shog gsung bzhin da res ba sa tshod bzang /stag lo 'dir nga ma shi na lo gsu sdod dgos/ shi song na 'gro sdod ci dgos khyod rang dbang chagasung / zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcur lha sgang jo bo'i drung du rigs 'dus kyi tshogs 'khor rgyas pa zhig gnang / de nyin thugs 481

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ — — ཿ — — — ཿ — — ༷ ༷ sko dgyes nyams che bzhin ngang rang re dpon slob las smon gyis 'brel legs/nyams chags kyi skyon med cing / phyi ma rnga yab dpal gyi ri bor 'di bzhin tshogs pa'i rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i kyon lam kho bos 'debs gsung sngon lam gyi mtha' rgyas mar me smon lam bcas spros spros mdzad song / de rjes phran ni lha sgang du maṇḍal bskang ba 'dra bsags nas bsdad btang / skyabs sde dpon slob byer nang dgon dang / sku nang sogs la phebs song bas/ sku nang phebs skabs zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu drug bcu bdun gyi skor zhis/ nas gsol bcas zhig gis rkyen byas bsnyun tshul bstan nas nyer gsum tsam la lha sgang du phebs byung / de nas yar dwangs lta bur yod 'phror lcags la tshang nas nan bskul gyis mdo la phebs song bas/ de rjes zla ba gnyis pa'i nyi shu'i tho rang tsam la gzhan don du dbo/ngas song ba yin 'dug /de rjes phran ni pho brang lnga rtser gnas skor zhig la song nas da lta ni lha sgang du rnying rgyud kyi lung 'don gyin yod lags/ /lnga ldan padma 'od kyi pho brang nas/ /snyigs ma'i 'gro ngor mngal gyi padmo las/ /slar yang mi yi zol gyis phebs pa gang / /brgyan gnyis pa grub pa'i dbang po den /zhal mthong gsung gi bdud cir longs spyod pa'i/ /skal bzang mngon sum thob pas srid pa 'dir/ /skyes pa'i dal rten lan ga/cig don yod par//gyur snyam skabs rer yid la sgo ba 'phel/ /'on kyang sprin bar nyi 'od mthong ba bzhin/ /ring du bsten pa'i las skal ma ldan pas/ /sngon chad bdag gis nong pa ci bgyis ces/ /nying 'khrul lam du'ang rang la sprad bzhin mchis/ /de lta na'ang tshig la mi ltos par/ /brda dang byin rlabs kho nas rjes 'dzin pa'i/ /'phags chen rnams kyi rnam thar spyod 482

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ ༷ — 7 ba ba ba spyo — ༷ byed she ba la ba da la la — na yul la/ /nges pa'i shes pa da gzod cung zad rnyed/ /yul med rang gsal rjen pa'i mnyam bzhag dang / /ngo shes ngang la skyong ba'i rjes thob bcas/ /myong tshor mtshan ma phra mo dang 'grogs pas/ /da dung gnyug ma'i gshis la sgrib mthong nas/ /da ni 'phro gnas gnyis med gang ltar yang / /'dzin pas ma bcing gnyen pos ma bcun pa'i/ /rang babs shes pa gnyis snang las 'das pa/ /so ma'i ngang der rang 'gros skyong ba lags/ /rang zhal mkha' 'gro'i stongasrog thob pades//khab len rdo la lcags bye 'du ba bzhin/ /rigs can bo ba'i sprin gyi padmo'i rdzing / /dbang med 'byud dang sdud bzhin gtib srung yang / /ming gi rtog pa spang bar ma nus pas/ /chos brgyad re dogs da ba ma chod de/ /mtsho gling gru gzingardo la thogs bzhin mchis/ /'di la rno gcod 'phrul gyi thabs shig zhu/ /gyi ling sgrog bkrol lta bu'i bka'i mchid cig /snying gi bdud cir thob par gyur na ko /glang chen rtsal gyis rab la gcod pa bzhin/ /yab mes rnams kyi shul der cis mi snyogs/ /masal mtshal gtam phul bar thugs dgongs mi khrel ba dang / ma ma'i char yang thugs brtses nam yang mi 'dor ba'i bka' drin byang chub snying po'i bar du zhu/ 'degs lha gos/ gsol 'bras phran bu rtags ldan bcas pad rdor gyis zla ba drug/ pa'i tshes gsum la lha sgang padma sa ba nas gus pas phul/ /

rdzogasachen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor ku/ ཿ — — — ༷ la ༷ zhe zhe — la sgo ga ཿ ཿ ba pa ༄ / /g.yag ze'i bla ma dpal sbyin la phul ba/ /rnam dag dam tshig gtsang ma'i dbyig 'dzin gzhir/ nges 'byung byang chub sems kyi ljon bzang rtser/ /gsang chen lam gyi 'thas bzang legs smin pa'i/ /de rje'i mched po gang de'i zhabs pad du/ /'di na snyom las ngang du chos tshul du/ /bcos pa'i zol du mi tshe bron byed pa'i/ /gyi na pa des snying nas spro ba'i mchin/ /dpyid kyi dpal mo'i glu bzhin len la spyo/ /gang na phyi rol 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng ba dang / /nang du don chung gsam kyi sbyor ba kun/ /spangs nas sems kyi dben pa la sbyor ba'i/ /rnam thar bzang po snying gi bdud cir gyur/ /g.yo sgyu zol zog bral ba'i drang po'i mchid/ /'di na yid kyi gsos su 'byor ba'i tshe/ /spro dga'i mngon rtogs rab dga'i dpalabazhin du/ /ches cher 'phel bas dngos mjal lta bur khro/ /grub brgya'i dbang phyug 'khor lo'i mgon po rnams/ /'bral med spyi bo'i rgyan du bsgom bzhin du/ /blosal rig pa rang babs chos sku'i ngang / /rtsal snang lha sngags ye shes rol mo ru/ /'gog med sgyu ma lta bu'irang du sbyongs//re dogs 'jur bus ma bcing sos dal du/ /slod nas rtsol med dran pas rgyang 'tsho tsam/ /byas pas dag dang ma das bzang ngan gyi/ /kun rtog mtha' dag chu yi ri mo dang / /nam mkha' 'ja' bzhin rang byung rang yal du/ /'khor 'das gnyis snang 'khrul zhen dbyings su dag /484

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ — — — — pa ba ༷ 0 na ཿ sge ཿ ཿ zhe 0 ba gzhi med rtsa bral nam mkha'i rang bzhin du/ /sems nyid ngang du 'bad rtsol zhig pa na/ /bden gnyis dbyer med blo bral chos sku'i zhal/ /ring por mi thogs mjal bar gdon mi za/ /babyed rdzogs lam gyi 'bras bu de lags te/ /de tshe spyod pa shugs 'byung bcos med du/ /tho cos ma bslad tshul 'chos kyis ma bcing / /'dzin med ngang du zhen med khrol ler skyongs/ /'a la ba zhig pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug lags/ /'phros don la/ sgyu 'phrul gyi mchod pa sog/sa sngags bla med skabs kyi lha mnyes pa'i thabs kyi tshogs dang sbyin bsreg sogs phyi bskyed rim dang 'brel ba'i las tshogs thams cad/ nang rdzogs rim bde ba chen po'i lam gyi yin byed kyi rgyu yin pas de ltar nges shing / de 'bras la rtog tshogs chos dbyings su sgrol zhing rig pa dbyings su sbyor ba'i rdzogs chen gyi gas pa skye dgos pa lags so / /nges med dben pa'i ri la sbas tshul gyi spyod pas/ /rim gnyis lam gyi gnad gsang tshul bzhin du rtogs nas/ /zab lam nyams su len pa'i rnal 'byor tsho skyid de/ /tshe 'dir zung 'jug sadod ma'i rgyal sa la chas 'gro/ /nyin snang babyed rim lam gyis lha sngags la gzhol zhing / /mtshan du rdzogs rim zab mos 'od bsal la sbyor ba//dus kun das mnyam chen po'i yo langs la spyod bzhin/ /yun ring zhabs pad brtan pa'i rten 'grel zhig zhu'o/ /'degs mtshon lha gos dang / dngul srang gang /zho gang bcas dben ri padma'i thang nas phran padma badzra pas phul ba'i zhu yig// / /485

rdzogasachen mkhan ra padma batsho gas thor bu/ —— la — ga ཿ — zhe — ༄7/ /gdams ngag rab 'byams rgyal ba/rab 'byams rgyal ba yongs kyi thugs rje'i gzugs/ /gzhan phan pha mtha' yas pa'i rdo je 'chang / /mtshungs med chos rje bla ma'i zhabs rdul la/ /phyag 'tshal snying nas gus pas 'di skad zhu/ 1 /bdag 'dra'i skyebo chos dred snyom las pas/ /chos mthun gdam pa khyed la ji zhig gsol/ /de lta na'ang nyid gsung mi ldog tsam/ /dam pa'i gsung sgos de tso'i zlos bzhin 72 /bye lags 'dir snang srid pa sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /bden med byis pa bslu ba'i chos can du/ / gzigs nas mkha' mnyam ma rnams bskyab pa'i phyir/ /byang chub mchog gi go 'phang mngon bzhed na/ na /sngon byon rgyal sras bya ba gshegs pa'i shul/ /srid la ma chags zhi la mi zhen pa'i/ /nges 'byung blo dang snying rje'i 'khor lo can/ /byang chub sems kyis shing rta la chibs nas/4/bde nas bde bar bgrod byed theg pa'i mchog /bsodanams tshad med skyes bu chen po'i lam//tshad med bzhi dang pha rol phyin pa drug /'khrul med lam gyi srog tu bzung 'tshal lo/ 5 /rgyu 'bras phra zhib thun mong theg pa'i gzhung / /ji bzhin ma nor rnam dag spyod pa'i khrims/ /drang srong chen po'i brtul zhugs legs gnas bzhin/ /mdo rgyud grub mtha' thos pas sgro 'dogs bcad/ 6 /kun spyod ma sa dang tshig 'ga' shes tsam gyis/ /srid las sgrol zhing gzhan don mi nus pas/ /dben pa'i 486

rdzogs chen mkha chen padma badzra'i gsung thor bu/ da da byed — — ཿ rsha / gnas su sgrub pa lhur blang nas/ /byang chub sems kyis thugs rgyud sbyangs par mdzod/7/de yang man ngag rdo rje thes pa yi/ /lam bzang bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen por bcas/ /brgyud ldan bla ma'i zhal las 'ong ba bzhin/ /nyin mtshan g.yel med brtson pas nyams bzhes te/ /tshe 'dir sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thugs stobs bskyed/ 8 /mdor na sdom pa gsum dang mi 'gal bar/ /spyod pas lta ba ma bcing phyogs zhen spangs//lta bas spyod pa ma khyer blang dor zhib/ /zung 'brel lam kyi gol sgrib shugs la chod/ 9 /lam dang grub mtha' spros pa'i tshogs rnams kun/ /shes par byas nas phyogs zhen kun dor te/ /theg pa'i rtse rgyal 'od gsal rdzogs pa che'i/ /dgongs pa'i dbyings su sems nyid ngal ga/so bya/ 10 /de skad zhal gyi gdams par sgro btags pa/ /gang dran nyams mtshar rtsed mo'i tshul du phul/ /dam pa khyod zhabs bamakha brgyar brtan bzhugs nas/ /phrin las phyogs brgyar rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog/ //ces rdzogs sprul rin po che'i bzhed skong du rdzogs chen gyi ban de padma badzra pas bris te phul ba'o////dge'o//bkra shis// // 87

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor gu/ ba ཿ — — — zhe ཿ — — — la ga ༷ ཿ ༷ ཿ ༷ ༷ ཿ rag /zhal gdams man ngag gi skor nges legs thar ba'i lam ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /srid la ma chags mang thos sgrub la ga la/ /zhi la mi gnas ga na phan bsdu dngos bzhis/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i re skong rgyal ba'isras/ /mtshungs med chos rje'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rdo rje theg pa'i lam ga dag snang dang / /dam tshig zung ldan rdo rje'i mched spyod la/ /chos dred chos rgyus can gyi zla bo ngas/ /chos dang mthun —pa'i badzir mchid nyung zad cig /phul 'dir gsan 'os gang lags dgyes bzhes mtshod/ /kye ho ma brtag nyams dga' srid pa'i grong / /bslu da sgyu ma'i zlos gar mang mod kyang / /legs par brtags na srin mo'i gling bzhin du/ /blo gtad bgaphebs bgyid pa'i yul ma mchis/ /'dod lnga'i yul 'di 'phral du dga' dga' ltar/ /snang yang 'bras bu sdug bsngal kho na ste/ /ji tsam 'byor yang ngoms pa med kyi steng / /slar yang srid pa'i me chen 'bar ba'i rgyu/ /dang po 'tshol dang bar du bsrung ba dang / /tha mar brlag dang la ba'i dus kun du/ /lus sems ngal ba'i sha thang chad gyur kyang / /'chi ba'i tshe na phan med gnod pa'i gzhi/ /gzugs byad lha 'dra 'byor pa klu 'dra zhing / /stobs dpal 'khor los sgyur ba dang mtshungs pa'i/ /snyan pa'i grags pas 'dzam gling gang 488

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma brngo'i gsung thor gu/ ཿ la ba4 la ༷ la zhe ba la la — 0 ༷ ba ca babyas kyang / /chal gyis bzhag nas gcig pur 'gro la dgongs/ /e ma 'dir snang srid pa'i phun tshogs kun//la 'ur la 'ur skad cig re re bzhin/ /'gyur zhing 'gyur ba'i ngang tshul 'di gzigs nas/ /tshe 'di'i snang shes mtha' dag ldog par mdzod/ /kye lags skyedagu'i skyabs gcig thugs rje can/ /shākya'i sras po don kun grub pa des/ /'khor los ra ba'i srid 'byor ma lus pa/ /mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin du bor nas kyang / /phyags dar khrod kyi gos dang gyi na'i zas/ /chu dang lo ma'i dka' thub la brten nas/ /ku sha'i gdan la byang chub shing drung du/ /zhi ba'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa lags/ /bdag cas rnams kyang mgon po de'i rjes su/ /slob pa'i slob ma nyid du khas che na/ /ga/nga de'i rnam thar ji bzhin skyong pa la/ /spro ba'i snying stobs ma yang gtong mi 'tshal/ /rnam g.yengs spangs te dben pa'i rir gnas tshe/ /rtse gcig nyams su blangs pa'i snying po ni/ /rgyu 'bras theg pa'i lam gnad mtha' dag kun/ / theg mchog rgyal po 'od gsal snying thig gi/ /gsang lam zab mo sbyor dngos rjes gsum du/ /dril nas nyams len gcig tu gzung ba ni/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po padma sam bha ga/rje 'bangs brgyud par bcas pa'i phyagasrol yin/ /de yang sngon 'gro mi rtag la sogs pa'i/ /thabs la brten nas nges 'byung blo dang ni/ /'gro kun mar shesasams dang snying rje'i blog /smon 'jug byang chub sems mchog bskyed la brtson/ /de rjes thun min lam gyi sngon 'gro ni/ /sems kyi khang bu bshig pa zhes bya ba/ /sems kyi gshis la byung gnas 'gro gsum gyi/ /rang bzhin btsal nas bden 'dzin bshig pa ste/ /btsal lugs klu sgrub zhabs kyi dbu ma dang /bla ma'i zhal las byung ba'i snyan brgyud gnyis/ /gzhung dang 489

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/ —— — ༷ ༷ — — ༷ ཿ ཿ — ཿ — man ngag dgongs pa phyogs gcig tu/ /babs pa'i gdams ngag tshad mas btsal bar bya/ /dngos gzhi rig pa rang ngo phrod pa ni/ /bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba'i blos/ /bcos min dad pa drag bos rgyud bskul nas/ /mos gus gdung bas dbang bzhi blang ba'i mthar/ /thugs yid dbyer med rig stong rjen par bsre/ /snang bas ma bslad 'dzin pas ma bcing pa'i /da lta'i shes rig spros bral bzo med du/ /rang babs nyid du phya ler bzhag pa la//dran 'dzin dmigs gtad yid byed kun dganas/ /rang gsal mngon sum ji chos med pa nyid//mun sgom had po'i gzeb las 'grol ba ni/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa yin par khu sa/ /rjes thob nyams kyi skyong thabs bstan pa ni/ /tshogs drug yul gyi snang ba ci shar yang / /dgag sgrub spangs te rig pa'i rangs gshis su/ /bzhag pas chudang rlabs bzhin gnyis med grol/ /gnas 'gyu dbyer med rig stong 'ba' zhig sa /shar tshe mnyam rjes 'dres zhes btags kyang rung / /de yi ngang nas tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong dang / /lha sgom sngags bzlas rtsa rlung la sogs pa'i/ /khros bcas spyod pa lam gyi bog 'don du//'gro bar 'dug na spyad kyang 'gal ba med/ /ma spyogs na yang ched du mi dgos te/ /rig stong dbyer med mnyam rjes 'khor lo la/ /tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i thabs tshuladapag med 'dus/ /tshul 'di mdo rgyud du ma'i dgongs pa dang / /bla ma'i man ngag las byung gdams pa ste/ /the tshom med par nyams su len mdzodarang / /'di'am 'chi kha dang ni bar do ru/ /chos sku rgyal po'i gtan sridasan par nges /gal ste de la gtan pa ma thob kyang / /skyosrid sprul pa'i sku ru 'phos gyuranas/ /rnam grol dbugs chen 'byin pa'i zhing 490

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor du/ — — — — — — ཿ ཿ — ༷ — — ༷lnga dang / /padma 'od sogs dag pa'i zhing rnams su/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i gral du mngon zhugs te//lam gyi 'phro mthud kun tu bzang po'i sar/ /skyeb gcig gis phyin par gdon mi za/ /de skad zhal gyi gdams par sgro btags pa'i/ /rmongs tshig yi ge'i lam du spel ba 'di/ /dpyod ldan gzhan byu thubs la mi 'thad kyang / /grogs khyod3na gyis bskul ba ldog dka' bas/ /g.yar khral tsam du chos gzugs snyoms las pa/ /padma badzra zhes su 'bod pa des/ /shar mar bris pa'i dge bas mkha' khyab 'gro/ /lhun grub kun bzang dgongs pa'i gzhi dbyings su//'bad med myur du grol ba'i rgyur gyur cig/ //dge'o// //491

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma bapa'i gsung thor bu/༷ la ༷ mi mi ba ba la ba la la ༷ ༷ ཿ ཿ ༷ ga na ba gag /rdo rje phur pa'i mngon rtogs/te ru ga la na mo/ arbu/ gar yang ma grub dbyings kyi rgya mtsho la/ /cir yang mi 'dzin blo yi rlabs thim pas/ /rang gsal mngon sum lhan skyes bde ba che/ /nga ni nges don zung 'jug ci la ya/ /dbyings rig dbyer med 'od gsal chen po'i rtsal/ /gar dgu'i rnam rol sgyu 'phrul da ba'i sku/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i phyag rgyar yongs shar ba/ /nga ni drang don rtags kyi kri la ya/ /chags pas rang gi btsun mor 'a da cing sbyor/ /sdang bas bdud sde'i tshogs la rngams shing 'khrug /rmongs pas gtsang che'i rtog bral ro chas can/ /nga ni dug gsum 'bar ba'i khri la ga rgyas bshad/ mtshan dpe'i sku la rus pa'i rgyan spras pa'i/ /mdzes shing sgeg pa'i gar gyis ma mo 'bum/ /dbang du sdud cing chags chen snying rje'i shugs/ /g.yos pa'i bzhad sgras rtsen cing bsrung pas dgyes//khong nas khros pa'i lus kyi sha 'gyur ba'i/ /khro gnyer g.yo ba dpa' ba'i nyams 'bar bas/ /brlang por gshe ba'i nga ro sgrog bzhin du/ /rngams pa'i stabs kyis bdud bgegs gsod cing za/ /shin tu rmongs pa'i gnyis rtog zhi ba'i nyams/ /sha rgyas yan lag rags shing khrag zhags chaganas/ /mi sdug thod sgrul dur khrod chas bgos nas/ /drag shul sgra yis srid gsum brgyal bar byed/ /snying rje'i sgeg cing bzhad pa'i gar ldan pas/ /chags chen rgya mtsho'i 492

rdzogs chen mkhan chen padma badzra'i gsung thor ku/0 0 ༷ ༷ ༷ rsha ༷ ba ༷ 0 kyi rsha — spyo ba rke cha 0 dba' rlabs g.yo ba'i dbus/ /bde stong lhan skyes rig pa'i rtsal rdzob/sa pa/ /'dod khams sprul skur sgrol ba'i kri la ya/ /dpa' bas rngams shing gshe ba'i gar ldan pas/ /zhe sdang me dpung 'bar ba'i dpal gyi rtser/ /gsal stong rdo rje khros pa'i nyams rgyas pa/ /gzugs khams longs skur sgrol ba'i khri la ya/ /zhi bas mi sdug drag shul gar ldan pas/ /gti mug mun pa 'khrigs pa'i klong dkyil nas/ /mi rtog 'od gsal ngang du 'byams klas pa/ /gzugs med chos skur sgrol ba'i smi la ga /don bsdus/ dug gsum rtog pa'i ngar dang ma bral bzhin/ /bde gsal mi rtog rig pa'i rtsal rdzogs nas/ /sku gsum 'thas bu lam du mngon byed pa//'dis thabs chenado rje'i theg pa'o/ /padma badzra pas so /dge'o// //493
